papers.title: On the emergence of quantum many-body chaos for tunably-broken integrability
papers.abstract: We develop a quantitative theory for the emergence of quantum many-body chaos as integrability is broken via a tunable parameter. In a circuit model of free fermions, 'doped' with a tunable density of integrability-breaking gates, we uncover the microscopic mechanisms underpinning the crossover from early-time integrable behaviour to late-time chaos through the lens of the out-of-time-ordered correlators (OTOCs). The integrability-breaking gates act as local, in spacetime, hotspots which locally amplify the OTOCs such that an accumulation of them eventually leads to fully-developed chaos. We identify the explicit characteristic time and length scales governing this crossover, as well as the dependence of the chaotic OTOC characteristics -- such as the butterfly velocity and front broadening -- on the integrability-breaking parameter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：develop a quantitative theory、circuit model、uncover microscopic mechanisms。；研究对象：可调参数破坏可积性时量子多体混沌的涌现过程，具体体系为自由费米子电路模型，其中掺杂了可调密度的破坏可积性的量子门。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了从早期可积行为到晚期混沌行为的交叉过程中的微观机制：破坏可积性的量子门作为时空中的局部热点，局部放大OTOC，其累积最终导致完全混沌；并给出了控制这一交叉的特征时间尺度和长度尺度，以及混沌OTOC特征（如蝴蝶速度和前沿展宽）对破坏可积性参数的依赖关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了从早期可积行为到晚期混沌行为的交叉过程中的微观机制：破坏可积性的量子门作为时空中的局部热点，局部放大OTOC，其累积最终导致完全混沌；并给出了控制这一交叉的特征时间尺度和长度尺度，以及混沌OTOC特征（如蝴蝶速度和前沿展宽）对破坏可积性参数的依赖关系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用自由费米子电路模型，通过可调密度掺杂破坏可积性的量子门，并利用out-of-time-ordered correlators（OTOCs）作为诊断工具进行理论分析。

papers.title: Anomalous thermopower from the drag of overdamped collective modes
papers.abstract: Inspired by the observation of a Seebeck coefficient ratio that exhibits a seemingly logarithmic divergence at low temperature in high-temperature superconducting cuprates, we show that a mechanisms similar to the standard phonon drag can give rise to anomalies in the thermopower of a metal, if the dragged collective mode is overdamped, with a damping coefficient that increases with lowering the temperature. Our finding adds a piece to the puzzle of the strange-metal behavior observed in many different systems and supports our proposal that overdamped charge density fluctuations can be responsible of such a behavior in high-temperature superconducting cuprates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show that a mechanism similar to... can give rise to...（提出机制）、proposal（理论提议）。；研究对象：高温超导铜氧化物中的反常热电输运现象，具体为塞贝克系数在低温下呈现对数发散行为，以及更广泛的奇异金属行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种类似标准声子拖曳的机制，若被拖曳的集体模式是过阻尼的且其阻尼系数随温度降低而增大，则可在金属中引起热电功率的异常行为，从而为高温超导铜氧化物中的奇异金属行为提供一种可能的解释。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种类似标准声子拖曳的机制，若被拖曳的集体模式是过阻尼的且其阻尼系数随温度降低而增大，则可在金属中引起热电功率的异常行为，从而为高温超导铜氧化物中的奇异金属行为提供一种可能的解释。；创新点：将传统声子拖曳机制推广至过阻尼集体模式，并指出该模式阻尼系数随温度降低而增大是产生反常热电功率的关键，为理解高温超导铜氧化物中的奇异金属行为提供了新的理论视角。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于对过阻尼集体模式（如过阻尼电荷密度涨落）拖曳效应的机制推导，并与实验观测到的塞贝克系数比值行为进行对比。

papers.title: Curvature-induced host-mediated polarization of active particles
papers.abstract: Polar collective motion commonly arises from alignment interactions, particle anisotropy, or an imposed directional bias. Here we identify a distinct route to polar order that does not rely on alignment interactions between the active particles. We show that non-aligning active Brownian particles embedded in a dense passive medium can develop polar coherence when confined to a compact curved surface. Persistent active motion redistributes stress through the host and creates passive-depleted regions. When the stress-spreading length becomes comparable to the sphere radius, these regions merge into elongated scars that channel active motion and, through feedback with the active flux, promote a common direction of motion. Removing the passive host suppresses polar coherence even though the active particles continue to cluster on the same sphere. Our results establish an environment-mediated route to collective polarity in which symmetry breaking emerges from the coupling between active motion, passive stress redistribution, and compact geometry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“active Brownian particles”“stress redistribution”“feedback”等理论建模与数值模拟关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：嵌入致密被动介质中的非对齐活性布朗粒子，在紧凑弯曲表面（如球面）上的集体运动行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 活性粒子在弯曲表面上通过宿主介导的应力重新分布，无需粒子间对齐相互作用即可自发形成极性有序运动；移除被动宿主后极性相干消失，表明该极性源于活性运动、被动应力再分布与紧凑几何的耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：活性粒子在弯曲表面上通过宿主介导的应力重新分布，无需粒子间对齐相互作用即可自发形成极性有序运动；移除被动宿主后极性相干消失，表明该极性源于活性运动、被动应力再分布与紧凑几何的耦合。；创新点：发现了一种不依赖粒子间对齐相互作用或各向异性的新型极性有序路径，揭示了环境（被动宿主与几何曲率）在活性物质集体运动中的关键作用。
papers.method_zh: 活性布朗粒子模型（Active Brownian particles）嵌入被动介质，在球面等紧凑弯曲表面上进行数值模拟，分析应力传播长度与球面半径的竞争关系，以及被动耗尽区的形成与演化。

papers.title: Complex dynamics in the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick game
papers.abstract: We study the outcome of adaptive learning of a large number of players engaging in sets of two-strategy two-player games. We are interested in typical games, and generate the payoff matrices at random at the beginning. The payoff matrices then remain fixed during the learning process. This provides a game theoretic foundation for the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick (SK) game, recently introduced by Garnier-Brun, Benzaquen and Bouchaud. The original model by these authors is a special case, with no bias towards any strategy. We here determine stability of learning for SK games with general random bias, and find that the nature of the stable state is affected by random fields. We also introduce a grand-canonical version of the SK game, in which players can choose to abstain. We determine the stability of learning for this game. Our analysis confirms that complex situations involving many players are frequently unlearnable, even if each player only chooses between two different actions. The rate with which players lose memory of past payoffs and the competitiveness of the game emerge as key parameters determining whether learning converges to a unique fixed point, whether there are many fixed points, or if the dynamics remains persistently volatile.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“study the outcome of adaptive learning”、“determine the stability of learning”、“our analysis confirms”等理论分析与建模关键词，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：Sherrington-Kirkpatrick (SK) 博弈中的复杂动力学，即大量玩家参与两策略两人博弈时的自适应学习过程，以及引入随机偏置和玩家可选择退出（grand-canonical版本）后的博弈系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在SK博弈中，学习稳定性受随机场影响，且大量玩家参与的复杂博弈常常是不可学习的；学习是否收敛到唯一不动点、存在多个不动点或持续波动，取决于玩家对过去收益的记忆衰减速率和博弈的竞争性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在SK博弈中，学习稳定性受随机场影响，且大量玩家参与的复杂博弈常常是不可学习的；学习是否收敛到唯一不动点、存在多个不动点或持续波动，取决于玩家对过去收益的记忆衰减速率和博弈的竞争性。；创新点：将原始SK博弈（无偏置特例）推广到一般随机偏置情形，并首次引入grand-canonical版本（玩家可退出），揭示了随机场对稳定态性质的影响，以及记忆衰减速率和竞争性作为关键参数决定学习动力学行为。
papers.method_zh: 基于博弈论的自适应学习框架，对随机生成的收益矩阵（固定不变）进行稳定性分析；引入随机偏置（random bias）和随机场（random fields）扩展原始SK博弈模型，并构建grand-canonical版本（允许玩家选择不参与）。

papers.title: Intrinsic orbital Hall effect in a nonuniform electric field
papers.abstract: Geometric analysis of electronic Bloch states offers a universal framework for understanding electronic properties, yet its role in the transport of orbital angular momentum remains unexplored. In this work, we establish an analytic connection between orbital angular momentum transport and the geometric properties of Bloch wave functions in electronic systems. Focusing on the intrinsic orbital Hall effect in the dc limit under a spatially nonuniform electric field, we show that its conductivity can be expressed in terms of universal geometric quantities, such as the orbital Berry curvature and quantum metric. This formulation provides a term-by-term correspondence with the geometric description of intrinsic charge Hall transport established in previous studies. Using a tight-binding model, we further illustrate that the higher-order orbital Hall response can exhibit enhanced sensitivity to the orientation of an anisotropic sample. Our work deepens the understanding of diverse intrinsic transverse transport phenomena and the role of quantum geometry in electronic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“几何分析”、“建立解析联系”、“公式化表述”等理论推导词汇，并基于紧束缚模型进行数值验证，未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：非均匀电场下电子系统中的轨道角动量输运现象，具体为内禀轨道霍尔效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在直流极限下，非均匀电场诱导的内禀轨道霍尔电导率可以用轨道贝里曲率和量子度量等普适几何量来表达，从而建立了轨道角动量输运与布洛赫波函数几何性质之间的解析联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在直流极限下，非均匀电场诱导的内禀轨道霍尔电导率可以用轨道贝里曲率和量子度量等普适几何量来表达，从而建立了轨道角动量输运与布洛赫波函数几何性质之间的解析联系。；创新点：首次探索了布洛赫态几何性质在轨道角动量输运中的作用，并建立了与已建立的电荷霍尔输运几何描述之间的逐项对应关系。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与紧束缚模型计算。具体而言，通过几何分析建立轨道角动量输运与布洛赫波函数几何性质的联系，并利用紧束缚模型进行数值验证，以说明高阶轨道霍尔响应对各向异性样品取向的敏感性。

papers.title: Bottlenecks in Hamiltonian-Adaptive Resolution Simulation Method for Modeling Interfaces
papers.abstract: The Hamiltonian-Adaptive Resolution Simulation (H-AdResS) method allows to combine atomistic and particle-based coarse-grained models in a single simulation box, which makes it very attractive to model systems containing interfaces or reactive regions surrounded by an interacting environment. In our previous work [arXiv:2604.21867], we implemented H-AdResS in LAMMPS 2023 and extended its use to interfaces, focusing on MOF/CO$_2$ interfaces as an example. We found that, despite its advantages, using this method properly for this kind of systems is not trivial. In this work, an in-depth analysis of the impact of the choice of thermostatting schemes and long-range electrostatics models is presented. Even though its Hamiltonian formulation enables performing H-AdResS simulations within constant temperatures ensembles, not every thermostat is appropriate. We demonstrate that Langevin thermostat is a reliable choice for this method, while Nosé-Hoover results in artifacts. In addition, we show that using short-range models such as the Damped Shifted Force method for electrostatics, a popular choice for H-AdResS simulations, can lead to non-physical results when modeling interfaces. The need of capping strategies to deal with discontinuities in forces and energies arising from abrupt changes in resolution is also discussed. Finally, the impossibility of changing the definition of the H-AdResS Hamiltonian to include a gradual interpolation of the bonded degrees of freedom is discussed. We hope that this contribution helps the reader to appropriately set up H-AdResS simulations and to assess if this method can be used to accurately model their system of interest.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：H-AdResS方法、LAMMPS实现、模拟分析）；研究对象：界面体系，具体以MOF/CO₂界面为例，研究哈密顿自适应分辨率模拟方法（H-AdResS）在界面建模中的瓶颈问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Langevin恒温器是H-AdResS方法的可靠选择，而Nosé-Hoover恒温器会导致伪影；使用短程静电力模型（如Damped Shifted Force方法）模拟界面时可能产生非物理结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Langevin恒温器是H-AdResS方法的可靠选择，而Nosé-Hoover恒温器会导致伪影；使用短程静电力模型（如Damped Shifted Force方法）模拟界面时可能产生非物理结果。；创新点：摘要未突出说明（但可推断：首次系统评估了H-AdResS方法中恒温器选择和静电力模型对界面模拟的适用性，并指出了短程静电力模型在界面体系中的非物理风险）。
papers.method_zh: 基于哈密顿自适应分辨率模拟（H-AdResS）方法，在LAMMPS 2023中实现，系统分析了不同恒温方案（Langevin、Nosé-Hoover）和长程静电力模型（包括短程近似方法）对界面模拟的影响，并讨论了力与能量不连续性的截断策略。

papers.title: Q-GAIN: A Python Package for Machine Learning and Physically Informed Analysis Applications
papers.abstract: Here we describe the quantum gas analysis and inference (Q-GAIN) Python package, which enables rapid deployment of machine learning (ML) and physics-informed analysis techniques for cold-atom experiments. Out of the box, Q-GAIN implements classification, object detection, and physics-informed metrics for feature detection in images of atomic Bose-Einstein condensates (BECs). Q-GAIN encourages a natural, module-based workflow: starting with data loading and preprocessing, followed by ML-based feature identification, and ending with conventional analysis techniques. We demonstrate this modularity by configuring Q-GAIN for three ML tasks. First, we demonstrate the basic workflow of the Q-GAIN framework by implementing the standard task of classifying handwritten digits from the MNIST dataset. Then, we re-implement our earlier soliton detection (SolDet) package in the Q-GAIN framework, enabling the detection and analysis of solitonic excitations in time-of-flight data. Finally, we develop an object-detection tool that identifies quantized vortices in images of ring-shaped BECs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/软件工具文章。判断依据：描述了一个Python软件包（Q-GAIN）的开发与应用，属于计算工具类研究。；研究对象：冷原子实验中的量子气体图像分析，具体包括：原子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BECs）图像中的特征检测（如孤子激发、量子涡旋）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Q-GAIN软件包实现了机器学习与物理信息分析技术的快速部署，能够对冷原子实验图像进行分类、目标检测及基于物理信息的特征识别，并展示了在孤子检测和环形BEC中量子涡旋识别等任务中的应用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Q-GAIN软件包实现了机器学习与物理信息分析技术的快速部署，能够对冷原子实验图像进行分类、目标检测及基于物理信息的特征识别，并展示了在孤子检测和环形BEC中量子涡旋识别等任务中的应用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 开发了基于Python的模块化软件包Q-GAIN，集成了机器学习（分类、目标检测）与物理信息度量方法，用于分析冷原子实验图像数据。具体演示了三个任务：MNIST手写数字分类、基于先前SolDet包的孤子检测、以及环形BEC中量子涡旋的目标检测工具。

papers.title: Coupled Spin-Orbital $p$-Wave Magnetism via Structural and Magnetic Chirality
papers.abstract: Helical spin textures represent the minimal realization of $p$-wave magnetism which is characterized by momentum-odd spin polarization. Independently, structurally chiral crystals exhibit momentum-odd orbital polarization arising from broken inversion symmetry. Here, we demonstrate that spin-orbit coupling couples these two independent microscopic chirality degrees of freedom, allowing the orbital polarization of a chiral crystal to generate an additional contribution to the $p$-wave spin splitting. The resulting spin-orbital state is naturally classified by the relative chirality $η=χ_{\mathrm c}χ_{\mathrm m}$, giving rise to two symmetry-distinct $p$-wave phases corresponding to homochiral and heterochiral configurations which can be directly probed by the longitudinal conductivity. These phases exhibit distinct transport signatures, establishing relative chirality as an experimentally accessible symmetry degree of freedom in chiral magnetic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“demonstrate”“classified by”“giving rise to”等理论推导和分类描述，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：手性磁体中的自旋-轨道耦合p波磁性态，具体涉及结构手性与磁手性耦合产生的自旋-轨道p波相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自旋-轨道耦合将结构手性与磁手性这两个独立的微观手性自由度耦合，使得手性晶体的轨道极化对p波自旋劈裂产生额外贡献；由此定义相对手性η=χ_c χ_m，可区分两种对称性不同的p波相（同手性与异手性），它们可通过纵向电导率直接探测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自旋-轨道耦合将结构手性与磁手性这两个独立的微观手性自由度耦合，使得手性晶体的轨道极化对p波自旋劈裂产生额外贡献；由此定义相对手性η=χ_c χ_m，可区分两种对称性不同的p波相（同手性与异手性），它们可通过纵向电导率直接探测。；创新点：提出相对手性η作为手性磁系统中可实验探测的对称性自由度，并揭示结构手性与磁手性通过自旋-轨道耦合产生耦合p波磁性的新机制。
papers.method_zh: 基于对称性分析与群论分类，结合输运理论（纵向电导率）对两种p波相的输运特征进行理论预测。摘要未明确使用具体数值计算或第一性原理方法。

papers.title: Correlation and entanglement dynamics of free fermions in disguise
papers.abstract: We study the nonequilibrium dynamics following a quantum quench in spin chains that can be solved via a mapping to free fermions in disguise. These models feature an exponential degeneracy of all energy eigenvalues, raising the question of the validity of the established framework describing the properties of integrable systems out of equilibrium. We present two main results. First, we develop an analytic method to compute the quasi-momentum distribution function characterizing the generalized Gibbs ensemble, and derive an analytic formula to compute the corresponding expectation values for special observables. Second, we conjecture a modification of the standard formula for the entanglement growth based on the quasi-particle picture, taking into account that each fermion in disguise carries an additional amount of entropy due to the exponential degeneracy of the energy eigenvalues. We test our theoretical predictions against numerical tensor-network computations for different initial states and Hamiltonian parameters. For the local observables, we find excellent agreement. For the entanglement dynamics, we find small deviations suggesting that our conjecture is only approximately correct. Our results represent a first step towards the extension of the established framework of integrable systems out of equilibrium to models hosting free fermions in disguise.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值计算）。判断依据：关键词包括“analytic method”、“conjecture”、“numerical tensor-network computations”。；研究对象：可通过“伪装自由费米子”映射求解的自旋链模型，特别是其量子淬火后的非平衡动力学，以及由能量本征值指数简并导致的关联与纠缠演化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文提出了计算广义吉布斯系综中准动量分布函数的解析方法，并针对纠缠增长提出了基于准粒子图像的修正公式，但数值检验显示该修正公式仅近似成立。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文提出了计算广义吉布斯系综中准动量分布函数的解析方法，并针对纠缠增长提出了基于准粒子图像的修正公式，但数值检验显示该修正公式仅近似成立。；创新点：首次尝试将可积系统非平衡动力学的标准框架扩展到具有“伪装自由费米子”的模型，并揭示了能量本征值指数简并对纠缠熵增长的影响。
papers.method_zh: 解析方法（推导准动量分布函数与特殊可观测量的期望值公式）结合数值张量网络计算（对不同初始态和哈密顿参数进行验证）。

papers.title: Contrarian Majority Dynamics: Violation of Detailed Balance and Nonequilibrium Steady States
papers.abstract: I revisit the Galam Majority Model (GMM) with contrarian agents from a statistical-mechanics perspective, revealing three fundamental features. First, in addition to the GMM simultaneous-update of small discussion groups, I construct a related single-agent stochastic dynamics, providing a Markovian microscopic representation, which is found to yield the same evolution equation. Second, I show that, contrary to what is often stated in the literature, the GMM closed evolution equation for the opinion density is not the result of a mean-field approximation. Indeed, I derive the conventional mean-field dynamics associated with majority-rule interactions and show that it yields a distinct, probabilistic evolution equation contrary the deterministic GMM equation. I therefore identify the GMM as an iterated mean-field dynamics. Third, I investigate the thermodynamic nature of the dynamics obtained from both single-agent and simultaneous updates. Both are shown to violate detailed balance. However, while Kolmogorov's cycle condition is satisfied for single-agent updates, it is violated for simultaneous updates, making the departure from equilibrium stronger in the latter case. I then compute the probability flux in the stationary state and show that it is non-vanishing, confirming the absence of an effective Hamiltonian and establishing that the stationary state is a genuine nonequilibrium steady state.These results clarify the statistical-mechanical foundations of the GMM and establish contrarian majority dynamics as an intrinsically non-equilibrium process with distinct regimes of irreversibility. Contrarians are not thermal noise.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：statistical-mechanics perspective、Markovian microscopic representation、derivation、thermodynamic nature。；研究对象：Galam多数模型（GMM）中的逆反者（contrarian agents）动力学，具体研究该模型在统计力学框架下的微观基础、细致平衡破坏以及非平衡稳态性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了GMM逆反者多数动力学本质上是一个内在的非平衡过程，其稳态是真正的非平衡稳态，且逆反者行为不等同于热噪声；同时澄清了该模型的演化方程并非平均场近似的结果，而是一种迭代平均场动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了GMM逆反者多数动力学本质上是一个内在的非平衡过程，其稳态是真正的非平衡稳态，且逆反者行为不等同于热噪声；同时澄清了该模型的演化方程并非平均场近似的结果，而是一种迭代平均场动力学。；创新点：首次从统计力学角度系统阐明了GMM逆反者动力学的三个基本特征：1）给出了其马尔可夫微观表示；2）纠正了文献中将其演化方程误认为平均场近似的观点，指出其为迭代平均场动力学；3）证明了同步更新和单Agent更新均破坏细致平衡，但前者还破坏Kolmogorov循环条件，具有更强的不可逆性，并确认稳态为非平衡稳态。
papers.method_zh: 构建了与GMM同步更新等价的单Agent随机动力学（马尔可夫微观表示），推导了平均场动力学方程并与GMM方程对比，通过细致平衡条件、Kolmogorov循环条件以及稳态概率流计算分析了热力学性质。

papers.title: Fundamental limitations of single-particle Green's-function zeroes as probes of many-body topology
papers.abstract: We show that topological invariants constructed from single-particle Green's functions (GFs) cannot reliably diagnose the topology of interacting many-body states. Using coupled interacting SSH chains as a minimal example, we demonstrate that a spin-spin interaction can trivialize the many-body ground state without affecting the GF topological invariant. This breakdown originates from the GF's inability to probe electronic excitations in the Fock sectors responsible for the topological degeneracy. Consequently, GF zeroes are not associated with physical topological quasiparticles and cannot generally characterize interacting topological phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show, demonstrate, originate, characterize（理论推导与论证）。；研究对象：相互作用多体系统的拓扑相，具体以耦合相互作用SSH链（Su-Schrieffer-Heeger模型）为最小示例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于单粒子格林函数构造的拓扑不变量无法可靠诊断相互作用多体态的拓扑性质；格林函数零点与物理拓扑准粒子无关，不能一般性地表征相互作用拓扑相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于单粒子格林函数构造的拓扑不变量无法可靠诊断相互作用多体态的拓扑性质；格林函数零点与物理拓扑准粒子无关，不能一般性地表征相互作用拓扑相。；创新点：揭示了单粒子格林函数在探测多体拓扑时存在根本性局限——无法探测导致拓扑简并的Fock扇区中的电子激发，从而证明格林函数零点并非可靠的拓扑探针。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，通过构建耦合相互作用SSH链模型，引入自旋-自旋相互作用，对比多体基态拓扑性质与单粒子格林函数拓扑不变量的行为。

papers.title: Hydrodynamics, Renormalization Group, and Universality Classes Far from Equilibrium
papers.abstract: Universality is one of the central organising principles of modern physics, explaining why systems with vastly different microscopic constituents can exhibit identical large-scale behaviour. While the classification of equilibrium critical phenomena through hydrodynamics and the renormalization group (RG) is now well established, our understanding of universality far from equilibrium remains far less developed. In recent years, however, rapid progress - driven in large part by developments in active and living matter - has uncovered a growing range of genuinely nonequilibrium universality classes (UCs) with no equilibrium counterparts. In this review, we present a pedagogical and unified introduction to hydrodynamic and RG approaches to nonequilibrium many-body systems. We first show how hydrodynamic theories can be systematically constructed from symmetry and conservation laws alone. We then introduce perturbative dynamic RG methods and demonstrate how hydrodynamic theories are organised into distinct UCs according to their scaling behaviour. Building on these foundations, we review the diverse nonequilibrium UCs uncovered since 2015, while emphasizing the conceptual connections and unifying physical principles underlying their emergence. We conclude by discussing open theoretical and experimental challenges for the field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：hydrodynamic theories, perturbative dynamic RG methods, review）；研究对象：远离平衡态的多体系统，特别是活性物质和生命物质中涌现的非平衡普适类（universality classes, UCs）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过对称性和守恒律系统构建流体力学理论，并结合重整化群方法，可将远离平衡态的多体系统按标度行为划分为不同的普适类；自2015年以来已发现多种无平衡对应物的非平衡普适类。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过对称性和守恒律系统构建流体力学理论，并结合重整化群方法，可将远离平衡态的多体系统按标度行为划分为不同的普适类；自2015年以来已发现多种无平衡对应物的非平衡普适类。；创新点：摘要未突出说明（但综述性工作系统整合了流体力学与重整化群方法，并梳理了2015年以来非平衡普适类的最新进展，强调其概念联系与统一物理原理）
papers.method_zh: 流体力学理论（基于对称性和守恒律的构建）、微扰动态重整化群方法（perturbative dynamic RG methods）

papers.title: Velocity and force autocorrelations in Brownian dynamics with a Lorentz force
papers.abstract: We derive a general relation between the velocity and force autocorrelation tensors (VACT and FACT) for a Brownian particle subject to an external magnetic field. Using time-symmetry arguments, we show that, for the full Langevin dynamics, the VACT depends only on the FACT, independently of the details of the interaction potential. Under the hypothesis of timescale separation between thermalization and interaction-driven motion, this relation simplifies considerably in the overdamped (Brownian) limit. A central feature of the overdamped result is that, unlike in the field-free case, the part of the VACT that controls the self-diffusion of the particle couples to the antisymmetric part of the FACT, with a coupling strength set by the ratio of the cyclotron frequency to the thermalization rate. We validate and illustrate the formalism on an exactly solvable model: a dimer of charged particles bound by a harmonic potential. Depending on the relative sign of the particle charges, the magnetic field is found to produce either a transient suppression of mobility and diffusion that is fully recovered at long times, or a persistent oscillatory force autocorrelation, regions of negative mobility, and a long-time suppression of self-diffusion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“derive a general relation”“using time-symmetry arguments”“validate the formalism on an exactly solvable model”等关键词，属于理论推导与解析模型分析。；研究对象：受外磁场（洛伦兹力）作用的布朗粒子的速度自相关张量（VACT）与力自相关张量（FACT）之间的关系，以及由此导致的扩散与迁移行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在过阻尼（布朗）极限下，控制自扩散的VACT部分与FACT的反对称部分耦合，耦合强度由回旋频率与热化速率之比决定；对于带电二聚体模型，磁场可导致瞬态迁移率抑制（长时间恢复）、持续振荡的力自相关、负迁移率区域以及长时间自扩散抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在过阻尼（布朗）极限下，控制自扩散的VACT部分与FACT的反对称部分耦合，耦合强度由回旋频率与热化速率之比决定；对于带电二聚体模型，磁场可导致瞬态迁移率抑制（长时间恢复）、持续振荡的力自相关、负迁移率区域以及长时间自扩散抑制。；创新点：首次建立了存在洛伦兹力时布朗粒子速度自相关与力自相关之间的普适关系，并揭示了磁场下过阻尼极限中VACT与FACT反对称部分的耦合机制，该耦合在无磁场情况下不存在。
papers.method_zh: 基于时间对称性论证推导VACT与FACT的一般关系；在热化与相互作用运动时间尺度分离假设下，取过阻尼极限简化；通过一个精确可解的带电谐振子二聚体模型验证理论形式。

papers.title: Localization and Topological Properties of SU(3) Fermions in non-Abelian Gauge Fields: Color-Orbit Coupling and Color-Flip Fields
authors: C. A. R. Sá de Melo
papers.abstract: The interplay between disorder, gauge fields, and internal degrees of freedom fundamentally affects localization and topological properties of quantum many-body systems. Motivated by recent experimental realizations of synthetic non-Abelian gauge fields for SU(3) colored fermions, we investigate their localization and topological properties in 1D bichromatic optical lattices consisting of strong and weak laser beams. Describing the non-Abelian gauge field via color-orbit coupling and color-flip (Rabi) fields, we obtain a tight-binding description of trapped SU(3) colored fermions corresponding to a generalized three-color Aubry-André model. We show that these fields explicitly break the conventional self-duality of a simple three-color Aubry-André system. This duality breaking generates mobility regions across the energy spectrum, demonstrating that non-Abelian fields can either enhance or hinder color localization. Using exact diagonalization, density-of-states evaluations, and finite-size scaling of the inverse participation ratio, we obtain phase diagrams that identify regions of extended or localized bulk states. Furthermore, the color-orbit and Rabi fields induce edge states with topological properties. We develop an exact mapping from our 1D disorder model into a 2D color Harper model with a fictitious magnetic flux ratio and dimension controlled by the weak laser beam's phase. Using this mapping, we evaluate topological invariants, such as the charge-charge Chern number, for edge states emerging in energy gaps, revealing the topological insulating nature of several gapped phases. Lastly, we identify that these topological color-insulator phases can energetically neighbor three configurations: two extended, two localized, or one of each. This sharply contrasts with conventional topological insulators, which always neighbor two extended phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“我们获得紧束缚描述”“利用精确对角化”“评估拓扑不变量”等理论计算与建模方法，未提及实验数据或实验操作。；研究对象：SU(3)色费米子在一维双色光晶格中的局域化与拓扑性质，具体体系为受非阿贝尔规范场（色-轨道耦合与色翻转场）调控的广义三色Aubry-André模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非阿贝尔规范场破坏了常规三色Aubry-André系统的自对偶性，从而在能谱中产生迁移率区域，可增强或阻碍色局域化；同时，色-轨道耦合与Rabi场诱导出具有拓扑性质的边缘态，形成拓扑色绝缘相，且这些相可邻接两种扩展相、两种局域相或各一种，与传统拓扑绝缘体不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非阿贝尔规范场破坏了常规三色Aubry-André系统的自对偶性，从而在能谱中产生迁移率区域，可增强或阻碍色局域化；同时，色-轨道耦合与Rabi场诱导出具有拓扑性质的边缘态，形成拓扑色绝缘相，且这些相可邻接两种扩展相、两种局域相或各一种，与传统拓扑绝缘体不同。；创新点：首次系统研究非阿贝尔规范场（色-轨道耦合与色翻转场）对SU(3)费米子局域化与拓扑性质的影响，并发现拓扑色绝缘相可邻接非对称的扩展/局域相组合，这一特征在传统拓扑绝缘体中不存在。
papers.method_zh: 采用紧束缚模型描述；使用精确对角化、态密度评估、逆参与比的有限尺寸标度分析获得相图；通过将一维无序模型映射到二维色Harper模型（含虚拟磁通比与维度由弱激光束相位控制），计算电荷-电荷陈数等拓扑不变量。

papers.title: How wrong is too wrong: A numerical study on the relevance of positional memory in the generalized Langevin equation
papers.abstract: If a generalized Langevin equation contains a potential of mean force, it cannot at the same time contain a linear memory kernel and a fluctuating force that obeys a second fluctuation dissipation theorem in the sense of Kubo, and be exact. As modelers often prefer to use generalized Langevin equations that have the first three properties, one needs to ask how close the model dynamics is to the dynamics of the underlying microscopic system. To test this, we analyze a simple model system in which the potential of mean force can be well approximated by a polynomial of low order. The exact generalized Langevin equation of this model contains memory terms in addition to the linear one. We show that these additional terms, at least for the model system regarded in this article, are important for the dynamics and cannot be neglected if one intends to model core aspects of the underlying system correctly.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“数值研究”（numerical study）和“分析一个简单模型系统”（analyze a simple model system）。；研究对象：广义朗之万方程（Generalized Langevin Equation, GLE）的建模精度问题。具体研究了一个模型系统，其中平均力势（potential of mean force）可以用低阶多项式很好地近似。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在广义朗之万方程中，如果同时包含平均力势、线性记忆核以及满足第二涨落耗散定理的涨落力，则这种模型动力学与底层微观系统的真实动力学之间存在显著偏差。对于本文研究的模型系统，除了线性记忆项之外的非线性记忆项对动力学至关重要，不可忽略。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在广义朗之万方程中，如果同时包含平均力势、线性记忆核以及满足第二涨落耗散定理的涨落力，则这种模型动力学与底层微观系统的真实动力学之间存在显著偏差。对于本文研究的模型系统，除了线性记忆项之外的非线性记忆项对动力学至关重要，不可忽略。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但该工作量化了在广义朗之万方程建模中，为了数学便利而忽略非线性记忆项所带来的动力学误差，并指出了这种近似在何种程度上会失效。
papers.method_zh: 通过构建一个简单的模型系统，对比其“精确”的广义朗之万方程（包含额外的非线性记忆项）与“近似”的广义朗之万方程（仅包含线性记忆项）的动力学行为，从而数值评估近似模型的误差。

papers.title: Disorder-induced superconductivity in graphene
papers.abstract: Correlated phases of matter are typically investigated in crystalline systems, where disorder is considered to be detrimental. However, intriguing exceptions exist, such as superconductivity being enhanced in amorphous realizations of Al and Bi. Here, we demonstrate that superconductivity can even emerge entirely from disorder, using monolayer graphene as an example. In the clean limit, the semi-metallic nature of graphene requires prohibitively strong electronic interactions to achieve superconductivity. Despite the inherently random nature of disorder, we show that introducing low concentrations of vacancies or hydrogenation in graphene provides a large density of low-energy states that easily induce superconductivity. For conventional $s$-wave pairing, disorder induces a finite superconducting order parameter for arbitrarily weak attractive interactions. Rather than forming isolated superconducting puddles, global phase coherence is established through a finite superfluid weight of purely geometrical origin. Away from the chiral limit of vacancies, hydrogenation similarly yields a finite transition temperature and nonzero superfluid weight for weak interactions. For unconventional nearest-neighbor pairing, typically more disrupted by disorder, superconductivity exhibits quantum-critical-like behavior, yet phase coherence persists at low interaction strengths, with mixed $d$-wave symmetries. Our work demonstrates the robust emergence of macroscopic superconducting phase coherence engineered entirely from microscopic disorder.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：demonstrate、show、induce、theoretical analysis，未提及实验或计算细节）；研究对象：单层石墨烯中由无序诱导的超导电性，具体涉及空位缺陷和氢化处理引入的无序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在清洁极限下本应需要极强电子相互作用才能实现超导的石墨烯，通过引入低浓度的空位或氢化无序，可在弱吸引相互作用下诱导出全局超导相，且超流权重具有纯几何起源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在清洁极限下本应需要极强电子相互作用才能实现超导的石墨烯，通过引入低浓度的空位或氢化无序，可在弱吸引相互作用下诱导出全局超导相，且超流权重具有纯几何起源。；创新点：首次证明无序本身可以完全从零开始诱导出宏观超导相，而非仅仅增强已有超导；揭示了无序诱导超导的全局相位相干性来源于几何起源的超流权重，而非孤立超导液滴的渗流。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于s波配对和非常规近邻配对（d波对称性混合）的配对对称性，研究无序对超导序参量、超流权重和转变温度的影响；考虑了空位缺陷（手性极限与非手性极限）和氢化两种无序类型。

papers.title: Josephson and Spin Currents in Coupled Polariton Condensates
papers.abstract: We analyze particle and spin currents in networks of coupled spinor exciton-polariton condensates arranged as plaquettes and regular polygonal rings. In closed geometries, spin-conserving and TE-TM-induced spin-flip tunnelling combine to generate circulating particle currents, hidden spin counterflows, and bond-dependent spin-current patterns. For the minimal geometries - an equilateral triangle, and a square plaquette - we derive analytical expressions for edge-resolved currents from stationary configurations obtained by energy minimization. We then show how particle, in-plane spin, and out-of-plane spin currents partition the parameter plane and provide direct signatures of the equilibrium phases. Finally, we apply the same current-resolved diagnostics to larger rings, where winding numbers and a branch-invariant common-phase coherence metric organize the resulting phase structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analyze、derive analytical expressions、energy minimization、phase structure。；研究对象：耦合自旋激子-极化激元凝聚体构成的网络，具体为plaquettes（小方块）和正多边形环结构中的粒子流和自旋流。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在封闭几何结构中，自旋守恒隧穿和TE-TM诱导的自旋翻转隧穿共同作用，产生循环粒子流、隐藏自旋逆流以及依赖于键的自旋流模式；通过边分辨电流可对平衡相进行直接标识。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在封闭几何结构中，自旋守恒隧穿和TE-TM诱导的自旋翻转隧穿共同作用，产生循环粒子流、隐藏自旋逆流以及依赖于键的自旋流模式；通过边分辨电流可对平衡相进行直接标识。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过能量最小化获得稳态构型，推导出等边三角形和正方形plaquette的边分辨电流解析表达式；利用粒子流、面内自旋流和面外自旋流对参数平面进行分区；对更大环结构引入绕数（winding numbers）和分支不变公共相位相干度量来组织相结构。

papers.title: From Bloch to Néel: Anisotropy-dependent Domain-Wall Character in FePd Thin Films
papers.abstract: We report an experimental investigation of the depth-dependent domain wall formation in L1$_0$-FePd thin films with high perpendicular magnetic anisotropy. Using circular dichroism X-ray resonant magnetic scattering (CD-XRMS) as a function of the incident X-ray angle, we explore the depth evolution of chiral spin textures in two samples with different strengths of magnetocrystalline anisotropy. Combined with CD-STXM, CD-ptychography, and macroscopic characterization of the structural order, magnetic properties, and surface morphology, we relate these observations to differences in the long-range order of the L1$_0$ phase of FePd. One FePd thin film with very high magnetocrystalline anisotropy, characterized by $Q_{PMA}=1.8$, exhibits an unexpectedly large Néel contribution. Angular-dependent CD-XRMS directly reveals a smooth transition from a hybrid Bloch-Néel chirality within the upper FePd layer towards a purely Néel-type structure at the lower FePd interface. In the second FePd sample, despite a still relatively large $Q_{PMA}=1.45$, the domain walls were found to be purely Néel type. These results indicate a crucial role of the long-range structural order in determining the formation of the magnetic structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“experimental investigation”、“circular dichroism X-ray resonant magnetic scattering (CD-XRMS)”、“CD-STXM”、“CD-ptychography”以及“macroscopic characterization”。；研究对象：L1₀-FePd薄膜中的手性自旋织构，特别是垂直于薄膜平面的磁畴壁（从Bloch型到Néel型的转变），以及磁晶各向异性强度对畴壁特征的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有高垂直磁各向异性的FePd薄膜中，畴壁类型从混合Bloch-Néel型平滑过渡到纯Néel型，且该过渡与薄膜深度和长程结构有序度密切相关；即使各向异性参数Q_{PMA}较大（1.45），畴壁仍可能为纯Néel型，表明长程结构有序对磁结构形成起关键作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有高垂直磁各向异性的FePd薄膜中，畴壁类型从混合Bloch-Néel型平滑过渡到纯Néel型，且该过渡与薄膜深度和长程结构有序度密切相关；即使各向异性参数Q_{PMA}较大（1.45），畴壁仍可能为纯Néel型，表明长程结构有序对磁结构形成起关键作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用圆二色X射线共振磁散射（CD-XRMS）随入射X射线角度变化来探测畴壁的深度演化；辅以圆二色扫描透射X射线显微镜（CD-STXM）、圆二色叠层成像（CD-ptychography）以及宏观结构有序度、磁性能和表面形貌的表征。

papers.title: From microscopic fluctuations to susceptibility spectra: single-molecule relaxation in glassy media
papers.abstract: Single-molecule (SM) rotational dynamics of fluorescent probes in polystyrene near the glass transition temperature ($T_g$) are investigated over long times to reconstruct susceptibility spectra. The loss spectrum, commonly recorded using external field-driven (frequency-domain) spectroscopy, such as dielectric spectroscopy, is reconstructed from purely thermal SM rotational fluctuations. The results reproduce time-temperature superposition typically seen in dielectric spectroscopy for materials near $T_g$ and show that the ensemble spectrum is comprised of individual molecular responses to distinct environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：investigated（研究）、reconstructed（重建）、recorded（记录）。；研究对象：玻璃态介质中荧光探针的单分子旋转动力学，具体体系为聚苯乙烯（polystyrene）在其玻璃化转变温度（T_g）附近的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过分析单分子热旋转涨落，成功重建了通常由外场驱动谱学（如介电谱）才能获得的损耗谱，并再现了时间-温度叠加原理。此外，发现系综谱是由单个分子对不同局域环境的响应叠加而成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过分析单分子热旋转涨落，成功重建了通常由外场驱动谱学（如介电谱）才能获得的损耗谱，并再现了时间-温度叠加原理。此外，发现系综谱是由单个分子对不同局域环境的响应叠加而成。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容推断，其创新点在于：首次（或首次在聚苯乙烯体系中）仅利用单分子尺度的热涨落（而非传统的外加交变电场）来重建与介电谱等价的宏观损耗谱，并直接观测到系综谱的微观起源——即不同分子对异质性环境的个体响应。
papers.method_zh: 单分子荧光光谱技术。具体通过长时间追踪聚苯乙烯中荧光探针的旋转动力学，利用其纯粹的热涨落（非外场驱动）来重建频率域的损耗谱（susceptibility spectra）。

papers.title: Interfacial Strain and Structural Defects Govern the Performance of Tantalum Superconducting Waveguide Resonators
papers.abstract: Tantalum (Ta) is a promising material for reaching long coherence times in superconducting qubits. A detailed understanding of the underlying structure-property relationship remains elusive though. In the present study, we sputter-deposited 200 nm thick Ta films on high-resistivity silicon (100) substrates at temperatures ranging from T = 20°C to 600°C, as well as on different seed layers (Nb, TiN and TaN). Alpha-Ta thin films were readily obtained at temperatures above 500°C and on all seed layers. The films were characterized in terms of surface morphology, residual-resistance ratio, crystal phase composition and superconducting transition temperature, as well as RF-performance using coplanar waveguide resonators. Internal quality factors of up to 1.5 million were measured at 100 mK in the single-photon regime. Despite similar bulk material properties, alpha-Ta films on different seed layers exhibit markedly different RF-performance, which we attribute to dissimilar strain and structural defects at the substrate-metal interfaces. Williamson-Hall analysis of XRD data reveals a clear correlation between decreasing microstrain and increasing quality factor. Cross-sectional HR-TEM further supports this interpretation by directly resolving interfacial disorder. Our results highlight the critical role of interface engineering in optimizing superconducting thin films for low-loss quantum computing circuitry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了薄膜的制备（溅射沉积）、表征（表面形貌、XRD、HR-TEM）和性能测试（RF性能、品质因子）等实验过程。；研究对象：钽（Tantalum, Ta）超导薄膜及其在共面波导谐振器中的射频性能。具体研究了不同沉积温度和不同种子层（Nb, TiN, TaN）对α-Ta薄膜性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: α-Ta薄膜的射频性能（内部品质因子）并非仅由体材料性质决定，而是强烈依赖于衬底-金属界面处的应变和结构缺陷。通过界面工程降低微应变可显著提升品质因子，最高可达150万。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：α-Ta薄膜的射频性能（内部品质因子）并非仅由体材料性质决定，而是强烈依赖于衬底-金属界面处的应变和结构缺陷。通过界面工程降低微应变可显著提升品质因子，最高可达150万。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但该工作的新意在于系统揭示了界面微应变和结构缺陷（而非体材料性质）是决定Ta超导薄膜射频损耗的关键因素，并建立了从XRD微应变分析到HR-TEM界面结构观察，再到宏观品质因子测量的直接关联，强调了界面工程在优化超导量子计算电路中的核心作用。
papers.method_zh: 磁控溅射沉积（制备200 nm厚Ta薄膜）、X射线衍射（XRD）及Williamson-Hall分析（表征晶体相组成和微应变）、高分辨透射电子显微镜（HR-TEM，直接观察界面无序结构）、剩余电阻率比（RRR）测量、超导转变温度（Tc）测量、共面波导谐振器射频测试（在100 mK单光子水平测量内部品质因子）。

papers.title: Efficient Large-Scale STEM-EELS Simulations With Torched-TACAW
papers.abstract: The time auto-correlation of auxiliary wave functions (TACAW) method enables efficient simulations of ultra-low-loss electron energy loss spectra (EELS) arising from vibrational and magnon excitations. In practical applications to realistic materials systems, however, TACAW calculations become challenging due to the large system sizes required for models containing defects, interfaces, impurities, or grain boundaries, as well as the substantial computational cost and data throughput associated with molecular dynamics and multislice calculations. Here we discuss a practical methodology for large-scale TACAW simulations and present torched-TACAW, a freely available implementation of the TACAW part of the described workflow for efficient STEM-EELS simulations. The overall approach combines molecular dynamics based on foundational machine-learned interatomic potentials, partitioning of elongated supercells, and on-the-fly processing of multislice outputs in order to enable near ab initio quality simulations with tractable memory use and data flow. Using rutile TiO2 as a model system, we analyze important numerical aspects of the method, including windowing and supercell partitioning, and demonstrate atomic-resolution STEM-EELS simulations for thick samples.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“simulations”、“methodology”、“implementation”、“computational cost”。；研究对象：论文研究的是超低损耗电子能量损失谱（EELS）的模拟方法，具体以金红石型TiO₂作为模型体系，涉及振动和磁振子激发。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合基于机器学习的分子动力学、超胞分区以及多片层输出的实时处理，实现了接近从头算质量的大规模扫描透射电子显微镜-电子能量损失谱（STEM-EELS）模拟，且内存使用和数据流可控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合基于机器学习的分子动力学、超胞分区以及多片层输出的实时处理，实现了接近从头算质量的大规模扫描透射电子显微镜-电子能量损失谱（STEM-EELS）模拟，且内存使用和数据流可控。；创新点：提出了一套实用的大规模TACAW模拟工作流程，并提供了自由可用的实现（torched-TACAW），解决了实际材料体系中因缺陷、界面、杂质或晶界导致的大系统尺寸带来的计算挑战，以及分子动力学和多片层计算中的高计算成本与数据吞吐量问题。
papers.method_zh: 采用了时间辅助波函数自相关（TACAW）方法，结合基于基础机器学习原子间势的分子动力学、伸长超胞的分区处理，以及多片层模拟输出的实时处理技术。具体实现为开源软件torched-TACAW。

papers.title: Ultrafast Demagnetization Governed by Spin Fluctuations in CaRuO$_{3}$/SrTiO$_{3}$ Superlattice
papers.abstract: For ultrafast magnetization switching devices, critical slowing down in conventional ferromagnets near their Curie temperature constitutes a key challenge that must be overcome. In contrast to this typical behavior, we observe an anomalous acceleration of demagnetization in CaRuO$_{3}$/SrTiO$_{3}$ superlattices, a moderately correlated weak itinerant ferromagnet. The demagnetization rate increases with rising temperature, pump fluence, and applied magnetic field. To explain these anomalous phenomena, we develop a phenomenological model integrating the three-temperature model with self-consistent renormalization theory. Because the intrinsic gradient magnetism of the superlattice suppresses the typical divergence of specific heat, the conventional thermodynamic bottleneck is bypassed. Our model reveals that this decoupling enables the ultrafast dynamics to be predominantly governed by the spin-fluctuation-driven enhancement of the electron-spin scattering vertex. Our work demonstrates how spatial inhomogeneity can decouple macroscopic thermodynamic singularities from microscopic scattering processes, offering a new paradigm for manipulating ultrafast spin dynamics in correlated quantum materials. The pronounced sensitivity of the demagnetization rate to external parameters further suggests the potential for designing highly tunable ultrafast spintronic devices that leverage enhanced fluctuations near the magnetic instability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论混合类型。判断依据：摘要中提及“观察”（实验）和“发展了一个现象学模型”（理论）。；研究对象：CaRuO₃/SrTiO₃超晶格中的超快退磁现象，具体为弱巡游铁磁体中的自旋动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在CaRuO₃/SrTiO₃超晶格中，退磁速率随温度、泵浦通量和外加磁场的升高而异常加速，这与传统铁磁体在居里温度附近的临界减速行为相反。该异常源于自旋涨落驱动的电子-自旋散射顶点增强，且超晶格的内禀梯度磁性抑制了比热发散，从而绕过了传统热力学瓶颈。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在CaRuO₃/SrTiO₃超晶格中，退磁速率随温度、泵浦通量和外加磁场的升高而异常加速，这与传统铁磁体在居里温度附近的临界减速行为相反。该异常源于自旋涨落驱动的电子-自旋散射顶点增强，且超晶格的内禀梯度磁性抑制了比热发散，从而绕过了传统热力学瓶颈。；创新点：揭示了空间不均匀性（超晶格结构）如何将宏观热力学奇异性与微观散射过程解耦，从而使得超快自旋动力学主要由自旋涨落主导，而非传统热力学瓶颈控制。摘要未突出说明具体实验表征手段（如是否使用X射线或磁光克尔效应等）。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用超快光学泵浦-探测技术测量退磁动力学；理论上发展了一个将三温度模型与自洽重整化理论相结合的现象学模型。

papers.title: Alternative routes to universal diversity scaling in component systems: from proteomes to large language models
papers.abstract: Remarkably common statistical laws characterize the diversity scaling and its fluctuations across a wide range of complex "component systems". These regularities are often interpreted as signatures of an underlying innovation mechanism driving the growth of component diversity, but the basic ingredients necessary for their emergence remain poorly understood. In particular, from language and technological artifacts to genomes and gene expression patterns, the number of distinct components grows sublinearly with system size, while its variance scales approximately as the square of its mean. This behavior is consistent across diverse systems, raising the question of whether general constraints or emergent principles underlying diversity and innovation define the architectures of realizations with different numbers of components. To address this question, we derive analytical conditions for the joint emergence of these two diversity laws within a broad class of growth models, showing that they require a specific asymptotic dependence of the innovation probability on diversity and system size. We then demonstrate that the same macroscopic laws arise in a different class of models with latent heterogeneity, where quadratic fluctuation scaling always emerges asymptotically as a consequence of general statistical principles, essentially the law of total variance, without explicitly assuming an innovation mechanism or any specific rule for system assembly. We compare these predictions with empirical data from language, genomes, LEGO constructions, and texts generated by large language models. Our results show that empirical diversity scaling laws strongly constrain generative models but do not uniquely identify the mechanisms generating diversity, revealing a close correspondence between innovation-driven growth models and latent-variable descriptions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数据分析与模型比较）。判断依据：推导了多样性标度律的解析条件，并与经验数据（语言、基因组、乐高、大语言模型文本）进行对比。；研究对象：复杂“组分系统”（component systems）中多样性（distinct components）随系统规模增长的标度行为及其涨落规律。具体包括：语言、基因组、乐高积木构造、大语言模型生成的文本等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 多样性标度律（组分数量随系统规模亚线性增长，方差与均值平方成正比）可以在两类不同模型中产生：一类是显式假设创新机制的成长模型，另一类是具有潜在异质性的模型（其中二次涨落标度由总方差定律自然导出）。经验数据虽强烈约束生成模型，但无法唯一确定多样性产生的机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：多样性标度律（组分数量随系统规模亚线性增长，方差与均值平方成正比）可以在两类不同模型中产生：一类是显式假设创新机制的成长模型，另一类是具有潜在异质性的模型（其中二次涨落标度由总方差定律自然导出）。经验数据虽强烈约束生成模型，但无法唯一确定多样性产生的机制。；创新点：揭示了多样性标度律的涌现并不唯一依赖于显式的创新机制，潜在异质性模型也能自然产生相同的宏观规律，从而阐明了不同机制之间的对应关系。摘要未突出说明与已有理论的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导了广义成长模型中创新概率与多样性、系统规模的渐近依赖关系；利用总方差定律（law of total variance）分析潜在异质性模型；将模型预测与来自语言、基因组、乐高构造、大语言模型文本的经验数据进行比较。

papers.title: Differentiable inverse design of short-range order in high-entropy alloys: from target sro to target property
papers.abstract: Short-range order (SRO) governs the mechanical response of multi-principal-element alloys, but designing an alloy for a target property usually means solving two disconnected problems: building a structure matching a desired SRO pattern, then separately checking its property, with no shared optimization. This work replaces the standard random-swap search (reverse Monte Carlo) with a gradient-based approach: atom occupancy is treated as continuous rather than fixed, so the whole process can be tuned using gradient descent, the same method used to train neural networks. This builder matches random-swap accuracy on small systems, but is six times faster and eight times more accurate on large 4000-atom systems, and scales smoothly to alloys with many elements without extra bookkeeping. A physics-based correction term, adapted from prior two-element work and extended here to many elements, keeps designed structures thermodynamically realistic rather than just numerically matching the target SRO pattern. A small neural network then predicts mechanical properties directly from composition and SRO statistics, closing the loop from target property back to structure. Tested on nine face-centered-cubic and body-centered-cubic alloys, the pipeline captured SRO-driven stiffness changes from -20% to +57%, and cell-size checks showed at least 864 atoms are needed to get the direction and size of these changes right, since the commonly used 108-atom cells can mislead. Against real simulations for a cobalt-chromium-nickel alloy, the method matched three of four target stiffness values within 6%. The method is released as an open-source Python package, anisro, offering a practical route to gradient-based, property-driven alloy design.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：gradient-based approach、reverse Monte Carlo、neural network、open-source Python package。；研究对象：高熵合金（多主元合金）中的短程有序（SRO）及其对力学性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于梯度下降的可微逆向设计方法，能够高效构建具有目标短程有序结构的高熵合金，并直接预测其力学性能，在4000原子大体系中比传统随机交换方法快6倍、精度高8倍；同时发现常用108原子模拟单元可能误导结果，至少需要864原子才能正确捕捉SRO驱动的刚度变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于梯度下降的可微逆向设计方法，能够高效构建具有目标短程有序结构的高熵合金，并直接预测其力学性能，在4000原子大体系中比传统随机交换方法快6倍、精度高8倍；同时发现常用108原子模拟单元可能误导结果，至少需要864原子才能正确捕捉SRO驱动的刚度变化。；创新点：将原本分离的结构构建与性能验证两个问题统一为可共享优化的梯度驱动流程，并开发了开源Python包anisro。
papers.method_zh: 将原子占据视为连续变量而非固定离散值，采用梯度下降（与训练神经网络相同的方法）替代传统的随机交换搜索（逆蒙特卡洛）；引入从两元素工作推广到多元素的物理修正项，确保设计结构热力学合理；使用小型神经网络直接从成分和SRO统计量预测力学性能。

papers.title: Exact amplitude relations for diffusion-limited aggregation
papers.abstract: It has been known for several decades that the third moment of the multifractal spectrum of the harmonic measure for diffusion-limited aggregates is linked to the underlying fractal dimension of the cluster. We demonstrate, using an argument based on the Hastings-Levitov formulation of diffusion-limited aggregation (DLA) in two dimensions, an even stronger link, connecting the universal amplitude of the third moment to the cluster fractal dimension. This argument can be used for both the standard circular DLA as well as DLA in a cylinder (i.e., with periodic boundary conditions).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“demonstrate, using an argument”、“theoretical link”等关键词，表明工作基于理论推导和论证。；研究对象：扩散限制聚集（DLA）过程中的调和测度（harmonic measure）的多分形谱（multifractal spectrum）。具体体系包括标准圆形DLA以及圆柱形（即周期性边界条件）DLA。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现DLA团簇调和测度第三矩的普适振幅（universal amplitude）与团簇的分形维数（fractal dimension）之间存在一个比以往认知更强的直接联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现DLA团簇调和测度第三矩的普适振幅（universal amplitude）与团簇的分形维数（fractal dimension）之间存在一个比以往认知更强的直接联系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但相对于已知的“第三矩与分形维数相关”这一事实，本工作建立了一个更强的联系，即连接了第三矩的“普适振幅”与分形维数，而不仅仅是矩本身。
papers.method_zh: 基于二维Hastings-Levitov公式的理论论证。该公式是描述DLA过程的一种解析框架。

papers.title: Entropy of Non-Abelian Anyons from Slow Quasiparticle Dynamics in Quantum Hall Interferometers
papers.abstract: Non-Abelian anyons emerging in fractional quantum Hall states carry a characteristic entropy, $ΔS = k_B \log d$, where \(d\) is the anyon's quantum dimension. This \(\mathcal{O}(1)\) entropy can, in principle, be extracted from charge measurements of an antidot via Maxwell relations. However, equilibrium charge measurements in fractional antidots have proven to be challenging with conventional charge detectors. Here, we propose a scheme based on an antidot embedded in an interferometer, in which the charge can be inferred from the recently observed time-dependent switching of the interference phase. Performing such non-local charge measurements at equilibrium, the characteristic \(\mathcal{O}(1)\) entropy of non-Abelian anyons (e.g., $d = \sqrt{2}$ for the $ν= 5/2$ state) can be extracted for intermediate temperatures, which exceed the level spacing of the interferometer edge, but are much smaller than the level spacing of the antidot.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose a scheme、Maxwell relations、non-local charge measurements。；研究对象：分数量子霍尔态中非阿贝尔任意子的熵，具体针对嵌入干涉仪的反点（antidot）体系，如ν=5/2态中量子维度d=√2的任意子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出通过干涉仪中反点电荷的非局域测量，利用麦克斯韦关系从中等温度下时间依赖的干涉相位开关行为，提取非阿贝尔任意子的特征熵ΔS = k_B log d。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出通过干涉仪中反点电荷的非局域测量，利用麦克斯韦关系从中等温度下时间依赖的干涉相位开关行为，提取非阿贝尔任意子的特征熵ΔS = k_B log d。；创新点：提出一种克服传统电荷探测器难以平衡测量分数量子反点电荷困难的新方案，利用干涉仪中时间依赖的相位开关实现非局域电荷测量，从而提取非阿贝尔任意子的特征熵。
papers.method_zh: 理论方案设计：基于嵌入干涉仪的反点结构，通过非局域电荷测量（从干涉相位开关推断电荷），结合麦克斯韦关系提取熵；温度条件要求介于干涉仪边缘能级间距与反点能级间距之间。

papers.title: A density matrix renormalization group approach to quantum point contacts
papers.abstract: Using the density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) combined with the correction-vector method, we investigate the competition between an harmonic potential and repulsive interactions in a one-dimensional fermionic system. The parabolic confinement induces spatial inhomogeneity, and by tuning its curvature one can continuously interpolate between a potential well--relevant for cold-atom setups--and a quantum barrier, as realized in mesoscopic systems such as quantum point contacts. We analyze how the ground-state particle distribution evolves with the strength and sign of the confining potential and how the confinement reshapes the spectral weight of the local density of states (LDOS) at the center of the chain. In the barrier regime, a localized peak emerges in the electron part of the spectrum ($ω>0$) as a direct consequence of the potential. In contrast, in the well configuration and for weak interactions, a localized feature persists but shifts to the hole sector ($ω<0$). However, for stronger interactions, the LDOS no longer displays clear signatures of the external potential, indicating that correlations dominate over single-particle confinement.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density matrix renormalization group (DMRG)、correction-vector method、数值计算。；研究对象：一维费米子系统中谐振子势与排斥相互作用之间的竞争，具体涉及从势阱（冷原子系统）到量子势垒（介观量子点接触）的连续调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在势垒区域，局域态密度（LDOS）的电子部分（ω>0）会出现一个由势垒直接导致的局域峰；而在势阱区域且相互作用较弱时，该局域特征转移到空穴部分（ω<0）。当相互作用增强时，LDOS不再显示外势的清晰特征，表明关联效应主导了单粒子束缚。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在势垒区域，局域态密度（LDOS）的电子部分（ω>0）会出现一个由势垒直接导致的局域峰；而在势阱区域且相互作用较弱时，该局域特征转移到空穴部分（ω<0）。当相互作用增强时，LDOS不再显示外势的清晰特征，表明关联效应主导了单粒子束缚。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）结合修正矢量（correction-vector）方法，计算一维费米子系统的基态粒子分布和局域态密度（LDOS）。

papers.title: Coherent two-dimensional electronic spectroscopy integrated with confocal back focal plane microscopy
papers.abstract: We introduce a setup for coherent two-dimensional electronic spectroscopy in the pump-probe reflection geometry that is integrated with a confocal back focal plane imaging microscope. The angle-resolved capability is utilized to control pump and probe wavevectors, while real space imaging enables co-localization of the collection spots for linear and ultrafast experiments. Compression of pulses down to 20 fs is achieved. We demonstrate the capabilities of this approach on an exfoliated WSe$_2$ monolayer on Si/SiO$_2$. The setup is suited to investigate excitons and exciton-polaritons in 2D Materials and their heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了实验装置的搭建（“introduce a setup”）、具体技术实现（“compression of pulses down to 20 fs”）以及实验演示（“demonstrate the capabilities... on an exfoliated WSe₂ monolayer”）。；研究对象：二维材料及其异质结构中的激子和激子极化激元。具体演示体系为剥离的WSe₂单层（置于Si/SiO₂基底上）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 成功搭建了一套集成共焦背焦平面显微术的相干二维电子光谱装置，可在泵浦-探测反射几何结构下实现角度分辨和实空间成像，并能在WSe₂单层上演示其功能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：成功搭建了一套集成共焦背焦平面显微术的相干二维电子光谱装置，可在泵浦-探测反射几何结构下实现角度分辨和实空间成像，并能在WSe₂单层上演示其功能。；创新点：将角度分辨波矢控制（通过背焦平面成像）与实空间共定位成像集成到二维电子光谱装置中，使得线性与超快实验的收集点可精确共定位，特别适用于研究二维材料中的激子和激子极化激元。
papers.method_zh: 相干二维电子光谱（coherent two-dimensional electronic spectroscopy），结合共焦背焦平面成像显微镜（confocal back focal plane imaging microscope），采用泵浦-探测反射几何结构（pump-probe reflection geometry），并实现20飞秒脉冲压缩。

papers.title: Theory of collective learning in populations of adaptive agents
papers.abstract: We investigate homogeneous populations of smart active agents that exchange information with their neighbors to perform a decentralized learning process aimed at achieving a prescribed macroscopic state. Such agents may, for example, represent simple microrobots. The exchanged information comprises tunable parameters governing the agent dynamics, referred to as the individual policy, together with an internal memory encoding previously visited states. This memory is used to evaluate a reward that quantifies the success of a policy to achieve the prescribed state. We extend the kinetic-theory description of collective learning in spatially homogeneous systems [Phys. Rev. Lett. 134, 248302 (2025)] and derive formal evolution equations for the distribution of policies across the population. A central outcome of our theory is the emergence of an effective reward function that fully determines the evolution of the policy distribution and encapsulates the microscopic details of the agents physical and memory dynamics. We obtain closed equations for the policy mean and variance which admit explicit time-dependent solutions under the assumption of Gaussian-distributed memories and polices. To illustrate the framework, we present a series of minimal microscopic models, considering both perfect and partial separation of physical, memory and policy exchange time scales, as well as models with one- and two-dimensional policies. The obtained theoretical results compare well with agent-based numerical simulations. The theory captures key aspects of collective learning, including the influence of population diversity and reward fluctuations on learning performance. Finally, we discuss potential applications to swarm robotics and machine learning, and highlight connections with classical models of biological evolution, including the Replicator equation and the Moran model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：kinetic-theory description、formal evolution equations、theoretical results。；研究对象：自适应智能体（如简单微型机器人）群体中的集体学习过程，具体研究群体如何通过交换信息（个体策略和内部记忆）实现预设的宏观状态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出群体中策略分布的演化方程，发现存在一个有效奖励函数，该函数完全决定策略分布的演化，并封装了智能体物理和记忆动力学的微观细节。理论结果与基于智能体的数值模拟吻合良好。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出群体中策略分布的演化方程，发现存在一个有效奖励函数，该函数完全决定策略分布的演化，并封装了智能体物理和记忆动力学的微观细节。理论结果与基于智能体的数值模拟吻合良好。；创新点：将动理学理论从先前工作（Phys. Rev. Lett. 134, 248302 (2025)）扩展到更一般的自适应智能体群体，揭示了有效奖励函数在决定集体学习动力学中的核心作用，并建立了与生物进化经典模型（复制方程、Moran模型）的联系。
papers.method_zh: 采用动理学理论（kinetic theory）框架，推导了空间均匀系统中策略分布的演化方程；在记忆和策略服从高斯分布的假设下，得到了策略均值和方差的封闭方程，并给出了显式时间依赖解；通过最小微观模型（考虑时间尺度分离、一维/二维策略）进行理论分析，并与基于智能体的数值模拟对比验证。

papers.title: Path-Measure Dynamics of Attention-Driven World Models: A Nonlocal Onsager--Machlup Approach
papers.abstract: Attention enables a world model to condition on its entire history, providing long-term memory that facilitates long-range predictions. While the local Onsager--Machlup theory in our companion paper assumes a temporally local predictive action, we investigate the conditions under which this locality holds. We derive the predictive path measure for latent dynamics that become non-Markovian due to attention-induced memory, demonstrating that this measure is the projection of a hidden linear Markov augmentation. Eliminating the auxiliary field results in a nonlocal Onsager--Machlup action, where memory manifests as a nonlocal quadratic form rather than a force. These kernels are completely monotone and exactly match a hidden Markov embedding with a finite relaxation spectrum; otherwise, the dynamics remain fundamentally nonlocal. By expanding the action in terms of the scale-separation parameter $ε=τ_{\text{mem}}/τ_{\text{dyn}}$, we show that the leading order recovers the local action of the companion paper, establishing locality as the short-memory limit of a nonlocal theory. We verify the reversible sector of this expansion term by term against an exactly solvable vector linear model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：非局域Onsager-Machlup理论、路径测度、投影方法、尺度分离展开。；研究对象：注意力机制驱动的世界模型中的潜在动力学，具体关注由注意力引入记忆效应导致的非马尔可夫动力学系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 注意力诱导的记忆效应使得潜在动力学变为非马尔可夫，其预测路径测度可表示为隐藏线性马尔可夫增广的投影；消除辅助场后，记忆表现为非局域二次型而非力，且该核函数完全单调，与有限弛豫谱的隐藏马尔可夫嵌入精确匹配。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：注意力诱导的记忆效应使得潜在动力学变为非马尔可夫，其预测路径测度可表示为隐藏线性马尔可夫增广的投影；消除辅助场后，记忆表现为非局域二次型而非力，且该核函数完全单调，与有限弛豫谱的隐藏马尔可夫嵌入精确匹配。；创新点：将局域Onsager-Machlup理论推广至非局域情形，严格建立了注意力记忆效应与非局域二次型作用量之间的数学对应，并给出了局域理论作为短记忆极限的严格证明。
papers.method_zh: 采用非局域Onsager-Machlup路径测度理论框架，通过隐藏线性马尔可夫增广投影方法推导非马尔可夫动力学，并利用尺度分离参数ε=τ_mem/τ_dyn进行展开，在短记忆极限下恢复局域作用量；通过可精确求解的矢量线性模型逐项验证可逆部分。

papers.title: Pore-scale distribution and transport of active particles in a two-dimensional lattice
papers.abstract: Suspensions of motile microswimmers such as bacteria and other active colloids frequently encounter porous environments where obstacles and complex shear flows strongly influence their dynamics. Here, we study the distribution and transport of a dilute suspension of active particles in a square lattice of pillars, which serves as a model porous medium. The microswimmers are modeled as slender point particles, and Brownian Dynamics simulations are performed to determine how their number density and polarization fields change with systematic variations in the medium porosity, polydispersity, flow strength, and self-propulsion strength. We find that in the absence of flow, self-propulsion drives particle accumulation and radial polarization at the pillar surfaces. In the presence of a background flow, particles preferentially accumulate in the wake of pillars and exhibit upstream polarization near their surface, consistent with experimental observations. At moderate flow strengths, topological defects nucleate in the polarization field. These defects are of purely kinematic origin and mark the transition from global upstream swimming at low flow strengths to the coexistence of upstream and downstream swimming regions in the lattice at high flow strengths. The structured lattice studied here provides a controlled framework for isolating the physical mechanisms governing active transport in complex geometries, with direct relevance to transport in structured microfluidic settings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“Brownian Dynamics simulations”（布朗动力学模拟）。；研究对象：活性粒子（如细菌、活性胶体）在二维方形柱阵（作为模型多孔介质）中的分布与输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 无背景流时，自推进导致粒子在柱表面聚集并形成径向极化；有背景流时，粒子优先在柱后尾流区聚集并呈现上游极化，且中等流速下极化场中会形成纯运动学起源的拓扑缺陷，标志着从全局上游游动到上下游游动区域共存的转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：无背景流时，自推进导致粒子在柱表面聚集并形成径向极化；有背景流时，粒子优先在柱后尾流区聚集并呈现上游极化，且中等流速下极化场中会形成纯运动学起源的拓扑缺陷，标志着从全局上游游动到上下游游动区域共存的转变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 布朗动力学模拟（Brownian Dynamics simulations），将微游泳者建模为细长点粒子，系统改变介质孔隙率、多分散性、流动强度和自推进强度。

papers.title: Phonon spectral function of Holstein polaron: Investigation of many-body effects with self-energy and vertex correction
papers.abstract: We study the impact of the many-body effects on the phonon spectral function of Holstein polaron in one-dimension in the antiadiabatic regime by incorporating the contributions from the electron self-energy and vertex corrections within a weak-coupling approach that respects the charge-conserving Ward identity. We find that while the polaronic spectral weight is suppressed due to contribution from the electron self-energy, on the other hand, the same is enhanced due to contribution from the vertex corrections. While strength of both the contributions increases with increasing the wave vector ($\q$) of phonons, they nearly cancel each other for the small-$\q$ modes so that the polaronic spectral weight is weakly affected due to the many-body effects. For the large-$\q$ modes near the zone boundary, the net many-body correction is dominated by the contribution of the electron self-energy which increases faster in comparison to that of the vertex corrections with increasing the wave vector thereby resulting in a significant suppression of the polaronic spectral weight. We find that while the weak-coupling perturbative approach provides a reliable estimation of the impact of the many-body effects deep inside the antiadibatic regime, the renormalization of quasiparticle spectrum must be taken into account for an accurate estimation when the phonon energy approaches the electronic bandwidth.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：weak-coupling approach、Ward identity、self-energy、vertex correction。；研究对象：一维反绝热区Holstein极化子中的声子谱函数，具体研究多体效应对其的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电子自能贡献抑制极化子谱权重，而顶点修正贡献增强谱权重；对于大波矢（靠近布里渊区边界）的声子模式，自能贡献增长更快，导致净多体效应显著抑制极化子谱权重。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电子自能贡献抑制极化子谱权重，而顶点修正贡献增强谱权重；对于大波矢（靠近布里渊区边界）的声子模式，自能贡献增长更快，导致净多体效应显著抑制极化子谱权重。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用满足电荷守恒Ward恒等式的弱耦合微扰方法，同时考虑电子自能和顶点修正的贡献，计算一维Holstein极化子模型在反绝热区的声子谱函数。

papers.title: Electrical transport in ultra-thin films: from Fuchs-Sondheimer to quantum-confinement
papers.abstract: Ultra-thin films are fundamental components of modern nanoelectronics, where reducing thickness to the few-nanometer scale leads to a dramatic increase in electrical resistivity. For decades, this behavior has been interpreted in terms of classical size effects, primarily surface scattering within the Fuchs--Sondheimer theory and grain-boundary scattering in the Mayadas--Shatzkes model. While these approaches successfully describe transport when the film thickness is comparable to the electronic mean free path, growing experimental evidence indicates that they become insufficient under extreme confinement. This review discusses the crossover from classical scattering to a quantum-confinement regime in which the electronic states available for transport are fundamentally restructured by finite size. We review the recently proposed reciprocal-space confinement theory, which predicts an exponential increase of resistivity with decreasing thickness at the nanoscale, and discuss how it can be combined with classical surface-scattering models to provide a unified description of ultra-thin metallic and semiconducting films. Finally, we summarize recent experimental evidence supporting this picture and discuss its implications for future nanoelectronic devices, nanoscale interconnects, and quantum transport under extreme spatial confinement.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论综述文章（关键词：review, discusses, proposed theory, unified description）；研究对象：超薄薄膜（厚度降至几纳米尺度）中的电输运现象，特别是从经典尺寸效应（Fuchs-Sondheimer理论、Mayadas–Shatzkes模型）到量子限域效应的交叉。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当薄膜厚度与电子平均自由程可比时，经典散射理论（Fuchs-Sondheimer和Mayadas–Shatzkes）已不足以描述极端限域下的输运行为；新提出的倒空间限域理论预测电阻率随厚度减小呈指数增长，可与经典表面散射模型结合，统一描述超薄金属和半导体薄膜的输运。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当薄膜厚度与电子平均自由程可比时，经典散射理论（Fuchs-Sondheimer和Mayadas–Shatzkes）已不足以描述极端限域下的输运行为；新提出的倒空间限域理论预测电阻率随厚度减小呈指数增长，可与经典表面散射模型结合，统一描述超薄金属和半导体薄膜的输运。；创新点：提出了从经典散射到量子限域输运的交叉图像，并给出了一个统一的理论框架（倒空间限域理论 + 经典表面散射模型），以解释超薄薄膜在极端限域下的电阻率异常增长。
papers.method_zh: 理论综述：回顾了经典尺寸效应理论（Fuchs-Sondheimer表面散射、Mayadas–Shatzkes晶界散射），并重点介绍了新近提出的倒空间限域理论（reciprocal-space confinement theory），同时结合了近期实验证据进行讨论。

papers.title: Unconventional Mixed-Parity Magnetism in Rare-Earth Tetraborides
papers.abstract: Altermagnetism has advanced the study of compensated magnets by revealing non-relativistic spin splitting, traditionally classified into strictly even- or odd-parity spin textures. Here, we unveil a fundamentally different regime: component-resolved mixed-parity spin splitting in a fully three-dimensional compensated magnet. Using first-principles calculations, tight-binding and $\mathbf{k} \cdot \mathbf{p}$ models, along with spin-group symmetry analysis, we demonstrate that the non-coplanar ground state of $\mathrm{TbB}_4$ enforces a unique momentum-space spin texture. The in-plane spin components exhibit odd-parity $p$- and $f$-wave-like textures, whereas the out-of-plane component retains an even-parity $d$-wave altermagnetic character. Crucially, the coexistence of the in-plane odd-parity textures is driven not by relativistic spin-orbit coupling, but by a staggered Berry phase arising from the inherent scalar spin chirality. This mixed-parity structure dictates distinct transport fingerprints, including bulk non-relativistic Edelstein and spin Hall responses, as well as a symmetry-allowed Berry curvature dipole. These results establish the rare-earth tetraborides as a robust platform for engineering complex spin-charge conversion phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：第一性原理计算、紧束缚模型、k·p模型、自旋群对称性分析。；研究对象：稀土四硼化物（具体为TbB₄）中的非常规混合宇称磁性，以及其非共面基态导致的动量空间自旋织构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在三维补偿磁体TbB₄中发现了分量分辨的混合宇称自旋劈裂：面内自旋分量呈现奇宇称的p波和f波织构，而面外自旋分量保持偶宇称的d波交变磁性特征。这种混合宇称结构由标量自旋手性产生的交错贝里相位驱动，而非相对论性自旋-轨道耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在三维补偿磁体TbB₄中发现了分量分辨的混合宇称自旋劈裂：面内自旋分量呈现奇宇称的p波和f波织构，而面外自旋分量保持偶宇称的d波交变磁性特征。这种混合宇称结构由标量自旋手性产生的交错贝里相位驱动，而非相对论性自旋-轨道耦合。；创新点：揭示了在完全三维补偿磁体中，非共面磁结构可产生非相对论性的混合宇称自旋劈裂（面内奇宇称与面外偶宇称共存），突破了传统交变磁性中严格偶宇称或奇宇称自旋织构的分类框架。摘要未突出说明与实验对比的具体细节。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算、紧束缚模型、k·p模型、自旋群对称性分析。

papers.title: Plaid-Like Spin Splitting and Chirality of Magnon Bands in Antiferromagnetic MnTe$_2$
papers.abstract: Altermagnets constitute an emerging class of magnetic materials that combine compensated antiferromagnetic order with spin-split excitations arising from crystalline symmetries. Despite strong theoretical interest, their experimental identification remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate that helicity- and angle-resolved Raman scattering measurements reveal reduced rotational symmetries of magnons and a pronounced imbalance between left- and right-circular polarization channels, indicating momentum-dependent magnon handedness. First-principles DFT+$U$ calculations combined with linear spin-wave theory uncover a characteristic plaid-like spin-splitting structure in momentum space. The resulting magnon spin textures are dictated by the unconventional sublattice symmetries of MnTe$_2$ and closely emulate those of altermagnetic electronic bands. Our work provides evidence of chiral spin-wave excitations unique to this non-coplanar antiferromagnet.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。依据：摘要中明确提到“helicity- and angle-resolved Raman scattering measurements”（实验手段）和“First-principles DFT+$U$ calculations combined with linear spin-wave theory”（计算方法）。；研究对象：反铁磁材料 MnTe$_2$ 中的磁振子（自旋波）及其手性行为，特别是与交变磁（altermagnet）相关的自旋劈裂结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在反铁磁 MnTe$_2$ 中，通过拉曼散射观测到磁振子具有降低的旋转对称性和显著的左右圆偏振通道不平衡，表明存在动量依赖的磁振子手性；第一性原理计算揭示了一种独特的格子状（plaid-like）自旋劈裂结构，其自旋纹理与交变磁电子能带类似。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在反铁磁 MnTe$_2$ 中，通过拉曼散射观测到磁振子具有降低的旋转对称性和显著的左右圆偏振通道不平衡，表明存在动量依赖的磁振子手性；第一性原理计算揭示了一种独特的格子状（plaid-like）自旋劈裂结构，其自旋纹理与交变磁电子能带类似。；创新点：首次在非共面反铁磁体 MnTe$_2$ 中通过实验和理论结合，揭示了具有格子状自旋劈裂的手性磁振子能带，并指出其与交变磁电子能带的相似性。摘要未突出说明与已有交变磁实验工作的具体区别。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用螺旋度分辨和角度分辨的拉曼散射测量；理论上采用 DFT+$U$ 第一性原理计算结合线性自旋波理论。

papers.title: A 2048-spin bulk acoustic wave Ising machine for number partitioning and Sudoku
papers.abstract: Optical coherent Ising machines based on time-multiplexing have demonstrated significant progress in terms of connectivity and spin scalability. However, they are constrained by large physical footprints, high power consumption, poor thermal stability, and high cost. Here, we present a time-multiplexed Ising machine leveraging propagating wave packets in solid-state delay lines at microwave frequencies, enabling thermally stable, robust, low-power, tabletop, and affordable design. We use two serially connected 20.5 MHz, 707 μs bulk acoustic wave delay lines supporting 2,048 spins. Our design provides all-to-all connectivity with 15-bit coupling resolution and finds approximate MAX-CUT solutions in 341 ms, potentially scalable to sub-ms by using higher frequency delay lines. Additionally, we demonstrate solutions to number partitioning and Sudoku problems. Compared with state-of-the-art Coherent Ising machines, our machine exhibits four orders of magnitude higher thermal stability. Against the simulated bifurcation algorithm, our design achieves comparable results on the MAX-CUT problem, while outperforming it on the more complex number-partitioning and Sudoku problems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了具体硬件实现（bulk acoustic wave delay lines）、实验参数（20.5 MHz, 707 μs）和性能测量（热稳定性、求解时间）。；研究对象：基于体声波延迟线的伊辛机（Ising machine），用于求解组合优化问题（MAX-CUT、数划分、数独）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该伊辛机利用微波频段的固态延迟线实现2048个自旋的全连接，在热稳定性上比最先进的光学相干伊辛机高四个数量级，并在数划分和数独问题上优于模拟分岔算法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该伊辛机利用微波频段的固态延迟线实现2048个自旋的全连接，在热稳定性上比最先进的光学相干伊辛机高四个数量级，并在数划分和数独问题上优于模拟分岔算法。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用两个串联的20.5 MHz、707 μs体声波延迟线，通过时间复用（time-multiplexing）技术支持2048个自旋，实现15位耦合分辨率的全连接拓扑，并在341 ms内求解近似MAX-CUT问题。

papers.title: Quantum-geometric shift of quasiequilibrium: Origin of nonreciprocal current driven by quantum-metric dipole
papers.abstract: We study nonlinear DC electric transport of quantum-metric origin by combining adiabatic perturbation theory with the nonequilibrium Green function approach. The adiabatic ansatz provides a basis for directly treating a DC electric field in the velocity gauge, rather than introducing it as the zero-frequency limit of an AC field. The resulting adiabatic-basis Hamiltonian takes the same form as in the length gauge, enabling a systematic comparison across different formulations. Applying this fully quantum formulation, we find a longitudinal nonreciprocal current governed by the quantum-metric dipole. The essential ingredient is a quantum correction to the distribution function that is absent in semiclassical treatments. We trace this correction to the finite spread of an electron wave packet during relaxation under a bias field, thereby identifying shifted quasiequilibrium as the physical origin of quantum-metric nonreciprocal transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。依据：关键词为“adiabatic perturbation theory”（绝热微扰理论）、“nonequilibrium Green function approach”（非平衡格林函数方法）、“fully quantum formulation”（全量子表述）。；研究对象：非线性直流电输运现象，具体为量子度量（quantum-metric）起源的非互易电流（nonreciprocal current）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一个由量子度量偶极子（quantum-metric dipole）控制的纵向非互易电流。该电流的物理起源被追溯到偏置场下弛豫过程中电子波包的有限展宽所导致的“移位准平衡”（shifted quasiequilibrium），这是一种在半经典处理中缺失的分布函数的量子修正。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一个由量子度量偶极子（quantum-metric dipole）控制的纵向非互易电流。该电流的物理起源被追溯到偏置场下弛豫过程中电子波包的有限展宽所导致的“移位准平衡”（shifted quasiequilibrium），这是一种在半经典处理中缺失的分布函数的量子修正。；创新点：首次将非互易电流的量子度量起源明确归因于分布函数的量子修正，并识别出“移位准平衡”这一物理图像，揭示了电子波包在弛豫过程中的量子展宽效应是产生该非互易输运的关键。摘要未突出说明与具体材料体系的关联。
papers.method_zh: 结合了绝热微扰理论与非平衡格林函数方法。通过绝热假设，直接在速度规范（velocity gauge）下处理直流电场，而非将其视为交流场的零频极限。由此得到的绝热基哈密顿量与长度规范（length gauge）形式相同，便于不同表述间的系统比较。

papers.title: The Wigner function for Integer quantum Hall effect
papers.abstract: Wigner's quasi-probability distribution function in phase space is a specialized representation of the density matrix, possessing significant physical importance. In this article, we first review the wave function describing electronic motion in an electromagnetic field under the Landau gauge. Next, based on an introduction to the properties of the Wigner function, we calculate the Wigner function for the integer quantum Hall effect using the integral method.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“Wigner准概率分布函数”、“密度矩阵”、“积分方法”等理论分析关键词，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：整数量子霍尔效应（Integer quantum Hall effect）中的电子相空间分布，具体为在Landau规范下电磁场中电子运动的Wigner函数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过积分方法计算得到了整数量子霍尔效应的Wigner函数，展示了该体系在相空间中的准概率分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过积分方法计算得到了整数量子霍尔效应的Wigner函数，展示了该体系在相空间中的准概率分布。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：首先回顾Landau规范下电磁场中电子运动的波函数，然后基于Wigner函数的性质，采用积分方法计算整数量子霍尔效应的Wigner函数。

papers.title: Anisotropic tunneling through magnetic barriers in 8-Pmmn borophene
papers.abstract: We present a theoretical study of electron tunneling through a magnetic barrier in 8-Pmmn borophene, created by depositing two ferromagnetic strips on the borophene sheet. Using a low-energy effective Hamiltonian that captures the anisotropic Dirac spectrum, we solve the Dirac equation in three regions and impose wave-function continuity at the interfaces. From the resulting spinor solutions, we compute current densities and determine transmission and reflection probabilities as functions of incident energy, angle, and barrier parameters. The transmission exhibits strong anisotropy due to the tilted Dirac cones, with pronounced suppression for specific incident directions, suggesting directional filtering of carriers. We further calculate the conductance using the Landauer-Büttiker formalism, revealing that both magnetic strength and barrier width can tune the charge transport properties. The results demonstrate that engineered magnetic barriers in 8-Pmmn borophene enable precise control over electron flow, offering a platform for anisotropic transport control and tunable quantum devices. The interplay between the intrinsic anisotropy of borophene and external magnetic barriers provides rich opportunities to manipulate Dirac fermions in two-dimensional systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“theoretical study”、“solve the Dirac equation”、“compute current densities”等理论计算关键词。；研究对象：8-Pmmn硼烯（8-Pmmn borophene）中通过沉积两个铁磁条形成的磁势垒，以及电子在该体系中的各向异性隧穿输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 由于8-Pmmn硼烯中狄拉克锥的倾斜特性，电子隧穿通过磁势垒时表现出强烈的各向异性，特定入射方向上的透射被显著抑制，从而实现载流子的方向性过滤；通过调节磁势垒强度和宽度，可精确控制电荷输运性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：由于8-Pmmn硼烯中狄拉克锥的倾斜特性，电子隧穿通过磁势垒时表现出强烈的各向异性，特定入射方向上的透射被显著抑制，从而实现载流子的方向性过滤；通过调节磁势垒强度和宽度，可精确控制电荷输运性质。；创新点：揭示了8-Pmmn硼烯本征各向异性与外加磁势垒之间的相互作用，为在二维体系中实现各向异性输运控制和可调谐量子器件提供了新平台。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用低能有效哈密顿量描述各向异性狄拉克能谱，在三个区域（势垒区及两侧）求解狄拉克方程，通过波函数连续性条件得到旋量解，进而计算电流密度、透射概率和反射概率；利用Landauer-Büttiker公式计算电导。

papers.title: Anisotropic nanoscale coherent polariton transport in CrSBr
papers.abstract: In a combined experimental and theoretical study, we demonstrate anisotropic polariton transport on the nanoscale in the van der Waals antiferromagnet CrSBr. While effective cavity-polariton formation emerges via the self-hybridization of ultra-high oscillator strength excitons with a thin slab photonic mode, the absence of external mirrors facilitates spectroscopic investigation of these polaritons via cathodoluminescence (CL) on length scales determined by the electron wavelength. This direct access allows us to perform precise charting of the polariton landscape with nanometric resolution, and to probe polariton interference phenomena. The main finding of the work highlights that the coherent polariton transport follows the $C_{2v}$ symmetry of CrSBr, allowing exclusive transport along the crystallographic a-axis, while no coherent feature is found along the b-axis direction. Our work sets the foundation to use CL spectroscopy in cavity-polaritonics in more advanced landscapes, such as photonic crystals or optical lattices, and establishes the technique as a powerful tool to probe anisotropic expansion and relaxation phenomena on the nanoscale
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与理论结合）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“combined experimental and theoretical study”，实验手段为阴极发光（CL）光谱，理论部分涉及对称性分析。；研究对象：范德华反铁磁体CrSBr中的各向异性纳米尺度极化激元输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CrSBr中的相干极化激元输运遵循其C₂ᵥ对称性，仅沿晶体学a轴方向传播，沿b轴方向无相干特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CrSBr中的相干极化激元输运遵循其C₂ᵥ对称性，仅沿晶体学a轴方向传播，沿b轴方向无相干特征。；创新点：首次在无外部反射镜的范德华反铁磁体中实现纳米尺度极化激元输运的各向异性直接观测，并证明CL光谱可作为探测纳米尺度各向异性扩展与弛豫现象的有力工具。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用阴极发光（CL）光谱，利用电子波长尺度直接探测极化激元干涉现象；理论上通过自杂化机制（超高振子强度激子与薄片光子模式耦合）形成腔极化激元，并结合对称性分析。

papers.title: Sandpile Models on complex networks
papers.abstract: We investigate the sandpile model on complex networks by developing a branching-process framework that explicitly incorporates dissipation during avalanche propagation. Unlike classical branching descriptions, which assume conservative transport and locally tree-like independence, the present approach introduces grain-loss effects directly into the offspring distribution, yielding generalized generating functions for dissipative avalanche dynamics. In the dissipative regime, avalanche-size distributions acquire exponential cutoffs while preserving topology-dependent scaling behavior. Numerical simulations confirm the theoretical predictions on sparse random networks and reveal systematic deviations in highly structured topologies. In particular, by using Holme-Kim clustered scale-free networks, we show that increasing clustering continuously lowers the avalanche exponent and enhances the probability of large cascades, demonstrating that short cycles generate strong correlations that invalidate the classical independent-branch approx imation. Surprisingly, trees also exhibit substantial deviations from power-law because low edge density and the abundance of leaves constrain avalanche propagation. These results show that dissipation, clustering, and sparse connectivity fundamentally reshape avalanche size distribution of the sandpile model on networks and establish quantitative limits for branching-process descriptions of avalanche dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值模拟）。判断依据：developing a branching-process framework（发展分支过程框架）、theoretical predictions（理论预测）、Numerical simulations confirm（数值模拟验证）。；研究对象：复杂网络上的沙堆模型（Sandpile Model），具体研究雪崩动力学（avalanche dynamics）在复杂网络上的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 耗散、聚类（短环）和稀疏连接性会根本性地重塑沙堆模型在复杂网络上的雪崩尺寸分布。聚类会降低雪崩指数并增加大规模级联的概率，而树状网络因低边密度和大量叶节点也会偏离幂律分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：耗散、聚类（短环）和稀疏连接性会根本性地重塑沙堆模型在复杂网络上的雪崩尺寸分布。聚类会降低雪崩指数并增加大规模级联的概率，而树状网络因低边密度和大量叶节点也会偏离幂律分布。；创新点：该工作首次将耗散效应直接纳入分支过程的子代分布中，从而超越了经典分支描述中保守传输和局域树状独立的假设，并定量建立了分支过程描述雪崩动力学的极限。
papers.method_zh: 发展了一个明确包含雪崩传播过程中耗散效应的分支过程（branching-process）理论框架，通过引入广义生成函数（generalized generating functions）来描述耗散雪崩动力学。数值模拟在稀疏随机网络和Holme-Kim聚类无标度网络上进行。

papers.title: A depth resolved investigation of hydrogen uptake in carbon based nanostructures by soft-to-hard photoemission spectroscopy
