papers.abstract: Hydrogen chemisorption on graphitic carbon modifies the carbon orbital hybridization from sp2 to sp3, altering both structural and electronic properties. Understanding not only the lateral extent but also the depth distribution of hydrogen uptake in three-dimensional carbon architectures is essential for both fundamental studies and storage applications. To this end, we investigate here the evolution of the C 1s core-level lineshape in nanoporous graphene (NPG) and vertically aligned carbon nanotubes (CNTs) upon hydrogenation, exploiting soft-to-hard X-ray photoemission spectroscopy to achieve a depth-resolved analysis. Decomposition of the C 1s spectra reveals the formation of an sp3 rich overlayer in both systems, with an effective thickness ranging from a fraction of a graphitic monolayer (NPG) to approximately one graphitic layer (CNTs), indicating limited hydrogen penetration beneath the outermost accessible surfaces. Overall, hydrogenation in both materials remains predominantly localized on the surface. These results clarify the spatial distribution of hydrogen in curved and porous graphitic networks and provide quantitative constraints on its chemisorption for carbon-based hydrogen storage applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：soft-to-hard X-ray photoemission spectroscopy（软硬X射线光电子能谱）、depth-resolved analysis（深度分辨分析）。；研究对象：氢在碳基纳米结构（纳米多孔石墨烯NPG和垂直排列碳纳米管CNTs）中的化学吸附，具体关注氢吸收的空间分布（特别是深度分布）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 氢化后，两种材料表面均形成富sp³杂化的覆盖层，有效厚度从亚单层（NPG）到约一个石墨层（CNTs），表明氢的渗透仅限于最外层可及表面，整体氢化主要局限于表面。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：氢化后，两种材料表面均形成富sp³杂化的覆盖层，有效厚度从亚单层（NPG）到约一个石墨层（CNTs），表明氢的渗透仅限于最外层可及表面，整体氢化主要局限于表面。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用软X射线到硬X射线的光电子能谱（soft-to-hard XPS）进行深度分辨分析，通过分解C 1s芯能级谱线形状来追踪sp²到sp³杂化转变。

papers.title: An efficient formalism for inertial spin waves: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya antiferromagnets as case studies
papers.abstract: Magnetic inertia, emerging in the ultrafast regime, supports inertial spin waves (SWs) as novel magnetic excitations. Despite considerable efforts devoted to inertial SWs, a systematic formalism for fully characterizing their intrinsic properties, especially chirality and polarization, is still lacking, and inertial SWs in spatially nonuniform magnetic configurations remain poorly explored. Here, we develop a framework for calculating inertial SWs and establish a general definition of their chirality and polarization via the ellipticity angle, a unified parameter encoding frequency sign, phase difference, and elliptical axis ratio. Using this method, we systematically investigate precessional and nutational SWs in uniaxial antiferromagnets with staggered and homogeneous Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions (DMIs), covering uniform collinear, canted, and spiral magnetic configurations. The results reveal that small staggered DMI preserves spin-wave degeneracy, whereas small homogeneous DMI lifts it. Further space-time inversion symmetry breaking in canted and spiral structures fully removes spin-wave degeneracy across the entire Brillouin zone. Long-wavelength nutational SWs behave as backward waves, and flat bands emerge in canted and spiral configurations near a critical inertial relaxation time. In canted and spiral configurations, nutational modes are always lefthanded whereas precessional modes are always righthanded; additionally, the dispersion spectra of the canted configuration can be derived from those of the spiral configuration via band folding. Polarization is wavenumber insensitive for uniform configurations but becomes strongly dispersive for nonuniform ones. This work advances the fundamental understanding of magnetic inertial dynamics and provides theoretical insights for the development of ultrafast magnonic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：formalism（形式理论）、framework（框架）、definition（定义）、systematically investigate（系统研究）。；研究对象：惯性自旋波（inertial spin waves），具体以具有交错和均匀Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用（DMI）的单轴反铁磁体为案例，涵盖均匀共线、倾斜和螺旋磁构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了通过椭圆率角统一表征惯性自旋波手性和极化的形式理论，揭示了交错DMI保持自旋波简并性而均匀DMI解除简并性，以及倾斜和螺旋构型中空间-时间反演对称性破缺导致全布里渊区自旋波简并完全解除。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了通过椭圆率角统一表征惯性自旋波手性和极化的形式理论，揭示了交错DMI保持自旋波简并性而均匀DMI解除简并性，以及倾斜和螺旋构型中空间-时间反演对称性破缺导致全布里渊区自旋波简并完全解除。；创新点：首次建立了完整表征惯性自旋波本征特性（手性和极化）的系统形式理论，并系统研究了非均匀磁构型（倾斜和螺旋）中的惯性自旋波行为，填补了该领域空白。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：通过椭圆率角（统一编码频率符号、相位差和椭圆轴比）定义自旋波手性和极化；基于该形式理论系统计算了单轴反铁磁体中进动模和章动模的色散关系。

papers.title: Transition-Metal Tailored $Ga_{2}O_{2}$ Monolayer: From Room-Temperature Gas Sensing to Chemical Scavenging
papers.abstract: Pristine $Ga_{2}O_{2}$ monolayers suffer from poor sensitivity and weak molecular capture, limiting their application in toxic gas detection and environmental detoxification. Here, we employ first-principles density functional theory (DFT) calculations to investigate the gas sensing and scavenging properties of $Ga_{2}O_{2}$ monolayers substitutionally tailored via seven transition-metals (TM): Pd, Zn, Zr, Mo, Ag, Ti, and Pt. All TM-substituted monolayers exhibit negative formation and binding energies, negligible lattice distortion, and structural stability in molecular dynamics simulations. Performance evaluation against eight toxic industrial and three environmental gases reveals functionalities ranging from selective, reusable room-temperature sensing to permanent molecular capture. Ag substitution exhibits exceptional selectivity for $NO$ with moderate adsorption strength (~-0.83eV), an up to eight-order-of-magnitude conductivity enhancement, besides facilitating reusable $O_2$ and $NO_2$ detection. Additionally, Pd-, Zn-, Zr-, and Mo substitutions tune selectivity toward $NO$, $NO_2$, $CO_2$, $CO$, and $O_2$. Coming to applications towards toxic gas capture, Zr- and Mo-substituted systems selectively scavenge oxidizing gases, whereas Ti and Pt act as universal scavengers. Further analysis reveals that Pd- and Ag-substituted monolayers remain selective for $NO$, while Zn substitution favors $NO_2$ detection even in ambient atmospheric conditions. Thus, these tailored $Ga_{2}O_{2}$ monolayers offer a practical platform for atmospheric monitoring and detoxification.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles density functional theory (DFT) calculations”。；研究对象：过渡金属（Pd, Zn, Zr, Mo, Ag, Ti, Pt）替代掺杂的 Ga₂O₂ 单层材料，及其对有毒工业气体和环境气体的传感与捕获性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过过渡金属替代掺杂，Ga₂O₂ 单层可从低灵敏度材料转变为具有选择性、可重复使用的室温气体传感器（如Ag掺杂对NO的优异选择性），或实现永久性分子捕获（如Ti和Pt作为通用捕获剂）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过过渡金属替代掺杂，Ga₂O₂ 单层可从低灵敏度材料转变为具有选择性、可重复使用的室温气体传感器（如Ag掺杂对NO的优异选择性），或实现永久性分子捕获（如Ti和Pt作为通用捕获剂）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，包括形成能、结合能、晶格畸变分析、分子动力学模拟（验证结构稳定性），以及吸附能、电导率变化等性能评估。

papers.title: HVAF Spraying of NiTi Coatings: Microstructure, Phase Transformation and Shape Memory Behavior
papers.abstract: Depositing various coatings on surface of engineering components with the aim to improve their performance concerning wear, corrosion, friction and thermal protection is already a standard practice. Depositing metallic NiTi shape memory alloy coatings may be a viable alternative for hard ceramic coatings. NiTi coatings offer additional benefits originating from unique functional thermomechanical properties. However, fabrication of thick NiTi coatings turned out to be difficult. Standard electroplating and laser cladding methods are not suitable for NiTi the most widely used plasma spray methods tend to produce chemically inhomogeneous coatings that do not transform martensitically, cold sprayed NiTi coatings suffer from poor adhesion to the substrates. In this work we report on first ever successful fabrication of thick NiTi coatings (100-300 um) that display functional thermomechanical properties and simultaneously show very good adherence to the substrate. We used high velocity air fuel thermal spray method to fabricate NiTi coatings deposited on mild steel using four different sets of processing parameters. Chemical composition, porosity, microstructure, phase transformation and functional thermomechanical properties of the NiTi coatings were evaluated. Although the coatings contain inhomogeneous microstructure, voids, oxide particles, high density of dislocation defects and internal stress, they undergo martensitic transformation upon cooling and or mechanical loading. As sprayed NiTi coatings need to be annealed to display functional thermomechanical properties. Despite their limited tensile strength, the coatings displayed thermal actuation in 3 point bending tests and shape memory effects in nanoindentation and scratch tests.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：HVAF spraying、fabrication、microstructure evaluation、mechanical testing。；研究对象：NiTi形状记忆合金厚涂层（100-300 μm），沉积在低碳钢基体上。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次成功制备出具有良好基体附着力和功能热机械性能（马氏体相变、热致动、形状记忆效应）的厚NiTi涂层，尽管涂层存在微观结构不均匀、孔隙、氧化物、高密度位错和内应力等缺陷。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次成功制备出具有良好基体附着力和功能热机械性能（马氏体相变、热致动、形状记忆效应）的厚NiTi涂层，尽管涂层存在微观结构不均匀、孔隙、氧化物、高密度位错和内应力等缺陷。；创新点：首次实现了厚NiTi涂层（100-300 μm）的制备，该涂层同时具备功能热机械性能和优异的基体附着力，克服了传统等离子喷涂涂层化学不均匀且不发生马氏体相变、冷喷涂涂层附着力差等难题。
papers.method_zh: 采用高速空气燃料（HVAF）热喷涂方法，使用四组不同工艺参数在低碳钢上制备NiTi涂层；通过化学组成分析、孔隙率测量、微观结构表征、相变分析以及三点弯曲测试、纳米压痕和划痕测试评估功能热机械性能。

papers.title: Curvature-driven wall accumulation in chiral active particles
papers.abstract: We study a dilute system of non-motile chiral active particles confined in geometries ranging from straight channels to circular enclosures. Activity is introduced through chiral particle-wall interactions, modeled as tangential wall forces that generate the edge currents characteristic of chiral active matter. Remarkably, although the particles lack self-propulsion, these boundary currents induce density inhomogeneities. We show that boundary curvature drives a wall accumulation phenomenon: particles remain uniformly distributed in straight channels but accumulate near the boundaries of circular confinements. Numerical simulations and a hydrodynamic theory for the density and momentum fields consistently capture this curvature-induced wall-accumulation. These results identify boundary curvature as a fundamental control parameter for chiral edge transport and confinement-induced organization, with potential experimental relevance to spinning colloids and granular spinners.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“数值模拟”和“流体动力学理论”，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：非自驱动手性活性粒子在受限几何结构（直通道、圆形围栏）中的壁面累积现象，具体涉及手性粒子与壁面的切向相互作用导致的边界流。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 边界曲率可驱动手性活性粒子在壁面累积：粒子在直通道中均匀分布，但在圆形围栏中会向边界聚集。这一现象源于手性粒子-壁面相互作用产生的边界流与几何曲率的耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：边界曲率可驱动手性活性粒子在壁面累积：粒子在直通道中均匀分布，但在圆形围栏中会向边界聚集。这一现象源于手性粒子-壁面相互作用产生的边界流与几何曲率的耦合。；创新点：首次将边界曲率识别为手性活性物质中边缘输运和受限诱导组织的基本控制参数，揭示了即使粒子无自推进，仅通过手性壁面相互作用也能产生密度不均匀性。
papers.method_zh: 采用数值模拟（具体方法未明确说明）和基于密度场与动量场的流体动力学理论进行建模与分析。

papers.title: Fermiology and spin polarization of topological surface states in PtBi$_2$
papers.abstract: Layered PtBi$_2$ is a candidate for topological superconductivity arising in Fermi-arc surface states. Using spin- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, we demonstrate that the Fermi arcs in PtBi$_2$ are singly degenerate and spin-polarized, which establishes their nontrivial topology and constitutes a necessary condition for topological superconductivity. We further uncover a pronounced surface-termination dependence of the Fermi-arc dispersion, yielding either nearly flat or approximately linear bands in agreement with first-principles calculations. Together, the observed spin polarization and termination-dependent bandwidth of the Fermi-arc surface states identify key ingredients underlying the potential emergence of topological superconductivity in PtBi$_2$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：spin- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy（自旋分辨角分辨光电子能谱）。；研究对象：层状材料 PtBi₂ 中的拓扑表面态（Fermi-arc surface states）及其费米面拓扑结构和自旋极化性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: PtBi₂ 中的费米弧表面态是单重简并且自旋极化的，这证实了其非平庸拓扑性质，并为拓扑超导的出现提供了必要条件。此外，费米弧的色散强烈依赖于表面终止层，可呈现近扁平或近似线性的能带结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：PtBi₂ 中的费米弧表面态是单重简并且自旋极化的，这证实了其非平庸拓扑性质，并为拓扑超导的出现提供了必要条件。此外，费米弧的色散强烈依赖于表面终止层，可呈现近扁平或近似线性的能带结构。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 自旋分辨角分辨光电子能谱（spin-ARPES），并结合第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）。

papers.title: Interaction-rotation driven localization-delocalization of eigenstate in Fock space: An exact diagonalization study on trapped Bose gas
papers.abstract: We investigate the localization-delocalization transition and entanglement structure in a finite system of interacting bosons in non-rotating and rotating cases. The many-body eigenspectrum is obtained via exact diagonalization within subspaces of fixed total angular momentum, and the structure of the ground state is analyzed using the inverse participation ratio (IPR), the Shannon entropy (information entropy) and the von Neumann entanglement entropy. In the non-rotating case, a transition from localized to delocalized behavior is observed with increasing interaction strength. The transition is characterized by a decrease in IPR and a corresponding increase in entropy measures, indicating spread of eigenstate weight over all the basis states in the Hilbert space. The effect becomes more pronounced with increasing number of bosons due to the increase of the Hilbert space dimension. In the presence of rotation, the system is driven further toward delocalization. For moderate angular momentum, the eigenstates exhibit partial spreading, while at higher angular momenta a saturation behavior emerges, where further increase in rotation has a limited effect on the localization properties. However, the saturation weakens with increasing system size, indicating a nontrivial interplay between rotation and number of bosons. The consistent behavior of IPR, information entropy and von Neumann entanglement entropy demonstrates that these measures provide a unified characterization of the localization-delocalization transition. The results highlight the combined role of interaction strength, rotation and number of bosons in driving the system towards delocalized state. We observe a connection between localization-delocalization and entanglement, with localized states exhibiting weaker entanglement and delocalized states showing stronger entanglement.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：exact diagonalization（精确对角化）、numerical study（数值研究）。；研究对象：非旋转和旋转情况下有限尺寸的相互作用玻色子体系，具体研究其Fock空间中的本征态局域-退局域转变及纠缠结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非旋转情况下，随相互作用增强，体系从局域态转变为退局域态；旋转会进一步驱动体系向退局域化发展，但在高角动量下出现饱和行为，且饱和程度随体系增大而减弱。局域态对应弱纠缠，退局域态对应强纠缠。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非旋转情况下，随相互作用增强，体系从局域态转变为退局域态；旋转会进一步驱动体系向退局域化发展，但在高角动量下出现饱和行为，且饱和程度随体系增大而减弱。局域态对应弱纠缠，退局域态对应强纠缠。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用固定总角动量子空间内的精确对角化方法获得多体能谱，并利用逆参与率（IPR）、香农熵（信息熵）和冯·诺依曼纠缠熵分析基态结构。

papers.title: Elastic Modulus in One-Dimensional Quantum Droplets
papers.abstract: Quantum droplets (QDs) are self-bound states of ultradilute quantum fluids stabilized by the interplay between the Lee Huang-Yang (LHY) quantum-fluctuation correction and the mean-field interaction, providing a useful platform for exploring macroscopic quantum phenomena. Recent studies on three-dimensional QDs have introduced the concept of bulk modulus and revealed its connection with the breathing-mode frequency, thereby linking the elastic response of QDs to their collective dynamics. Motivated by this progress, we investigate the elastic modulus of one-dimensional QDs. Based on a super Gaussian variational ansatz, we systematically derive the elastic modulus B and analyze its dependence on the interaction strength and particle number. The analytical predictions are further validated by numerical simulations based on imaginary time evolution and the spatial scaling method. We also establish a quantitative relation between the elastic modulus and the eigenfrequency of the breathing mode. In addition, by incorporating corrections to the droplet width beyond the Thomas Fermi approximation, we obtain the dependence of the ratio η = B/2 on the control parameters g and N. Unlike the three-dimensional case, where the corresponding ratio follows a simple power-law scaling, the one-dimensional system is affected by the soliton-to-droplet crossover, leading to a more intricate dependence of η on g and N. Our results show that, in the high-particle-number regime, the elastic modulus asymptotically approaches a limiting value determined mainly by the interaction strength, whereas in the low-particle-number regime it depends on both the particle number and the interaction strength.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：variational ansatz、analytical predictions、numerical simulations）；研究对象：一维量子液滴（one-dimensional quantum droplets）的弹性模量（elastic modulus）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 一维量子液滴的弹性模量在高粒子数极限下渐近趋于由相互作用强度决定的极限值，在低粒子数区域则同时依赖于粒子数和相互作用强度；与三维情况不同，一维体系中弹性模量与呼吸模式频率的比值η = B/2受孤子-液滴交叉影响，呈现更复杂的依赖关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：一维量子液滴的弹性模量在高粒子数极限下渐近趋于由相互作用强度决定的极限值，在低粒子数区域则同时依赖于粒子数和相互作用强度；与三维情况不同，一维体系中弹性模量与呼吸模式频率的比值η = B/2受孤子-液滴交叉影响，呈现更复杂的依赖关系。；创新点：首次系统研究一维量子液滴的弹性模量，并建立其与呼吸模式本征频率的定量关系；揭示了一维体系与三维体系在弹性响应标度行为上的本质差异（一维受孤子-液滴交叉影响，而非简单幂律标度）。
papers.method_zh: 基于超高斯变分假设（super Gaussian variational ansatz）解析推导弹性模量B，并通过虚时演化（imaginary time evolution）和空间缩放方法（spatial scaling method）进行数值模拟验证；同时引入超越托马斯-费米近似的液滴宽度修正。

papers.title: Quantifying angular momentum of coherently driven circular phonons
papers.abstract: The use of intense terahertz (THz) pulses to manipulate low-energy excitations offers a powerful approach for ultrafast control of electronic and magnetic properties in materials. Theory suggests that circular ionic motions driven by THz fields carry angular momentum, potentially generating internal magnetic fields. Recent experiments in nonmagnetic SrTiO3 (STO) have hinted at such THz-induced fields, but their origin remains debated. Here, we employ ultrafast x-ray diffraction to resolve the time-dependent ionic trajectories in STO following excitation by circularly polarized THz pulses. Our analysis reveals that oxygen ions, despite their lower mass, contribute around 90% of the phonon angular momentum. The resulting imbalance between the negatively and positively charged ions provides a clear explanation for the mechanism behind induced magnetism in STO. This work further provides the first quantitative measurement of circular ionic motions and their angular momentum and establishes a general methodology for the investigation of angular momentum transfer in solids, paving the way for new strategies to control topological phonon transport and phonon-driven magnetism in quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“ultrafast x-ray diffraction”（超快X射线衍射）作为主要研究手段，并提及“quantitative measurement”（定量测量）。；研究对象：非磁性钛酸锶（SrTiO3，STO）中由圆偏振太赫兹脉冲激发的相干圆偏振声子及其角动量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非磁性STO中，圆偏振太赫兹脉冲驱动的离子运动（圆偏振声子）携带角动量，其中质量较轻的氧离子贡献了约90%的声子角动量。正负离子角动量的不平衡是诱导出磁性的机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非磁性STO中，圆偏振太赫兹脉冲驱动的离子运动（圆偏振声子）携带角动量，其中质量较轻的氧离子贡献了约90%的声子角动量。正负离子角动量的不平衡是诱导出磁性的机制。；创新点：该工作首次对固体中的圆偏振离子运动及其角动量进行了定量测量，并建立了一套研究固体中角动量转移的通用方法。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用超快X射线衍射技术，解析了圆偏振太赫兹脉冲激发后STO中离子轨迹随时间的变化。

papers.title: Evidence for Deconfined Magnetic Order in the Kitaev-$J_3$ Model
papers.abstract: We investigate the Kitaev-$J_3$ honeycomb model using variational Monte Carlo calculations combined with a vison-quasiparticle analysis of the parent Kitaev spin liquid (KSL). We provide evidence for deconfined magnetic phases in which zigzag or antiferromagnetic order coexists with remnant $\mathbb{Z}_2$ topological structure inherited from the KSL. The optimized variational wave functions retain multiple linearly independent topological sectors on a torus, whereas those of conventional ordered phases collapse to a single sector. The vison-quasiparticle analysis shows that magnetic order naturally arises from vison-pair condensation while single visons remain gapped, yielding a microscopic mechanism for magnetic ordering without immediate confinement. The resulting phases further host gapless spinons with multiple Majorana cones, offering a possible microscopic scenario for the anomalous low-temperature longitudinal thermal transport reported in magnetically ordered Kitaev materials such as Na$_2$Co$_2$TeO$_6$. Our results reveal a microscopic route to fractionalized magnetism beyond the conventional dichotomy between magnetic order and spin-liquid behavior.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：variational Monte Carlo calculations（变分蒙特卡洛计算）、vison-quasiparticle analysis（涡旋准粒子分析）。；研究对象：Kitaev-$J_3$ 蜂窝晶格模型，以及其中可能存在的退禁闭磁性相，特别是与 Kitaev 自旋液体（KSL）相关的拓扑序和磁有序共存现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Kitaev-$J_3$ 模型中，存在退禁闭磁性相，其中之字形或反铁磁序与来自 Kitaev 自旋液体的残余 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 拓扑结构共存；磁有序源于涡旋对凝聚，而单个涡旋仍保持有能隙，从而提供了一种不立即导致禁闭的磁有序微观机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Kitaev-$J_3$ 模型中，存在退禁闭磁性相，其中之字形或反铁磁序与来自 Kitaev 自旋液体的残余 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 拓扑结构共存；磁有序源于涡旋对凝聚，而单个涡旋仍保持有能隙，从而提供了一种不立即导致禁闭的磁有序微观机制。；创新点：揭示了超越传统磁有序与自旋液体二分法的分数化磁性微观路径，并指出该相中存在的无能隙自旋子（具有多个马约拉纳锥）可能解释 Na$_2$Co$_2$TeO$_6$ 等磁性 Kitaev 材料中异常的低温纵向热输运现象。
papers.method_zh: 变分蒙特卡洛计算（variational Monte Carlo），结合对母体 Kitaev 自旋液体的涡旋准粒子分析（vison-quasiparticle analysis）。

papers.title: Density functional study of native point defects in CaO
papers.abstract: We investigate the structural, electronic, and optical properties of native point defects in CaO using first-principles density-functional calculations. Oxygen vacancies are favored under O-poor conditions, whereas calcium vacancies dominate under O-rich conditions. Calculated migration barriers and binding energies indicate that vacancy complexes are thermodynamically stable and can survive high-temperature annealing. Optical transition energies, evaluated using the Franck-Condon framework, suggest that several experimentally observed absorption and emission peaks can be attributed to negatively charged vacancy complexes as well as isolated oxygen vacancies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：first-principles density-functional calculations（第一性原理密度泛函计算）。；研究对象：CaO（氧化钙）中的本征点缺陷，包括氧空位、钙空位及其复合体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 氧空位在贫氧条件下更易形成，钙空位在富氧条件下占主导；带负电的空位复合体以及孤立氧空位可解释实验观测到的多个吸收和发射峰。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：氧空位在贫氧条件下更易形成，钙空位在富氧条件下占主导；带负电的空位复合体以及孤立氧空位可解释实验观测到的多个吸收和发射峰。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理密度泛函计算（DFT），结合Franck-Condon框架计算光学跃迁能量，并计算了迁移势垒和结合能。

papers.title: Ultrasonic Observation of Slowing Down of Multipole Fluctuations in Sr$_2$RuO$_4$
papers.abstract: We performed ultrasonic measurements on the unconventional superconductor Sr$_2$RuO$_4$ to investigate the dynamical properties of the electronic states near its superconducting transition temperature, $T_\mathrm{c} = 1.4$ K. We observed an increase in the in-plane transverse ultrasonic attenuation coefficient as the temperature approached $T_\mathrm{c}$. The ultrasonic attenuation exhibited a Landau-Khalatnikov-type ultrasonic frequency dependence with a typical relaxation time of approximately $10^{-10}$ s. Under an applied magnetic field of 10 T, the superconducting transition was suppressed. However, the ultrasonic attenuation coefficient exhibited an increase down to low temperatures, indicating the slowing down of fluctuations associated with multipole degrees of freedom. Based on group-theoretical considerations, we propose that the electric hexadecapole plays a crucial role in the slowing down. Furthermore, we discuss the relationship between multi-component superconducting order parameters and multipole degrees of freedom.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确描述了“performed ultrasonic measurements”（进行了超声测量），并报告了超声衰减系数的实验结果。；研究对象：非常规超导体 Sr₂RuO₄，具体研究其超导转变温度（Tc = 1.4 K）附近电子态的动力学性质，特别是与多极涨落相关的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Sr₂RuO₄ 中，随着温度趋近超导转变温度，面内横向超声衰减系数增大，表现出具有约 10⁻¹⁰ 秒弛豫时间的 Landau-Khalatnikov 型频率依赖关系。在 10 T 磁场下抑制超导后，超声衰减系数在低温下仍持续增大，表明与多极自由度相关的涨落发生了减速。基于群论分析，电十六极矩在该减速过程中起关键作用。

papers.title: Predicting Novel Stable Materials for Experimental Synthesis
papers.abstract: Machine-learning-accelerated materials discovery has yielded large numbers of computationally stable compounds, yet many remain experimentally unrealized, underscoring a persistent gap between prediction and synthesis. Here, we introduce a hierarchical screening framework that combines PBE-based thermodynamic stability, efficient dynamical-stability screening enabled by universal machine-learning interatomic potentials, and SCAN-based thermodynamic refinement. Applying this protocol to the 894 stable materials previously reported in Sci. Data 9, 302 (2022), we first curate 603 unique structures, of which only 298 remain thermodynamically stable on the complete PBE phase diagrams, demonstrating the critical role of competing phases in stability assessment. Dynamical screening then identifies 166 materials stable under both harmonic-phonon and finite-temperature molecular dynamics criteria, and SCAN phase diagrams further narrow this set to 109. Finally, by combining decomposition enthalpy with chemical-space completeness, we prioritize 25 candidates as high-confidence targets for experimental synthesis. This work provides a practical protocol for translating stability predictions into experimentally actionable synthesis targets, closing a key gap in machine-learning-driven materials discovery.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词包括“machine-learning-accelerated materials discovery”、“PBE-based thermodynamic stability”、“dynamical-stability screening”、“universal machine-learning interatomic potentials”、“SCAN-based thermodynamic refinement”。；研究对象：论文研究的是通过机器学习加速材料发现所预测的大量计算稳定化合物，具体针对先前报道的894种稳定材料，旨在筛选出可用于实验合成的高置信度候选材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合热力学稳定性、动力学稳定性（包括谐波声子和有限温度分子动力学）以及SCAN相图精修的多层次筛选框架，从894种候选材料中最终筛选出25种高置信度目标，显著缩小了理论预测与实验合成之间的差距。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合热力学稳定性、动力学稳定性（包括谐波声子和有限温度分子动力学）以及SCAN相图精修的多层次筛选框架，从894种候选材料中最终筛选出25种高置信度目标，显著缩小了理论预测与实验合成之间的差距。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用分层筛选框架：1）基于PBE泛函的热力学稳定性评估（考虑完整相图中的竞争相）；2）利用通用机器学习原子间势进行高效动力学稳定性筛选（包括谐波声子和有限温度分子动力学标准）；3）基于SCAN泛函的热力学精修；4）结合分解焓与化学空间完整性进行最终优先级排序。

papers.title: Quantum Heat Under the Microscope: A Perspective on Cryogenic Scanning Thermal Microscopy
papers.abstract: Exploring thermal transport at cryogenic temperatures presents both significant challenges and valuable insights. By uncovering the thermal counterpart of well-known quantum phenomena, researchers investigated fascinating phenomena ranging from the violation of the Wiedemann-Franz law to the quantisation of phonons. One key frontier remains : no existing method can image local heat transport at the nanoscale under cryogenic conditions. In this Perspective, we review the current state state of the art of local heat transport characterisation techniques and highlight their limitations. As a motivation for the development of cryogenic Scanning Thermal Microscopy, we provide five case studies illustrating how this approach could deepen our understanding of exotic quantum phases and enable the emergence of transformative technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/综述文章（Perspective）。判断依据：关键词“Perspective”、“review”、“case studies”、“motivation”。；研究对象：低温（cryogenic）条件下纳米尺度局域热输运的成像与表征，特别是量子热现象（如Wiedemann-Franz定律的违反、声子量子化）以及奇异量子相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 目前尚无能够在低温条件下对纳米尺度局域热输运进行成像的方法；发展低温扫描热显微镜（cryogenic Scanning Thermal Microscopy）有望深化对奇异量子相的理解并催生变革性技术。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：目前尚无能够在低温条件下对纳米尺度局域热输运进行成像的方法；发展低温扫描热显微镜（cryogenic Scanning Thermal Microscopy）有望深化对奇异量子相的理解并催生变革性技术。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 综述了现有局域热输运表征技术的现状与局限性，并通过五个案例研究（case studies）论证发展低温扫描热显微镜的必要性与潜在应用。摘要未提及具体实验或计算手段。

papers.title: Many-body benchmarking of DFT local-registry energetics in bilayer InSe
papers.abstract: Density functional theory (DFT) is widely used to model twisted bilayers, but the accuracy of the local stacking energetics underlying such models remains uncertain. Here, we benchmark the local-registry landscape of bilayer InSe using diffusion quantum Monte Carlo (DMC). DFT predicts that AB, AAr, and ABr stackings, which share the same interfacial Se registry, are nearly degenerate within 1.5 meV/f.u. and exhibit nearly indistinguishable DFT charge-density responses. DMC instead separates these stackings by 8(5) and 41(4) meV/f.u., while the energy difference between the most stable and least stable registries reaches 60(7) meV/f.u.. These large energy separations show that the stacking energetics are not determined by the interfacial atomic motif alone but depend on the full registry and its associated many-body electronic response. More broadly, these results show that DFT-based moiré models can substantially underestimate local stacking-energy corrugation, with direct consequences for predicted structural relaxation, domain formation, and electronic reconstruction in twisted layered materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density functional theory (DFT), diffusion quantum Monte Carlo (DMC), benchmarking。；研究对象：双层InSe（二硒化铟）中的局部堆叠能量学（local-registry energetics），特别是不同堆叠方式（AB、AAr、ABr）的能量差异及其对莫尔超晶格模型的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: DFT预测的局部堆叠能量差异很小（约1.5 meV/f.u.），而高精度的DMC计算显示这些堆叠之间的能量差异可达41(4) meV/f.u.，最稳定与最不稳定堆叠的能量差高达60(7) meV/f.u.。这表明DFT严重低估了局部堆叠能量的起伏（corrugation），且堆叠能量不仅取决于界面原子构型，还依赖于完整的堆叠序及其多体电子响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：DFT预测的局部堆叠能量差异很小（约1.5 meV/f.u.），而高精度的DMC计算显示这些堆叠之间的能量差异可达41(4) meV/f.u.，最稳定与最不稳定堆叠的能量差高达60(7) meV/f.u.。这表明DFT严重低估了局部堆叠能量的起伏（corrugation），且堆叠能量不仅取决于界面原子构型，还依赖于完整的堆叠序及其多体电子响应。；创新点：首次使用高精度DMC方法系统性地基准测试了DFT在双层InSe局部堆叠能量学中的准确性，揭示了DFT在描述莫尔超晶格中堆叠能量起伏方面的系统性低估，并指出这种低估对结构弛豫、畴形成和电子重构有直接影响。
papers.method_zh: 使用扩散量子蒙特卡洛（DMC）方法对DFT预测的双层InSe局部堆叠能量进行基准测试（benchmarking），对比DFT与DMC在电荷密度响应和能量上的差异。

papers.title: Intrinsically low thermal conductivity of stoichiometric lithium niobate:Experimental measurement and microscopic origin
papers.abstract: With the rapid development of integrated electro-optic and nonlinear optical devices based on lithium niobate (LiNbO$_3$, LN), thermal management is becoming a critical area of focus. However, experimental measurement of thermal transport in stoichiometric LiNbO$_3$ (sLN) remains scarce, and the intrinsic microscopic mechanisms remain to be established. Here, we combine the laser pump-probe technique of frequency-domain thermoreflectance (FDTR) with state-of-the-art machine-learned atomistic simulations to comprehensively investigate thermal transport in sLN. The measured and simulated room-temperature thermal conductivity ($κ$) values of sLN agree well, which are orders-of-magnitude lower than that of many classic and emerging semiconductors such as silicon. Furthermore, the temperature-dependent $κ$ exhibits a $T^{-α}$ scaling with $α$ near unity, suggesting that thermal transport is dominated by intrinsic phonon-phonon scattering. By comparing sLN with cubic boron arsenide (cBAs) which serves as an ultrahigh-$κ$ benchmark, we reveal that harmonic properties are not responsible for the low $κ$ of sLN, which feature phonon heat capacity and group velocities that are either higher than or comparable to those in cBAs. Instead, the low $κ$ originates from substantially stronger anharmonicity and larger scattering phase space. These two factors collectively suppress phonon lifetimes by 1-2 orders of magnitude, leading to a maximum phonon mean free path of approximately 140 nm. As a result, notable size effects emerge in thin-film sLN below 1 $μ$m, with $κ$ dropping to half the bulk value at 10 nm. Altogether, our findings establish a fundamental understanding of thermal transport in sLN and provide atomistic insights for thermal management in advanced lithium niobate technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。关键词：激光泵浦-探测技术（FDTR）、机器学习原子模拟。；研究对象：化学计量比铌酸锂（stoichiometric LiNbO₃, sLN）的热输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: sLN的室温热导率远低于硅等经典半导体，其低热导率并非源于声子热容或群速度的不足，而是由极强的非简谐性和更大的散射相空间导致声子寿命被抑制1-2个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：sLN的室温热导率远低于硅等经典半导体，其低热导率并非源于声子热容或群速度的不足，而是由极强的非简谐性和更大的散射相空间导致声子寿命被抑制1-2个数量级。；创新点：首次将FDTR实验与机器学习原子模拟相结合，系统揭示了sLN低热导率的微观起源，并定量比较了与超高导热材料立方砷化硼（cBAs）的谐性和非谐性差异。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用频域热反射法（FDTR）测量热导率；理论上结合最先进的机器学习原子模拟进行原子尺度计算。

papers.title: Phase-selective orbital-charge conversion in $\mathrm{MoTe_2}$
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) have emerged as promising materials for spin--orbitronics owing to their strong spin--orbit coupling and rich electronic phases. However, their orbital transport properties remain largely unexplored. Here, we demonstrate that the orbitronic response of $\mathrm{MoTe_2}$ is governed by a thickness-driven structural phase transition. RF-sputtered $\mathrm{MoTe_2}$ thin films exhibit a crossover at a critical thickness of approximately $4.5\,\mathrm{nm}$, stabilizing in the metallic $1T^\prime$ phase below this threshold and in the semiconducting $2H$ phase above it. Raman spectroscopy and scanning tunneling spectroscopy (STS) confirm the structural and electronic transition, revealing gapless behavior in ultrathin films and a finite band gap in thicker samples. Spin-pumping measurements detect an additional transverse charge-conversion signal exclusively in metallic $1T^\prime$-$\mathrm{MoTe_2}$, in agreement with first-principles calculations that identify a dominant orbital Rashba--Edelstein response as the underlying conversion mechanism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以第一性原理计算）。判断依据：摘要明确提及“RF-sputtered薄膜制备”、“Raman光谱”、“扫描隧道谱（STS）”、“自旋泵浦测量”等实验手段，并提到“第一性原理计算”作为理论支撑。；研究对象：二维过渡金属硫族化合物（TMD）MoTe₂薄膜，具体研究其厚度驱动的结构相变（1T′金属相与2H半导体相）对轨道输运（轨道-电荷转换）行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MoTe₂薄膜在约4.5 nm临界厚度处发生结构相变：超薄薄膜为金属性1T′相，较厚薄膜为半导体性2H相。仅在金属性1T′相中观测到额外的横向电荷转换信号，该信号源于轨道Rashba-Edelstein效应，而非自旋相关机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MoTe₂薄膜在约4.5 nm临界厚度处发生结构相变：超薄薄膜为金属性1T′相，较厚薄膜为半导体性2H相。仅在金属性1T′相中观测到额外的横向电荷转换信号，该信号源于轨道Rashba-Edelstein效应，而非自旋相关机制。；创新点：首次揭示了MoTe₂中厚度驱动的结构相变对轨道输运（而非自旋输运）的调控作用，并实验证实了纯轨道Rashba-Edelstein效应主导的电荷转换，拓展了对TMD材料中轨道电子学（orbitronics）行为的理解。
papers.method_zh: 射频溅射（RF-sputtering）制备MoTe₂薄膜；拉曼光谱（Raman spectroscopy）和扫描隧道谱（STS）表征结构与电子态；自旋泵浦（spin-pumping）测量检测横向电荷转换信号；第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）识别轨道Rashba-Edelstein响应机制。

papers.title: Tuning nonlinear waves in nonreciprocal active filaments
papers.abstract: The instabilities of slender structures power biological locomotion across scales, and offer a compelling method to actuate soft robots. Nonreciprocal elastic solids have been found to amplify flexural waves in one direction only, but design principles to tune and stabilize these waves are missing. Here we develop a geometrically exact theory of nonreciprocal filaments and provide simulations that capture their post-instability nonlinear dynamics. We find that nonreciprocity, when coupled to inertia or pre-stress, amplifies and advects curvature variations. The resulting one-way patterns of shape morphing can then be selected via dissipative interactions with the environment. Our work offers a continuum-based strategy for how internal stresses can drive active unidirectional waves without need for additional degrees of freedom.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。判断依据：关键词“develop a geometrically exact theory”、“provide simulations”。；研究对象：非互易活性细丝（nonreciprocal active filaments）中的非线性波动现象，具体为细长结构在非互易弹性固体中的弯曲波放大与单向传播。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非互易性与惯性或预应力的耦合可以放大并平流弯曲曲率变化，从而产生单向的形状变形模式；通过与环境耗散相互作用可调控这些模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非互易性与惯性或预应力的耦合可以放大并平流弯曲曲率变化，从而产生单向的形状变形模式；通过与环境耗散相互作用可调控这些模式。；创新点：提出了基于连续介质的设计策略，利用内部应力驱动活性单向波，无需引入额外的自由度（如额外的驱动单元或主动元件）。
papers.method_zh: 几何精确理论（geometrically exact theory）构建非互易细丝的连续介质模型，并结合数值模拟捕捉后失稳阶段的非线性动力学行为。

papers.title: Mixing induced by microswimmers as probed by mutual information
papers.abstract: We investigate fluid mixing induced by microswimmers using mutual information as a global, information-theoretic measure of mixing efficiency. For a two-dimensional squirmer model in a confined domain, we compute numerically the swimmer-generated flows and solve the advection-diffusion equation for the transport of tracer particles in the fluid. We show that the spatial distribution of swimmers strongly affects mixing, which is suppressed by swimmer aggregation and enhanced by positional and orientational disorder. At fixed energy dissipation, mixing efficiency depends non-monotonically on the squirmer parameter, with an optimal finite value arising from the balance between swimmer translation and dipolar flow generation. When hydrodynamic interactions are included, pushers outperform pullers. The mutual information as a function of time decays in three stages: an initial diffusion-dominated stage, an intermediate advection enhanced regime, and a final relaxation stage controlled by system size. Our results demonstrate that mutual information, previously validated as a measure of mixing efficiency only in simplified model systems, can equally be used in complex flows. Its application reveals that mixing by microswimmers is subject to a trade-off between the generation of strong shear flows and achieving optimal dispersion across the fluid domain.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：numerically compute、solve the advection-diffusion equation、simulation。；研究对象：微游泳者（microswimmers）在受限域内诱导的流体混合现象，具体采用二维squirmer模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 微游泳者的空间分布强烈影响混合效率：聚集抑制混合，位置和取向无序增强混合；在固定能量耗散下，混合效率随squirmer参数非单调变化，存在最优有限值；当考虑流体动力学相互作用时，pusher（推手型）优于puller（拉手型）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：微游泳者的空间分布强烈影响混合效率：聚集抑制混合，位置和取向无序增强混合；在固定能量耗散下，混合效率随squirmer参数非单调变化，存在最优有限值；当考虑流体动力学相互作用时，pusher（推手型）优于puller（拉手型）。；创新点：首次将互信息这一已在简化模型系统中验证的混合效率度量应用于复杂流动（微游泳者诱导的混合），并揭示了混合效率受强剪切流生成与最优流体域分散之间的权衡制约。
papers.method_zh: 数值计算squirmer模型产生的流场，并求解示踪粒子在流体中的平流-扩散方程；采用互信息（mutual information）作为全局信息论度量来评估混合效率。

papers.title: Nonperturbative Nonlinear Hall Effect in Nonequilibrium Steady States
papers.abstract: The nonlinear Hall effect in quantum materials has attracted broad interest, yet most existing studies focus on the weak-field, perturbative regime. Here we develop a nonperturbative approach based on nonequilibrium steady-state Green's functions for dc-field-driven lattice systems, with dissipation and interactions incorporated through self-energies beyond the constant relaxation-time approximation and interband transitions treated alongside their intraband counterparts. Applied to a two-band semimetal model, our approach provides direct access to the strong-field Hall response beyond the nonperturbative crossover where the edge of the nonequilibrium distribution reaches Berry-curvature hot spots, a regime in which constant relaxation-time estimates and Berry curvature dipole calculations become unreliable. We further demonstrate that interaction and electron-phonon self-energies within dynamical mean-field theory can substantially change the Hall signal. Our framework enables quantitative simulations of nonequilibrium nonlinear Hall phenomena and provides guidance for strong-field transport experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“develop a nonperturbative approach”、“nonequilibrium steady-state Green's functions”、“dynamical mean-field theory”。；研究对象：直流电场驱动下的晶格体系中的非线性霍尔效应，具体以两带半金属模型为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强场非微扰区域（非平衡分布边缘达到贝里曲率热点），常弛豫时间近似和贝里曲率偶极子计算变得不可靠；相互作用和电子-声子自能（通过动力学平均场理论）可显著改变霍尔信号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强场非微扰区域（非平衡分布边缘达到贝里曲率热点），常弛豫时间近似和贝里曲率偶极子计算变得不可靠；相互作用和电子-声子自能（通过动力学平均场理论）可显著改变霍尔信号。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于非平衡稳态格林函数的非微扰方法，通过自能（超越常弛豫时间近似）引入耗散和相互作用，同时处理带间和带内跃迁；结合动力学平均场理论计算自能。

papers.title: Elasto-Hydrodynamic Propulsion of a Magnetically Actuated Filament
papers.abstract: We investigate the low-Reynolds-number propulsion of a slender elastic filament with a dipolar magnetic head actuated by an oscillating field in a viscous fluid by studying its strokes and net forward motion. To capture these dynamics, we employ an elasto-hydrodynamic (EH) framework that couples Euler-Bernoulli beam mechanics with resistive force theory. Unlike prescribed-kinematics models, filament shapes here emerge self-consistently from the actuation and the force and torque boundary conditions (BCs). We demonstrate that viscous boundary contributions are crucial for quantitative agreement and show that the swimming dynamics are governed by the EH length and a magneto-viscous-elastic stroke amplitude introduced here. The swimming speed is non-monotonic with increasing ratio of the swimmer length to the EH length, and is shown to reach a maximum when the swimmer length is on the order of the EH length. We further discuss the analytical limit in which the tail BCs can be described as free, and the limitations that arise when viscous contributions to the BCs are ignored.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“investigate”（研究）、“employ an elasto-hydrodynamic (EH) framework”（采用弹性-流体动力学框架）、“demonstrate”（证明）、“discuss”（讨论），未提及任何实验数据或具体实验操作。；研究对象：在低雷诺数粘性流体中，由振荡磁场驱动的、带有偶极磁头的细长弹性细丝的推进运动。具体物理现象是弹性细丝在流固耦合作用下的自洽变形与净向前运动。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 游泳速度随游泳者长度与弹性-流体动力学（EH）长度的比值呈非单调变化，当游泳者长度与EH长度相当时，速度达到最大值。此外，粘性边界贡献对于定量准确描述该推进过程至关重要。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：游泳速度随游泳者长度与弹性-流体动力学（EH）长度的比值呈非单调变化，当游泳者长度与EH长度相当时，速度达到最大值。此外，粘性边界贡献对于定量准确描述该推进过程至关重要。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新点在于：1）提出了一个自洽的EH模型，而非预设运动学模型；2）引入了“磁-粘-弹冲程振幅”（magneto-viscous-elastic stroke amplitude）这一新参数来刻画动力学；3）明确指出了粘性边界贡献在定量计算中的关键作用，并讨论了忽略该贡献时的局限性。
papers.method_zh: 采用弹性-流体动力学（EH）理论框架，该框架将欧拉-伯努利梁力学与阻力力理论（Resistive Force Theory）耦合。与预设运动学模型不同，该模型中细丝的形状由外部驱动、力和力矩边界条件自洽地决定。

papers.title: Resonant cooling of nuclear spins by optically-oriented holes in MAPbI$_3$ perovskite crystals
papers.abstract: Resonant cooling of nuclear spins by photogenerated spin-oriented holes is demonstrated for MAPbI$_3$ perovskite crystals. It is evidenced by Hanle-effect measurements under helicity-modulated excitation with variable frequency. The resonance position in magnetic field shifts toward higher fields with increasing modulation frequency. The invariance of the Hanle curve upon in-plane sample rotation is consistent with the involvement of $^{207}$Pb nuclei with spin $I = 1/2$, which do not exhibit quadrupolar splitting. The shape of the resonance feature in the Hanle curve reveals that the nuclear spins are cooled by carriers with a negative $g$-factor, consistent with holes. The resonance fields associated with the modulation frequencies exceed the half-width of the weakly localized hole contribution to the Hanle curve, indicating that strongly localized holes are the primary carriers responsible for the nuclear spin cooling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：Hanle-effect measurements、helicity-modulated excitation、variable frequency。；研究对象：MAPbI₃钙钛矿晶体中，由光生自旋极化空穴对核自旋进行的共振冷却现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在MAPbI₃钙钛矿晶体中，通过光生自旋极化的空穴实现了对核自旋的共振冷却，且该冷却主要由强局域化的空穴主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在MAPbI₃钙钛矿晶体中，通过光生自旋极化的空穴实现了对核自旋的共振冷却，且该冷却主要由强局域化的空穴主导。；创新点：首次在MAPbI₃钙钛矿中演示了由光生自旋极化空穴对核自旋的共振冷却，并利用Hanle曲线共振特征确认了参与冷却的载流子为具有负g因子的空穴，且强局域化空穴是主要贡献者。
papers.method_zh: 采用螺旋度调制的光激发，在不同调制频率下进行Hanle效应测量，并通过改变面内样品旋转角度验证各向同性。

papers.title: Fabrication of high-quality topological insulator nanodevices from bulk-insulating air-sensitive Sb-Bi$_2$Se$_3$
papers.abstract: High-quality topological insulator (TI) materials are essential for the realization and detection of Majorana bound states (MBSs) in TI-superconductor hybrid platforms. Widely used compensated TIs exhibit substantial disorder and charge inhomogeneity, which may be detrimental for Majorana devices. In this regard, Sb-substituted Bi$_2$Se$_3$ (SBS) is promising, because it is non-compensated and yet achieves very low bulk carrier density. We systematically investigate the impact of thermal processing during microfabrication on the transport properties of SBS. We developed a room-temperature fabrication protocol that preserves the low carrier density of exfoliated SBS upon fabrication of Hall bar and nanowire devices as evidenced from the observation of quantum interference oscillations in nanowires, a large gate tunability, and clear signatures of weak antilocalization (WAL).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确描述了“fabrication”、“transport properties”、“observation of quantum interference oscillations”等实验关键词。；研究对象：拓扑绝缘体材料Sb-Bi₂Se₃（SBS）及其纳米器件（Hall bar和纳米线），重点研究其微加工过程中的热工艺对输运性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了一种室温微加工工艺，能够保持剥离的SBS材料低载流子密度，并在纳米线中观测到量子干涉振荡、大栅极可调性以及弱反局域化（WAL）的清晰特征，证明该工艺可制备高质量拓扑绝缘体纳米器件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了一种室温微加工工艺，能够保持剥离的SBS材料低载流子密度，并在纳米线中观测到量子干涉振荡、大栅极可调性以及弱反局域化（WAL）的清晰特征，证明该工艺可制备高质量拓扑绝缘体纳米器件。；创新点：针对空气敏感的Sb-Bi₂Se₃材料，系统研究了微加工中热工艺对输运性质的影响，并开发了室温制备流程，避免了传统高温工艺导致的载流子密度升高，从而获得高质量、低无序的拓扑绝缘体纳米器件。
papers.method_zh: 采用微纳加工技术（包括热工艺处理）制备Hall bar和纳米线器件，通过低温输运测量（观测量子干涉振荡、栅极调控、弱反局域化）表征材料质量。

papers.title: Generalized quantum geometry formulated through interacting vertex correlations
papers.abstract: Quantum geometry characterizes the variation of electron wavefunctions in solids along a parameter space. Conventionally, crystal momentum is chosen as the parameter, since it couples to electromagnetic fields, offering an interpretation of quantum geometry in terms of dipole matrix elements, polarization fluctuations, and optical responses. However, Bloch momentum is not the only possible parameter space in which a wavefunction can evolve. In this work, we show that quantum geometry can be extended beyond the bare Bloch-band geometry to manifolds whose adiabatic parameters represent deformations of the ground state, including collective bosonic fluctuations, external fields, or structural distortions. We show that the generalized quantum geometric tensor is encoded by correlations of interacting vertices, conjugate to the deformation parameters. By way of illustration, we briefly discuss the application of these extended geometric concepts to manifolds generated by Hubbard-Stratonovich bosonic fields, or Jahn-Teller configurational spaces. The formulation presented here is framed by general manifolds, which extend quantum geometry to generic structural, collective, and interactive many-body systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“we show”“we discuss”“formulation”等理论推导与概念构建的表述，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：量子几何的广义化框架，研究对象为多体系统中电子波函数在非布洛赫动量参数空间（如集体玻色子涨落、外场、结构畸变等）中的几何性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子几何可以超越传统的布洛赫能带几何，扩展到由基态变形（如集体激发、外场、结构畸变）所定义的流形上，其广义量子几何张量由与变形参数共轭的相互作用顶点关联函数编码。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子几何可以超越传统的布洛赫能带几何，扩展到由基态变形（如集体激发、外场、结构畸变）所定义的流形上，其广义量子几何张量由与变形参数共轭的相互作用顶点关联函数编码。；创新点：将量子几何从传统的布洛赫动量参数空间推广到一般流形（包括结构、集体、相互作用多体系统），并建立其与相互作用顶点关联函数的联系。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架构建，基于相互作用顶点关联函数与广义量子几何张量的数学对应关系，并举例讨论Hubbard-Stratonovich玻色子场流形与Jahn-Teller构型空间的应用。

papers.title: Vitriflow: calibrated amorphous structure ensembles from melt-quench simulation
papers.abstract: Melt--quench molecular dynamics is widely used to construct amorphous materials models, but the resulting ensemble is defined by choices that are often made implicitly: numerical settings, melt temperature, liquid-hold time, quench rate, system size, and post-generation screening. We introduce vitriflow, a computational materials methodology that turns these choices into an explicit decision chain. The framework couples numerical stability, descriptor-based protocol calibration, user-defined artefact screening, and statistical convergence of the generated analysis ensemble in a material-specific descriptor space. We demonstrate the approach for a-SiO$_2$, a-Si$_3$N$_4$, and a-Sm$_2$O$_3$, which respectively test tetrahedral network fidelity, MG2 $\rightarrow$ PBE $\rightarrow$ HSE06 DFT refinement of a heteropolar nitride, and amorphous/crystal discrimination in a mixed-coordination rare-earth oxide. vitriflow separates defect-free from oxygen-bridge-defective silica, quantifies DFT-refinement response in a common a-Si$_3$N$_4$ structural population, and removes recrystallised Sm$_2$O$_3$ structures without imposing fixed coordination. The result is a reproducible route for generating amorphous ensembles whose numerical settings, thermal protocol, screening actions, and statistical precision are selected from the materials question rather than assumed a priori.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：melt-quench molecular dynamics、DFT refinement、computational materials methodology。；研究对象：非晶态材料（amorphous materials）的结构模型构建，具体以a-SiO₂（非晶二氧化硅）、a-Si₃N₄（非晶氮化硅）和a-Sm₂O₃（非晶氧化钐）为演示体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为“vitriflow”的计算框架，将熔融-淬火分子动力学模拟中隐含的数值设置、热力学协议、后处理筛选等选择显式化为可重复的决策链，从而生成校准后的非晶结构系综，并成功区分了无缺陷与氧桥缺陷的二氧化硅、量化了氮化硅的DFT精炼响应、以及去除了再结晶的氧化钐结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为“vitriflow”的计算框架，将熔融-淬火分子动力学模拟中隐含的数值设置、热力学协议、后处理筛选等选择显式化为可重复的决策链，从而生成校准后的非晶结构系综，并成功区分了无缺陷与氧桥缺陷的二氧化硅、量化了氮化硅的DFT精炼响应、以及去除了再结晶的氧化钐结构。；创新点：将传统上隐含的模拟参数选择（如熔融温度、保温时间、淬火速率、系统尺寸、后处理筛选）转化为显式、可重复的决策链，并基于材料问题而非先验假设来选取数值设置、热协议、筛选操作和统计精度，从而提供了一条可复现的非晶系综生成路线。
papers.method_zh: 熔融-淬火分子动力学模拟（melt-quench molecular dynamics），结合数值稳定性检查、基于描述符的协议校准、用户定义的人工伪迹筛选、以及材料特定描述符空间中的统计收敛分析。对于a-Si₃N₄，还涉及MG2 → PBE → HSE06级别的DFT精炼（DFT refinement）。

papers.title: First passage time distribution in underdamped harmonic oscillators
papers.abstract: We derive the distribution of the first passage time $t_{fp}$ for the position $x$ of an underdamped harmonic oscillator to overcome a threshold $x_B$. As the $t_{fp}$ distribution depends on the oscillator quality factor $Q$ different approaches are used. At very large quality factor ($Q\gg 100$) and intermediate and long $t_{fp}$ the proof is based on an energy diffusion model, whereas at medium quality factor ($Q\sim 10$) the proof is based on the study of the eigenvalues of the Kramers linear differential operator with absorbing boundary conditions. For all $Q$ and short $t_{fp}$ we use a Hamiltonian approximation. The theoretical predictions are in excellent agreement with direct numerical simulations of underdamped oscillator dynamics. Finally we show that the mean of the trajectories ending at $t_{fp}$ presents a particular shape driven by a specific noise pattern.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：推导分布、基于模型（能量扩散模型、Kramers线性微分算子、哈密顿近似）、与数值模拟对比。；研究对象：欠阻尼谐振子的首次通过时间分布，具体为谐振子位置越过阈值 \(x_B\) 的首次通过时间 \(t_{fp}\) 的统计特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导了欠阻尼谐振子首次通过时间的分布，该分布依赖于谐振子品质因子 \(Q\)，且在不同 \(Q\) 和 \(t_{fp}\) 区间需采用不同理论方法；理论预测与直接数值模拟高度吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导了欠阻尼谐振子首次通过时间的分布，该分布依赖于谐振子品质因子 \(Q\)，且在不同 \(Q\) 和 \(t_{fp}\) 区间需采用不同理论方法；理论预测与直接数值模拟高度吻合。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与数值模拟相结合。具体理论框架包括：1）极高品质因子（\(Q\gg 100\)）下基于能量扩散模型的证明；2）中等品质因子（\(Q\sim 10\)）下基于含吸收边界条件的Kramers线性微分算子本征值分析的证明；3）所有 \(Q\) 下短 \(t_{fp}\) 区间采用哈密顿近似。

papers.title: First passage time for an underdamped harmonic oscillator and application to the power of an information engine
papers.abstract: The distribution of the first passage time $t_{fp}$ for the position $x$ to overcome a threshold $x_B$ is calculated in an underdamped harmonic oscillator. The proof combines several approaches based on the determination of the eigenvalues of the Kramers differential operator for the intermediate and long time regimes and on a Hamiltonian approximation for the short times. The theoretical predictions are in excellent agreement with the results of an experiment on an underdamped micro-cantilever. The knowledge of the $t_{fp}$ distribution opens the way to several applications, among them the precise estimation of the power of information engines, which we have also experimentally checked.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论+实验混合类型。关键词：计算了分布、理论预测与实验吻合、实验验证。；研究对象：欠阻尼谐振子（underdamped harmonic oscillator）的首通时间（first passage time）分布，及其在信息引擎（information engine）功率估计中的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出了欠阻尼谐振子位置越过阈值所需首通时间的分布函数，理论预测与微悬臂梁实验高度一致，并利用该分布精确估计了信息引擎的功率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出了欠阻尼谐振子位置越过阈值所需首通时间的分布函数，理论预测与微悬臂梁实验高度一致，并利用该分布精确估计了信息引擎的功率。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论方面：通过求解Kramers微分算子的本征值（用于中长时间尺度）和短时间尺度的哈密顿近似，推导首通时间分布。实验方面：使用欠阻尼微悬臂梁（micro-cantilever）进行测量验证，并进一步实验检验了信息引擎功率。

papers.title: Microscopic origins of inertial magnetization dynamics
papers.abstract: Ultrafast experiments have uncovered inertial magnetization dynamics in ferromagnets, but their microscopic origin remains elusive. Using a non-Markovian quantum master equation we show that inertial dynamics arise from coherent interactions with optical phonons in the lattice. The fast optical frequency explains the nutation observed on picosecond timescales and accounts for variations between experiments through substrate-dependent phonon damping. By establishing magnon{phonon coupling as the microscopic basis of inertial magnetization, our results open new pathways for tailoring ultrafast spin dynamics and controlling magnetic states at terahertz frequencies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：使用非马尔可夫量子主方程（non-Markovian quantum master equation）进行理论推导与分析。；研究对象：铁磁体中的惯性磁化动力学（inertial magnetization dynamics），特别是与光学声子（optical phonons）的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 惯性磁化动力学源于磁振子与晶格中光学声子的相干相互作用。光学声子的快速频率解释了皮秒时间尺度上观测到的章动（nutation）现象，并通过衬底依赖的声子阻尼解释了不同实验间的差异。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：惯性磁化动力学源于磁振子与晶格中光学声子的相干相互作用。光学声子的快速频率解释了皮秒时间尺度上观测到的章动（nutation）现象，并通过衬底依赖的声子阻尼解释了不同实验间的差异。；创新点：首次将磁振子-声子耦合（magnon-phonon coupling）确立为惯性磁化动力学的微观基础，为在太赫兹频率下调控超快自旋动力学和磁态提供了新途径。摘要未突出说明与以往唯象模型的具体区别。
papers.method_zh: 非马尔可夫量子主方程（non-Markovian quantum master equation）理论框架。

papers.title: Quantum Tunneling-induced Hybridization and Coherent Dynamics of Jackiw-Rebbi Zero Modes in a Modified Su-Schrieffer-Heeger Chain
papers.abstract: We investigate analytically and numerically the tunneling-induced hybridization and coherent dynamics of Jackiw-Rebbi (JR) zero modes in a modified Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) model. Unlike the conventional SSH model, this modified system possess two bulk gap closing points, namely, the quadratic-type gap closing point at $k=0$ and the Dirac-type gap closing point at $k=\pmπ/4a$. While the quadratic point does not support a topological domain wall due to the absence of mass inversion, the low-energy Dirac theory around $k=\pmπ/4a$ predicts an effective mass that changes sign at two spatially separated interfaces under a kink profile, generating a pair of JR bound states localized at those interfaces. We show that finite overlap between the JR zero modes lifts the zero-energy degeneracy through quantum tunneling, producing symmetric-antisymmetric hybridized states analogous to a quantum mechanical double-well system. An effective two-level description reveals coherent oscillations of the occupation probability between the two JR modes, accompanied by periodic transfer of sublattice polarization between the (A,C) and (B,D) sectors. The oscillation period is governed by the hybridization gap, providing a tunable route for controlling topological bound states. Our results establish a unified framework connecting JR zero modes, quantum tunneling, and coherent dynamics in modified SSH systems, offering a promising platform for controllable topological quantum-state transfer in engineered lattice structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“analytically and numerically investigate”（解析和数值研究），未提及实验手段。；研究对象：修改版Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）链中的Jackiw-Rebbi（JR）零模，具体研究其通过量子隧穿诱导的杂化与相干动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在修改版SSH模型中，两个空间分离界面处的JR零模通过量子隧穿效应发生杂化，形成类似量子力学双势阱系统的对称-反对称杂化态，导致占据概率在两JR模之间发生相干振荡，振荡周期由杂化能隙决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在修改版SSH模型中，两个空间分离界面处的JR零模通过量子隧穿效应发生杂化，形成类似量子力学双势阱系统的对称-反对称杂化态，导致占据概率在两JR模之间发生相干振荡，振荡周期由杂化能隙决定。；创新点：揭示了修改版SSH体系中JR零模、量子隧穿与相干动力学的统一框架，提供了通过调控杂化能隙实现可控拓扑量子态转移的途径。
papers.method_zh: 解析低能Dirac理论（围绕k=±π/4a展开）预测有效质量符号反转；数值计算（摘要未明确说明具体数值方法，如紧束缚模型对角化等）验证隧穿诱导的杂化与动力学。

papers.title: From Dirac Cones to Semions: An Exact Finite-Size Theory of Parity-Anomaly Transport in Chiral Spin Liquids
papers.abstract: Chiral spin liquids carry a hidden bookkeeping problem: the integer Chern number of their fractionalized spinons, the level of the emergent Chern--Simons gauge field, and the fractional spin response actually measured in experiment or simulation are related but distinct quantities, and the literature routinely conflates them. Here we resolve this by deriving the exact parity-odd determinant of a gapped Dirac cone on a spatial cylinder, resummed to all orders in the compact holonomy rather than truncated at leading order. The result proves that finite-circumference corrections to the topological response are strictly exponential, with no universal $1/L$ term, and fixes the precise map from microscopic spinon Chern number to physical spin Hall conductance. We validate this chain of reasoning on the kagome lattice at three independent levels: an exact parton band-structure calculation ($C=-1$, converging exponentially over cylinders four to twelve sites wide), and an interacting density-matrix renormalization group flux pump ($ν_s=-0.500\pm0.011$) that agrees with the analytic prediction without any adjustable parameter. Together, these results turn a one-loop anomaly calculation into a quantitatively verified bridge between microscopic topology and observable fractional response.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算验证）。判断依据：推导了精确的宇称奇性行列式，并结合了精确的准粒子能带计算和密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）通量泵计算。；研究对象：手性自旋液体中的宇称反常输运，具体研究狄拉克锥到半子（semion）的拓扑响应，以及微观自旋子陈数与物理自旋霍尔电导之间的精确映射。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了有限周长对拓扑响应的修正是指数衰减的，不存在普遍的1/L项；并精确建立了从微观自旋子陈数到物理自旋霍尔电导的映射关系，在kagome晶格上通过无任何可调参数的DMRG计算（ν_s=-0.500±0.011）验证了理论预测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了有限周长对拓扑响应的修正是指数衰减的，不存在普遍的1/L项；并精确建立了从微观自旋子陈数到物理自旋霍尔电导的映射关系，在kagome晶格上通过无任何可调参数的DMRG计算（ν_s=-0.500±0.011）验证了理论预测。；创新点：解决了文献中长期混淆的整数陈数、陈-西蒙斯规范场能级与分数化自旋响应之间的对应关系，将单圈反常计算转化为可定量验证的微观拓扑与可观测分数化响应之间的桥梁。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导了空间圆柱上带隙狄拉克锥的精确宇称奇性行列式（对紧致holonomy全阶求和而非截断至领头阶）；数值上采用精确的准粒子能带结构计算（C=-1，在4至12格点宽的圆柱上指数收敛）以及相互作用的密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）通量泵计算。

papers.title: A Fuzzy Sphere Journey in Critical Phenomena
papers.abstract: This review discusses the recently proposed fuzzy sphere regularization for studying $2+1$D critical phenomena, particularly three-dimensional (3D) conformal field theory (CFT). The fuzzy sphere scheme not only offers remarkable efficiency in extracting extensive CFT data at low computational cost but also reveals unexpected connections among 3D CFT (critical phenomena), noncommutative geometry, and the quantum Hall effect. We introduce the fundamental ideas of fuzzy sphere regularization, emphasizing its role in demonstrating the state-operator correspondence of 3D CFTs on the $S^2 \times \mathbb{R}$ geometry. Additionally, we review key developments in this approach across various directions and outline potential future applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（综述）。关键词：review、fuzzy sphere regularization、CFT、critical phenomena。；研究对象：2+1维临界现象，特别是三维共形场论（3D CFT），以及与之相关的非对易几何和量子霍尔效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 模糊球正则化方案不仅能够以低计算成本高效提取大量共形场论数据，还揭示了三维共形场论（临界现象）、非对易几何与量子霍尔效应之间意想不到的联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：模糊球正则化方案不仅能够以低计算成本高效提取大量共形场论数据，还揭示了三维共形场论（临界现象）、非对易几何与量子霍尔效应之间意想不到的联系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 模糊球正则化方法（fuzzy sphere regularization），用于在 \( S^2 \times \mathbb{R} \) 几何上实现三维共形场论的态-算符对应。

papers.title: Ising superconductivity and anomalous metallic states in a bulk crystal with artificial unidirectional stacking layers
papers.abstract: The two-dimensional (2D) limit in macroscopic bulk crystals provides a powerful platform for exploring exotic quantum phases. Here, we report the synthesis of a Sr0.75ClNbS2 superconductor that achieves unidirectional, parallel AA stacking-a configuration never before realized in a bulk crystal. Unlike conventional intercalation, which merely expands the interlayer spacing, our approach employs a planar Sr-Cl network to enforce a complete stacking reorganization, driving all NbS2 layers from the native antiparallel AB stacking into a unidirectional, parallel AA arrangement. This stacking switch globally breaks inversion symmetry, transforming centrosymmetric 2H-NbS2 into a noncentrosymmetric bulk crystal with D3h point group symmetry. Crucially, this structural design reproduces, in three dimensions, the electronic environment of an isolated monolayer, thereby preventing cancellation of the local Ising fields. As a result, strong Ising spin-orbit coupling and spin-split bands persist throughout the bulk. Transport measurements reveal extreme superconducting anisotropy (γ ~ 77), an in-plane upper critical field (~ 10.65 T) that far exceeds the Pauli paramagnetic limit, and clean-limit superconductivity indicative of high crystalline quality. Moreover, magnetotransport uncovers a novel magnetic-field-induced anomalous metallic state characterized by finite dissipation yet a vanishing Hall response. Direct band-structure measurements corroborate the layer-decoupled, quasi-2D electronic nature of the system. This work establishes stacking-geometry engineering as a powerful strategy to artificially enforce a globally noncentrosymmetric, quasi-2D superconducting state in bulk crystals, paving the way for designing quantum materials with tunable crystalline symmetry and electronic band topology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：synthesis（合成）、transport measurements（输运测量）、magnetotransport（磁输运）、direct band-structure measurements（直接能带结构测量）。；研究对象：一种通过人工单向堆叠层实现的新型块体超导体 Sr₀.₇₅ClNbS₂，以及其中出现的伊辛超导和反常金属态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过平面 Sr-Cl 网络将 NbS₂ 层从反平行 AB 堆叠强制转变为单向平行 AA 堆叠，在块体晶体中实现了全局非中心对称的准二维伊辛超导态，并观测到极端超导各向异性、远超泡利顺磁极限的上临界场，以及一种由磁场诱导的、具有有限耗散但霍尔响应消失的反常金属态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过平面 Sr-Cl 网络将 NbS₂ 层从反平行 AB 堆叠强制转变为单向平行 AA 堆叠，在块体晶体中实现了全局非中心对称的准二维伊辛超导态，并观测到极端超导各向异性、远超泡利顺磁极限的上临界场，以及一种由磁场诱导的、具有有限耗散但霍尔响应消失的反常金属态。；创新点：首次在块体晶体中实现单向平行 AA 堆叠，通过堆叠几何工程人为打破全局反演对称性，将二维伊辛自旋-轨道耦合效应扩展到三维块体，从而在宏观晶体中复现孤立单层的电子环境，并发现新型反常金属态。
papers.method_zh: 采用化学合成方法制备 Sr₀.₇₅ClNbS₂ 单晶；通过输运测量（包括上临界场、各向异性）和磁输运测量表征超导和反常金属态；结合直接能带结构测量（如角分辨光电子能谱，摘要未明确具体技术）验证层解耦的准二维电子性质。

papers.title: On the limits of the energetic coupling between field dislocation mechanics and phase field crystal
papers.abstract: This paper investigates the energetic coupling between Field Dislocation Mechanics (FDM) and the Phase Field Crystal (PFC) model proposed in Phys. Rev. B 102, 064109, 2020. While FDM correctly solves the initial boundary value problem of a continuum body with dislocation fields, PFC captures the underlying crystallographic structure. The coupling, which penalizes the $L^2$ distance between elastic distortion from FDM and configurational distortion from PFC in the $L^2$ sense, had been proposed to reconcile dislocation mechanics with crystallography in a single continuum framework. Variational analysis reveals that the coupling term acts as a divergence-driven forcing in the phase-field evolution that matches only the compatible (curl-free) parts of the distortion fields. Consequently, its contributions are insensitive to the incompatible (divergence-free) elastic distortion carrying all the information on dislocation topology. Furthermore, the nature of the configurational distortion causes mechanical boundary conditions to be transmitted diffusively from FDM to PFC rather than elastically. Numerical simulations demonstrate that this coupling cannot prevent the unnatural core spreading in FDM. Finally, it is shown that even in the most general case, an energetic coupling suffers from the same drawbacks, which limits its ability to integrate dislocation mechanics with crystallography.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：variational analysis、numerical simulations、energetic coupling。；研究对象：场位错力学（FDM）与相场晶体（PFC）模型之间的能量耦合机制，旨在将位错力学与晶体学整合到单一连续介质框架中。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该能量耦合项仅能匹配畸变场中相容（无旋）的部分，而对携带位错拓扑信息的不相容（无散）弹性畸变不敏感；且该耦合无法阻止FDM中非自然的位错核扩展，因此其整合位错力学与晶体学的能力存在根本局限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该能量耦合项仅能匹配畸变场中相容（无旋）的部分，而对携带位错拓扑信息的不相容（无散）弹性畸变不敏感；且该耦合无法阻止FDM中非自然的位错核扩展，因此其整合位错力学与晶体学的能力存在根本局限。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 变分分析（variational analysis）与数值模拟（numerical simulations）。具体基于Phys. Rev. B 102, 064109 (2020)提出的FDM-PFC耦合模型，通过L²范数惩罚FDM弹性畸变与PFC构型畸变之间的差异。

papers.title: Quantum mutual information as a robust probe of integrability in open quantum systems
papers.abstract: The dynamics of a quantum system encode signatures of whether the underlying Hamiltonian is integrable or chaotic, giving rise to the concept of quantum information scrambling through the properties of the resulting dynamical states or operators. We introduce an information-theoretic framework based on the Haar-averaged sum of total correlations (aSTC), together with average genuine multipartite entanglement generated dynamically from initially fully separable states, as robust probes of quantum information scrambling. Using the long-range quantum XYZ spin model in transverse and longitudinal magnetic fields, whose integrable limit is the nearest-neighbor transverse XY model, we demonstrate that the long-time average and, more importantly, the temporal fluctuations of the aSTC provide a faithful and system-size-independent signature of integrable and chaotic dynamics, similar to the conventional measure of scrambling, out-of-time-ordered correlator (OTOC). When the system is in contact with the thermal reservoir and system-bath coupling follows Markovianity, we find that the fluctuations of the aSTC and OTOC continue to distinguish integrable and chaotic dynamics only at intermediate times. However, we observe that in the non-Markovian domain, information backflow restores the scrambling dynamics, enabling the aSTC to retain its distinguishing power even at long times. Interestingly, we exhibit that, under Markovian amplitude damping and non-Markovian dephasing noise, the temporal fluctuations of the aSTC can discriminate between integrability and non-integrability in the weak Markovian regime, even when OTOC fails to do so.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：information-theoretic framework、Haar-averaged sum、quantum information scrambling、Markovianity、non-Markovian。；研究对象：开放量子系统中的可积性与混沌动力学，具体以长程量子XYZ自旋模型（在横向和纵向磁场中）为测试体系，其可积极限为近邻横向XY模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于Haar平均的总关联和（aSTC）及其时间涨落，在封闭和开放量子系统中均可作为区分可积与混沌动力学的稳健探针；在非马尔可夫噪声下，aSTC在长时间尺度仍能保持区分能力，且在弱马尔可夫振幅阻尼和非马尔可夫退相位噪声下，aSTC的涨落甚至能在OTOC失效时仍有效区分可积性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于Haar平均的总关联和（aSTC）及其时间涨落，在封闭和开放量子系统中均可作为区分可积与混沌动力学的稳健探针；在非马尔可夫噪声下，aSTC在长时间尺度仍能保持区分能力，且在弱马尔可夫振幅阻尼和非马尔可夫退相位噪声下，aSTC的涨落甚至能在OTOC失效时仍有效区分可积性。；创新点：首次提出将Haar平均的总关联和（aSTC）作为开放量子系统中可积性的鲁棒探针，并发现其在非马尔可夫噪声下及OTOC失效的弱马尔可夫区域仍能有效区分可积与混沌动力学。
papers.method_zh: 采用信息论框架，计算Haar平均的总关联和（aSTC）及其时间涨落，并与传统混沌探针——离时有序关联子（OTOC）进行对比。系统与热库的耦合分别考虑马尔可夫和非马尔可夫两种情形（具体包括马尔可夫振幅阻尼和非马尔可夫退相位噪声）。

papers.title: On a Rosenzweig-Porter-type model
papers.abstract: We consider a very general Rosenzweig-Porter-type model, $H=H_0+λW$, where $H_0$ is an arbitrary Hermitian matrix and $W$ is a standard Wigner matrix. We precisely trace the localization properties of the eigenvectors and the eigenstate thermalisation hypothesis (ETH) as the coupling constant $λ$ interpolates between the trivial $λ=0$ case and the fully mean field regime of large $λ$. Our results hold uniformly in $H_0$ and $λ$, substantially generalising all previous local laws on deformed Wigner matrices even in the mean field regime. Our proof precisely captures the deterministic approximation to the resolvent which exhibits a strongly inhomogeneous structure. As a byproduct, we conclude the emergence of a mobility edge and study the phenomenon of re-entrant localization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：考虑模型、证明、确定性近似、结论。；研究对象：Rosenzweig-Porter 型随机矩阵模型，具体为形如 \( H = H_0 + \lambda W \) 的哈密顿量，其中 \( H_0 \) 为任意厄米矩阵，\( W \) 为标准 Wigner 矩阵。研究该模型的本征态局域化性质及本征态热化假说（ETH）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 精确刻画了当耦合常数 \( \lambda \) 从 0 变化到大值（平均场区域）时，本征向量局域化性质及 ETH 的演化轨迹；作为副产品，发现了迁移率边的出现并研究了重入局域化现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：精确刻画了当耦合常数 \( \lambda \) 从 0 变化到大值（平均场区域）时，本征向量局域化性质及 ETH 的演化轨迹；作为副产品，发现了迁移率边的出现并研究了重入局域化现象。；创新点：该结果对任意厄米矩阵 \( H_0 \) 和所有耦合常数 \( \lambda \) 一致成立，极大推广了以往仅在平均场区域成立的变形 Wigner 矩阵局部律；精确捕捉了预解式的强非均匀确定性近似，并由此揭示了迁移率边和重入局域化现象。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，具体包括对预解式的确定性近似，该近似呈现出强非均匀结构。证明结果对 \( H_0 \) 和 \( \lambda \) 一致成立，显著推广了以往关于变形 Wigner 矩阵的局部律。

papers.title: Mesoscopic Linear Statistics for Two Ensembles of Quantum Graphs
papers.abstract: We study mesoscopic linear spectral statistics for two ensembles of random quantum graphs. These are defined by a discrete graph $G$ and a unitary-matrix-valued function $U(k)$ indexed by directed edges of $G$. The matrix function $U(k)$ is constructed from unitary matrices $U^{(v)}$ indexed by the neighbours of each vertex $v$. The first ensemble is obtained by sampling the underlying discrete graph uniformly from the set of $d$-regular graphs. The second ensemble is obtained by sampling $U^{(v)}$ uniformly from the Haar measure, independently for each vertex. We prove that the variance of a linear spectral statistic in the large graph limit on polynomial mesoscopic scales coincides with that of the Gaussian Orthogonal/Unitary Ensemble.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：研究、证明、线性统计量、方差、大图极限。；研究对象：两类随机量子图系综的介观线性谱统计。具体定义为：由离散图 \( G \) 和一个由有向边索引的幺正矩阵值函数 \( U(k) \) 构成的量子图，其中 \( U(k) \) 由每个顶点 \( v \) 的邻居索引的幺正矩阵 \( U^{(v)} \) 构造。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在大图极限下，多项式介观尺度上的线性谱统计量的方差与高斯正交系综/高斯幺正系综的方差一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在大图极限下，多项式介观尺度上的线性谱统计量的方差与高斯正交系综/高斯幺正系综的方差一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。第一类系综：从 \( d \)-正则图集合中均匀采样底层离散图；第二类系综：对每个顶点独立地从 Haar 测度中均匀采样 \( U^{(v)} \)。通过数学证明得到方差结果。

papers.title: Grounded autonomous research: a fault-tolerant LLM pipeline from corpus to manuscript in frontier computational physics
papers.abstract: Autonomous-research agents have demonstrated end-to-end LLM automation in machine-learning sandboxes where execution provides calibration. Frontier physical science differs categorically: physical reasoning underlies every methodology choice, toolchains are often underdocumented, and calibration must come from external literature anchors - which unscaffolded agents cite but do not confront, hallucinating plausible, unverifiable results from internal priors. We present a pipeline that runs end-to-end from a corpus of 11,083 recent condensed-matter physics arXiv papers to a publication-grade manuscript with three substantive physics findings (here on altermagnetic piezomagnetism): the agent autonomously conceives a research direction by mapping the corpus, calibrates methodology by reproducing published references, conducts novel first-principles computations, and writes the manuscript - grounded in literature throughout, across 47 fresh-context sessions in six phases sharing only on-disk state, with 2,162 literature-consultation events. Fault tolerance emerges from redundancy: fresh-context isolation, distributed grounding, and adversarial review catch what any single session misses; pre- and post-pilot stages are fully autonomous, and pilot requires bounded human intervention only at reproduction failures - operational knowledge curation, not scientific direction. Two paired failure modes - a pre-architecture baseline and a no-pilot ablation - isolate structurally enforced numerical confrontation at calibration checkpoints as the operative grounding mechanism. The primitives, characterized failure modes, and quantified intervention pattern lay a foundation for autonomous research in high-stakes scientific domains beyond computational physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算+方法论）。判断依据：摘要提及“first-principles computations”（第一性原理计算），同时核心贡献是提出并验证了一个基于LLM的自动化研究管线（方法论）。；研究对象：论文研究的物理现象是**交变磁体中的压电性（altermagnetic piezomagnetism）**。具体材料体系摘要未明确说明，但研究基于对11,083篇近期凝聚态物理arXiv论文的语料库分析。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作证明，一个基于LLM的自动化研究管线能够端到端地从文献语料出发，自主构思研究方向、校准方法、进行原创第一性原理计算，并最终生成具有三个实质性物理发现的、达到发表级别的学术手稿。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作证明，一个基于LLM的自动化研究管线能够端到端地从文献语料出发，自主构思研究方向、校准方法、进行原创第一性原理计算，并最终生成具有三个实质性物理发现的、达到发表级别的学术手稿。；创新点：该工作的主要新意在于：1）提出了一个**容错（fault-tolerant）**的端到端自动化研究管线，专门针对前沿物理科学（而非机器学习沙盒环境）；2）通过**结构化强制数值核对（structurally enforced numerical confrontation）**作为核心锚定机制，解决了LLM在缺乏外部校准时的幻觉问题；3）量化了失败模式与人工干预模式，为高风险科学领域的自主研究奠定了基础。
papers.method_zh: 核心方法是**基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动化研究管线**。具体包括：1）对11,083篇凝聚态物理arXiv论文进行语料库映射；2）通过复现已发表文献来校准方法论（reproducing published references）；3）进行原创的第一性原理计算（first-principles computations）。管线采用47个全新上下文会话（fresh-context sessions），分六个阶段运行，共享磁盘状态，并包含2162次文献咨询事件。其容错机制包括冗余设计（全新上下文隔离、分布式锚定、对抗性审查）以及一个需要有限人工干预的“试运行（pilot）”阶段。

papers.title: Molecular interpretability of the bulk electrochemical impedance of concentrated electrolytes
papers.abstract: Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) is a widely used technique to understand time-dependent response and relaxation under applied voltage. While these spectra contain a wealth of information, major gaps in our understanding can hinder our ability to interpret EIS spectra in terms of microscopic chemical mechanisms. We propose an alternative approach to common empirical fitting procedures for describing the contribution of the bulk electrolyte to the EIS spectrum. This new approach is rooted in determining the moments of the frequency-dependent conductivity, with molecular interpretability provided by a generalized Langevin equation description of an effective single particle dynamics; the `itinerant oscillator' (IO) model. In contrast to a Debye--Falkenhagen description, the IO model makes no assumptions regarding the concentration of the electrolyte, a fact we demonstrate by analysing molecular dynamics simulations of a room-temperature ionic liquid. By analysing the memory function from simulation within the framework provided by the IO model, we reveal the importance of capturing the separation of timescales within the memory function for describing the temperature dependent $β$-relaxation process. We go on to show how our impedance model directly reports on this distribution of timescales while retaining the simplicity of commonly employed workflows.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：generalized Langevin equation、molecular dynamics simulations、memory function。；研究对象：浓电解质（包括室温离子液体）的体相电化学阻抗谱（EIS）的微观分子解释。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出基于“游走振子”（itinerant oscillator, IO）模型的阻抗分析方法，能够不依赖电解质浓度假设，通过记忆函数中的时间尺度分离来揭示温度依赖的β弛豫过程，并直接报告时间尺度分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出基于“游走振子”（itinerant oscillator, IO）模型的阻抗分析方法，能够不依赖电解质浓度假设，通过记忆函数中的时间尺度分离来揭示温度依赖的β弛豫过程，并直接报告时间尺度分布。；创新点：提出了一种替代常见经验拟合的新方法，该方法不假设电解质浓度（适用于浓溶液和离子液体），并通过记忆函数的时间尺度分离直接关联微观弛豫机制与阻抗谱的简单工作流程。
papers.method_zh: 采用广义朗之万方程描述有效单粒子动力学，结合分子动力学模拟分析记忆函数，并利用游走振子（IO）模型替代传统的Debye-Falkenhagen描述来拟合体相电解质阻抗谱。

papers.title: Pressure-drop localization and momentum insulation in liquid-gas coexistence Poiseuille flow
papers.abstract: We study pressure-driven Poiseuille flow of a one-component fluid between adiabatic plates in liquid-gas coexistence. The analysis uses Poiseuille flow and Fourier heat conduction in the bulk regions together with particle and energy conservation. From these bulk equations, we identify extremely small dimensionless parameters $A^\mathrm{L}$ and $A^\mathrm{G}$ describing coexistence Poiseuille flow, whose smallness comes from squared microscopic-to-macroscopic length ratios. In weak driving with macroscopic liquid and gas regions, the pressure difference is concentrated across the interfacial region, and the ordinary Poiseuille particle current is strongly reduced. For equal-temperature reservoirs, this residual particle current produces interfacial cooling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“分析”“从体相方程识别”“描述”等理论推导术语，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：液-气共存态下单一组分流体的压力驱动泊肃叶流动（Poiseuille flow），具体关注两相共存时流动中的压力降局域化与动量绝缘现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在宏观液-气区域共存的弱驱动泊肃叶流动中，压力差集中在界面区域，导致普通泊肃叶粒子流被强烈抑制；当储层温度相等时，残余粒子流会引起界面冷却。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在宏观液-气区域共存的弱驱动泊肃叶流动中，压力差集中在界面区域，导致普通泊肃叶粒子流被强烈抑制；当储层温度相等时，残余粒子流会引起界面冷却。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于体相区域的泊肃叶流动方程和傅里叶热传导方程，结合粒子守恒与能量守恒，通过识别描述共存泊肃叶流动的极小无量纲参数 \(A^\mathrm{L}\) 和 \(A^\mathrm{G}\)（其小量性源于微观-宏观长度比的平方）进行理论分析。

papers.title: One More Time: Revisiting Neural Quantum States from a Reinforcement Learning Perspective
papers.abstract: Neural quantum states (NQS) provide a flexible and scalable framework for approximating quantum many-body wavefunctions. Among NQS parameterizations, autoregressive models are especially attractive because they enable exact, independent sampling from the Born distribution, avoiding the autocorrelation and mixing issues of Markov chain methods. Yet their optimization remains comparatively underexplored: Adam is a scalable method but ignores function space geometry, while stochastic reconfiguration is principled but costly and numerically fragile in large models. To address this gap, we show that variational energy minimization can be viewed as an advantage policy-gradient problem over the Born distribution, motivating trust-region optimization for NQS training. We introduce Proximal Wavefunction Optimization (PWO), a principled trust-region algorithm that clips probability-ratio changes in the amplitude channel and phase increments in the phase channel. PWO avoids explicit matrix inversion, reuses samples across multiple updates, and combines the scalability of first-order optimization with theoretical guarantees. Across Ising and frustrated $J_1$-$J_2$ one- and two-dimensional spin systems, PWO improves stability and wall-clock convergence over Adam, minSR, and SPRING. Finally, we fine-tune a $1.5$B-parameter RWKV-7 model, demonstrating NQS optimization at a scale over three orders of magnitude beyond prior work.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Neural quantum states (NQS)、autoregressive models、trust-region optimization、variational energy minimization。；研究对象：量子多体波函数近似，具体测试体系为伊辛模型和阻挫J1-J2自旋系统（一维和二维），以及一个15亿参数的RWKV-7模型（用于展示大规模优化能力）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为Proximal Wavefunction Optimization (PWO)的信任域算法，该算法在振幅通道和相位通道分别进行概率比裁剪和相位增量裁剪，避免了显式矩阵求逆，在稳定性和收敛速度上优于Adam、minSR和SPRING等现有方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为Proximal Wavefunction Optimization (PWO)的信任域算法，该算法在振幅通道和相位通道分别进行概率比裁剪和相位增量裁剪，避免了显式矩阵求逆，在稳定性和收敛速度上优于Adam、minSR和SPRING等现有方法。；创新点：首次将神经量子态（NQS）的优化问题从强化学习中的策略梯度视角进行系统分析，并据此设计了无需显式矩阵求逆的信任域算法PWO，同时展示了在15亿参数规模上的优化能力，远超此前工作。
papers.method_zh: 将变分能量最小化重新表述为基于Born分布的优势策略梯度问题，并引入信任域优化算法PWO。该方法结合了随机重配置的几何原则与一阶优化的可扩展性，通过裁剪概率比和相位增量实现稳定更新，并复用样本进行多次更新。

papers.title: Bockstein braiding statistics
papers.abstract: Braiding statistics, from the Aharonov-Bohm phase to anyons in fractional quantum Hall systems, play a central role in quantum physics. For $p$- and $q$-dimensional excitations in $d$ spatial dimensions, ordinary braiding requires $p+q=d-2$. In a field-theoretic description of $\mathbb Z_N$ excitations, ordinary braiding is described by the linking response $(2πi/N)\int A_{d-p}\cup B_{d-q}$, where $A_{d-p}$ and $B_{d-q}$ are background fields coupled to the two excitation types. In this work, we identify new mutual statistics in the adjacent case $p+q=d-1$. For two invertible excitations obeying $\mathbb Z_N$ fusion, one can choose local creation operators $X$ and $Y$ whose supports have a staggered one-dimensional overlap. The closed unitary process $W_N(X,Y)=(Y^{-1}X^{-1})^N(YX)^N$ measures the resulting mutual statistic. Its field-theory description is $(2πi/N)\int A_{d-p}\cupβ_N B_{d-q}$, where $β_N$ is the Bockstein operation; we therefore call the invariant Bockstein braiding statistics. The construction yields particle-particle statistics in one dimension, particle-loop statistics in two dimensions, and loop-loop or particle-membrane statistics in three dimensions. Nontrivial Bockstein braiding statistics obstructs simultaneous condensation of the two $\mathbb Z_N$ excitations. It also rules out a fully symmetric gapped phase for systems with the corresponding mixed anomaly and implies symmetry fractionalization when one of the $\mathbb Z_N$ symmetries is broken.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：field-theoretic description、braiding statistics、Bockstein operation。；研究对象：空间维度中不同维度（p维和q维）的激发子（excitations）之间的编织统计（braiding statistics），特别是当p+q=d-1时的相邻情况（adjacent case），以及与之相关的Bockstein编织统计。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在p+q=d-1的相邻情况下，对于服从Z_N融合规则的可逆激发子，存在一种新的互统计（mutual statistics），称为Bockstein编织统计。该统计由场论中的(2πi/N)∫ A_{d-p} ∪ β_N B_{d-q}描述，其中β_N是Bockstein操作。非平凡的Bockstein编织统计会阻碍两个Z_N激发子的同时凝聚，并排除具有相应混合反常的系统的完全对称有能隙相。
