papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在p+q=d-1的相邻情况下，对于服从Z_N融合规则的可逆激发子，存在一种新的互统计（mutual statistics），称为Bockstein编织统计。该统计由场论中的(2πi/N)∫ A_{d-p} ∪ β_N B_{d-q}描述，其中β_N是Bockstein操作。非平凡的Bockstein编织统计会阻碍两个Z_N激发子的同时凝聚，并排除具有相应混合反常的系统的完全对称有能隙相。；创新点：识别并定义了在p+q=d-1这一相邻维度情况下的新互统计——Bockstein编织统计，填补了传统编织统计（要求p+q=d-2）之外的空白。该工作将编织统计推广到了更一般的维度组合，并揭示了其与混合反常、对称性分数化等物理现象的关联。
papers.method_zh: 采用场论描述（field-theoretic description），通过引入背景场A_{d-p}和B_{d-q}，并利用Bockstein操作β_N来定义新的编织统计量。通过构造局域产生算符X和Y以及封闭幺正过程W_N(X,Y)来测量该统计。

papers.title: A transition-metal qubit in diamond with all-optical control and millisecond quantum memory
papers.abstract: Quantum networks require qubits that combine efficient optical access, coherent control, and long-lived quantum memory, but realizing all three in one scalable platform remains a central bottleneck. Diamond color centers are leading candidates, yet widely studied defects retain tradeoffs among these capabilities. Here, we show that transition-metal defects in diamond provide a distinct route beyond these platforms by combining spin-orbit protected ground-state coherence, all-optical control, and near-infrared emission. Using a single nickel-vacancy (NiV$^-$), we demonstrate an all-optically controlled diamond spin qubit with coherence exceeding one millisecond at 1.65 K, compatible with compact closed-cycle cryogenics. We implement Raman Rabi oscillations and Ramsey interferometry and use all-optical dynamical decoupling to extend coherence from $T_2^*$ = 371 ns to $T_2^{CPMG-4}$ = 1.27 ms, establishing NiV$^-$ as a deployable diamond spin-photon interface.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验演示（“demonstrate”、“implement”），并给出了具体的实验测量结果（如相干时间、Rabi振荡等）。；研究对象：金刚石中的过渡金属缺陷——具体为带负电的镍-空位色心（NiV⁻）。这是一个自旋-光子界面量子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在金刚石NiV⁻色心中，实现了全光学控制的自旋量子比特，其相干时间在1.65 K下超过1毫秒，证明了该体系兼具高效光学接口、相干控制和长寿命量子存储能力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在金刚石NiV⁻色心中，实现了全光学控制的自旋量子比特，其相干时间在1.65 K下超过1毫秒，证明了该体系兼具高效光学接口、相干控制和长寿命量子存储能力。；创新点：该工作展示了过渡金属缺陷（NiV⁻）作为金刚石色心的一种新路径，克服了传统广泛研究的色心（如NV中心）在光学效率、相干控制和存储寿命之间存在的权衡问题，首次实现了三者在一体化平台中的结合。摘要未突出说明与具体已有工作的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：拉曼拉比振荡（Raman Rabi oscillations）、拉姆齐干涉测量（Ramsey interferometry）以及全光学动态解耦（all-optical dynamical decoupling）。实验在1.65 K的低温下进行，兼容紧凑型闭循环低温系统。

papers.title: Computable measures of fermionic non-Gaussianity from the covariance matrix
papers.abstract: Fermionic non-Gaussianity, or fermionic magic, is a key resource underlying the computational complexity of fermionic quantum systems, yet tractable and operationally meaningful ways to quantify it remain limited. We address this challenge by developing a convex resource theory of fermionic non-Gaussianity and introducing two families of computable measures for pure fermionic states, both derived from the Williamson normal form of the covariance matrix. The first family, occupation number entropies, is defined as the Tsallis-$α$ entropy of the occupation numbers. We prove that one member of this family is monotonic under Gaussian protocols, establishing it as a computable convex resource monotone. It consequently lower bounds the number of non-Gaussian gates needed for state preparation. The second family, natural-orbital participation entropies, is given by the Rényi-$α$ entropy of the squared amplitudes of the state in the natural-orbital basis, defined by the eigenvectors of the covariance matrix. These measures quantify state compressibility in this basis and thus upper bound the classical simulation cost in an orthonormal Gaussian basis. We analyze both families for stabilizer and translation-invariant states, where they simplify and reveal additional structure. We further study representative examples, including random SWAP-doped matchgate circuits and the bond-modulated XXZ model, highlighting the role of non-Gaussianity in many-body phenomena. Our work establishes a resource-theoretic framework for computable fermionic non-Gaussianity that unifies notions arising across quantum information, condensed-matter physics, and quantum chemistry, opening new directions for studying the complexity of quantum many-body systems and providing practical tools to assess the classical simulability of fermionic states relevant for quantum advantage.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“developing a convex resource theory”、“introducing two families of computable measures”、“prove”、“analyze”。；研究对象：费米子非高斯性（fermionic non-Gaussianity），即费米子量子态中超越高斯态的“魔法”资源，及其在量子信息、凝聚态物理和量子化学中的可计算度量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了两类基于协方差矩阵威廉姆森标准形的可计算费米子非高斯性度量：占据数熵（occupation number entropies）和自然轨道参与熵（natural-orbital participation entropies），其中前者被证明是高斯协议下的单调量，可作为凸资源单调量，从而为态制备所需的非高斯门数量提供下界；后者则通过自然轨道基下的态压缩性，为经典模拟成本提供上界。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了两类基于协方差矩阵威廉姆森标准形的可计算费米子非高斯性度量：占据数熵（occupation number entropies）和自然轨道参与熵（natural-orbital participation entropies），其中前者被证明是高斯协议下的单调量，可作为凸资源单调量，从而为态制备所需的非高斯门数量提供下界；后者则通过自然轨道基下的态压缩性，为经典模拟成本提供上界。；创新点：建立了可计算费米子非高斯性的资源理论框架，统一了量子信息、凝聚态物理和量子化学中相关概念，并提供了评估费米子态经典可模拟性的实用工具。摘要未突出说明与已有度量相比的具体数值优势或实验可操作性细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用凸资源理论框架，利用协方差矩阵的威廉姆森标准形（Williamson normal form）定义度量。具体引入Tsallis-α熵（用于占据数熵）和Rényi-α熵（用于自然轨道参与熵），并证明单调性。对稳定子态和平移不变态进行简化分析，并通过随机SWAP掺杂匹配门电路和键调制XXZ模型进行示例研究。

papers.title: Fluctuations of the Sherrington--Kirkpatrick free energy at critical temperature
papers.abstract: We consider the Sherrington--Kirkpatrick spin glass model at the critical inverse temperature $β= 1$ with zero external field. We prove that the free energy $F_N = F_{N,β=1}$ of this model has variance \[ \mathrm{Var}(F_N) = \frac16 \log N + O(1)\,, \] confirming a physics prediction of Aspelmeier \cite{aspelmeier2008free}, and that the centered and scaled $F_N$ satisfies a Gaussian CLT. We also identify the critical two-replica overlap scale, proving \[ \mathbb{E} \langle R_{1,2}^2\rangle \asymp N^{-2/3}\,, \] as conjectured by Talagrand \cite{talagrand2011mean2}, together with a uniform exponential moment bound for $N^{1/3} |R_{1,2}|$. The key input is a comparison between the Ising and spherical SK partition functions $Z_N$ and $Z^{\mathrm{sp}}_N$: if $X_N = Z_N / Z^{\mathrm{sp}}_N$, then $X_N = 1 + o(1)$ in $L^2$. Thus $Z^{\mathrm{sp}}_N$ captures the diverging critical fluctuations of $Z_N$ and serves as a tractable reweighting variable for estimating overlap moments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“prove”“confirms a physics prediction”“conjectured”等理论推导与证明术语，无实验或计算模拟描述。；研究对象：Sherrington–Kirkpatrick（SK）自旋玻璃模型在临界温度（逆温度β=1、零外场）下的自由能涨落与重叠序参量标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了SK模型在临界温度下自由能的方差为(1/6) log N + O(1)，且中心极限定理成立；同时验证了临界两副本重叠平方的期望值∼ N^{-2/3}，并给出了N^{1/3}|R_{1,2}|的一致指数矩有界性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了SK模型在临界温度下自由能的方差为(1/6) log N + O(1)，且中心极限定理成立；同时验证了临界两副本重叠平方的期望值∼ N^{-2/3}，并给出了N^{1/3}|R_{1,2}|的一致指数矩有界性。；创新点：建立了Ising与球面SK模型在临界点的精确配分函数等价性（L^2收敛），从而将难以直接计算的临界涨落问题转化为可解析处理的球面模型问题，并严格证实了Aspelmeier和Talagrand的物理预言与猜想。
papers.method_zh: 通过比较Ising型SK配分函数Z_N与球面型SK配分函数Z_N^{sp}，证明两者之比X_N = Z_N / Z_N^{sp}在L^2意义下趋于1，从而利用Z_N^{sp}作为可处理的重新加权变量来估计重叠矩。

papers.title: Thermodynamics of Quantum Reservoir Computing
papers.abstract: Quantum reservoir computing provides a framework for processing complex temporal data, yet its fundamental computational and energetic limits remain unresolved. Here, we establish a non-equilibrium thermodynamic framework that links the macroscopic predictive performance of driven open quantum systems to their microscopic energetic costs. By mapping the Holevo capacities onto the Bogoliubov-Kubo-Mori geometric manifold, we analytically prove that the computational peak within the quantum critical region originates from a strict spectral resonance: the closing of the energy gap forces the reservoir's transition frequencies to align with the chaotic drive. To evaluate the associated thermodynamic costs, we introduce quantum informational dissipation to quantify the non-predictive historical data structurally retained by the reservoir, deriving a generalized Landauer bound for continuous temporal processing. This reveals a fundamental thermodynamic trade-off: the critical resonance that unlocks optimal predictive capacity inherently maximizes informational dissipation and the irreversible work required for environmental erasure. Furthermore, coherence decomposition demonstrates that dynamic quantum coherences strictly amplify predictive capacity without demanding additional mechanical work. These findings establish the ultimate energetic limits of quantum learning devices, providing theoretical principles for designing energy-efficient quantum neuromorphic hardware.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“建立非平衡热力学框架”“解析证明”“推导广义朗道尔界限”等理论推导表述，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：量子储层计算（Quantum Reservoir Computing）的热力学极限与能量成本，具体研究驱动开放量子系统在时间序列处理中的计算性能与微观能量消耗之间的基本关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子临界区域的计算峰值源于严格的谱共振——能隙闭合迫使储层跃迁频率与混沌驱动对齐；该临界共振在解锁最优预测能力的同时，必然最大化信息耗散和不可逆擦除功，揭示了计算性能与热力学成本之间的基本权衡。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子临界区域的计算峰值源于严格的谱共振——能隙闭合迫使储层跃迁频率与混沌驱动对齐；该临界共振在解锁最优预测能力的同时，必然最大化信息耗散和不可逆擦除功，揭示了计算性能与热力学成本之间的基本权衡。；创新点：首次将量子储层计算的计算性能与微观热力学成本通过非平衡热力学框架严格关联，并推导出连续时间处理场景下的广义朗道尔界限，揭示了临界共振导致的热力学权衡。
papers.method_zh: 非平衡热力学框架；将Holevo容量映射到Bogoliubov-Kubo-Mori几何流形进行解析证明；引入“量子信息耗散”量化储层保留的非预测历史信息；推导连续时间处理的广义朗道尔界限；采用相干分解分析动态量子相干性的作用。

papers.title: Open-boundary integrable quantum circuits with different geometries
papers.abstract: We present a complete classification of integrable Yang-Baxter quantum circuits with open boundary conditions and arbitrary circuit geometries. Starting from the standard transfer-matrix construction with two types of staggered inhomogeneities, we derive a general mapping that determines the arrangement of circuit gates in terms of the inhomogeneities and the system size. We conjecture that time-periodic quantum circuits are integrable whenever the local bulk and boundary gates satisfy the Yang-Baxter equation and the same bulk gate is applied exactly once per period to every nearest-neighbor pair of spins. Our construction also provides an algorithm to detect Yang-Baxter integrability for circuits with arbitrary geometries. Furthermore, we introduce a third type of inhomogeneity, denoted by $ρ$, and demonstrate that the minimum possible circuit depth is four. We show that when these $ρ$-inhomogeneities are placed at the endpoints and in their immediate neighborhood, the resulting boundary gates can be interpreted as single gates acting on multiple sites. Our construction is fully general and applies to regular $R$-matrices, both of difference and non-difference type, together with their associated boundary matrices. As an application, we consider two-qubit gates corresponding to 6- and 8-vertex $R$-matrices of non-difference form satisfying the Yang-Baxter equation, and we construct the associated reflection matrices that generate integrable quantum circuits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“分类”、“映射”、“构造”、“算法”等理论推导和框架性描述，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：具有开放边界条件和不同几何构型的可积量子电路。具体研究的是基于Yang-Baxter方程的可积电路，包括体门和边界门的构造与分类。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 给出了开放边界条件下、任意几何构型可积量子电路的完整分类，并证明当每个最近邻自旋对在每个周期内恰好应用一次相同的体门时，时间周期量子电路是可积的。此外，引入第三种非均匀性参数ρ，证明最小电路深度为4。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：给出了开放边界条件下、任意几何构型可积量子电路的完整分类，并证明当每个最近邻自旋对在每个周期内恰好应用一次相同的体门时，时间周期量子电路是可积的。此外，引入第三种非均匀性参数ρ，证明最小电路深度为4。；创新点：首次对开放边界条件下任意几何构型的可积量子电路进行完整分类；引入第三种非均匀性参数ρ并证明最小电路深度为4；将边界门解释为作用于多个格点的单门。摘要未突出说明与已有具体工作的对比。
papers.method_zh: 基于标准转移矩阵构造方法，引入两种交错非均匀性，推导出电路门排列与系统大小及非均匀性之间的通用映射。提出检测任意几何构型电路Yang-Baxter可积性的算法。构造适用于正则R矩阵（包括差分型和非差分型）及其关联边界矩阵的通用框架。

papers.title: Undamped Modes in an N-Qubit Heisenberg Chain with Collective Dissipation
papers.abstract: We investigate the undamped behaviors in a spin-1/2 Heisenberg chain coupled with an environment via collective spin jump operators. Using the Bethe ansatz basis, we show that undamped modes exist for any chain length N >= 3. These modes remain robust against variations in the system parameters, including the specific form of the collective dissipation, and the external field. Exploiting the Bethe ansatz solution, we further characterize the number of undamped modes and their oscillation frequencies, uncovering long-lived coherent dynamics in open integrable quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Bethe ansatz basis、理论分析、open integrable quantum systems。；研究对象：具有集体耗散的自旋1/2海森堡链（N-qubit Heisenberg chain），具体研究该开放量子系统中的无阻尼模式（undamped modes）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于任意长度N≥3的自旋1/2海森堡链，在集体自旋跳跃算符耦合环境的情况下，系统始终存在无阻尼模式，且这些模式对系统参数（如集体耗散的具体形式、外场）的变化具有鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于任意长度N≥3的自旋1/2海森堡链，在集体自旋跳跃算符耦合环境的情况下，系统始终存在无阻尼模式，且这些模式对系统参数（如集体耗散的具体形式、外场）的变化具有鲁棒性。；创新点：揭示了开放可积量子系统中存在长寿命相干动力学，并系统刻画了无阻尼模式的存在条件与参数鲁棒性。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于Bethe ansatz基（Bethe ansatz basis）进行理论分析，利用可积系统的精确解方法表征无阻尼模式的数量和振荡频率。

papers.title: False vacuum decay in a two-dimensional quantum spin system
papers.abstract: False vacuum decay describes the relaxation of a metastable state through the nucleation and growth of bubbles of the stable phase. Despite describing a broad variety of phenomena across different fields, the quantum version of the nucleation theory has little experimental or numerical support. Testing its predictions is particularly important in two or more spatial dimensions, where bubble nucleation acquires its true geometrical nature. Here, we study false vacuum decay in the quantum Ising model in two dimensions. Through tree tensor network simulations we extract the decay rate, the effective interface tension and the critical bubble size. We compare them to new semi-classical field theory calculations, and find excellent agreement. These results provide numerical evidence that the critical-bubble picture survives in an interacting quantum spin system in 2+1 dimensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。关键词：tree tensor network simulations、semi-classical field theory calculations。；研究对象：二维量子伊辛模型中的假真空衰变（false vacuum decay）现象，即亚稳态通过稳定相气泡的成核与生长而弛豫的过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过树张量网络模拟提取的衰变速率、有效界面张力及临界气泡尺寸，与新的半经典场论计算结果高度吻合，为临界气泡图像在2+1维相互作用量子自旋系统中的有效性提供了数值证据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过树张量网络模拟提取的衰变速率、有效界面张力及临界气泡尺寸，与新的半经典场论计算结果高度吻合，为临界气泡图像在2+1维相互作用量子自旋系统中的有效性提供了数值证据。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 树张量网络（tree tensor network）数值模拟，结合半经典场论（semi-classical field theory）计算。

papers.title: The ring wants to be broken
papers.abstract: The Ramsey community number $r_κ$ is the minimum network size at which a graph's connectivity is better described by a partition into communities than by no partition, under a prescribed community-detection rule. It was introduced through numerical simulations of networks grown by local rules, which suggested that community structure can emerge without any node heterogeneity. Here I compute $r_κ$ analytically for the simplest homogeneous, locally wired graph: the circulant ring lattice $C_n(1,\dots,c)$. Using a Bernoulli stochastic block model with symmetric $\mathrm{Beta}$ priors as the detection rule, the Bayesian evidence for a balanced two-community partition and for the unpartitioned network are both obtained in closed form, so the transition between them can be located exactly. The result is a sharp dependence on the interaction range: the plain cycle ($c=1$) is never partitioned, its two-community posterior decaying as $n^{-(2α+3)}$, so $r_κ=\infty$; but the next-nearest-neighbour ring ($c=2$) acquires a finite $r_κ\simeq 35$ nodes, above which the partition is preferred with a log-evidence growing as $(\ln 2)\,n$. This provides an exactly solvable instance of community emergence in a network with no built-in communities, and shows that a minimal amount of local connectivity is enough to break the ring.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytically compute、Bayesian evidence、closed form、exactly solvable instance。；研究对象：循环环状晶格（circulant ring lattice）\(C_n(1,\dots,c)\) 中的社区结构涌现现象，具体研究在无内置社区（无节点异质性）的均匀网络中，社区结构如何通过局部连接规则自发出现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于最近邻环（\(c=1\)），网络永远不会被划分为两个社区（\(r_\kappa=\infty\)）；而对于次近邻环（\(c=2\)），当节点数超过约35时，两社区划分的贝叶斯证据优于无划分，且对数证据随节点数线性增长（\((\ln 2)n\)），表明最小量的局部连接足以“打破”环结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于最近邻环（\(c=1\)），网络永远不会被划分为两个社区（\(r_\kappa=\infty\)）；而对于次近邻环（\(c=2\)），当节点数超过约35时，两社区划分的贝叶斯证据优于无划分，且对数证据随节点数线性增长（\((\ln 2)n\)），表明最小量的局部连接足以“打破”环结构。；创新点：首次解析计算了Ramsey社区数 \(r_\kappa\)，为“无内置社区的网络中社区结构自发涌现”提供了精确可解实例，并揭示了局部连接范围对社区涌现的尖锐依赖性。
papers.method_zh: 采用伯努利随机块模型（Bernoulli stochastic block model）作为社区检测规则，并引入对称Beta先验。通过解析计算平衡两社区划分与无划分网络的贝叶斯证据（Bayesian evidence），精确确定两者之间的转变点（Ramsey社区数 \(r_\kappa\)）。

papers.title: Shallow Unitary Circuits for Kramers-Wannier Dualities
papers.abstract: The quantum Kramers-Wannier (KW) duality is a fundamental transformation mapping short-range entangled (SRE) states to long-range entangled (LRE) states. While spatially local unitary circuits require linear-in-system-size depth to implement this duality, the ultimate speed limit for purely unitary circuits equipped with nonlocal connectivity remains an open question. Here, we explicitly construct logarithmic depth, spatially nonlocal unitary circuits that realize the exact $\mathbb{Z}_2$ KW dualities in both one and two spatial dimensions. We further generalize the construction to arbitrary $\mathbb{Z}_n$ KW dualities. Unlike algorithms tailored to prepare specific target states, our circuits implement complete duality maps. Within the symmetric (charge-neutral) sector, these dualities exactly transform arbitrary non-fixed-point SRE states into their corresponding LRE duals. Consequently, our results establish an efficient, purely coherent pathway for exploring phase transitions and topological dualities on modern quantum platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：construct、unitary circuits、generalize、algorithms。；研究对象：量子Kramers-Wannier (KW) 对偶性，具体针对一维和二维空间中的 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 及 $\mathbb{Z}_n$ 对偶变换，以及短程纠缠态与长程纠缠态之间的映射。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文构造了深度为对数级别的空间非局域幺正电路，能够精确实现 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 和 $\mathbb{Z}_n$ KW对偶性，从而在对称（电荷中性）扇区内将任意非不动点短程纠缠态高效地变换为其对应的长程纠缠对偶态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文构造了深度为对数级别的空间非局域幺正电路，能够精确实现 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 和 $\mathbb{Z}_n$ KW对偶性，从而在对称（电荷中性）扇区内将任意非不动点短程纠缠态高效地变换为其对应的长程纠缠对偶态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论构造：明确设计具有对数深度、空间非局域连接性的幺正电路，用于实现完整的KW对偶映射，而非针对特定目标态的制备算法。

papers.title: Identical-Particle Symmetry-Enabled Complete Coherent Control of Ultracold Atomic and Molecular Collisions
papers.abstract: We show that exchange symmetry in collisions of identical particles enables symmetry-protected coherent control of the total scattering cross section. For identical fermions, antisymmetrization enforces complete phase synchronization of the contributing scattering channels, yielding maximal control visibility. For identical bosons, synchronization persists but with reduced visibility due to additional exchange (satellite) contributions. Collisions of distinguishable particles lack this symmetry-imposed phase locking, leading to lower controllability and visibility. We elucidate these principles through coupled-channel quantum-scattering calculations for lithium-lithium collisions, comparing the $^{6}\mathrm{Li}$-$^{6}\mathrm{Li}$ (identical fermions), $^{7}\mathrm{Li}$-$^{7}\mathrm{Li}$ (identical bosons), and $^{6}\mathrm{Li}$-$^{7}\mathrm{Li}$ (distinguishable) systems. Furthermore, in the identical particle cases, symmetry-enforced synchronization enables full control over the parity of the final state at any collisional energy. This mechanism is broadly applicable to identical-particle collisions, including homonuclear molecules for which established approaches -- DC electric fields, or microwave shielding -- are ineffective or unavailable.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：We show that...，We elucidate these principles through... calculations）；研究对象：超冷原子和分子碰撞中的全同粒子散射过程，具体以锂-锂碰撞（$^{6}\mathrm{Li}$-$^{6}\mathrm{Li}$， $^{7}\mathrm{Li}$-$^{7}\mathrm{Li}$， $^{6}\mathrm{Li}$-$^{7}\mathrm{Li}$）为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 全同粒子碰撞中的交换对称性能够实现对称性保护的相干控制，从而完全控制总散射截面；对于全同费米子，反对称化导致所有散射通道完全相位同步，实现最大控制可见度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：全同粒子碰撞中的交换对称性能够实现对称性保护的相干控制，从而完全控制总散射截面；对于全同费米子，反对称化导致所有散射通道完全相位同步，实现最大控制可见度。；创新点：揭示了全同粒子交换对称性在散射控制中的根本作用，证明了该机制能实现对最终态宇称的完全控制，且适用于直流电场或微波屏蔽等传统方法无效的同核分子碰撞。
papers.method_zh: 通过耦合通道量子散射计算（coupled-channel quantum-scattering calculations）对锂-锂碰撞体系进行理论分析，比较了全同费米子、全同玻色子和可区分粒子三种情况。

papers.title: Lamb Shift of a Static Atom Facing a Rotating Surface
papers.abstract: We study how the Lamb shift of a static atom is modified when a nearby planar body rotates rigidly about its normal while the atom is held at a fixed distance $a$. We derive a general formula for the shift in terms of the angularly Doppler-shifted reflection coefficients of the surface, valid for any axially symmetric planar material. Expanding the result to second order in the angular velocity $Ω$, we identify two independent contributions associated with the orbital and spin components of the electromagnetic angular momentum. The orbital contribution, proportional to $(Ωρ)^2$, reproduces locally the Lamb shift induced by a surface translating at the tangential velocity $Ωρ$, whereas the spin contribution, proportional to $(aΩ)^2$, originates from the rotational Doppler shift of the photon helicity and survives even on the rotation axis. We first illustrate the formalism using a graphene sheet and then apply it to finite-thickness Drude and plasma conductors and to doped semiconductors. Rotation enhances the Casimir-Polder interaction for graphene and metallic surfaces, whereas it weakens it for doped semiconductors, depending on whether the carrier plasma frequency reaches the near-field scale $1/a$. Above a threshold angular velocity, the atomic level also acquires a finite linewidth, providing a spectroscopic signature of quantum friction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“We study”“We derive”“Expanding the result”“We first illustrate the formalism”。；研究对象：静态原子与旋转平面表面之间的Lamb位移（Lamb shift）修正，具体涉及石墨烯、有限厚度Drude导体、等离子体导体及掺杂半导体等材料体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 旋转表面会通过电磁角动量的轨道和自旋分量对静态原子的Lamb位移产生两种独立贡献：轨道贡献与表面切向平移效应局部等价，自旋贡献源于光子螺旋度的旋转多普勒频移，即使在旋转轴上也存在。旋转可增强石墨烯和金属表面的Casimir-Polder相互作用，但削弱掺杂半导体的相互作用；超过阈值角速度时，原子能级还会获得有限线宽，可作为量子摩擦的光谱特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：旋转表面会通过电磁角动量的轨道和自旋分量对静态原子的Lamb位移产生两种独立贡献：轨道贡献与表面切向平移效应局部等价，自旋贡献源于光子螺旋度的旋转多普勒频移，即使在旋转轴上也存在。旋转可增强石墨烯和金属表面的Casimir-Polder相互作用，但削弱掺杂半导体的相互作用；超过阈值角速度时，原子能级还会获得有限线宽，可作为量子摩擦的光谱特征。；创新点：首次系统揭示了旋转表面引起的Lamb位移中轨道与自旋贡献的物理起源，并指出自旋贡献在旋转轴上依然存在，以及旋转对Casimir-Polder相互作用的材料依赖性调控效应。
papers.method_zh: 推导了适用于任意轴对称平面材料的Lamb位移一般公式（基于角向多普勒频移反射系数），并展开至角速度Ω的二阶项，分别分析轨道和自旋贡献。以石墨烯为例进行形式化说明，随后应用于有限厚度Drude导体、等离子体导体和掺杂半导体。

papers.title: How effective normal stress oscillations advance failure in fault gouge: frequency dependence, non-failure window, and the role of dilation
papers.abstract: Cyclic pore-pressure or normal stress variations arise both in relation to natural earthquakes and in engineered subsurface systems, yet their effect on fault stability remains poorly constrained at the grain scale. Here we numerically model, using a coupled Discrete Element--fluid dynamics model, the response of a sheared, fluid-saturated or dry, gouge-filled fault to effective normal stress oscillations over a wide frequency range (0.5-10000 Hz). The effective normal stress is oscillated either by cycling the pore-pressure or by directly cycling the normal stress, while keeping the stress state below the Mohr-Coulomb threshold measured in continuous loading. Despite this sub-critical loading, we observe failure across most frequencies, with a non-monotonic frequency dependence. A distinct non-failure window emerges at intermediate frequencies (30-200 Hz), bounded by failure at both lower and higher frequencies; the system exhibits four regimes from cyclic failure-and-arrest to continuous sliding. Pore-pressure and normal stress oscillations produce the same regime structure, confirming that they act as equivalent forcings via Terzaghi's principle, with fluid coupling adding only a delay due to dilatant hardening. Sub-critical failure arises from dilation-induced strength deterioration via two mechanisms: (i) low-frequency cycles allow sufficient time for shear-driven ratcheting dilation, while (ii) high-frequency cycles induce dynamic dilation (acoustic fluidization) via amplified seepage forces, stress gradients and inertial forces. The intermediate non-failure window represents the gap between these mechanisms. These results identify frequency as a controlling parameter for failure in granular materials, with implications for dynamic earthquake triggering and cyclic injection protocols.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：numerically model、Discrete Element--fluid dynamics model。；研究对象：流体饱和或干燥断层泥（fault gouge）在有效正应力循环振荡下的响应，具体为颗粒尺度下的剪切破坏行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在亚临界加载条件下，断层泥在大多数频率下仍会发生破坏，且破坏频率呈非单调依赖关系；在中等频率（30-200 Hz）出现一个明显的“非破坏窗口”，该窗口由低频和高频下的两种不同膨胀机制所界定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在亚临界加载条件下，断层泥在大多数频率下仍会发生破坏，且破坏频率呈非单调依赖关系；在中等频率（30-200 Hz）出现一个明显的“非破坏窗口”，该窗口由低频和高频下的两种不同膨胀机制所界定。；创新点：首次在颗粒尺度上系统揭示了有效正应力振荡频率对断层泥破坏的控制作用，发现了中间频率下的“非破坏窗口”，并区分了低频剪切驱动棘轮膨胀与高频动态膨胀（声学流化）两种破坏机制，同时验证了孔隙压力与正应力振荡通过太沙基原理等效。
papers.method_zh: 采用耦合离散元-流体动力学模型（Discrete Element--fluid dynamics model），对有效正应力进行循环振荡（通过循环孔隙压力或直接循环正应力），频率范围0.5-10000 Hz，并保持应力状态低于连续加载下的莫尔-库仑阈值。

papers.title: Mechanistic Interpretability and Causal Feature Steering of Neural Quantum States via Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract: Neural Quantum States (NQS) are a remarkably expressive class of variational ansätze for quantum many-body wavefunctions, yet little is understood about their internal mechanisms: trained on variational objectives alone, how do NQS accurately capture physical observables that they have never been explicitly optimized for? In this work, we present a systematic approach to analyze the internal activations of NQS using sparse autoencoders. We extract features from the residual stream and demonstrate that these features strongly correlate with physical observables such as order parameters, staggered magnetization, and half-chain correlators, across both ground state representation and real-time dynamics. Remarkably, the discovery of these features is entirely unsupervised, with no physical labels provided. We further establish that such features causally affect the corresponding observables predicted by NQS, by showing that targeted, post-training intervention on a \textit{single} feature smoothly and monotonically steers the corresponding observable, while leaving the variational energy nearly unchanged. These results demonstrate that NQS are not merely functional approximators, but encode rich, interpretable internal representations of physical information. Our approach provides both a diagnostic and an intervention tool for NQS, and serves as a foundation for using mechanistic interpretability towards more reliable, transparent NQS.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Neural Quantum States、variational ansätze、sparse autoencoders、mechanistic interpretability。；研究对象：神经网络量子态（Neural Quantum States, NQS）的内部工作机制，具体应用于量子多体波函数的基态表示和实时动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: NQS内部激活通过稀疏自编码器提取的特征与物理可观测量（如序参量、交错磁化强度、半链关联函数）高度相关，且对单个特征进行后训练干预可平滑单调地调控相应可观测量，同时几乎不改变变分能量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：NQS内部激活通过稀疏自编码器提取的特征与物理可观测量（如序参量、交错磁化强度、半链关联函数）高度相关，且对单个特征进行后训练干预可平滑单调地调控相应可观测量，同时几乎不改变变分能量。；创新点：首次将机械可解释性（Mechanistic Interpretability）方法系统应用于NQS，在无物理标签条件下无监督发现与可观测量强相关的内部特征，并证明这些特征对输出具有因果控制作用，揭示了NQS内部编码了可解释的物理信息。
papers.method_zh: 使用稀疏自编码器（Sparse Autoencoders）分析NQS残差流中的内部激活，提取无监督特征；通过相关性分析和因果干预（后训练定向操控单个特征）验证特征与物理观测量的因果关系。

papers.title: Quantum Trajectory Entanglement in Seeded Boundary Time Crystals
papers.abstract: We investigate the entanglement dynamics along quantum trajectories during the seeding of time-crystalline order in a boundary time crystal (BTC). Specifically, how entanglement spreads among different spin ensembles when a BTC attempts to seed its time-crystalline behavior onto otherwise static spin ensembles, through a collective dissipative channel. We analyse both the dynamical growth of entanglement in time and the steady-state properties of the system. Our results reveal two fundamentally distinct regimes. In the seeded BTC phase, the steady-state entanglement entropy between the ensembles grows with system size $N$, accompanied by macroscopic fluctuations along the trajectories. In contrast, in the non-seeded static phase, both the steady-state entanglement and its fluctuations decay exponentially with $N$. The model thus features a measurement-induced phase transition (MIPT) driven by the seeding mechanism. Furthermore, these findings establish dissipative seeding as a powerful mechanism for controlling quantum correlations in open many-body systems, with direct experimental relevance to this class of model without a postselection barrier.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate, analyse, results reveal, model features。；研究对象：边界时间晶体（Boundary Time Crystal, BTC）中，通过集体耗散通道将时间晶体行为“播种”（seeding）到静态自旋系综时，沿量子轨迹的纠缠动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了两种截然不同的相：在“播种”的BTC相中，稳态纠缠熵随系统尺寸N增长，并伴随沿轨迹的宏观涨落；而在非播种的静态相中，稳态纠缠及其涨落随N指数衰减。该模型展示了一个由播种机制驱动的测量诱导相变（MIPT）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了两种截然不同的相：在“播种”的BTC相中，稳态纠缠熵随系统尺寸N增长，并伴随沿轨迹的宏观涨落；而在非播种的静态相中，稳态纠缠及其涨落随N指数衰减。该模型展示了一个由播种机制驱动的测量诱导相变（MIPT）。；创新点：建立了耗散播种作为控制开放多体系统中量子关联的强大机制，并且该模型在实验上具有直接相关性，无需后选择（postselection）障碍。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体包括：研究沿量子轨迹的纠缠动力学，分析纠缠随时间的动态增长以及系统的稳态性质。

papers.title: Controlling Waiting Time Statistics in Monitored Collective Spins: Mitigating Detector's Resolution Barrier in Measurement-Induced Phase Transitions
papers.abstract: In collective dissipative spin systems, the postselection barrier can be partially mitigated; however, a further obstacle may be posed by the finite temporal resolution of detectors. In this work, we investigate how initial-state inhomogeneities can control waiting-time statistics between quantum jumps, thereby mitigating the detector-resolution problem. We consider a collectively monitored spin model with a boundary time-crystalline phase, introducing inhomogeneity by partitioning the ensemble into two subsystems rotated by an angle $θ$. We find that the measurement-induced phase transition survives under inhomogeneities, with different entanglement scaling regimes. The waiting time increases with $θ$, scaling as $1/N$ but with a prefactor strongly enhanced by orders of magnitude, and in the anti-aligned limit $θ= π$ it remains finite, fully resolving the resolution barrier. This mitigation, however, comes at a cost: the entanglement saturation time becomes significantly longer, partially reintroducing the postselection barrier. Our results highlight a trade-off between detector resolution and postselection overhead, with direct implications for the experimental observation of measurement-induced phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“investigate”“consider a model”“find that”等理论分析用语，未涉及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：集体耗散自旋系统中的测量诱导相变，具体为边界时间晶体相中的等待时间统计，以及探测器有限时间分辨率对相变观测的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入初始态不均匀性（将自旋系综分为两个旋转角度为θ的子集），可以显著延长量子跃迁之间的等待时间，从而缓解探测器有限时间分辨率带来的观测障碍；但这一缓解以延长纠缠饱和时间为代价，部分重新引入了后选择障碍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入初始态不均匀性（将自旋系综分为两个旋转角度为θ的子集），可以显著延长量子跃迁之间的等待时间，从而缓解探测器有限时间分辨率带来的观测障碍；但这一缓解以延长纠缠饱和时间为代价，部分重新引入了后选择障碍。；创新点：揭示了探测器时间分辨率与后选择开销之间的权衡关系，并指出通过控制初始态不均匀性可以跨越探测器分辨率障碍，为实验观测测量诱导现象提供了新思路。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：构建一个集体监测的自旋模型，通过将系综划分为两个旋转角度为θ的子系统引入不均匀性，研究等待时间统计、纠缠标度以及测量诱导相变的存活条件。

papers.title: One-Body Purity, Non-Gaussianity, and Entanglement in Interacting Integrable Models
papers.abstract: When describing entanglement in typical midspectrum eigenstates of many-body lattice Hamiltonians, two paradigms have emerged that capture the behavior observed in integrable and nonintegrable systems, Haar-random fermionic Gaussian states and Haar-random pure states, respectively. Remarkably, the former capture the behavior of interacting integrable systems, whose eigenstates are non-Gaussian. We argue that the paradigm that captures both the entanglement properties and the lack of Gaussianity in integrable systems is that of random superpositions of polynomially many Gaussian states. In contrast, eigenstates of nonintegrable systems are consistent with being described by random superpositions of exponentially many Gaussian states. We gain this understanding by comparing analytical and numerical results for the one-body purity, the non-Gaussianity, and the entanglement entropy of the random superpositions and the Hamiltonian eigenstates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：analytical and numerical results、random superpositions、entanglement entropy）；研究对象：多体晶格哈密顿量本征态中的纠缠特性，特别是可积与不可积系统中的单体纯度、非高斯性与纠缠熵。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 可积相互作用系统的本征态虽非高斯态，但其纠缠性质可由多项式数量高斯态的随机叠加描述；而不可积系统本征态则需指数数量高斯态的随机叠加来描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：可积相互作用系统的本征态虽非高斯态，但其纠缠性质可由多项式数量高斯态的随机叠加描述；而不可积系统本征态则需指数数量高斯态的随机叠加来描述。；创新点：提出用多项式数量高斯态的随机叠加作为统一范式，同时捕捉可积系统中的纠缠性质与缺乏高斯性的特征，区别于以往分别用Haar随机费米子高斯态（可积）和Haar随机纯态（不可积）的二元范式。
papers.method_zh: 通过对比随机叠加态与哈密顿量本征态的单体纯度、非高斯性及纠缠熵的分析与数值结果，建立理论框架。

papers.title: Logarithmic negativity typically equals exact entanglement cost
papers.abstract: Quantum entanglement plays a leading role in modern understanding of physical systems, from quantum phases of matter to quantum gravity. In quantum information theory, one seeks operationally meaningful quantifiers of entanglement, which for large quantum systems are notoriously difficult to evaluate due to the lack of computationally efficient algorithms. In this Letter, we show that for large random induced mixed states the logarithmic negativity, an efficiently computable entanglement measure, generically coincides with the exact entanglement cost under positive-partial-transpose-preserving operations, thereby acquiring a precise operational interpretation. Our results establish logarithmic negativity as an exact characterization of entanglement in generic many-body states and provide a tractable route for quantifying entanglement in complex quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：quantum information theory、operationally meaningful quantifiers、computationally efficient algorithms。；研究对象：量子纠缠在大型量子系统中的量化问题，具体针对随机诱导混合态（random induced mixed states）和多体量子态（many-body states）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于大型随机诱导混合态，对数负性（logarithmic negativity）通常与在正偏转置保持操作（PPT-preserving operations）下的精确纠缠代价（exact entanglement cost）相等，从而获得了精确的操作性解释。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于大型随机诱导混合态，对数负性（logarithmic negativity）通常与在正偏转置保持操作（PPT-preserving operations）下的精确纠缠代价（exact entanglement cost）相等，从而获得了精确的操作性解释。；创新点：首次证明了对数负性在一般多体态中具有精确的操作性意义，即它等价于PPT操作下的纠缠代价，从而为复杂量子系统中纠缠的量化提供了可计算的途径。
papers.method_zh: 采用量子信息理论框架，通过分析随机诱导混合态（random induced mixed states）的纠缠性质，证明了对数负性这一可高效计算的纠缠度量与精确纠缠代价的等价性。摘要未明确说明具体数学工具或数值方法。

papers.title: Brownian ratchets and pumps universally simulate many-body active dynamics
papers.abstract: Active systems can exhibit a broad range of phenomena forbidden in equilibrium. Their dynamics are often specified by abstract local update rules, and it is generally unclear when the same behavior can arise from physically natural driving. Here we show that two simple driving mechanisms can universally simulate any local active dynamics in spin systems. The first is the familiar setting of a time-periodic Hamiltonian coupled to a cold bath, which we call a "many-body Brownian pump." As a second mechanism, we promote the Brownian ratchet, traditionally a mechanism for transport, to a "many-body Brownian ratchet": a static Hamiltonian coupled to a hot bath and a cold bath, where the resulting steady heat current can be harnessed not only to drive transport but also to generate local active dynamics. Using probabilistic cellular automata as an explicit model, we prove that for any continuous-time (or discrete-time) local active dynamics, there is always a many-body Brownian ratchet (or pump) that approximates the dynamics, up to noise that can be made arbitrarily weak by tuning energy scales and other parameters. As a concrete demonstration, we construct a simple ferromagnetic Ising ratchet on a bilayer lattice. When the two layers are coupled to baths at different temperatures, this model serves as a robust classical memory even under a symmetry-breaking field, something impossible in equilibrium. More broadly, our work shows that ratchets can use steady heat currents to autonomously generate and stabilize novel collective behavior, realizing a new static setting for nonequilibrium many-body dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show、prove、construct、theoretical framework。；研究对象：自旋系统中的活性多体动力学，具体包括布朗棘轮（Brownian ratchet）和布朗泵（Brownian pump）作为驱动机制，以及概率元胞自动机作为显式模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明两种简单驱动机制——时间周期哈密顿量耦合冷浴（多体布朗泵）和静态哈密顿量耦合热浴与冷浴（多体布朗棘轮）——可以普适地模拟任何局域活性自旋动力学，且通过调节能量尺度可将噪声任意减弱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明两种简单驱动机制——时间周期哈密顿量耦合冷浴（多体布朗泵）和静态哈密顿量耦合热浴与冷浴（多体布朗棘轮）——可以普适地模拟任何局域活性自旋动力学，且通过调节能量尺度可将噪声任意减弱。；创新点：将传统用于输运的布朗棘轮机制推广到多体系统，证明其不仅能驱动输运，还能利用稳态热流自主产生和稳定新的集体行为，实现非平衡多体动力学的静态新设定。摘要未突出说明与已有活性动力学模拟方法的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用概率元胞自动机作为显式模型，通过数学证明（连续时间或离散时间）表明任何局域活性动力学均可被多体布朗棘轮或泵近似实现。具体构造了一个双层晶格上的铁磁伊辛棘轮模型作为演示。

papers.title: Confinement in a magnetically induced WSe$_2$ quantum dots
papers.abstract: Monolayer tungsten diselenide (WSe$_2$) has become a suitable platform for quantum transport and spintronics and valleytronics applications because it possesses an intrinsic band gap and strong spin-orbit coupling and spin-valley coupling features. The electrostatic confinement of Dirac fermions proves challenging in graphene because of Klein tunneling, yet WSe$_2$ provides an environment that supports both carrier localization and the development of confined quantum states. In this work, we theoretically investigate the confinement of massive Dirac fermions in a WSe$_2$ quantum dot generated by a localized magnetic field. Using the effective Dirac Hamiltonian in the presence of a magnetic flux, we derive the exact wave functions and scattering coefficients by employing Kummer's confluent hypergeometric functions together with Bessel and Hankel functions. Our results show that the localized magnetic field provides an efficient mechanism to suppress Klein tunneling and promote the formation of stable quasibound states. We systematically examine the scattering efficiency and carrier density distributions as functions of the incident energy, magnetic field strength, and quantum dot radius. We find that low-energy carriers are strongly confined by the magnetic barrier, while the interplay between magnetic localization and geometric confinement gives rise to sharp and tunable resonance peaks. These results provide valuable insight into the control of spin-valley transport in transition metal dichalcogenide nanostructures and establish a theoretical basis for the development of quantum confinement devices and quantum information technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretically investigate”、“effective Dirac Hamiltonian”、“derive the exact wave functions and scattering coefficients”。；研究对象：单层WSe₂中由局域磁场诱导的量子点，具体研究该体系中大质量狄拉克费米子的束缚态与输运特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 局域磁场能有效抑制克莱因隧穿，促进稳定准束缚态的形成；低能载流子被磁势垒强烈束缚，磁局域与几何约束的相互作用产生尖锐且可调的共振峰。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：局域磁场能有效抑制克莱因隧穿，促进稳定准束缚态的形成；低能载流子被磁势垒强烈束缚，磁局域与几何约束的相互作用产生尖锐且可调的共振峰。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用有效狄拉克哈密顿量描述存在磁通时的WSe₂量子点，通过库默尔合流超几何函数、贝塞尔函数和汉克尔函数精确求解波函数与散射系数，系统分析散射效率与载流子密度分布随入射能量、磁场强度和量子点半径的变化。

papers.title: Observation of Flat Bands in Type-II Weyl Semimetal TaRhTe$_{4}$
authors: K. U. R. R. S. Rathnayaka
papers.abstract: Flat bands have been theoretically predicted for decades but have only recently been realized in quantum materials such as magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene, kagome and Lieb lattices, and rare-earth metal compounds. To date, only twisted layered materials have enabled tuning of flat-band energies near the electronic chemical potential, thereby influencing transport and thermodynamic properties. Here, we report the presence of flat bands near the chemical potential in bulk TaRhTe$_{4}$, a noncentrosymmetric van-der Waals type-II Weyl semimetal. Flat bands are rarely observed in Weyl semimetals, particularly in nonmagnetic bulk systems, and the observed flat bands were not predicted by density functional theory calculations. TaRhTe$_{4}$ therefore provides a platform in which nontrivial topology coexists with flat bands near the Fermi level, as evidenced by our angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy measurements”（ARPES测量），并基于实验观测报告了平带的存在。；研究对象：非中心对称范德瓦尔斯型-II Weyl半金属TaRhTe₄中的平带及其与拓扑性质的共存。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在块体TaRhTe₄中，通过ARPES实验观测到化学势附近存在平带，且该平带未被密度泛函理论（DFT）计算预测，表明该材料中非平庸拓扑与费米能级附近的平带共存。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在块体TaRhTe₄中，通过ARPES实验观测到化学势附近存在平带，且该平带未被密度泛函理论（DFT）计算预测，表明该材料中非平庸拓扑与费米能级附近的平带共存。；创新点：在非磁性块体Weyl半金属中首次实验观测到化学势附近的平带，且该平带未被理论预测，打破了以往仅在扭曲层状材料中实现平带能量调谐的局限。
papers.method_zh: 角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）实验测量，并结合密度泛函理论（DFT）计算进行对比。

papers.title: Electric-field effects on defect migration energetics in GaN
papers.abstract: A predictive understanding of defect transport in GaN under operating electric fields is critical for assessing device reliability in high-power and radiation environments. In this work, a ReaxFF reactive force field for GaN is developed using a density-functional-theory training set that includes structural, thermodynamic, and defect properties. The force field yields various properties such as lattice parameters, cohesive energies, and defect formation and migration energies in close agreement with prior first-principles and experimental results. Under externally applied electric fields, we find that migration barriers can be strongly modulated, with changes that depend on defect type and field orientation. Notably, the electric fields do not simply linearly bias defect motion in GaN, but can anisotropically modify migration barriers through charge-lattice coupling, leading to nonlinear transport behavior. The response arises from field-induced partial charge redistribution and local lattice distortion. These results demonstrate that electric fields can complexly modify the defect migration landscape, providing new insight into defect transport in GaN under high-field conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：ReaxFF reactive force field、density-functional-theory training set、first-principles。；研究对象：GaN（氮化镓）中缺陷在外加电场下的迁移行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 外加电场并非简单地线性偏置缺陷运动，而是通过电荷-晶格耦合各向异性地改变迁移势垒，导致非线性输运行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：外加电场并非简单地线性偏置缺陷运动，而是通过电荷-晶格耦合各向异性地改变迁移势垒，导致非线性输运行为。；创新点：揭示了电场通过诱导部分电荷重新分布和局域晶格畸变，复杂地调控缺陷迁移势垒的机制，为理解高场条件下GaN中的缺陷输运提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 基于密度泛函理论（DFT）训练集开发了GaN的ReaxFF反应力场，并利用该力场模拟了外加电场下缺陷的迁移能垒变化。

papers.title: Topological Hall effect due to electron-skyrmion scattering
papers.abstract: Electron scattering from chiral spin textures such as skyrmions is fundamental to the understanding of transport in more complex systems, including skyrmion crystals. Most of the previous studies have focused on the weak-coupling regime, where the exchange interaction is small compared with the electron energy. Real materials, however, often lie in the strong-coupling regime, which exhibits qualitatively different behavior. Using the Lippmann-Schwinger equation and Green's function formalism, valid for all coupling strengths, we uncover several new features in the scattering cross section, including Ramsauer-Townsend minima, pronounced intermediate-coupling resonances, and Landau-level resonances for skyrmions with larger winding numbers. These features strongly influence the topological and spin Hall conductivities, which depend sensitively on the incident electron energy. Our work provides important insights into the Hall transport in collective chiral spin textures such as the skyrmion crystal.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：Lippmann-Schwinger equation、Green's function formalism、理论推导。；研究对象：电子与手性自旋纹理（如斯格明子）散射过程中的拓扑霍尔效应，特别关注强耦合区间的输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强耦合区间，电子-斯格明子散射截面出现Ramsauer-Townsend极小值、中等耦合共振以及大缠绕数斯格明子的朗道能级共振，这些特征显著影响拓扑霍尔电导率和自旋霍尔电导率，且对入射电子能量敏感。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强耦合区间，电子-斯格明子散射截面出现Ramsauer-Townsend极小值、中等耦合共振以及大缠绕数斯格明子的朗道能级共振，这些特征显著影响拓扑霍尔电导率和自旋霍尔电导率，且对入射电子能量敏感。；创新点：此前研究多集中于弱耦合区间（交换相互作用远小于电子能量），而本工作系统揭示了强耦合区间中定性不同的散射行为（如共振结构），并指出这些特征对霍尔输运的关键影响。
papers.method_zh: 采用Lippmann-Schwinger方程和格林函数形式，该理论框架适用于所有耦合强度（弱耦合到强耦合），并计算了散射截面及拓扑/自旋霍尔电导率。

papers.title: Strange Luttinger liquids in a cavity-embedded one-dimensional electronic chain
papers.abstract: We study a one-dimensional electronic chain coupled to a homogeneous quantized vacuum field and electron-electron interactions. In the absence of the latter, we derive a low-energy effective description in the presence of light-matter coupling, which we identify as a strange Luttinger liquid. Although it retains a formal resemblance to conventional Luttinger liquid theory, the coupling to the quantum field qualitatively modifies the low-energy sector and breaks the standard velocity relation underlying Luttinger universality. For finite electron-electron interactions, we recover a phase diagram featuring several phases as a function of interaction strength and hopping amplitude, including a phase hosting Majorana-like zero modes. Using exact diagonalization, we compute observables that characterize the phase boundaries and show that the cavity field significantly shifts them. We also study the fate of Majorana-like states under the influence of the cavity field, highlighting their modification by light-matter coupling. Finally, we investigate whether the strange Luttinger liquid description identified in the noninteracting regime continues to hold when electron-electron interactions are introduced.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：低能有效描述、相图、精确对角化）；研究对象：嵌入均匀量子化真空腔场的一维电子链，包含光-物质耦合与电子-电子相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无电子-电子相互作用时，光-物质耦合导致一种“奇异Luttinger液体”，它形式上类似传统Luttinger液体但破坏了标准速度关系；在有限电子-电子相互作用下，系统相图包含多个相，其中存在类马约拉纳零模，且腔场显著移动了相边界并改变了类马约拉纳态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无电子-电子相互作用时，光-物质耦合导致一种“奇异Luttinger液体”，它形式上类似传统Luttinger液体但破坏了标准速度关系；在有限电子-电子相互作用下，系统相图包含多个相，其中存在类马约拉纳零模，且腔场显著移动了相边界并改变了类马约拉纳态。；创新点：首次在腔耦合一维电子链中识别出“奇异Luttinger液体”这一新低能描述，并系统揭示了腔场对相图、相边界及类马约拉纳零模的调控作用。
papers.method_zh: 低能有效理论推导、精确对角化计算。

papers.title: Diamond Diode for Extreme Venus Environments
papers.abstract: A diamond Schottky PIN diode (SPIND) with the highest reported current density to date of ~116 kA/cm2 is demonstrated carrying a total current of ~1.3 A through a 50 micron wide pseudo-vertical diode structure. The diamond SPIND also provides a maximum power handling capacity of 1.85 MW/cm2 and a low specific on-resistance Ron,S of 0.05 mOhm-cm2 at a forward bias of ~16 V. The diamond SPIN diode also shows excellent rectification characteristics with a current on-off ratio of ~6e12. An analytical model including thermionic emission and space charge limited current is presented together with Silvaco ATLAS TCAD simulations, to accurately reproduce the experimental J-V characteristics using multiple single trap levels and other physical models emulating a real device. Theoretical analysis from the analytical models in conjunction with ATLAS simulations shows that further improvement in the device turn on voltage and Ron,S can be achieved by reducing the defect density and contact resistance in order to approach the ultimate performance in the Mott-Gurney space charge limited current regime
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：demonstrated, carrying a total current, experimental J-V characteristics）；研究对象：一种用于极端金星环境的金刚石肖特基PIN二极管（SPIND），具体为伪垂直二极管结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该金刚石SPIND实现了迄今为止报道的最高电流密度（~116 kA/cm²）和极高的功率处理能力（1.85 MW/cm²），并具有极低的比导通电阻（0.05 mOhm-cm²）和优异的整流特性（电流开关比~6e12）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该金刚石SPIND实现了迄今为止报道的最高电流密度（~116 kA/cm²）和极高的功率处理能力（1.85 MW/cm²），并具有极低的比导通电阻（0.05 mOhm-cm²）和优异的整流特性（电流开关比~6e12）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验制备了50微米宽的伪垂直二极管结构并进行电学表征；理论分析采用了包含热电子发射和空间电荷限制电流的解析模型，并结合Silvaco ATLAS TCAD仿真，通过引入多个单陷阱能级等物理模型来复现实验J-V特性。

papers.title: Exact dimer ground states of long-range spin chains and ladders
papers.abstract: Interacting spin chains and ladders are known to support a plethora of quantum phases with complex ground-state phase diagrams. In this work, we study a large family of such models and determine precise, explicit conditions under which an exact dimer state is guaranteed to be the ground state. These general conditions are validated for various generalizations of the Majumdar-Ghosh model using exact diagonalization. Our results provide exact reference points in the phase diagrams of a wide class of spin chains and ladders, including those with anisotropic and arbitrary-range interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：study、determine conditions、exact dimer state、ground state。；研究对象：具有长程相互作用的自旋链和自旋梯子模型，特别是Majumdar-Ghosh模型的推广形式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出了一组精确且显式的条件，在这些条件下，精确的二聚体态（dimer state）被保证是系统的基态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出了一组精确且显式的条件，在这些条件下，精确的二聚体态（dimer state）被保证是系统的基态。；创新点：为具有各向异性和任意范围相互作用的一类广泛自旋链和梯子模型提供了精确的基态参考点，而此前这类系统的基态相图通常仅通过数值或近似方法研究。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导（确定精确基态条件）结合精确对角化（exact diagonalization）数值验证。

papers.title: Universal Short-Imaginary-Time Quantum Critical Dynamics Near Boundaries
papers.abstract: While imaginary-time evolution has long served as a standard paradigm for ground-state preparation in numerical simulations and quantum devices, its intrinsic dynamical properties has been largely overlooked. Here, we investigate the short-imaginary-time critical dynamics in quantum systems with boundaries. A universal scaling theory is developed and verified in the two-dimensional quantum Ising model, uncovering rich dynamic critical behaviors dictated by boundary universality classes. For ordered initial states, the boundary order parameter $M_s$ decays with imaginary time $τ$ as $M_s \propto τ^{-β_1/νz}$, where $β_1$ denotes the boundary order parameter exponent, and $ν$ and $z$ correspond to the correlation length exponent and the dynamic exponent, respectively. For disordered initial states, the autocorrelation of the boundary order parameter is governed by a novel critical exponent $θ_1$, which is closely related to the critical initial slip behavior of $M_s$ characterized by the corresponding exponent $θ_1'$. In contrast to its positive bulk counterpart, the boundary initial-slip exponent $θ_1'$ is negative for the ordinary transition while remaining positive for the special transition. Although the static universality classes of $d$-dimensional quantum phase transitions generally coincide with those of $(d+1)$-dimensional classical phase transitions, we show that $θ_1$ does not follow this conventional quantum-classical mapping. We further discuss the implications of our results for more exotic forms of boundary criticality. Our findings provide new physical insights into boundary critical dynamics and offer a novel route for probing exotic boundary critical behaviors in quantum many-body systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“universal scaling theory is developed”、“we show”、“provide new physical insights”。；研究对象：量子多体系统在边界附近的短虚时临界动力学行为，具体以二维量子伊辛模型为例，研究边界序参量在虚时演化中的标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了边界序参量在短虚时临界动力学中遵循普适标度律：有序初态下边界序参量按幂律衰减，指数由边界序参量指数、关联长度指数和动力学指数决定；无序初态下边界自关联函数由新临界指数θ₁控制，且边界初始滑移指数θ₁'在普通跃迁中为负、在特殊跃迁中为正，与体态行为不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了边界序参量在短虚时临界动力学中遵循普适标度律：有序初态下边界序参量按幂律衰减，指数由边界序参量指数、关联长度指数和动力学指数决定；无序初态下边界自关联函数由新临界指数θ₁控制，且边界初始滑移指数θ₁'在普通跃迁中为负、在特殊跃迁中为正，与体态行为不同。；创新点：首次系统揭示边界对短虚时临界动力学的影响，发现边界初始滑移指数θ₁'与体态符号相反，并指出边界临界动力学中的新指数θ₁不遵循传统量子-经典映射关系（即d维量子相变与d+1维经典相变静态普适类相同，但θ₁不满足该映射）。
papers.method_zh: 发展普适标度理论，并在二维量子伊辛模型中进行数值验证（摘要未明确说明具体数值方法，如量子蒙特卡洛或张量网络等）。

papers.title: Chiral enhancement of two-magnon bound states in an $S=1/2$ triangular-lattice magnet
papers.abstract: We study one- and two-magnon excitations above the fully polarized state of the spin-$1/2$ triangular-lattice $J_1$-$J_2$-$J_3$ Heisenberg model with an additional uniform scalar-chirality interaction. In the one-magnon sector of the Heisenberg model, we identify two special minimum manifolds by rewriting the dispersion in complete-square form. The scalar-chirality term cancels exactly in this sector, leaving the one-magnon dispersion and the single-magnon instability unchanged. In contrast, it survives in the two-magnon sector as an oriented interaction between neighboring flipped spins. Using symmetry-adapted triangular-lattice harmonics, we derive finite-dimensional gap equations at the $Γ$ point in the symmetry-resolved $\mathsf{A_1}$ and $\mathsf{E_2}$-type partial-wave channels. The chirality coupling splits the two opposite relative-motion chiralities in the $\mathsf{E_2}$-type sector, thereby selectively enhancing one two-magnon bound-state channel. Exact diagonalization confirms this mechanism and reveals enhanced binding, as well as additional bound states at $M$ and at incommensurate total momenta. Our results identify scalar chirality as an efficient microscopic mechanism for strengthening two-magnon binding without shifting the one-magnon spectrum, and provide a route toward high-field spin-nematic and multipolar instabilities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：study, derive, exact diagonalization）；研究对象：自旋-1/2三角晶格$J_1$-$J_2$-$J_3$海森堡模型，并附加均匀标量手性相互作用；具体物理现象为双磁子束缚态的手性增强。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 标量手性相互作用在单磁子扇区完全抵消，不影响单磁子谱；但在双磁子扇区作为相邻翻转自旋之间的定向相互作用存活，通过分裂$\mathsf{E_2}$型分波通道中两个相反相对运动手性，选择性地增强一个双磁子束缚态通道。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：标量手性相互作用在单磁子扇区完全抵消，不影响单磁子谱；但在双磁子扇区作为相邻翻转自旋之间的定向相互作用存活，通过分裂$\mathsf{E_2}$型分波通道中两个相反相对运动手性，选择性地增强一个双磁子束缚态通道。；创新点：首次提出标量手性相互作用作为不改变单磁子谱、但能有效增强双磁子束缚的微观机制，为高场自旋向列相和多极不稳定性提供新途径。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导（将色散写成完全平方形式、对称性适配三角晶格谐波、有限维能隙方程）；数值精确对角化（exact diagonalization）。

papers.title: Bandwidth-Limited Critical Currents in Electrically Tunable Moiré Bands
papers.abstract: Moiré superlattices host narrow minibands whose bandwidth governs correlated and topological phases. Here, we demonstrate that the bandwidth also sets the critical current for the onset of out-of-equilibrium transport. In bilayer graphene aligned to hexagonal boron nitride, we explore the high-current transport regime as we continuously flatten the valence miniband using an out-of-plane displacement field. We observe a significant reduction in the critical current, which is captured by a minimal analytical model and corresponds to the calculated narrowing of the miniband. Moreover, by comparing distinct moiré platforms, we show that the scaling between critical current and bandwidth is a universal feature of graphene superlattices. Our results reveal a direct link between miniband dispersion and high-current transport, and establish this regime as a fast and accessible electrical probe of bandwidth evolution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：demonstrate, observe, compare distinct moiré platforms）；研究对象：双层石墨烯与六方氮化硼对齐形成的莫尔超晶格中的价带，以及高电流输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 莫尔超晶格中临界电流的大小由微带带宽决定，带宽越窄，临界电流越小；该标度关系在石墨烯超晶格中具有普适性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：莫尔超晶格中临界电流的大小由微带带宽决定，带宽越窄，临界电流越小；该标度关系在石墨烯超晶格中具有普适性。；创新点：首次建立了微带带宽与高电流输运临界电流之间的直接联系，并证明该关系是石墨烯莫尔超晶格的普适特征，从而将高电流输运区确立为一种快速、易行的带宽演化电学探针。
papers.method_zh: 通过施加垂直位移场连续调控价带带宽，测量高电流输运区的临界电流，并结合最小解析模型与带宽计算进行对比分析。

papers.title: Breathing mode inducing dynamical pairing in Kagome materials
papers.abstract: The breathing mode in Kagome materials is a structural modulation that breaks inversion symmetry and has been shown to be a crucial source for intriguing phases in the normal state. In this work, we carry out a full classification of superconducting symmetries in kagome superconductors and demonstrate the emergence of odd-frequency dynamical Cooper pairs entirely driven by the breathing mode. We then show that odd-frequency spin-singlet Cooper pairs can be realized by controlling the breathing mode in kagome lattices with conventional spin-singlet $s$-wave superconductivity. Since odd-frequency pairing is intrinsically nonlocal in time, our results put forward the breathing mode for designing dynamical Cooper pairs in kagome materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“carry out a full classification of superconducting symmetries”（对称性分类）、“demonstrate the emergence”（理论论证）、“show that... can be realized”（理论预言），未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：Kagome材料中的呼吸模（breathing mode）及其诱导的非常规超导配对，具体关注奇数频率（odd-frequency）动力学库珀对。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Kagome材料中的呼吸模（一种破坏反演对称性的结构调制）能够完全驱动奇数频率动力学库珀对的产生；在具有常规自旋单态s波超导的Kagome晶格中，通过控制呼吸模可实现奇数频率自旋单态库珀对。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Kagome材料中的呼吸模（一种破坏反演对称性的结构调制）能够完全驱动奇数频率动力学库珀对的产生；在具有常规自旋单态s波超导的Kagome晶格中，通过控制呼吸模可实现奇数频率自旋单态库珀对。；创新点：首次揭示呼吸模作为驱动奇数频率动力学库珀对的唯一来源，并指出可通过调控呼吸模在常规s波超导Kagome体系中实现时间非局域的奇数频率配对。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 超导对称性完整分类（full classification of superconducting symmetries），基于对称性分析的理论推导。

papers.title: Exact interlayer triplet-pairing eigenstates in the extended Hubbard model
papers.abstract: $η$-pairing symmetry generalizes the pairing mechanisms in superconductivity but is broken in the presence of interlayer interactions. In this work, we extend this approach to triplet pairs. We propose interlayer triplet-pairing operators for the multi-layer extended Hubbard model. We find that a set of exact condensate-pair eigenstates can be constructed, which exhibit off-diagonal long-range order. In contrast to the $η$-pairing mechanism, this originates from restricted spectrum generating algebra and is only available for bilayer and trilayer systems in the presence of interlayer Hubbard interactions. Nevertheless, the system also retains the original on-site $η$-pairing symmetry in the absence of interlayer interactions. Consequently, both singlet and triplet pairs coexist in the eigenstates of the multi-layer Hubbard model. We employ quench dynamics to demonstrate the results through numerical simulations. Our findings open avenues for the study of exact condensate-pair states in strongly correlated systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exact eigenstates、restricted spectrum generating algebra、quench dynamics、numerical simulations。；研究对象：多层扩展Hubbard模型中的层间三重态配对态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在多层层间Hubbard相互作用存在时，可以构造出一组精确的凝聚对（condensate-pair）本征态，这些态具有非对角长程序；该机制源于受限谱生成代数，仅适用于双层和三层系统，且与原有的η配对对称性共存，导致单重态和三重态对在多层Hubbard模型本征态中同时存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在多层层间Hubbard相互作用存在时，可以构造出一组精确的凝聚对（condensate-pair）本征态，这些态具有非对角长程序；该机制源于受限谱生成代数，仅适用于双层和三层系统，且与原有的η配对对称性共存，导致单重态和三重态对在多层Hubbard模型本征态中同时存在。；创新点：将η配对对称性推广至三重态配对，并发现层间Hubbard相互作用下可构造精确三重态配对本征态，突破了传统η配对在层间相互作用下被破坏的限制。
papers.method_zh: 理论构造（层间三重态配对算符、受限谱生成代数分析）结合数值模拟（quench dynamics，即淬火动力学模拟）。

papers.title: Diffusiophoretic transport of colloids and emulsions in complex environments
papers.abstract: Chemical gradients are ubiquitous in porous and crowded environments, including soils, filters, fabrics, tissues, hydrogels, biofilms and living cells. They arise from displacement fronts, dissolution and precipitation, ion exchange, metabolism, root exudation, evaporation, gas dissolution, freeze--thaw cycles and externally imposed chemical treatments. These gradients can drive colloids, macromolecules and emulsion droplets by diffusiophoresis, while simultaneously driving diffusioosmotic flows along confining surfaces. Classical models of colloid transport in porous media emphasize hydrodynamic dispersion, surface interactions, straining, deposition, detachment and filtration. This chapter places diffusiophoresis within that broader transport framework and reviews how porous media generate, stretch, disperse and sustain the solute gradients that drive phoretic motion. We first discuss sources of chemical gradients and the distinction between spreading and mixing, then summarize classical colloid transport, the minimal physicochemical model for diffusiophoresis and diffusioosmosis, and the experimental platforms used to study these effects. Particular emphasis is placed on recent results showing that diffuse solute fronts can enhance phoretic removal from dead-end pores by prolonging the duration of forcing, and that cross-streamline migration within flowing pathways can change macroscopic breakthrough and dispersion by orders of magnitude. We close by discussing emulsion droplets, multiphase flows, confined and living media, and open problems, including the transition from algebraic mixing in two-dimensional micromodels to chaotic mixing in three-dimensional porous media.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/综述文章。判断依据：关键词为“reviews”、“classical models”、“minimal physicochemical model”、“open problems”，属于对已有理论和实验的系统梳理与展望。；研究对象：胶体与乳液在复杂多孔及受限环境中的扩散泳输运现象。具体涉及：多孔介质、水凝胶、生物膜、活细胞等复杂环境中的化学梯度驱动下的胶体、大分子和乳液液滴运动。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 扩散溶质前沿可通过延长驱动力持续时间增强从死端孔隙中去除颗粒的泳动效应；在流动通道中，跨流线迁移可数量级地改变宏观穿透曲线和弥散行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：扩散溶质前沿可通过延长驱动力持续时间增强从死端孔隙中去除颗粒的泳动效应；在流动通道中，跨流线迁移可数量级地改变宏观穿透曲线和弥散行为。；创新点：将扩散泳置于多孔介质输运的广义框架中，系统阐述了多孔介质如何生成、拉伸、分散和维持驱动泳动运动的溶质梯度，并特别强调了溶质前沿对死端孔隙去除效率的增强作用以及跨流线迁移对宏观输运的显著影响。
papers.method_zh: 基于经典胶体输运框架（水动力弥散、表面相互作用、过滤等），结合扩散泳与扩散渗流的最小物理化学模型，并综述了用于研究这些效应的实验平台。

papers.title: Effect of radially heterogeneous band gap collapse on formation of swift heavy ion tracks in Al2O3
papers.abstract: We estimate the effects of radial heterogeneity in the collapse of the electronic band gap on the damage in Al2O3 after impact of a swift heavy ion decelerated in the electronic stopping regime. The Monte Carlo code TREKIS describes the initial excitation of the electronic and ionic systems following the ion passage, while the density functional theory based molecular dynamics traces changes in the band structure in the ion track. This combination of methods enables us to compute the profile of energy transferred to the lattice by the time of relaxation of the electronic excitation, accounting for the induced spatial inhomogeneity of the band structure around the ion trajectory. We demonstrate that impact of a 700 MeV Bi ion induces a transient metal-semiconductor heterojunction in Al2O3: the metallization (the band gap collapse) occurs within a radius of about 2 nm from the ion trajectory. The band gap shrinks at distances of about 3-5 nm, while it remains almost unaffected at radii larger than 5 nm. Using this data, we estimate the atomic heating depending on the degree of band gap reduction at different radii from the ion trajectory. This approach refines the damage modeling, producing more pronounced discontinuous damage patterns along the ion path for all crystallographic directions compared to the model that assumes all the energy accumulated in the electron-hole ensemble is delivered to the atoms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：使用了蒙特卡洛代码（TREKIS）和基于密度泛函理论的分子动力学（DFT-MD）进行模拟计算。；研究对象：论文研究的是在电子阻止能损机制下，快重离子辐照对Al2O3（氧化铝）造成的损伤，特别是电子能带结构径向不均匀塌缩对损伤形成的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 研究发现，700 MeV的Bi离子撞击会在Al2O3中沿离子轨迹形成一个瞬态的金属-半导体异质结：在轨迹中心约2 nm半径内发生能带塌缩（金属化），在3-5 nm半径内能带隙缩小，而大于5 nm的区域能带结构几乎不受影响。这种径向不均匀的能带塌缩会导致沿离子路径产生更明显的不连续损伤图案。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：研究发现，700 MeV的Bi离子撞击会在Al2O3中沿离子轨迹形成一个瞬态的金属-半导体异质结：在轨迹中心约2 nm半径内发生能带塌缩（金属化），在3-5 nm半径内能带隙缩小，而大于5 nm的区域能带结构几乎不受影响。这种径向不均匀的能带塌缩会导致沿离子路径产生更明显的不连续损伤图案。；创新点：该工作首次在损伤建模中明确考虑了快重离子径迹周围能带结构塌缩的径向不均匀性（即从金属化到半导体再到绝缘体的空间渐变），并展示了这种不均匀性对原子加热和最终损伤图案的精细化影响，比假设所有电子-空穴对能量均匀传递给原子的模型更精确。
papers.method_zh: 采用了两步模拟方法：1）使用蒙特卡洛代码TREKIS描述离子通过后电子和离子系统的初始激发；2）使用基于密度泛函理论的分子动力学（DFT-MD）追踪离子径迹中能带结构的变化。通过结合这两种方法，计算了电子激发弛豫时转移到晶格的能量分布，并考虑了能带结构的空间不均匀性。

papers.title: Phase diagram of a double-occupancy cell model of a fluid with Curie-Weiss interaction
papers.abstract: A double-occupancy cell model of a fluid with Curie-Weiss interaction is studied. First, we show that the model is isomorphic to the Blume-Capel model on a complete graph through a simple transformation from spin to occupancy variables. We then investigate its phase behavior within the grand-canonical ensemble using a combination of analytical and numerical methods. Despite its simplicity, the model exhibits a remarkably rich thermodynamic behavior depending on the ratio between the local repulsive and global attractive interactions. We identify regimes characterized by a single critical point, two distinct critical points, tricritical behavior, and triple-point formation. For sufficiently strong repulsion, the system possesses three fluid phases of different densities, leading to both gas-liquid and liquid-liquid coexistence. The locations of the critical, tricritical, and triple points are determined, and the corresponding phase diagrams are constructed. These results demonstrate that the competition between double-occupancy repulsion and long-range attraction is sufficient to generate complex phase behavior in a minimal multiple-occupancy lattice-gas model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“使用解析与数值方法结合”“研究相行为”“构建相图”，属于统计物理与凝聚态理论建模研究。；研究对象：具有Curie-Weiss相互作用的双占据格子气模型（double-occupancy cell model of a fluid with Curie-Weiss interaction），具体研究该模型在局域排斥与全局吸引竞争下的相变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型在局域排斥与全局吸引的竞争下展现出丰富的热力学行为，包括单一临界点、两个不同临界点、三临界行为以及三相点形成；当排斥足够强时，系统存在三种不同密度的流体相，导致气-液和液-液共存。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型在局域排斥与全局吸引的竞争下展现出丰富的热力学行为，包括单一临界点、两个不同临界点、三临界行为以及三相点形成；当排斥足够强时，系统存在三种不同密度的流体相，导致气-液和液-液共存。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过从自旋变量到占据变量的简单变换，证明该模型与完全图上的Blume-Capel模型同构；在巨正则系综下采用解析与数值方法结合研究相行为，确定临界点、三临界点和三相点的位置并构建相图。

papers.title: Complex crystal structure prediction using ML-enhanced multi-minima iterative genetic algorithm
papers.abstract: Current machine learning (ML) approaches for materials discovery rely heavily on known structural databases, limiting their ability to identify entirely novel structure types. In this work, we develop a multi-minima iterative genetic algorithm (MMIGA) that integrates an artificial-neural-network machine learning (ANN-ML) interatomic potential with an iterative, metadynamics-inspired penalty scheme. We demonstrate the robustness of this method on a complex ternary La-Co-Pb system, characterized by Co-Pb immiscibility and an intricate energy landscape. The ML-enhanced MMIGA successfully predicts the ground-state Pbam structure of the recently synthesized La4Co4Pb antagonistic-pair-phase, a novel structure missed by previous database-reliant ML predictions, while also identifying multiple metastable competing phases. Additionally, we challenged the MMIGA method to predict the structure of La5CoPb2 antagonistic-pair-phase, a new compound discovered during earlier attempts to synthesize the predicted phase La3CoPb. With only knowledge of the composition, our MMIGA approach successfully predicts the orthorhombic structure of La5CoPb2, producing an exact match with the structure independently determined by x-ray diffraction. By efficiently mapping both global minimum and relevant competing metastable states, this approach provides critical theoretical insights into phase selection for novel quantum and magnetic materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：genetic algorithm、machine learning、interatomic potential、structure prediction）；研究对象：复杂三元La-Co-Pb体系，特别是La4Co4Pb和La5CoPb2两种“拮抗对相”（antagonistic-pair-phase）的晶体结构预测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: ML增强的多极小迭代遗传算法（MMIGA）成功预测了La4Co4Pb的基态Pbam结构（此前依赖数据库的ML方法未能发现），并准确预测了La5CoPb2的正交结构，与X射线衍射独立确定的结构完全一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：ML增强的多极小迭代遗传算法（MMIGA）成功预测了La4Co4Pb的基态Pbam结构（此前依赖数据库的ML方法未能发现），并准确预测了La5CoPb2的正交结构，与X射线衍射独立确定的结构完全一致。；创新点：提出了一种不依赖已知结构数据库的晶体结构预测方法，能够同时高效地搜索全局最小能量结构及相关亚稳态竞争相，为新型量子与磁性材料的相选择提供关键理论见解。
papers.method_zh: 多极小迭代遗传算法（MMIGA），集成人工神经网络机器学习（ANN-ML）原子间势，并结合基于元动力学（metadynamics）启发的迭代惩罚方案。

papers.title: Geometry-Driven Magnetoelectric Coupling in Two-Dimensional Compensated Ferrimagnets
papers.abstract: The magnetoelectric coupling in compensated magnets enables stray-field-free manipulation of spin-splitting, holding great promise for spintronics, but inherently hindered by the symmetry mismatch between spatial-inversion-broken ferroelectricity and time-reversal-broken spin states. Here, based on a symmetry-decoupled analysis of magnetoelectric coupling in compensated magnets, we establish a geometry-driven spin-ferroelectric coupling mechanism in bilayer breathing kagome lattices. Within this geometric framework interlocking the out-of-plane electric polarization with cooperative intralayer structural distortions, we demonstrate that polarization switching drives a deterministic reversal of the global spin splitting. First-principles calculations on a prototype bilayer Nb3Cl8 successfully validate this mechanism, demonstrating the switching of spin-splitting states through an energetically feasible, asynchronous layer-by-layer transition pathway. Our proposed coupling originates from lattice geometry and structural symmetry, establishing a unique route toward switchable spin splitting in compensated ferrimagnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含第一性原理计算）。判断依据：symmetry-decoupled analysis、First-principles calculations、geometry-driven mechanism。；研究对象：二维补偿铁磁体中的磁电耦合，具体以双层呼吸笼目晶格（bilayer breathing kagome lattices）为模型体系，原型材料为双层Nb₃Cl₈。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种几何驱动的自旋-铁电耦合机制：在双层呼吸笼目晶格中，面外电极化与层内结构畸变协同锁定，使得极化翻转能够确定性地反转全局自旋劈裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种几何驱动的自旋-铁电耦合机制：在双层呼吸笼目晶格中，面外电极化与层内结构畸变协同锁定，使得极化翻转能够确定性地反转全局自旋劈裂。；创新点：通过晶格几何与结构对称性设计，在补偿铁磁体中实现了无需杂散场的可切换自旋劈裂，克服了传统磁电耦合中空间反演破缺铁电性与时间反演破缺自旋态之间的对称性失配。
papers.method_zh: 对称性解耦分析（symmetry-decoupled analysis）建立几何框架，结合第一性原理计算（First-principles calculations）在原型材料双层Nb₃Cl₈上验证机制，并揭示能量可行的异步逐层过渡路径（asynchronous layer-by-layer transition pathway）。

papers.title: Exceptional points in dissipative coupling polaron-polaritons
papers.abstract: Understanding how strong correlations and dissipation combine to shape collective quantum excitations is a central challenge in many-body physics. We investigate the effect of dissipative light-matter coupling on strongly interacting exciton-polaritons in the presence of a biexciton resonance, which gives rise to polaron-polariton quasiparticles. We show that the interplay between many-body correlations and non-Hermitian coupling generates anomalous dispersion relations and exceptional points in the polaron-polariton spectrum. The location and coexistence of exceptional points are controlled by the dissipative coupling and the relative decay rates of the excitonic and photonic constituents, allowing them to emerge across different polaron-polariton branches. These results identify dissipative polaron-polaritons as a versatile platform for exploring non-Hermitian many-body physics with tunable light-matter quasiparticles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：We investigate, We show, These results identify（理论分析与预言）。；研究对象：耗散耦合下的极化激元-极化激元（polaron-polaritons）体系，具体是存在双激子共振的强相互作用激子-极化激元系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了耗散光-物质耦合与多体关联的相互作用会在极化激元-极化激元谱中产生反常色散关系和奇异点（exceptional points），且奇异点的位置和共存性可由耗散耦合强度及激子/光子组分的相对衰减率调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了耗散光-物质耦合与多体关联的相互作用会在极化激元-极化激元谱中产生反常色散关系和奇异点（exceptional points），且奇异点的位置和共存性可由耗散耦合强度及激子/光子组分的相对衰减率调控。；创新点：将非厄米物理（奇异点）与强关联多体物理（极化激元-极化激元）相结合，提出耗散极化激元-极化激元作为研究可调谐光-物质准粒子非厄米多体物理的通用平台。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，具体涉及非厄米耦合（non-Hermitian coupling）与多体关联（many-body correlations）的结合，用于处理双激子共振下的极化激元-极化激元准粒子。

papers.title: Magnon-polaron mediated spin Seebeck effect in altermagnets
papers.abstract: Altermagnets, distinguished by compensated antiparallel spins yet nondegenerate magnon spectra, bridge the gap between ferromagnets and antiferromagnets. Although several probes such as anisotropic transport and spectroscopic measurements have been proposed to identify altermagnetic order, experimentally accessible transport signatures remain highly desirable. Here, we show that in altermagnets subject to an external magnetic field, the spin Seebeck effect exhibits pronounced directional anisotropy. Specifically, the spin Seebeck coefficient differs significantly along in-plane directions, and this anisotropy increases with field strength. Magnetoelastic interactions further produce resonant peaks whose positions with respect to an applied magnetic field reflect the intrinsic magnon band anisotropy, and provide localized features that enhance the distinguishability of the altermagnetic response. The peaks provide a robust experimental signature of altermagnetic order. Our findings serve as signatures of altermagnetic order while laying the groundwork for their application in spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we show”“our findings”等表述，未提及实验或计算具体手段，主要基于理论推导和模型分析。；研究对象：交变磁体（altermagnets）中的自旋塞贝克效应（spin Seebeck effect），特别是磁振子-极化子（magnon-polaron）介导的输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在外加磁场下，交变磁体的自旋塞贝克系数沿面内方向表现出显著的各向异性，且该各向异性随磁场增强而增大；磁弹性相互作用产生的共振峰位置反映了磁振子能带的固有各向异性，可作为交变磁序的稳健实验标志。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在外加磁场下，交变磁体的自旋塞贝克系数沿面内方向表现出显著的各向异性，且该各向异性随磁场增强而增大；磁弹性相互作用产生的共振峰位置反映了磁振子能带的固有各向异性，可作为交变磁序的稳健实验标志。；创新点：首次提出利用自旋塞贝克效应的方向各向异性及其磁弹性共振峰作为交变磁序的实验可观测输运特征，为交变磁体的识别提供了新的、易于实验实现的探测手段。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，具体包括：基于磁振子能带各向异性的模型推导、磁弹性耦合（magnetoelastic interactions）对自旋塞贝克效应的影响分析、共振峰与磁场关系的理论预测。

papers.title: Single Chain Expulsion from Diblock Copolymer Micelles with Dense Corona
papers.abstract: We use self-consistent field theory to investigate the free energy landscape for single-chain expulsion from a diblock copolymer micelle with a dense corona. Using the distance from the micelle center-of-mass to the hydrophilic-hydrophobic junction of the chain as the reaction coordinate, we compute the free energy landscape for chain exchange. Our results show that the expulsion free energy barrier scales linearly with both the hydrophobic block length and the solvent selectivity, consistent with recent experiments. To accurately resolve chain conformation, we introduce a second reaction coordinate: the distance between the junction and the free end of the hydrophobic block, and construct a two-dimensional free energy surface. Using the string method to identify the minimum energy path, we find that all pathways converge to a nearly degenerate reaction channel, irrespective of the initial path. Within this channel, the end-to-end distance of the hydrophobic block exhibits a broad distribution, yet the corresponding expulsion barriers remain nearly indistinguishable. Together, these findings establish a continuum-level theoretical foundation for understanding the hyperstretching mechanism and the transition state ensemble in micellar chain exchange.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：self-consistent field theory（自洽场理论）、free energy landscape（自由能景观）、string method（弦方法）。；研究对象：双嵌段共聚物胶束中单链从致密电晕层中排出的过程，具体关注链交换的自由能景观与过渡态机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单链排出的自由能垒与疏水嵌段长度及溶剂选择性呈线性关系，与近期实验一致；所有最小能量路径收敛于一个近乎简并的反应通道，在该通道内疏水嵌段的末端距分布广泛但对应的排出势垒几乎不可区分。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单链排出的自由能垒与疏水嵌段长度及溶剂选择性呈线性关系，与近期实验一致；所有最小能量路径收敛于一个近乎简并的反应通道，在该通道内疏水嵌段的末端距分布广泛但对应的排出势垒几乎不可区分。；创新点：通过二维自由能曲面与弦方法，首次在连续介质理论层面揭示了胶束链交换中的“超拉伸机制”（hyperstretching mechanism）与过渡态系综（transition state ensemble）的微观图像。
papers.method_zh: 自洽场理论（SCFT）计算自由能景观；引入两个反应坐标（链的亲水-疏水连接点距胶束质心的距离、连接点与疏水嵌段自由端之间的距离）构建二维自由能曲面；采用弦方法（string method）确定最小能量路径。

papers.title: Tensor Network Solvers for Ultra-large Tight-binding Hamiltonians: Algorithms and Applications
papers.abstract: Understanding quantum materials at meso and even macroscopic scales requires tight-binding calculations on system sizes where explicit matrix representations become prohibitively costly. This represents a major bottleneck to rationalize phenomena in moiré and super-moiré heterostructures and quasicrystals. Here, we present a unified tensor-network methodology to solve tight-binding problems at exceptionally large scales, by mapping a system of $N = 2^L$ sites onto a many-body problem of $L$ pseudospin sites, which is subsequently solved with tensor network algorithms. For Hamiltonians with compressible real-space structure, the tensor network bond dimension remains modest, typically of order a few tens, independent of $N$.Tensor network representations of arbitrary hopping functions including long-range, spatially modulated, and twisted-layer couplings are built with quantics tensor cross interpolation, and all physical observables are evaluated entirely with tensor network algebra without explicit matrix storage or diagonalization. We demonstrate applications to spectral functions, momentum-space spectra via the tensor-network quantum Fourier transform, real-space topological invariants, real-time dynamics, correlation induced symmetry breaking with self-consistent mean-field calculations, non-Hermitian phenomena, and excitonic many-body physics. Our methodology enables routinely solving systems with billions of sites, by leveraging the tensor network compressibility of real-space structures, and establishing a flexible framework to study quantum matter at ultra-large length scales. The methodology is implemented in the open-source Julia package TensorBinding.jl.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：tensor-network methodology、tight-binding calculations、open-source Julia package。；研究对象：超大尺度紧束缚模型，包括莫尔/超莫尔异质结、准晶等量子材料中的电子结构、拓扑性质、动力学及多体物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将N=2^L个格点映射为L个赝自旋格点的多体问题，并利用张量网络算法，可在不显式存储或对角化矩阵的情况下，高效求解包含数十亿格点的紧束缚哈密顿量，且键维数仅需数十量级，与系统大小N无关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将N=2^L个格点映射为L个赝自旋格点的多体问题，并利用张量网络算法，可在不显式存储或对角化矩阵的情况下，高效求解包含数十亿格点的紧束缚哈密顿量，且键维数仅需数十量级，与系统大小N无关。；创新点：提出统一的张量网络框架，将超大尺度紧束缚问题转化为可压缩的赝自旋多体问题，使得系统尺寸可扩展至数十亿格点，并支持非厄米现象、激子多体物理等广泛物理量的计算，突破了传统显式矩阵方法的规模瓶颈。
papers.method_zh: 采用量子张量交叉插值（quantics tensor cross interpolation）构建任意跃迁函数（包括长程、空间调制、扭曲层耦合）的张量网络表示；利用张量网络量子傅里叶变换计算动量空间谱；结合自洽平均场处理关联诱导的对称性破缺；所有物理量均通过张量网络代数计算，无需显式矩阵存储或对角化。方法已实现为开源Julia包TensorBinding.jl。

papers.title: Substrate-dependent electrical transport in individual single-walled carbon nanotubes grown across SiO$_2$ and hexagonal boron nitride
papers.abstract: The electronic transport properties of carbon nanotubes (CNTs) are strongly affected by their surrounding environment, making the underlying substrate a critical factor for device performance. Here, we demonstrate enhanced carrier transport of individual single-walled CNTs on hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) by directly comparing CNT channels on SiO$_2$ and hBN within the same nanotube. This within-tube comparison removes tube-to-tube variability in chirality, diameter, and defect density, allowing the intrinsic substrate effect to be evaluated more reliably. The CNTs were synthesized using gas flow-directed growth, which yields long, well-aligned CNTs without transfer processes, allowing a single nanotube to extend across different substrate regions. Multichannel field-effect transistors fabricated along an individual CNT exhibit clear ambipolar characteristics. CNT channels on hBN consistently exhibit higher field-effect mobility than those on SiO$_2$. In contrast, temperature-dependent transport near the charge neutrality point exhibits thermally activated behavior with similar activation energies (15-20 meV) on both substrates, indicating that the intrinsic small bandgap of CNTs is largely unaffected by the substrate. These results provide direct evidence that hBN enhances low-field carrier transport in CNTs and establish a foundation for the fabrication of high-performance electronics based on hBN-supported CNTs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：demonstrate、fabricated、exhibit、temperature-dependent transport。；研究对象：单个单壁碳纳米管（single-walled carbon nanotubes）在二氧化硅（SiO₂）和六方氮化硼（hBN）两种衬底上的电输运特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在同一根单壁碳纳米管上，hBN衬底上的沟道始终表现出比SiO₂衬底更高的场效应迁移率，但两种衬底上靠近电荷中性点附近的温度依赖输运均呈现热激活行为，且激活能相近（15-20 meV），表明碳纳米管的本征小带隙基本不受衬底影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在同一根单壁碳纳米管上，hBN衬底上的沟道始终表现出比SiO₂衬底更高的场效应迁移率，但两种衬底上靠近电荷中性点附近的温度依赖输运均呈现热激活行为，且激活能相近（15-20 meV），表明碳纳米管的本征小带隙基本不受衬底影响。；创新点：通过在同一根单壁碳纳米管上直接比较SiO₂和hBN两种衬底上的输运性能，消除了管间在手性、直径和缺陷密度上的差异，从而更可靠地评估了衬底的固有影响。
papers.method_zh: 采用气流导向生长法合成长且排列整齐的单壁碳纳米管，无需转移过程即可使同一根纳米管跨越不同衬底区域；制备多通道场效应晶体管，进行电输运测量（包括场效应迁移率提取和变温输运测量）。

papers.title: Modification of Damon-Eshbach magnetostatic mode spectra in ferromagnet/paramagnet bilayer
papers.abstract: Using the magnetostatic approximation, we calculate the spectra of bulk and surface spin waves in an in-plane magnetized ferromagnet/paramagnet bilayer.
