Due to the dipolar coupling between the layers, the paramagnet becomes polarized, which in turn modifies the spectrum of the Damon-Eshbach magnetostatic modes. We assume that the paramagnet is characterized by a magnetic susceptibility, $χ\propto 1/(T-T_C)$, which reaches large values when the system temperature $T$ is close to the Curie temperature $T_C$. We find the conditions under which surface spin waves become unidirectional, i.e., capable of carrying energy in only one direction, and determine the magnitude of their frequency nonreciprocity. We demonstrate the possibility of switching the unidirectional wave regime on and off by varying the external magnetic field or temperature, making the ferromagnet/paramagnet system an attractive platform for tunable magnonic logic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：magnetostatic approximation（静磁近似）、calculate（计算）、we find（我们发现）。；研究对象：面内磁化的铁磁体/顺磁体双层膜中的Damon-Eshbach静磁模式谱。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 顺磁层因与铁磁层的偶极耦合而被极化，从而改变Damon-Eshbach静磁模式的谱；通过调节外磁场或温度，可实现表面自旋波单向传播模式的开/关切换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：顺磁层因与铁磁层的偶极耦合而被极化，从而改变Damon-Eshbach静磁模式的谱；通过调节外磁场或温度，可实现表面自旋波单向传播模式的开/关切换。；创新点：揭示了在铁磁/顺磁双层体系中，通过温度或外磁场调控顺磁层磁化率，可实现表面自旋波单向性（频率非互易性）的开关控制，为可调谐磁子逻辑器件提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 采用静磁近似（magnetostatic approximation）计算体自旋波和表面自旋波的谱；顺磁层用磁化率χ∝1/(T-T_C)描述，当温度接近居里温度时χ达到大值。

papers.title: First-principles calculations of spin-split bands in chiral hybrid organic-inorganic perovskites ($R$/$S$-PEA)PbI$_3$ and ($R$/$S$-NEA)PbI$_3$
papers.abstract: Chiral hybrid organic-inorganic perovskites provide a promising platform for investigating the physics of chirality-driven spin-split bands because they combine robust molecular chirality with strong spin-orbit coupling from heavy inorganic ions. First-principles calculations including spin-orbit coupling are performed for the one-dimensional chiral perovskites ($R$/$S$-PEA)PbI$_3$ and ($R$/$S$-NEA)PbI$_3$ to compare their spin-split band structures and to identify the factors controlling their differences. In ($R$/$S$-PEA)PbI$_3$, the lowest conduction bands predominantly consist of Pb orbitals, whereas in ($R$/$S$-NEA)PbI$_3$, they are formed by hybridization between Pb orbitals and the lowest unoccupied molecular orbital of NEA. Both compounds exhibit pronounced spin splitting near the valence-band maximum and conduction-band minimum. The effective spin splitting of the edges of the valence bands is stronger in ($R$/$S$-NEA)PbI$_3$, despite similar linear-in-$k$ splitting coefficients near the relevant high-symmetry points. This enhancement originates from larger gaps induced by spin-orbit coupling at high-symmetry points and band (anti)crossings in the multiband structure. For a given molecular handedness, the PEA- and NEA-based compounds exhibit opposite spin textures, consistent with the opposite chiral distortions of the [PbI$_6$]$^{4-}$ octahedra and with the previously observed opposite signs of circular dichroism. Group-theoretical analysis for the nonsymmorphic space group $P2_12_12_1$ further accounts for band sticking, symmetry-enforced degeneracies, and the disappearance of spin polarization at specific Brillouin-zone-boundary points. These results provide a solid foundation for future studies of chirality-dependent electromagnetic responses, including circular dichroism, in chiral hybrid organic-inorganic perovskites.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：First-principles calculations、spin-orbit coupling、group-theoretical analysis。；研究对象：手性杂化有机-无机钙钛矿 (R/S-PEA)PbI₃ 和 (R/S-NEA)PbI₃ 中的自旋劈裂能带结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 两种手性钙钛矿在价带顶和导带底附近均表现出显著的自旋劈裂，且 (R/S-NEA)PbI₃ 的价带边有效自旋劈裂更强，这源于高对称点处自旋-轨道耦合诱导的更大能隙以及多能带结构中的能带（反）交叉。对于给定的分子手性，两种化合物表现出相反的自旋织构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：两种手性钙钛矿在价带顶和导带底附近均表现出显著的自旋劈裂，且 (R/S-NEA)PbI₃ 的价带边有效自旋劈裂更强，这源于高对称点处自旋-轨道耦合诱导的更大能隙以及多能带结构中的能带（反）交叉。对于给定的分子手性，两种化合物表现出相反的自旋织构。；创新点：系统比较了两种不同有机阳离子（PEA 与 NEA）的手性钙钛矿的自旋劈裂差异，并揭示了导致 (R/S-NEA)PbI₃ 中更强自旋劈裂的微观机制（能隙与能带交叉效应）。同时，通过群论解释了布里渊区边界处的能带粘合、对称性强制简并及自旋极化消失现象。摘要未突出说明与实验结果的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用包含自旋-轨道耦合的第一性原理计算（DFT+SO），并结合非对称空间群 P2₁2₁2₁ 的群论分析。

papers.title: Symmetry Classification of Non-Reciprocal Responses in Multiterminal Ring Devices
papers.abstract: We present a symmetry-based framework to classify the non-reciprocal responses of multiterminal ring quantum devices. The device is modeled as a ring of $n$ vertices, where a binary variable $e_k\in\{+1,-1\}$ on each bond encodes the preferred direction of signal flow between terminals. Non-reciprocity corresponds to a preferred current configuration on the ring, and the symmetry group of the device partitions all $2^n$ configurations into equivalence classes(orbits) characterized by a topological winding number $W$. Using the minimal non-trivial case $n=3$, we establish two results independent of microscopic details. First, lifting the degeneracy within an orbit generates non-reciprocal responses. For $n=3$ this requires simultaneous breaking of both time-reversal $T$ and spatial inversion $I$. Breaking either alone is insufficient. Second, the residual geometry symmetry after $T$ and $I$ are broken determines which responses are observable. For an isosceles triangular geometry, only two types of response are allowed: uniform circulation (all bonds carrying current in the same direction) and semi-circulation with the reversed bond on the geometrically distinct base. Semi-circulation with the reversed bond on either equal leg is symmetry-forbidden. Both predictions are validated using a minimal toy model of three quantum dots coupled to superconducting baths, which demonstrates a reactive quantum circulator response.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有模型验证）。判断依据：提出对称性分类框架，建立拓扑绕数分类，并用最小玩具模型验证。；研究对象：多端环形量子器件中的非互易响应，具体为n个顶点构成的环上电流方向配置的对称性分类。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于最小非平凡情况n=3，同时打破时间反演对称性T和空间反演对称性I才能产生非互易响应；残余几何对称性决定哪些响应可观测，例如等腰三角形几何中仅允许均匀环流和底边反向的半环流两种响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于最小非平凡情况n=3，同时打破时间反演对称性T和空间反演对称性I才能产生非互易响应；残余几何对称性决定哪些响应可观测，例如等腰三角形几何中仅允许均匀环流和底边反向的半环流两种响应。；创新点：建立了基于对称性的多端环形器件非互易响应分类框架，揭示了拓扑绕数W与响应可观测性的几何对称性约束关系，并证明T和I必须同时破缺才能产生非互易响应。
papers.method_zh: 对称性群论分类（将2^n种电流配置按轨道分类，引入拓扑绕数W），以及最小玩具模型（三个量子点耦合超导浴）的数值验证。

papers.title: Imaging superconducting weak spots through vortex-assisted THz near-field photovoltage
papers.abstract: Nanoscale inhomogeneities are a defining feature of many superconducting materials, yet their local electromagnetic response has remained difficult to access experimentally. This is because their relevant energy scale lies in the terahertz range, where wavelengths -- on the order of hundreds of microns -- are too large to spatially resolve nanoscopic variations. Here, we demonstrate the first application of THz near-field photovoltage nanoscopy in a superconductor, achieving 300 nm spatial resolution at 2.52 THz. Scanning a current-biased NbN strip, we reveal photovoltage peaks within the bulk associated with nanoscopic defects of reduced superfluid density. The observed photovoltage follows the evolution of the vortex-dissipative state and is attributed to enhanced vortex-antivortex pair nucleation at defect sites. Together, these results open a direct route to probing how material inhomogeneities influence light-matter interactions in superconductors, with implications for superconducting devices and strongly inhomogeneous systems such as high-Tc and moiré materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验过程（“Scanning a current-biased NbN strip”）、使用的技术（“THz near-field photovoltage nanoscopy”）以及观测到的现象（“reveal photovoltage peaks”）。；研究对象：超导体中的纳米尺度不均匀性（weak spots），具体材料为氮化铌（NbN）薄膜。研究的物理现象是超导体的局域电磁响应，特别是与涡旋耗散态相关的光电压效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过太赫兹近场光电压纳米成像技术，在电流偏置的NbN薄膜中观测到与超流密度降低的纳米级缺陷相关的光电压峰，并证实该光电压源于缺陷处增强的涡旋-反涡旋对成核。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过太赫兹近场光电压纳米成像技术，在电流偏置的NbN薄膜中观测到与超流密度降低的纳米级缺陷相关的光电压峰，并证实该光电压源于缺陷处增强的涡旋-反涡旋对成核。；创新点：首次将太赫兹近场光电压纳米成像技术应用于超导体，克服了传统太赫兹成像因波长过大而无法分辨纳米尺度不均匀性的难题，为直接探测超导体中材料不均匀性对光-物质相互作用的影响开辟了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 太赫兹近场光电压纳米成像（THz near-field photovoltage nanoscopy）。实验在2.52 THz频率下进行，实现了300 nm的空间分辨率，并对样品施加了电流偏置。

papers.title: Strengthening and interface-mediated plastic co-deformation in an ultrafine Cr-Ni eutectic: A nanomechanical investigation
papers.abstract: Ultrafine eutectic heterostructures provide a stringent test of plasticity in high-strength materials, where deformation must be accommodated through interfaces and strain gradients. Room temperature ductility is typically limited by premature fracture of the hard phase, leaving open the fundamental questions regarding the interface spacing, atomic structure and local chemistry that enable plastic co-deformation. Here we address this question using a model system of Cr-Ni binary alloy, processed via electron-beam powder bed fusion that produces a lamellar eutectic microstructure of Cr-rich BCC and Ni-rich FCC phases, with an average interlamellar spacing of ~450 nm. Atomic-resolution STEM revealed a stepped semi-coherent FCC/BCC interface with the Kurdjumov-Sachs orientation relationship and Ni-enrichment confined to a few atomic planes on the BCC side. In situ micro-scale compression and tension tests in SEM demonstrate high flow stresses coupled with large plastic strains without cracking, indicating stable accommodation of plastic incompatibility. Correlative TEM/HR-STEM establishes a deformation sequence: initial plasticity is dominated by strain-gradient driven dislocation accumulation in the FCC lamellae adjacent to interfaces, followed by deformation twinning in FCC and local interfacial shear and reorientation. The BCC phase subsequently develops a high density of mobile dislocations. Atomistic modeling has been employed to understand the influence of the FCC/BCC interface atomic structure and chemistry on the slip activation in the hard phase. These findings show that nanoscale confinement, stepped K-S interfacial structure, and interfacial chemistry collectively promote dislocation glide in a hard phase below its monolithic brittle to ductile transition temperature, and plastic codeformation at high flow strengths.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：nanomechanical investigation、in situ micro-scale compression and tension tests、correlative TEM/HR-STEM、atomistic modeling）；研究对象：Cr-Ni二元共晶合金，具体为超细层状共晶组织（Cr-rich BCC相与Ni-rich FCC相，平均层间距~450 nm）及其界面介导的塑性共变形行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在超细Cr-Ni共晶中，纳米尺度约束、台阶状半共格K-S界面结构及界面Ni富集化学共同作用，使硬质BCC相在其单体脆-韧转变温度以下仍能激活位错滑移，从而实现高流变应力下的塑性共变形。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在超细Cr-Ni共晶中，纳米尺度约束、台阶状半共格K-S界面结构及界面Ni富集化学共同作用，使硬质BCC相在其单体脆-韧转变温度以下仍能激活位错滑移，从而实现高流变应力下的塑性共变形。；创新点：首次在超细共晶体系中系统揭示了界面间距、原子结构（台阶状K-S界面）和局域化学（Ni在BCC侧数原子层富集）三者协同作用如何使硬相在室温下实现塑性共变形，突破了传统对硬相过早断裂导致延性受限的认识。
papers.method_zh: 电子束粉末床熔融制备样品；原子分辨率扫描透射电镜（STEM）表征界面原子结构与化学；原位扫描电镜（SEM）微米尺度压缩与拉伸实验；关联透射电镜/高分辨STEM（TEM/HR-STEM）追踪变形序列；原子尺度建模（atomistic modeling）分析界面结构与化学对硬相滑移激活的影响。

papers.title: Characterization of Hydroxyls in Surface Oxide of Superconducting Tantalum and Their Mitigation in Quantum Circuits
papers.abstract: Recently, tantalum (Ta) has gained attention in superconducting quantum circuits due to the longer coherence times achieved when replacing niobium (Nb) in capacitor pads. Previous literature shows that surface oxides that form upon ambient exposure on superconducting metals such as Ta, Al, and Nb host two-level system (TLS) defects, which are a leading source of microwave loss and decoherence. While the surface oxides of Nb and Al have been extensively studied, Ta oxides remain less well understood. Using secondary ion mass spectrometry of alpha-Ta films deposited at 300 mm wafer scale, we show for the first time that hydroxyls accumulate in the Ta suboxide region above the underlying Ta. Angle-resolved X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy shows that the surface region is dominated by Ta2O5, with sub-stoichiometric TaOx present in between the Ta2O5 and underlying Ta. The thickness of the tantalum oxide is confirmed by transmission electron microscopy. We demonstrate that [OH] incorporation can be suppressed by replacing the native oxide with an oxide formed during chemical mechanical planarization of alpha-Ta films. Our findings support the hypothesis that TLS defects are non-uniform within the oxide thickness and suggest hydroxyls as a probable molecular origin of these loss channels. Furthermore, we show the feasibility of plasma nitridization as a method to decrease hydroxyl loading on alpha-Ta surfaces. The modulation of hydroxyl content through surface engineering of alpha-Ta can enable the fabrication of more robust, high-coherence superconducting quantum circuits by addressing a potential TLS source.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了二次离子质谱、角分辨X射线光电子能谱、透射电子显微镜等实验手段。；研究对象：超导金属钽（Ta）表面氧化物中的羟基（[OH]）及其对超导量子电路中退相干的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次发现羟基在钽的亚氧化物区域（Ta suboxide）中积累，并证明通过化学机械平坦化形成的氧化物或等离子体氮化处理可抑制羟基掺入，从而减少导致微波损耗的两能级系统缺陷。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次发现羟基在钽的亚氧化物区域（Ta suboxide）中积累，并证明通过化学机械平坦化形成的氧化物或等离子体氮化处理可抑制羟基掺入，从而减少导致微波损耗的两能级系统缺陷。；创新点：首次直接表征了超导钽表面氧化物中羟基的分布，并提出了通过表面工程调控羟基含量以抑制两能级系统缺陷的可行方案。
papers.method_zh: 二次离子质谱（SIMS）、角分辨X射线光电子能谱（ARXPS）、透射电子显微镜（TEM），以及化学机械平坦化（CMP）和等离子体氮化处理等表面工程方法。

papers.title: Two-dimensional vertically polarized Hg3AsSe4I monolayer for efficient photocatalytic water-splitting: promoting carrier separation by intrinsic electric field and Rashba effect
papers.abstract: Efficient separation of photo-excited electron-hole pairs is essential for developing the high performance photocatalysts towards light-driven water-splitting applications. To this end, pho tocatalytic performances of two-dimensional (2D) semiconducting ferroelectric (FE) materials with out-of-plane polarizations have been extensively explored. However, out-of-plane polarizations in 2D FE materials are susceptible to the critical thickness limitation and can be easily compensated by surface adsorbates. On the other hand, 2D vertically polarized materials with stable and ir reversible out-of-plane polarizations may overcome the critical thickness limitation, enabling the practical advantage for spatial separation of photo-excited electron-hole pairs during the photo catalytic reactions. In the current work, 2D vertically polarized Hg3AsSe4I, an experimentally synthesized van der Waals (vdW) layered material, has been systematically investigated as a high performance 2D photocatalyst. Owing to its semiconducting band gap suitable for visible-light absorption, high carrier mobility, and desirable band edge alignment ideally matching water reduc tion and oxidation potentials, Hg3AsSe4I monolayer fulfills both optical and electronic prerequisites for photocatalytic water-splitting reactions. Besides the stable vertical polarization able to persist in Hg3AsSe4I monolayer, the dual mechanism for efficient separation of photo-excited carriers has also been demonstrated. Rashba spin-orbit coupling (SOC) of large strength emerges within 2D Hg3AsSe4I, splitting the band edges into spin-resolved band branches with unique spin-momentum locking characters.........
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：systematically investigated、DFT（隐含）、Rashba spin-orbit coupling (SOC) 计算。；研究对象：二维垂直极化材料 Hg₃AsSe₄I 单层，用于光催化水分解。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Hg₃AsSe₄I 单层兼具适合可见光吸收的带隙、高载流子迁移率、匹配水分解氧化还原电位的能带边缘，以及稳定的垂直极化；其光生载流子的高效分离由内建电场和强 Rashba 自旋-轨道耦合双重机制驱动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Hg₃AsSe₄I 单层兼具适合可见光吸收的带隙、高载流子迁移率、匹配水分解氧化还原电位的能带边缘，以及稳定的垂直极化；其光生载流子的高效分离由内建电场和强 Rashba 自旋-轨道耦合双重机制驱动。；创新点：提出并验证了在二维垂直极化材料中，利用稳定的面外极化（克服临界厚度限制）与强 Rashba 效应协同促进光生电子-空穴对分离的新机制。
papers.method_zh: 基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的第一性原理计算，包含自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）效应，分析能带结构、载流子迁移率、极化特性及光催化性能。

papers.title: Non-self-averaging topological Anderson insulator
papers.abstract: Current research on the disordered topological quantum phases primarily focuses on the uncorrelated and short-range correlated disorder regime. These topological Anderson insulators are typically self-averaging. However, topological quantum systems with long-range correlated disorder have received limited attention due to the absence of tractable analytical methods. In fact, the long-range correlated disorder introduces more complex effects on topological quantum states. Here, we demonstrate that the long-range correlated disorder could induce anomalously statistical feature where the topological Anderson states become non-self-averaging, and the phase diagram is strongly dependent on individual disorder configurations. We term this statistical phase the non-self-averaging topological Anderson insulator. The non-self-averaging property is identified by the non-vanishing finite values of the relative variance of the Lyapunov exponent in the thermodynamic limit, alongside the non-Gaussian distributions of the Lyapunov exponent. Consequently, the topological properties of a single disordered sample deviate from the ensemble average, causing a breakdown of the central limit theorem. The non-self-averaging topological Anderson insulator provides insights into the interplay between correlated disorder and topology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：demonstrate、statistical feature、thermodynamic limit、Lyapunov exponent。；研究对象：具有长程关联无序的拓扑量子系统，具体为一种新型拓扑安德森绝缘体相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 长程关联无序可诱导拓扑安德森态出现非自平均统计特性，其相图强烈依赖于单个无序构型，导致中心极限定理失效。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：长程关联无序可诱导拓扑安德森态出现非自平均统计特性，其相图强烈依赖于单个无序构型，导致中心极限定理失效。；创新点：首次揭示了长程关联无序可导致拓扑安德森绝缘体出现非自平均行为，突破了以往对无序拓扑相研究中普遍假设的自平均性。
papers.method_zh: 通过计算热力学极限下Lyapunov指数的相对方差（非零有限值）及其非高斯分布来识别非自平均性质，属于解析与统计理论分析。

papers.title: The Role of Compressibility in Modified Quasi-Linear Viscoelasticity: A Comparison of Simple Shear and Torsion
papers.abstract: We investigate the role of compressibility in the modified quasi-linear viscoelastic (MQLV) constitutive framework for soft solids at finite strain, where shear and bulk responses are governed by distinct relaxation functions. Analytical and semi-analytical results are derived for simple shear and torsion, under incompressible and slightly compressible assumptions. We show that compressibility affects the response only when volume changes occur: under isochoric deformations, the bulk contribution vanishes, while even small deviations from isochoricity significantly alter the normal response. Shear stress and torque are largely insensitive to compressibility, whereas normal stress and axial force exhibit pronounced sensitivity due to the coupling between shear and bulk relaxation. We further demonstrate that volumetric effects interact with the Poynting effect: in simple shear they oppose each other, reducing relaxation, while in torsion they reinforce each other, enhancing it. These trends agree with brain tissue experiments but reveal limitations of the slightly compressible model for highly compressible materials, such as agarose gels. Overall, the results emphasise the importance of accounting for compressibility in modelling normal stress responses and motivate the development of fully compressible formulations and numerical implementations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：constitutive framework、analytical and semi-analytical results、theoretical comparison）；研究对象：软固体在有限应变下的可压缩性对修正准线性粘弹性（MQLV）本构框架的影响，具体比较简单剪切与扭转两种变形模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 可压缩性仅当体积变化发生时影响响应；在等容变形下体响应消失，而微小偏离等容性会显著改变法向响应。剪切应力与扭矩对可压缩性不敏感，但法向应力与轴向力因剪切与体松弛的耦合而高度敏感。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：可压缩性仅当体积变化发生时影响响应；在等容变形下体响应消失，而微小偏离等容性会显著改变法向响应。剪切应力与扭矩对可压缩性不敏感，但法向应力与轴向力因剪切与体松弛的耦合而高度敏感。；创新点：系统揭示了可压缩性在MQLV框架下对法向应力与Poynting效应的不同影响机制（简单剪切中相互抵消、扭转中相互增强），并指出微可压缩模型对高可压缩材料（如琼脂糖凝胶）的局限性。
papers.method_zh: 基于修正准线性粘弹性（MQLV）本构框架，在不可压缩与微可压缩假设下，推导简单剪切与扭转的解析与半解析结果。

papers.title: Vanadium superconducting microwave resonators on silicon wafers
papers.abstract: Understanding the correlation between material properties and microwave losses in superconducting films is a crucial subject for developing low-loss materials for quantum circuits. We focus on vanadium (V) as a novel material for superconducting quantum devices and discuss loss in V films in relation to their structural properties. Using a sputtering method, we grow four V-film structures on (001)-oriented Si wafers, employing Nb and Ta as the buffer and capping layer materials, respectively: Nb/V/Ta, Nb/V, V/Ta, and V. X-ray diffraction and atomic force microscopy reveal that the V films grown on the Nb buffer layers have higher uniformity of lattice orientation and smaller grain size than that directly grown on the Si wafer. Coplanar waveguide resonators are fabricated from the four V-film structures, and averaged photon number ($\langle n_{\rm ph} \rangle$) dependences of internal quality factor ($Q_{\rm int}$) are obtained by performing microwave measurements. By analyzing the obtained $Q_{\rm int}$ vs $\langle n_{\rm ph} \rangle$, it is found that loss at the V surface is dominated by $\langle n_{\rm ph} \rangle$-independent non-two-level-system (non-TLS) losses, which can be mitigated by introducing the Ta capping layer. Furthermore, the V films on the Nb buffer layers exhibit lower $Q_{\rm int}$ in the $\langle n_{\rm ph} \rangle$ range from 10$^{0}$ to 10$^{6}$ and higher non-TLS loss than that directly grown on Si wafers, even though the former has higher lattice-orientation uniformity than the latter. Origins of these trends might be relevant to V oxides, of which presence at surfaces and grain boundaries in bulk regions in the V resonators is suggested by energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, and/or V hydrides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：sputtering method（溅射法）、X-ray diffraction（X射线衍射）、atomic force microscopy（原子力显微镜）、microwave measurements（微波测量）。；研究对象：钒（Vanadium, V）超导薄膜及其在硅（Si）衬底上制备的共面波导谐振器。具体研究了不同缓冲层（Nb）和覆盖层（Ta）结构对薄膜性质及微波损耗的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 钒薄膜表面的微波损耗主要由与平均光子数无关的非二能级系统（non-TLS）损耗主导，引入Ta覆盖层可抑制该损耗。尽管在Nb缓冲层上生长的V薄膜具有更高的晶格取向均匀性，但其在宽光子数范围内的内部品质因子（Q_int）反而更低，非TLS损耗更高。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：钒薄膜表面的微波损耗主要由与平均光子数无关的非二能级系统（non-TLS）损耗主导，引入Ta覆盖层可抑制该损耗。尽管在Nb缓冲层上生长的V薄膜具有更高的晶格取向均匀性，但其在宽光子数范围内的内部品质因子（Q_int）反而更低，非TLS损耗更高。；创新点：首次系统研究了钒（V）作为超导量子器件新型材料的微波损耗特性，并揭示了其损耗机制（非TLS损耗主导）以及缓冲层/覆盖层（Nb/Ta）对损耗和薄膜结构的影响。摘要未突出说明与已有钒膜研究相比的具体新意。
papers.method_zh: 采用磁控溅射法在(001)取向的Si晶圆上生长了四种V薄膜结构（Nb/V/Ta, Nb/V, V/Ta, V）。使用X射线衍射（XRD）和原子力显微镜（AFM）表征薄膜结构。通过微波测量获得四种共面波导谐振器的内部品质因子（Q_int）随平均光子数（⟨n_ph⟩）的变化关系。利用能量色散X射线光谱（EDX）和X射线光电子能谱（XPS）分析元素成分。

papers.title: Electrical control of spin photocurrent in a magnetoelectric oxide Cr$_2$O$_3$
papers.abstract: Controlling magnetism by electric field or current is a central topic in spintronics. In this work, we argue that the magnon spin photocurrent can also be controlled by the electric field in magnetoelectrics. Taking Cr$_2$O$_3$ as an example, we demonstrate how the spin current is modified by the electric field, using nonlinear response theory. We find that the Dzyaloshinsky--Moriya interaction induced by the applied field plays a key role in modifying spin-current conductivity, which exhibits pronounced anisotropy with respect to the light polarization. In particular, both the resonance frequency and the peak intensity show distinct dependences on the external electric field $E$, demonstrating electrical control of the spin photocurrent. In addition, we show that the two-magnon processes give rise to a continuum spectrum, a consequence of the field-induced spin canting. These results show that Cr$_2$O$_3$ is a promising platform for realizing electrically tunable spin photovoltaic effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：nonlinear response theory（非线性响应理论）、argue（论证）、demonstrate（演示）。；研究对象：磁电氧化物Cr₂O₃中的自旋光电流，以及电场对其的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在磁电材料Cr₂O₃中，外加电场可通过诱导Dzyaloshinsky–Moriya相互作用来显著改变自旋光电流的电导率，实现对自旋光电流的共振频率和峰值强度的电学调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在磁电材料Cr₂O₃中，外加电场可通过诱导Dzyaloshinsky–Moriya相互作用来显著改变自旋光电流的电导率，实现对自旋光电流的共振频率和峰值强度的电学调控。；创新点：首次提出在磁电材料中可以通过电场控制磁振子自旋光电流，并揭示了电场诱导的Dzyaloshinsky–Moriya相互作用在其中的关键作用。摘要未突出说明与已有实验或理论工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用非线性响应理论（nonlinear response theory）进行计算分析，研究了电场对自旋电流的修正机制。

papers.title: Prediction of coherent interfaces between diamond and clathrate structures
papers.abstract: Diamond (or its binary zincblende variant)-type structure can form coherent interface with clathrate type II via the common transitional layer known previously as a $(3\times 3)$-dimer-stacking fault (DS) reconstruction of the (111)-diamond surface. The generic $\sim 11\%$ lattice misfit can be eliminated in multicomponent heterostructures such as Ge(diamond)/CsSn(clathrate) or InN(zincblende)/Ge(clathrate). Interface models subjected to ab-initio molecular dynamics annealing are stable up to the temperatures approaching melting point of the constituent systems, and in some studied cases the diamond/clathrate bonding is stronger than the intra-clathrate bonding, as evidenced by simulated crack experiments. Composition-calibrated lattice-matching can stabilize even metastable clathrates as epitaxially grown films on the diamond/zincblende substrate.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：摘要中提及“ab-initio molecular dynamics annealing”（第一性原理分子动力学退火）、“simulated crack experiments”（模拟裂纹实验）等关键词，表明主要采用计算模拟方法。；研究对象：金刚石（或闪锌矿）结构与II型笼合物结构之间的相干界面，具体涉及Ge(金刚石)/CsSn(笼合物)、InN(闪锌矿)/Ge(笼合物)等多组分异质结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 金刚石/闪锌矿型结构与II型笼合物结构可通过(3×3)-二聚体堆垛层错（DS）重构的(111)金刚石表面作为共同过渡层形成相干界面；通过组分调节晶格匹配，可在金刚石/闪锌矿衬底上外延生长甚至亚稳态的笼合物薄膜。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：金刚石/闪锌矿型结构与II型笼合物结构可通过(3×3)-二聚体堆垛层错（DS）重构的(111)金刚石表面作为共同过渡层形成相干界面；通过组分调节晶格匹配，可在金刚石/闪锌矿衬底上外延生长甚至亚稳态的笼合物薄膜。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理分子动力学退火（ab-initio molecular dynamics annealing）评估界面稳定性，并通过模拟裂纹实验（simulated crack experiments）比较界面键合强度。

papers.title: Universal logic circuit for gate-controlled superconductor-based switches operating at liquid-helium temperatures
papers.abstract: The observation of the gate-controlled supercurrent (GCS) effect in superconducting nanostructures initiated major research efforts toward the realisation of superconducting-based computing architectures. Here we introduce a universal logic circuit that can be a promising superconducting building block of classical hybrid supercomputers. We demonstrate a functionally complete set of logic gates by realising the AND, OR, NOT and COPY gates. The general layout and scalability of our device, combined with recent experiments demonstrating fast switching and small voltage signals, make it a functional candidate in superconducting electronics. Our device enables the realization of all classical logic gates and the half-adder combinational logic circuit using at most three nanowires, each uniquely configured with two side-gate electrodes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：observation、demonstrate、device、experiments。；研究对象：基于门控超电流效应的超导纳米线开关，以及由其构建的通用逻辑电路。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用最多三根纳米线（每根配置两个侧栅电极）实现了包括AND、OR、NOT、COPY在内的功能完备逻辑门集，并构建了半加器组合逻辑电路，展示了该器件作为超导混合超级计算机基本构建单元的潜力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用最多三根纳米线（每根配置两个侧栅电极）实现了包括AND、OR、NOT、COPY在内的功能完备逻辑门集，并构建了半加器组合逻辑电路，展示了该器件作为超导混合超级计算机基本构建单元的潜力。；创新点：提出了一种通用逻辑电路架构，仅需少量纳米线即可实现所有经典逻辑门和半加器，且器件布局具有可扩展性，结合已有快速开关和小电压信号实验，使其成为超导电子学中具有功能性的候选方案。
papers.method_zh: 通过实验制备具有侧栅电极的超导纳米线器件，测量其门控超电流效应，并基于此实现逻辑门操作。摘要未明确说明具体材料体系（如超导材料种类）或制备/测量技术细节。

papers.title: Power-Law Relaxation of Non-Gaussian Parameter and Self-Dynamic Structure Factor in Multidimensional Rugged Energy Landscapes
papers.abstract: Ruggedness of the underlying energy landscape gives rise to heterogeneous mobility and non-Gaussian diffusion. We develop a theoretical framework for tagged-particle diffusion in multidimensional rugged energy landscapes modeled as correlated quenched Gaussian random fields. Using the self-propagator and self-dynamic structure factor, we characterize finite-time diffusion beyond the effective diffusion coefficient. We determine the effects of dimensionality, spatial correlations, and initial preparation. By introducing a coarse-grained mobility field and a mobility-memory approximation, we relate the non-Gaussian parameter to the time correlation of the mobility sampled by the particle. In the homogenized diffusive regime, the mobility correlation decays algebraically, leading to long-time relaxation of the non-Gaussian parameter as $t^{-1/2}$ in one dimension, $(\ln t)/t$ in two dimensions, and $t^{-1}$ for $d>2$, with amplitudes that depend on dimensionality and the initial ensemble. Our results show that rugged energy landscapes leave distinct signatures in the effective diffusion coefficient, self-dynamic structure factor, and relaxation of non-Gaussian fluctuations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretical framework”、“modeled as”、“approximation”、“relate...to”。；研究对象：多维粗糙能量景观中标记粒子的扩散行为，具体研究非高斯参数和自动态结构因子的幂律弛豫。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在均匀化扩散区，非高斯参数随时间呈幂律衰减：一维为 \( t^{-1/2} \)，二维为 \( (\ln t)/t \)，三维及以上为 \( t^{-1} \)，且振幅依赖于维度和初始系综。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在均匀化扩散区，非高斯参数随时间呈幂律衰减：一维为 \( t^{-1/2} \)，二维为 \( (\ln t)/t \)，三维及以上为 \( t^{-1} \)，且振幅依赖于维度和初始系综。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 将粗糙能量景观建模为关联淬火高斯随机场，引入粗粒化迁移率场和迁移率-记忆近似，通过自传播子和自动态结构因子表征有限时间扩散，并推导非高斯参数与粒子采样迁移率时间关联函数的关系。

papers.title: Resilient $j$=3/2 superconductivity in topological semimetal YPtBi
papers.abstract: Cooper pairing in most of the known fermionic superfluids occurs via spin-1/2 quasiparticle interactions that lead to spin-singlet or spin-triplet pairing. In the topological semimetal YPtBi, strong spin-orbit coupling results in a band inversion between highly symmetric $s$- and $p$-like electronic bands and a degeneracy at the $Γ$ point that ensures the manifold of $j$=3/2 quasiparticle states thrive near the Fermi level, where superconducting pairing occurs. Here we study the effects of magnetic and nonmagnetic disorder and carrier density on this exotic superconducting pairing state. By varying levels of disorder and carrier densities by nearly two and three orders of magnitude, respectively, we show that the superconducting critical temperature of YPtBi has a remarkable robustness, with little variation across this span. Our results suggest that superconductivity in YPtBi may reside in a regime where phase stiffness, rather than pair formation, governs the transition temperature. The insensitivity of Cooper pairing to dramatic changes in quasiparticle environment in a $j$=3/2 superconductor highlights a new form of protection realized in topological high-spin superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“通过改变无序程度和载流子密度……我们展示了超导临界温度的显著鲁棒性”，属于实验观测结果。；研究对象：拓扑半金属YPtBi中的j=3/2超导配对态，特别是其在高自旋轨道耦合和能带反转背景下的超导特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: YPtBi的超导临界温度在无序程度和载流子密度分别变化近两个和三个数量级时仍表现出显著的鲁棒性，表明其超导转变温度可能由相位刚度而非库珀对形成主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：YPtBi的超导临界温度在无序程度和载流子密度分别变化近两个和三个数量级时仍表现出显著的鲁棒性，表明其超导转变温度可能由相位刚度而非库珀对形成主导。；创新点：揭示了在j=3/2高自旋超导体中，库珀配对对准粒子环境的剧烈变化不敏感，体现了一种拓扑高自旋超导体中新型的保护机制。
papers.method_zh: 通过调控无序程度（如引入磁性/非磁性杂质）和载流子密度，测量超导临界温度的变化。具体实验手段摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: Deconfined criticality between an antiferromagnetic insulator and a nodal d-wave superconductor: a quantum Monte Carlo study
papers.abstract: We present a quantum Monte Carlo study of the transition between the insulating Néel state and the nodal $d$-wave superconductor on the square lattice at half-filling. We access a regime of frustrated magnetic order without a sign problem using a parton representation of the electron in terms of fermionic spinons and bosonic chargons. Both partons move in a background $π$-flux (so the electron experiences no net flux) and are coupled to a quantum fluctuating SU(2) lattice gauge field. In contrast to earlier studies directly on the electronic degrees of freedom, we find evidence for a second-order deconfined quantum phase transition at which both the Néel and $d$-wave superconductivity orders vanish continuously. We compute correlators of the spinon-chargon composite with the same quantum numbers as the electron: we find a gapless Dirac dispersion inside the $d$-wave superconductor, turning into a gapped dispersion in the antiferromagnet.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（理论计算）。关键词：quantum Monte Carlo study、parton representation、SU(2) lattice gauge field。；研究对象：正方晶格上半满的绝缘性Néel反铁磁态与节线d波超导态之间的量子相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现该相变为二级解禁闭量子相变，Néel序和d波超导序均连续消失；在d波超导相中，电子（自旋子-电荷子复合体）呈现无能隙的狄拉克色散，而在反铁磁相中变为有能隙色散。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现该相变为二级解禁闭量子相变，Néel序和d波超导序均连续消失；在d波超导相中，电子（自旋子-电荷子复合体）呈现无能隙的狄拉克色散，而在反铁磁相中变为有能隙色散。；创新点：与以往直接基于电子自由度的研究不同，该工作通过部分子-规范场框架首次在数值上支持该相变为二级解禁闭量子相变。
papers.method_zh: 采用量子蒙特卡洛模拟，通过电子的部分子表示（费米子自旋子+玻色子电荷子）在π-通量背景中运动，并与量子涨落的SU(2)格点规范场耦合，从而避免符号问题。

papers.title: The BiP-PRISM algorithm for fast and scalable core-loss STEM-EELS simulations
papers.abstract: Quantitative interpretation of atomic-resolution STEM-EELS requires dynamical simulation of the electron probe before and after core-loss transitions, which is computationally expensive. While the PRISM algorithm accelerates this by reusing scattering matrices, we introduce beam partitioning for both the probe-forming ($\mathcal{S}_1$) and detector-propagating ($\mathcal{S}_2$) PRISM matrices to further reduce computational and memory costs. Each matrix is calculated on a sparse set of parent beams and reconstructed via natural-neighbor interpolation locally at the ionized atom. A locality result demonstrates that the total error is governed entirely by this on-atom reconstruction error. The resulting BiP-PRISM algorithm removes per-scan exit wave propagation and significantly reduces memory requirements, enabling full-resolution elemental mapping, 4D cubes, and momentum-resolved qEELS on consumer-grade GPUs. We characterize the approximation's validity regime and demonstrate the simulation of a multimodal five-edge oxide-interface map and an FePt nanoparticle Fe-L map at 5x memory reduction, showing that the algorithm achieves high accuracy with significantly lower computational demands.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：simulations（模拟）、algorithm（算法）、computational costs（计算成本）、memory requirements（内存需求）。；研究对象：扫描透射电子显微镜-电子能量损失谱（STEM-EELS）的模拟，具体应用于原子分辨率的元素分布图谱（elemental mapping）和动量分辨的qEELS（momentum-resolved qEELS）。示例体系包括多模态五边氧化物界面（multimodal five-edge oxide-interface）和FePt纳米颗粒（FePt nanoparticle）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了BiP-PRISM算法，通过对探针形成和探测器传播两个过程的PRISM矩阵进行波束分区（beam partitioning）和自然邻域插值（natural-neighbor interpolation）重建，在保持高精度的前提下，显著降低了核心损失STEM-EELS模拟的计算和内存开销，使得在消费级GPU上即可完成全分辨率元素图谱和4D数据立方体的模拟。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了BiP-PRISM算法，通过对探针形成和探测器传播两个过程的PRISM矩阵进行波束分区（beam partitioning）和自然邻域插值（natural-neighbor interpolation）重建，在保持高精度的前提下，显著降低了核心损失STEM-EELS模拟的计算和内存开销，使得在消费级GPU上即可完成全分辨率元素图谱和4D数据立方体的模拟。；创新点：1）首次将波束分区（beam partitioning）策略同时应用于PRISM算法的两个散射矩阵（S1和S2），而不仅仅是其中一个。2）通过严格的局域性分析（locality result）证明，总误差完全由电离原子位置上的重建误差决定，为算法的精度控制提供了理论依据。3）消除了每个扫描点（per-scan）的出射波传播计算，并大幅降低了内存需求，实现了在消费级GPU上的高效模拟。
papers.method_zh: 基于PRISM（Plural Scattering with Reduced Incident-beam Scanning Matrix）算法的改进。具体方法包括：1）将PRISM算法中的两个散射矩阵（探针形成矩阵S1和探测器传播矩阵S2）分别进行稀疏波束集（sparse set of parent beams）计算；2）利用自然邻域插值（natural-neighbor interpolation）在电离原子位置（on the ionized atom）局部重建完整的散射矩阵。该方法被称为BiP-PRISM（Beam-Partitioned PRISM）。

papers.title: Pattern formation in nonlinear dynamics of nematic liquid crystals above the flexoelectric instability threshold
papers.abstract: For many decades, researchers have been studying various types of electro-hydrodynamic instabilities in liquid crystals. A significant amount of experimental data has been collected, however, the theoretical interpretations of the results typically rely on linear analysis. In response to this limitation, we investigate the nonlinear stage of the flexoelectric instability in nematics, focusing on liquid crystals with a negative anisotropy in their dielectric permittivity and electrical conductivity. We base our analysis on a comprehensive set of nonlinear electro-hydrodynamic equations for these nematics influenced by an external alternating electric field. The equations predict an instability that is driven by the flexoelectric effect. In order to examine the peculiarities of this phenomenon, we use a model that was proposed in our previous publications, Refs. [1,2], which allows us to perform numerical simulation of nonlinear dynamics. We examine patterns that are formed above the instability threshold. Through numerical simulations, we have identified static and dynamic patterns that occur over a timescale that is much longer than the period of the external electric field. The static patterns are one-dimensional structures and dynamic patterns are standing or traveling one-dimensional waves. The type of the realized pattern depends on the material and experimentally controlled parameters. We found that the standing waves are stable with respect to small transverse perturbations, whereas the propagating waves are unstable. We present a Ginzburg-Landau-like phenomenology that applies near the instability threshold. This approach allows us to rationalize our numerical findings with a few parameters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：非线性动力学方程、数值模拟、Ginzburg-Landau唯象模型。；研究对象：向列相液晶中高于挠性电不稳定性阈值时的图案形成，具体针对介电常数和电导率均为负各向异性的液晶体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高于挠性电不稳定性阈值时，系统可形成静态一维结构以及驻波或行波形式的动态一维图案；驻波对小横向扰动稳定，而行波不稳定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高于挠性电不稳定性阈值时，系统可形成静态一维结构以及驻波或行波形式的动态一维图案；驻波对小横向扰动稳定，而行波不稳定。；创新点：突破了以往仅依赖线性分析的理论局限，首次系统研究了挠性电不稳定性在非线性阶段的图案形成，并通过数值模拟和唯象理论揭示了静态与动态图案的稳定性差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于一套完整的非线性电-流体动力学方程，对受外加交变电场作用的负各向异性向列相液晶进行数值模拟；并采用作者先前提出的模型（参考文献[1,2]）进行非线性动力学模拟；在阈值附近引入Ginzburg-Landau类唯象理论进行解释。

papers.title: Atomic Cluster Expansion Potentials for Screw Dislocations in BCC Refractory Metals
papers.abstract: Accurate atomistic modeling of screw dislocations in body-centered cubic (bcc) metals remains challenging because their plasticity is governed by a complex dislocation glide behavior due to their compact three-fold symmetric core structure and a strongly temperature-dependent flow stress induced by the large Peierls barrier. In the context of group 6 (V, Nb, Ta) and group 5 (Mo, W) refractory metals (RMs), both classical interatomic potentials and some machine learning potentials consistently fail to reproduce density functional theory (DFT) Peierls barriers and the glide plane. Here, we developed an array of atomic cluster expansion (ACE) potentials for these RMs by extending an existing DFT database. The developed ACE potentials significantly improve the description of screw dislocation properties, achieving near-DFT accuracy for Mo and W and substantial improvement for V, Nb, and Ta. The results show that transferability to screw dislocation behavior depends sensitively on both database composition and element-specific energetics, and that achieving a single-humped Peierls barrier alone is not a sufficient validation metric for accurate prediction of dislocation glide. For Nb, Mo, and W, the developed ACE models also enable reliable calculation of kink-pair activation enthalpies, which are well described by both Kocks' law and a line-tension model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：atomic cluster expansion (ACE) potentials、DFT、atomistic modeling。；研究对象：体心立方（bcc）难熔金属（V, Nb, Ta, Mo, W）中的螺位错及其滑移行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发的原子簇展开（ACE）势能显著提高了对bcc难熔金属中螺位错性质的描述，对Mo和W达到近DFT精度，对V、Nb、Ta也有实质性改进；同时发现仅实现单峰Peierls势垒不足以准确预测位错滑移。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发的原子簇展开（ACE）势能显著提高了对bcc难熔金属中螺位错性质的描述，对Mo和W达到近DFT精度，对V、Nb、Ta也有实质性改进；同时发现仅实现单峰Peierls势垒不足以准确预测位错滑移。；创新点：系统评估了数据库组成和元素特异性对ACE势能向螺位错行为可迁移性的敏感影响，并指出单峰Peierls势垒作为验证指标的不足。
papers.method_zh: 基于扩展的DFT数据库，采用原子簇展开（ACE）方法构建机器学习势能，并结合Kocks定律和线张力模型计算扭结对激活焓。

papers.title: Weak-coupling tensor cross interpolation impurity solver for nonequilibrium dynamical mean-field theory
papers.abstract: Simulating nonequilibrium quantum many-body systems remains a major challenge due to the exponential growth of the computational complexity with real time. Here we implement a nonequilibrium impurity solver based on the weak-coupling expansion and the tensor cross interpolation (TCI), and apply it to nonequilibrium dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT). The method approximates the integrands of the high-dimensional integrals arising in the weak-coupling expansion in a tensor-train form, enabling efficient evaluations without stochastic sampling and thereby mitigating the sign problem affecting continuous-time quantum Monte Carlo (CT-QMC) methods. Benchmark calculations for an exactly solvable nonequilibrium impurity model agree well with the exact results and reveal a low-rank structure of the integrands. When applied to interaction-quench problems in the half-filled Hubbard model, the method reproduces fast thermalization at a critical interaction strength with accuracy comparable to CT-QMC. Away from half filling, where the sign problem becomes even more severe, the present approach remains well controlled, revealing a crossover instead of a sharply defined fast thermalization point in the 3/4-filled case. The solver can also be applied to steady-state DMFT problems, yielding accurate spectral functions in the metallic regime without analytic continuation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：impurity solver、tensor cross interpolation、dynamical mean-field theory、benchmark calculations。；研究对象：非平衡量子多体系统，具体包括：可精确求解的非平衡杂质模型、半满及3/4填充的Hubbard模型中的相互作用淬火问题，以及稳态DMFT中的金属态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于弱耦合展开和张量交叉插值（TCI）的非平衡杂质求解器能够高效计算高维积分，避免随机采样带来的符号问题，在半满时准确复现临界相互作用强度下的快速热化，在远离半满（如3/4填充）时仍保持可控，揭示出交叉行为而非尖锐的快速热化点；该方法还可用于稳态DMFT，无需解析延拓即可获得金属区的精确谱函数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于弱耦合展开和张量交叉插值（TCI）的非平衡杂质求解器能够高效计算高维积分，避免随机采样带来的符号问题，在半满时准确复现临界相互作用强度下的快速热化，在远离半满（如3/4填充）时仍保持可控，揭示出交叉行为而非尖锐的快速热化点；该方法还可用于稳态DMFT，无需解析延拓即可获得金属区的精确谱函数。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 弱耦合展开结合张量交叉插值（TCI）的杂质求解器，应用于非平衡动力学平均场理论（DMFT）。通过将弱耦合展开中出现的高维积分被积函数近似为张量列（tensor-train）形式，实现高效数值求积，替代连续时间量子蒙特卡洛（CT-QMC）中的随机采样。

papers.title: Dependence of charge separation efficiency on the exciton-charge transfer offset and Gaussian disorder in organic solar cells
papers.abstract: State-of-the-art organic solar cells increasingly rely on low-offset semiconductor blends, challenging the traditional requirement of a large energetic driving force for efficient charge separation. In these systems, the energetic offset $ΔE_{\mathrm{LE-CT}}$ between local exciton (LE) and charge-transfer (CT) states approaches the thermal energy, making exciton-CT hybridization and thermal repopulation of the exciton level critical to device performance. In this work, we directly compare a macroscopic two-state rate model with three-dimensional kinetic Monte-Carlo (kMC) simulations to investigate microscopic charge separation dynamics and the role of Gaussian energetic disorder. We demonstrate that in the absence of disorder, the analytical rate model accurately reproduces kMC predictions for the whole range of $ΔE_{\mathrm{LE-CT}}$. Specifically, the macroscopic model successfully explains horizontal shifts in the internal quantum efficiency curves that arise depending on how the energetic offset is physically realized in the constituent molecules. We show that these variations can be captured entirely through the ratio of degeneracies of the LE and CT states, respectively. Introducing Gaussian energetic disorder into the kMC simulation reveals a distinct crossover behavior depending on $ΔE_{\mathrm{LE-CT}}$. While disorder is mostly detrimental at large offsets, it can significantly boost efficiency at intermediate and low offsets. Thermalization of charge carriers within the disorder-broadened density of states creates an effective driving force allowing charge separation even at zero or negative energetic offsets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：直接比较宏观速率模型与三维动力学蒙特卡洛（kMC）模拟，未提及实验数据。；研究对象：有机太阳能电池中激子-电荷转移态能量偏移（ΔE_LE-CT）和高斯无序对电荷分离效率的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无无序时，宏观速率模型可准确复现kMC模拟结果，且内量子效率曲线的水平偏移完全由局域激子（LE）与电荷转移（CT）态的简并度比值决定；引入高斯无序后，在中等和低能量偏移下无序可显著提升电荷分离效率，甚至在零或负偏移下通过载流子热化产生有效驱动力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无无序时，宏观速率模型可准确复现kMC模拟结果，且内量子效率曲线的水平偏移完全由局域激子（LE）与电荷转移（CT）态的简并度比值决定；引入高斯无序后，在中等和低能量偏移下无序可显著提升电荷分离效率，甚至在零或负偏移下通过载流子热化产生有效驱动力。；创新点：揭示了高斯无序在不同能量偏移区间对电荷分离效率的截然相反作用（大偏移下有害，中低偏移下有益），并指出零/负偏移下无序诱导的热化可替代传统大驱动力要求。
papers.method_zh: 宏观两态速率模型（解析）与三维动力学蒙特卡洛（kMC）模拟的直接对比。

papers.title: Facet-selective ballistic supercurrent in a weak topological insulator
papers.abstract: Topological superconductivity is widely pursued by inducing superconducting correlations in topologically protected boundary states. In two dimensions, this strategy has been realized using one-dimensional topological edge modes, but in three-dimensional crystals, spatially separated surface supercurrents confined to selected facets have not yet been achieved. Here we demonstrate facet-selective ballistic supercurrent in Josephson junctions based on the weak topological insulator ZrTe<sub>5</sub>. Superconducting quantum interferometry reveals SQUID-like critical current oscillations with flux-quantum periodicity, establishing that the supercurrent is spatially concentrated on specific crystallographic facets that host gapless topological surface states. Rotating the magnetic field yields markedly distinct interference patterns, linking the supercurrent distribution to the underlying bulk topology. The exponential temperature dependence of the critical current and triangular interference lobes provide signatures of ballistic transport due to high-transmission topological channels. These results establish weak topological insulators as a platform for facet-resolved superconducting devices and higher-order topological superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：demonstrate、Josephson junctions、superconducting quantum interferometry、measurements。；研究对象：弱拓扑绝缘体ZrTe₅中的约瑟夫森结，具体研究其面选择性弹道超流现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在弱拓扑绝缘体ZrTe₅的约瑟夫森结中，超流被空间限制在特定晶面上，这些晶面承载无带隙拓扑表面态，且超流输运为弹道输运，由高透射拓扑通道主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在弱拓扑绝缘体ZrTe₅的约瑟夫森结中，超流被空间限制在特定晶面上，这些晶面承载无带隙拓扑表面态，且超流输运为弹道输运，由高透射拓扑通道主导。；创新点：首次在三维晶体中实现了空间上局限于特定晶面的表面超流，并建立了超流分布与体拓扑性质的联系，为面分辨超导器件和高阶拓扑超导提供了平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验上制备基于ZrTe₅的约瑟夫森结，利用超导量子干涉测量（superconducting quantum interferometry）观测到类似SQUID的临界电流振荡（具有磁通量子周期性），并通过旋转磁场获得明显不同的干涉图案，同时测量临界电流随温度的指数依赖关系及三角干涉瓣。

papers.title: Quantum Oscillations of $\mathrm{Sr}_2\mathrm{RuO}_4$ under c-Axis Uniaxial Stress
papers.abstract: Uniaxial stress has now been widely used to study correlated electron materials. However, Fermi surface-resolved experimental data on the evolution of the electronic structure under piezoelectrically applied stress are sparse, with no reports of de Haas-van Alphen (dHvA) effects under uniaxial stress. Here we present dHvA measurements under $c$-axis uniaxial stress on the unconventional superconductor $\mathrm{Sr}_2\mathrm{RuO}_4$. This allows us to study the evolution of the electronic structure directly and to gain insight into the contradicting behavior of the predicted enhancement of the electronic density of states and the observed suppression of $T_\text{c}$. We are able to follow all Fermi surfaces for stress up to $-1.8$~GPa and find that the cross-sectional areas of the hole-like $α$ sheet increase and electron-like $β$ sheet decrease. At the same time, the area of the electron-like $γ$ sheet increases. Therefore, in contrast to in-plane uniaxial stress, charge transfer is the mechanism for approaching the electron-to-hole Lifshitz transition and the associated Van Hove singularity. Additionally, we find that the effective masses on all three Fermi sheets are slightly enhanced as the Lifshitz transition is approached. We compare the dHvA results with quantum oscillations in the magnetostriction and band structure calculations, and find good agreement. At a more general level, our findings show that quantum oscillation measurements under uniaxial stress, combined with band-structure calculations, offer a promising new route for studying quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：dHvA测量、磁致伸缩量子振荡、能带结构计算（混合类型，以实验为主辅以计算对比）。；研究对象：非常规超导体Sr₂RuO₄在c轴单轴应力下的电子结构演化，特别是费米面、有效质量及Lifshitz相变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在c轴单轴应力下，空穴型α费米面面积增大，电子型β费米面面积减小，而电子型γ费米面面积增大；电荷转移是趋近电子-空穴Lifshitz相变及相关Van Hove奇点的主要机制，且所有费米面有效质量在接近相变时略有增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在c轴单轴应力下，空穴型α费米面面积增大，电子型β费米面面积减小，而电子型γ费米面面积增大；电荷转移是趋近电子-空穴Lifshitz相变及相关Van Hove奇点的主要机制，且所有费米面有效质量在接近相变时略有增强。；创新点：首次报道了单轴应力下的dHvA效应实验数据，实现了对费米面演化的直接、分辨性观测，并揭示了c轴应力与面内应力不同的电荷转移机制。
papers.method_zh: de Haas-van Alphen（dHvA）量子振荡测量（在压电施加的c轴单轴应力下进行）、磁致伸缩量子振荡测量、能带结构计算（与实验对比）。

papers.title: Spinterface-like mechanism of the chirality-induced spin selectivity in donor chiral-bridge acceptor complexes
papers.abstract: The chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS) effect has been invoked to explain recent reports of differences in the time-resolved EPR signals between chiral and achiral molecules. However, the microscopic origin of these differences and their connection to CISS remains contested, particularly since these systems lack a metal interface. Here we introduce an intramolecular spinterface-like mechanism that naturally arises within donor-chiral bridge-acceptor (D--$χ$B--A) complexes and quantitatively reproduces experimentally reported observed spin polarization in time-resolved EPR studies. In our two-electron Lindblad model, the photoexcited charge-transfer electron traversing the chiral bridge exchanges with the residual donor electron, which acts as a localized magnetic moment analogous to an induced magnetic moment on an electrode surface. The resulting through-bridge charge current produces an effective solenoidal field at the donor--bridge interface, breaking spin degeneracy and directional symmetry, thus enabling spin-selective transport without invoking intrinsic spin-orbit coupling on the bridge. We show that the interplay between this current-induced field, donor thermalization (which breaks time-reversal symmetry), and bridge spin mixing yields tens-of-percent polarization over realistic experimental conditions and charge-transfer time scales, matching reported CISS signatures in triads and DNA hairpins. By explicitly resolving the dependence on solenoidal coupling strength, temperature, and spin-mixing rates, the model identifies the regime in which internal spinterfaces can generate robust CISS-like spin filtering. These findings demonstrate that CISS-like signals in isolated D--$χ$B--A complexes are fully compatible with a spinterface mechanism, providing a unified conceptual framework for interpreting both device-based and molecule-internal CISS platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Lindblad模型、理论框架、数值模拟。；研究对象：手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）效应在供体-手性桥-受体（D--χB--A）复合物中的微观机制，特别是时间分辨EPR信号中观测到的自旋极化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种分子内“自旋界面”（spinterface-like）机制：光激发电荷在手性桥上传输时，与供体上的残余电子（充当局域磁矩）相互作用，在供体-桥界面产生有效螺线管场，从而在不依赖桥体本征自旋-轨道耦合的情况下实现自旋选择性输运，定量复现了实验观测的自旋极化信号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种分子内“自旋界面”（spinterface-like）机制：光激发电荷在手性桥上传输时，与供体上的残余电子（充当局域磁矩）相互作用，在供体-桥界面产生有效螺线管场，从而在不依赖桥体本征自旋-轨道耦合的情况下实现自旋选择性输运，定量复现了实验观测的自旋极化信号。；创新点：首次在无金属界面的孤立分子体系中，提出并定量验证了“分子内自旋界面”机制，将CISS效应的解释从传统的金属-分子界面扩展至纯分子内体系，为统一理解器件型和分子内CISS平台提供了理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用双电子Lindblad主方程模型，模拟了光激发电荷转移电子在手性桥上的输运过程，考虑了供体热化（打破时间反演对称性）、桥体自旋混合以及电流诱导的螺线管场耦合。

papers.title: Collective phase modes in twisted $d$-wave superconducting bilayers
papers.abstract: Twisted cuprate bilayers have been predicted to host high-temperature chiral $d+id'$ superconductivity, originating from higher-order Josephson coupling processes. In such two-dimensional superconducting systems, long-wavelength fluctuations in the phase of the superconducting order parameter constitute gapless collective modes and therefore remain significant even at zero temperature. Here, we perform a theoretical analysis of the low-energy phase fluctuations in twisted $d$-wave superconducting bilayers, systematically retaining Josephson coupling to all orders. We demonstrate that higher-order Josephson coupling processes lead to nontrivial modifications of the phase dynamics. In particular, the stiffness of the relative phase between the two layers is finite even in the normal state, which is a direct consequence of the intralayer U(1) symmetry breaking explicitly induced by interlayer tunneling. Phase fluctuations suppress the relative-phase stiffness but enhance the overall-phase stiffness in the $d+id'$ phase. Furthermore, the relative-phase fluctuations acquire a small but finite excitation gap, which is no longer equal to the Josephson plasma frequency and is strongly suppressed upon approaching the chiral quantum critical point, indicating the breakdown of Josephson phase locking within the superconducting state.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretical analysis、systematically retaining、demonstrate。；研究对象：扭转铜氧化物双层膜中的d波超导体系，具体关注其低能相位涨落行为，特别是手性d+id'超导态中的集体相位模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高阶约瑟夫森耦合过程导致层间相对相位刚度在正常态下即有限，并在d+id'相中相对相位涨落获得一个小的有限激发能隙，该能隙在接近手性量子临界点时被强烈抑制，表明超导态内约瑟夫森相位锁定失效。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：高阶约瑟夫森耦合过程导致层间相对相位刚度在正常态下即有限，并在d+id'相中相对相位涨落获得一个小的有限激发能隙，该能隙在接近手性量子临界点时被强烈抑制，表明超导态内约瑟夫森相位锁定失效。；创新点：揭示了高阶约瑟夫森耦合对相位动力学的非平庸修正，包括正常态下相对相位刚度的出现以及相对相位涨落能隙与约瑟夫森等离子体频率的偏离。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，系统保留至所有阶的约瑟夫森耦合，对扭转d波超导双层膜中的低能相位涨落进行解析计算。

papers.title: Double-pulse control of all optical magnetization reversal in Tb/Co multilayers
papers.abstract: Recent experiments have shown that femtosecond laser pulse with a Gaussian intensity profile can induce magnetization reversal in Tb/Co multilayers with a ring-shaped switching pattern within the laser-irradiated area. Here, we investigate the ultrafast magnetization dynamics leading to such a ring-shaped switching by using double-pulse laser excitation. The laser pulses cause heat-induced quenching and subsequent recovery of the magnetic anisotropy in the multilayers and drive the precessional magnetization switching in the magnetic multilayers. By adjusting the delay between the two pump pulses, we demonstrate that the recovery process can be manipulated and show, experimentally and numerically, that this allows control over the final magnetic domain pattern.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与数值模拟结合）。关键词：experimentally and numerically。；研究对象：Tb/Co 多层膜中的全光磁化反转现象，特别是由飞秒激光脉冲诱导的环形磁畴翻转模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过双脉冲激光激发，可以调控磁各向异性的恢复过程，从而实现对最终磁畴图案的控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过双脉冲激光激发，可以调控磁各向异性的恢复过程，从而实现对最终磁畴图案的控制。；创新点：利用双脉冲激光延迟调控磁各向异性的恢复过程，首次在实验和数值上展示了对环形磁畴翻转图案的可控性。
papers.method_zh: 采用双脉冲激光激发实验，结合数值模拟，研究超快磁化动力学过程。具体手段包括：飞秒激光脉冲（高斯强度分布）激发、泵浦-探测延迟调节、磁畴成像。

papers.title: Quench of chiral superconductivity by quantum phase fluctuations in twisted cuprate bilayers
papers.abstract: Following theoretical proposals of chiral $d+id'$ superconductivity in twisted cuprate bilayers, experimental signatures of time-reversal symmetry breaking (TRSB) remain highly controversial. Here we demonstrate that quantum phase fluctuations fundamentally reshape the phase diagram of this proposed chiral state. Unlike regular superconducting orders, the chiral $d+id'$ state requires long-range coherence of an interlayer phase degree of freedom and is therefore intrinsically vulnerable to phase fluctuations. Incorporating these fluctuations nearly eliminates the chiral phase over most parts of the phase diagram, restricting it to a narrow twist-angle window and ultra-low temperatures. The fluctuation-driven destruction of chirality produces a first-order transition into the $d$-wave state, giving rise to coexistence and metastability. Meanwhile, Josephson phase locking is strongly weakened at the TRSB quantum critical point, which sits well within the superconducting regime. More broadly, our work establishes quantum phase fluctuations as a fundamental constraint on the emergence of TRSB phases in low-dimensional layered quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“demonstrate”（论证）、“incorporating fluctuations”（引入涨落）、“produces a first-order transition”（产生一级相变），属于理论计算与分析。；研究对象：扭曲铜酸盐双层异质结中的手性d+id’超导态，以及量子相位涨落对该手性态的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子相位涨落从根本上重塑了扭曲铜酸盐双层中手性d+id’超导态的相图，将其限制在一个极窄的扭转角窗口和极低温度下，并导致手性态通过一级相变转变为d波态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子相位涨落从根本上重塑了扭曲铜酸盐双层中手性d+id’超导态的相图，将其限制在一个极窄的扭转角窗口和极低温度下，并导致手性态通过一级相变转变为d波态。；创新点：首次明确指出量子相位涨落是限制低维层状量子材料中时间反演对称性破缺（TRSB）相出现的基本约束条件，并揭示了手性d+id’态因需要层间相位长程相干而本质上易受相位涨落破坏的脆弱性。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，具体包括：考虑层间相位自由度的长程相干性，引入量子相位涨落（quantum phase fluctuations）对超导序参量的影响，并分析由此产生的相图、相变性质（一级相变）及约瑟夫森相位锁定行为。

papers.title: In vacuo synthesis of single-layer Ni3(HITP)2 on HOPG surface using metallo-organic precursor
papers.abstract: Single-layer conjugated metal-organic frameworks (SL c-MOFs) are predicated theoretically to host rich quantum phases. To date, however, the experimental synthesis has largely resulted in SL c-MOFs on metal substrates, whose intrinsic properties are strongly screened due to substrate hybridization. To overcome this obstacle, here we develop a method to grow clean SL c-MOF Ni3(HITP)2 on a chemically inert substrate of highly oriented pyrolytic graphite (HOPG). By means of an ultra-high vacuum based multi-step protocol using nickel acetylacetonate [Ni(acac)2] precursor, we obtain continuous single-layer Ni3(HITP)2. Scanning tunneling microscopy reveals a well-defined hexagonal framework with a uniform azimuthal orientation rotated by approximately 30 degrees with respect to the underlying graphite lattice. Furthermore, we control the growth of bilayer Ni3(HITP)2 which features an unusual AA stacking configuration. This work establishes metallo-organic chemistry as an efficient route for integrating 2D c-MOFs onto inert substrates, which opens a new avenue for exploring the exotic quantum properties of SL c-MOFs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验合成方法（ultra-high vacuum based multi-step protocol）、表征手段（scanning tunneling microscopy）以及具体实验操作（使用镍前驱体）。；研究对象：单层共轭金属有机框架（SL c-MOF）Ni₃(HITP)₂，生长在化学惰性基底高定向热解石墨（HOPG）上。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过使用金属有机前驱体乙酰丙酮镍[Ni(acac)₂]的多步超高真空方法，成功在HOPG上合成了清洁的单层Ni₃(HITP)₂，并实现了双层AA堆叠生长，避免了金属基底对MOF本征性质的屏蔽。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过使用金属有机前驱体乙酰丙酮镍[Ni(acac)₂]的多步超高真空方法，成功在HOPG上合成了清洁的单层Ni₃(HITP)₂，并实现了双层AA堆叠生长，避免了金属基底对MOF本征性质的屏蔽。；创新点：首次在化学惰性基底HOPG上合成单层共轭金属有机框架，克服了以往金属基底导致的电子屏蔽问题；同时实现了罕见的AA堆叠双层生长。
papers.method_zh: 超高真空多步合成法（使用Ni(acac)₂前驱体）；扫描隧道显微镜（STM）表征结构。

papers.title: Robustness of Quantum Discord in Nonequilibrium Electronic Transport through Tunnel-Coupled Quantum Dots
papers.abstract: Quantum discord captures quantum correlations beyond entanglement and can remain finite even when the entanglement vanishes. We investigate the transient nonequilibrium dynamics and steady-state behavior of quantum discord and classical correlations in a double quantum dot (DQD) system coupled to fermionic reservoirs. By employing a quantum Langevin equation formalism, we obtain the exact reduced density matrix of the system, enabling a comprehensive analysis of its quantum and classical correlations under nonequilibrium conditions. The influence of system-reservoir coupling strength, spectral bandwidth, thermal bias, and varying initial state on both the transient dynamics and steady-state correlations is systematically analyzed. Quantum discord remains finite in the nonequilibrium steady state over a broad parameter range. Although thermal gradients reduce the overall magnitude of correlations, quantum discord persists and exhibits greater resilience. These results demonstrate that nonequilibrium electronic transport, together with the environmental spectral properties and reservoir asymmetry, provides an effective means of controlling nonclassical correlations in mesoscopic systems and establishes quantum discord as a robust hallmark of open fermionic quantum devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“采用量子朗之万方程形式”、“获得精确约化密度矩阵”、“系统分析”等理论推导与计算关键词。；研究对象：双量子点（DQD）系统，耦合到费米子库，研究其在非平衡电子输运过程中的量子失协（quantum discord）与经典关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非平衡稳态下，量子失协在广泛的参数范围内保持有限；尽管热梯度会降低关联的整体幅度，但量子失协表现出更强的鲁棒性，证明其可作为开放费米子量子器件中非经典关联的稳健标志。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非平衡稳态下，量子失协在广泛的参数范围内保持有限；尽管热梯度会降低关联的整体幅度，但量子失协表现出更强的鲁棒性，证明其可作为开放费米子量子器件中非经典关联的稳健标志。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用量子朗之万方程（quantum Langevin equation）形式，精确求解系统的约化密度矩阵，从而分析非平衡条件下的量子与经典关联。

papers.title: Entropy-Driven Structural Phase Transition in Nb$_3$Cl$_8$ via Density Functional Theory and an Effective Model
papers.abstract: As a prototypical flat-band cluster Mott insulator on an effective triangular lattice, Nb$_3$Cl$_8$ is a potential candidate for hosting a quantum spin liquid (QSL) state. Nevertheless, a first-order structural phase transition around 90K transforms the high-temperature paramagnetic $α$ phase into the low-temperature nonmagnetic $β$ phase, suppressing the candidate QSL regime of the $α$ phase. To clarify the microscopic origin of this transition, we combine first-principles calculations with an extended Hubbard model to construct a unified free-energy framework. This framework reveals that the transition is jointly driven by phonon and spin entropy: the $α$ phase is stabilized by softer phonons and larger paramagnetic spin entropy, whereas the $β$ phase is favored by interlayer dimerization, which hardens the phonons and quenches the spin entropy through singlet formation. Furthermore, by evaluating the pressure-dependent generalized enthalpy, we provide a thermodynamic explanation for the suppression of the transition under c-axis uniaxial pressure, where stabilizing the $α$ phase may allow the candidate QSL regime of the $α$ phase to be explored at low temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。判断依据：结合第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）与扩展哈伯德模型（extended Hubbard model）构建自由能框架。；研究对象：Nb₃Cl₈ 中的结构相变，具体为高温顺磁 α 相到低温非磁 β 相的一级结构相变，以及该相变对量子自旋液体候选态的抑制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该结构相变由声子熵和自旋熵共同驱动：α 相因更软的声子和更大的顺磁自旋熵而稳定，β 相则通过层间二聚化硬化声子并形成单重态淬灭自旋熵而稳定。此外，c轴单轴压力可通过热力学机制抑制该相变，从而可能使 α 相的量子自旋液体候选态在低温下得以探索。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该结构相变由声子熵和自旋熵共同驱动：α 相因更软的声子和更大的顺磁自旋熵而稳定，β 相则通过层间二聚化硬化声子并形成单重态淬灭自旋熵而稳定。此外，c轴单轴压力可通过热力学机制抑制该相变，从而可能使 α 相的量子自旋液体候选态在低温下得以探索。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）第一性原理计算，结合扩展哈伯德模型构建统一的自由能框架，并评估压力依赖的广义焓。

papers.title: A general-purpose atomic cluster expansion interatomic potential for niobium
papers.abstract: Niobium, a body-centered cubic transition metal, poses a challenge for interatomic potentials, which struggle to capture its properties, such as phonons, high-pressure behavior, energy barriers to dislocation glide, and others. To tackle this challenge, we constructed a general-purpose atomic cluster expansion (ACE) potential for niobium. We trained our ACE on thousands of density functional theory (DFT) structures spanning a diversity of local environments. We validated it across a range of properties and compared it with existing empirical and machine learning (ML) potentials, including a novel universal ML potential. The resulting ACE balances accuracy, efficiency, and robustness, enabling large-scale exploration of niobium with near-DFT precision. Finally, our ACE held its own in a stringent test: a near-million-atom molecular dynamics simulation of fracture
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“atomic cluster expansion (ACE) potential”、“density functional theory (DFT) structures”、“molecular dynamics simulation”。；研究对象：铌（niobium），一种体心立方过渡金属。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 构建了一个通用型原子团簇展开（ACE）势，能够以接近密度泛函理论（DFT）的精度平衡准确性、效率和鲁棒性，成功捕捉铌的声子、高压行为、位错滑移能垒等关键性质，并在近百万原子的断裂模拟中表现良好。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：构建了一个通用型原子团簇展开（ACE）势，能够以接近密度泛函理论（DFT）的精度平衡准确性、效率和鲁棒性，成功捕捉铌的声子、高压行为、位错滑移能垒等关键性质，并在近百万原子的断裂模拟中表现良好。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用原子团簇展开（ACE）方法构建势函数，训练数据来自数千个覆盖多种局域环境的DFT结构，并与现有经验势、机器学习势（包括一种新型通用机器学习势）进行对比验证。

papers.title: Strongly frustrated 2D magnetism in a 3D hexagonal perovskite
papers.abstract: Exotic quantum phenomena are often found to occur in spin systems that exhibit low-dimensional magnetism. By combining nuclear magnetic resonance, neutron scattering, and muon-spin spectroscopy ($μ$SR) techniques, we report a rare instance of strongly frustrated two-dimensional (2D) magnetism in a three-dimensional (3D) hexagonal perovskite. Here, Ba$_2$La$_2$MnTe$_2$O$_{12}$, a triangular-lattice magnet, is shown to undergo a magnetic transition at $T_\mathrm{N} \approx$ 4.4 K, below which the manganese moments form a 120$^{\circ}$ AFM order within the $ab$-plane, while staying disordered along the $c$-axis. This exotic ground state, which exhibits ideal 2D magnetism, is highly consistent with the persistently strong spin fluctuations and the large internal field distributions revealed by zero-field $μ$SR. Further, the 2D magnetism also leads to a significant frustration, much larger than that of most known magnetically-ordered frustrated systems. Our work on Ba$_2$La$_2$MnTe$_2$O$_{12}$ not only challenges the interpretations of magnetic order in other 3D hexagonal perovskites, but it also provides insight into how the dimensionality affects the exotic magnetic states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到结合核磁共振、中子散射、μ子自旋谱学（μSR）等实验技术。；研究对象：三维六方钙钛矿Ba₂La₂MnTe₂O₁₂中的强阻挫二维磁性，具体为三角晶格磁体中的磁性相变与基态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该材料在约4.4 K发生磁相变，形成ab面内120°反铁磁序，而c轴方向保持无序，展现出理想的二维磁性，并伴随显著的自旋阻挫效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该材料在约4.4 K发生磁相变，形成ab面内120°反铁磁序，而c轴方向保持无序，展现出理想的二维磁性，并伴随显著的自旋阻挫效应。；创新点：在三维六方钙钛矿中发现了罕见的强阻挫二维磁性，其二维磁性基态与强自旋涨落及大内场分布高度一致，且阻挫程度远大于大多数已知的有序阻挫磁体，挑战了对其他三维六方钙钛矿中磁有序的传统解释。
papers.method_zh: 核磁共振（NMR）、中子散射、μ子自旋谱学（μSR，包括零场μSR）。

papers.title: Effect of granules anisotropy on "double quantum" magnetic resonance excitation in nanogranular composites
papers.abstract: Films of metal-insulator nanogranular composites (CoFeB)x(Al2O3)100-x with different contents of the metal ferromagnetic (FM) phase CoFeB (x ~ 15-50 at.%) are investigated by the method of electron spin resonance (ESR) in a wide range of frequencies (f = 7-80 GHz) and temperatures (T = 4.2-300 K). Besides the conventional FM resonance signal, the experimental spectra demonstrate an additional absorption peak with a double effective g-factor g ~ 4 which is explained within the quantum mechanical "giant spin" model by excitation of "double quantum" transitions in FM granules CoFeB. According to the theory, the intensity of this "double quantum" peak is a complex function of frequency and temperature, including as parameters the granule magnetic moment and anisotropy. Experimentally, the size and anisotropy of the granules can be varied either changing the nominal FM phase content x in the composites or annealing the samples at different temperatures. Here we study the effects of concentration x and thermal annealing of (CoFeB)x(Al2O3)100-x films on their ESR spectral parameters. The observed behavior of the "double quantum" peak intensity is well explained within the considered "giant spin" theoretical concept. In conclusion, we demonstrate the correlation between the size of FM granules in nanocomposites and their anisotropy, indicating the surface origin of this anisotropy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“investigated by the method of electron spin resonance (ESR)”，并详细描述了实验条件（频率、温度范围）和样品处理（退火、改变浓度）。；研究对象：金属-绝缘体纳米颗粒复合材料 (CoFeB)x(Al2O3)100-x 薄膜，具体研究其中铁磁颗粒的“双量子”磁共振激发行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在常规铁磁共振信号之外，实验观察到具有有效g因子~4的额外吸收峰，该峰被解释为铁磁颗粒中“双量子”跃迁的激发；该“双量子”峰的强度随频率和温度的变化可由“巨自旋”理论模型解释，且铁磁颗粒的尺寸与各向异性之间存在关联，表明各向异性起源于表面。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在常规铁磁共振信号之外，实验观察到具有有效g因子~4的额外吸收峰，该峰被解释为铁磁颗粒中“双量子”跃迁的激发；该“双量子”峰的强度随频率和温度的变化可由“巨自旋”理论模型解释，且铁磁颗粒的尺寸与各向异性之间存在关联，表明各向异性起源于表面。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 电子自旋共振（ESR）实验，频率范围7-80 GHz，温度范围4.2-300 K；通过改变名义铁磁相含量x（15-50 at.%）和退火温度来调控颗粒尺寸与各向异性。

papers.title: Real-time dynamics of triplet-resonant tunneling driven by nonequilibrium phonons
papers.abstract: Driven nonequilibrium systems can host emergent functionalities beyond equilibrium, but real-time access to excited-state dynamics remains limited. Here we report real-time measurements of phonon-driven charge and spin dynamics in excited states of a double quantum dot. Under phonon irradiation, resonant inter-dot tunneling emerges at triplet resonance. Time-resolved charge sensing reveals that the resonant inter-dot tunneling is strongly modified by spin blockade. For weaker inter-dot coupling, the nonequilibrium phonon environment generates a unidirectional transport cycle along the phonon density gradient.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：real-time measurements、Time-resolved charge sensing。；研究对象：双量子点中由非平衡声子驱动的激发态电荷与自旋动力学，具体涉及三重态共振隧穿现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在声子辐照下，双量子点中出现了三重态共振隧穿，且该共振隧穿受到自旋阻塞的强烈调制；对于较弱的量子点间耦合，非平衡声子环境沿声子密度梯度产生单向输运循环。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在声子辐照下，双量子点中出现了三重态共振隧穿，且该共振隧穿受到自旋阻塞的强烈调制；对于较弱的量子点间耦合，非平衡声子环境沿声子密度梯度产生单向输运循环。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实时电荷传感技术（Time-resolved charge sensing），用于测量声子驱动下的电荷与自旋动力学。

papers.title: Atom-selective spin-polarized transport in a charge-ordered altermagnet
papers.abstract: Altermagnets provide a promising platform for spin-polarized transport without net magnetization, but their transport properties are usually discussed in terms of momentum-space spin splitting. Here, using first-principles calculations and quantum transport simulations, we show that the charge-ordered altermagnet $α$-Fe$_2$PO$_5$ exhibits a distinct form of real-space spin selectivity despite weak altermagnetic spin splitting near the Fermi level. The charge order creates inequivalent Fe$^{2+}$ and Fe$^{3+}$ sites within each sublattice, while the puckered C-type antiferromagnetic stacking suppresses inter-sublattice transport. As a result, electron and hole doping activate spin-polarized transport predominantly through Fe$^{3+}$- and Fe$^{2+}$-based channels, respectively. These atom-selective channels carry opposite spin polarizations on the two antiferromagnetic sublattices, giving rise to a globally compensated charge current with hidden Néel spin character. We further propose an all-in-one $α$-Fe$_2$PO$_5$ tunnel junction, where matching or mismatching atom-selective conduction channels yields orders-of-magnitude conductance modulation. Our findings establish a real-space design principle for atomically controlled spin functionality and spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：first-principles calculations, quantum transport simulations）；研究对象：电荷有序的交变磁体α-Fe₂PO₅，及其在实空间中的自旋极化输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 尽管α-Fe₂PO₅在费米能级附近的交变磁自旋分裂较弱，但电荷有序导致同一子晶格内出现不等价的Fe²⁺和Fe³⁺位点，结合褶皱C型反铁磁堆垛抑制了子晶格间输运，从而实现了电子和空穴掺杂分别通过Fe³⁺和Fe²⁺通道产生自旋极化输运，并表现出隐藏的Néel自旋特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：尽管α-Fe₂PO₅在费米能级附近的交变磁自旋分裂较弱，但电荷有序导致同一子晶格内出现不等价的Fe²⁺和Fe³⁺位点，结合褶皱C型反铁磁堆垛抑制了子晶格间输运，从而实现了电子和空穴掺杂分别通过Fe³⁺和Fe²⁺通道产生自旋极化输运，并表现出隐藏的Néel自旋特征。；创新点：提出了基于实空间原子选择性通道的自旋极化输运设计原理，区别于传统基于动量空间自旋分裂的交变磁输运机制，并展示了通过匹配/失配原子选择性通道实现隧道结电导数量级调制的全功能器件方案。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（DFT）结合量子输运模拟。

papers.title: Weak Ferromagnetism in NiS$_2$ under Nanocrystallization
papers.abstract: Structurally well-ordered NiS$_2$ nanocrystals with an average diameter of $27.0 \pm 6.5$ nm retain the bulk-like two-step antiferromagnetic transitions, as shown by magnetization and heat-capacity measurements. Below the lower transition, the nanocrystals exhibit a hysteretic ferromagnetic response with large coercivity, exchange bias, and a vertical loop shift after field cooling, whereas the $M$-$H$ response just above the transition is nearly linear. These features are best explained by uncompensated surface moments generated where the low-temperature antiferromagnetic order terminates at the nanocrystal surface. The absence of a clear additional bulk-like weak-ferromagnetic component constrains homogeneous-canting models and indirectly favors a domain-wall scenario for the weak ferromagnetism of bulk NiS$_2$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：magnetization and heat-capacity measurements（磁化与热容测量）、field cooling（场冷）。；研究对象：纳米晶化后的二硫化镍（NiS₂）材料，具体为平均直径27.0 ± 6.5 nm的结构有序NiS₂纳米晶体，以及其弱铁磁性现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: NiS₂纳米晶体在低温下表现出具有大矫顽力、交换偏置和场冷后垂直回线偏移的磁滞铁磁响应，该现象源于低温反铁磁序在纳米晶表面终止时产生的不补偿表面磁矩。此外，未观察到明显的体相弱铁磁成分，这间接支持了体相NiS₂弱铁磁性的畴壁机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：NiS₂纳米晶体在低温下表现出具有大矫顽力、交换偏置和场冷后垂直回线偏移的磁滞铁磁响应，该现象源于低温反铁磁序在纳米晶表面终止时产生的不补偿表面磁矩。此外，未观察到明显的体相弱铁磁成分，这间接支持了体相NiS₂弱铁磁性的畴壁机制。；创新点：通过纳米晶化手段，将体相NiS₂的弱铁磁性归因于表面效应而非均匀倾斜模型，并排除了体相弱铁磁成分的贡献，从而为体相弱铁磁性的畴壁机制提供了间接证据。摘要未突出说明与以往纳米晶研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 磁化测量（M-H回线、场冷过程）和热容测量。

papers.title: Single-cell-level distributions and relationships can differentiate cell-division and growth models
papers.abstract: Complex interactions among regulatory molecules determine the rules underlying cell growth and division in microbial cells. While the governing molecular network may not always be obvious, it is well known that correlations among certain physiological quantities measured in experiments, such as birth-size, division-size, division-time, and division-added-size, can differentiate among various cell-division models, such as Timer, Sizer, and Adder. Here we show that, apart from these correlations, which we extend for the case of stochastic single-cell growth and stochastic asymmetric partitioning, probability distributions of these quantities and statistical relationships between them can also be used to differentiate between these division models. Interestingly, we show that these quantities can not only differentiate the division models, but also distinguish among the single-cell growth paradigms, such as linear and exponential growth. We then demonstrate this differentiability among various division and growth models by comparing our analytical results with published experimental data. We further show that these results remain valid even when the growth rate of a cell is correlated with the growth rate of cells from previous generations in the lineage.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有与实验数据对比）。判断依据：关键词“analytical results”、“published experimental data”、“stochastic single-cell growth”、“statistical relationships”。；研究对象：微生物细胞分裂与生长模型，具体包括Timer（计时器）、Sizer（尺寸器）和Adder（加法器）模型，以及线性与指数型单细胞生长范式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 除了已知的生理量（如出生尺寸、分裂尺寸、分裂时间、分裂新增尺寸）之间的相关性外，这些量的概率分布及其统计关系也能区分不同的细胞分裂模型和单细胞生长模式（线性vs指数生长），且该区分能力在细胞生长速率与祖代相关时依然成立。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：除了已知的生理量（如出生尺寸、分裂尺寸、分裂时间、分裂新增尺寸）之间的相关性外，这些量的概率分布及其统计关系也能区分不同的细胞分裂模型和单细胞生长模式（线性vs指数生长），且该区分能力在细胞生长速率与祖代相关时依然成立。；创新点：将区分细胞分裂模型的手段从传统的相关性分析扩展到概率分布和统计关系层面，并首次证明这些量还能区分线性与指数型单细胞生长范式。摘要未突出说明是否涉及新的数学工具或具体实验技术。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：建立随机单细胞生长与非对称随机分配下的概率模型，推导出生理量的分布与统计关系；与已发表的实验数据进行对比验证。

papers.title: Slow heat-driven flow in a gas of hard disks
papers.abstract: We study a slow heat-driven flow in a gas of elastically colliding hard disks confined to a long channel. The initial state consists of two regions with large temperature and density contrasts but nearly equal pressures, leading to a low-Mach-number, nearly isobaric evolution. In the dilute limit, the corresponding isobaric hydrodynamic theory reduces to a previously known ideal-gas description. We extend this theory to finite densities by incorporating a non-ideal equation of state of a hard-disk fluid, and solve the resulting one-dimensional equations numerically. Finite-density effects produce appreciable deviations from the ideal-gas prediction. We then test the theory directly against event-driven molecular dynamics simulations of hard disks and find very good agreement in both the dilute and finite-density regimes. The results provide, to our knowledge, the first particle-level test of isobaric gas dynamics of a strongly inhomogeneous cooling flow.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章与计算文章混合类型。判断依据：摘要中提及“isobaric hydrodynamic theory”（理论框架）和“event-driven molecular dynamics simulations”（数值模拟）。；研究对象：硬碟气体在长通道中的缓慢热驱动流动，具体研究非均匀冷却流中的等压气体动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有限密度效应会导致硬碟气体热驱动流动显著偏离理想气体预测；通过事件驱动分子动力学模拟验证了扩展后的等压流体力学理论在稀薄和有限密度区域均与模拟结果高度一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有限密度效应会导致硬碟气体热驱动流动显著偏离理想气体预测；通过事件驱动分子动力学模拟验证了扩展后的等压流体力学理论在稀薄和有限密度区域均与模拟结果高度一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论方面：将硬碟流体的非理想状态方程纳入等压流体力学理论，将稀薄极限下的理想气体描述推广至有限密度。计算方面：采用一维数值求解流体力学方程，并使用事件驱动分子动力学模拟进行直接验证。

papers.title: Surface Platinum Alloying for Passivation of Oxide Interfaces on Superconducting Niobium Films
papers.abstract: Dielectric loss arising from two-level systems (TLS) at surfaces and interfaces remains a primary limitation to coherence in superconducting transmon qubits. Niobium (Nb), a widely used material in superconducting quantum circuits, readily forms native oxides under ambient conditions, leading to lossy dielectric interfaces that degrade device performance. Here, a robust and scalable fabrication strategy is demonstrated for chemically stabilizing Nb surfaces and mitigating further oxidation, including protection of both surface and sidewall regions. High-purity Nb films were fabricated with bulk-like superconducting transition temperatures ($T_c = 9.30\pm0.10$) K. We demonstrate that a thin Pt encapsulation layer, deposited after native oxide formation, can be transformed via thermal annealing into a Nb-Pt alloy at the surface. Spectroscopic and microscopic analyses confirm the formation of a chemically stable metallic alloy layer and its ability to suppress further oxide growth. Ab initio simulations elucidate the atomic-scale rearrangement and electronic structure evolution associated with Pt incorporation on native niobium oxide, providing insight into the stabilization mechanism of the alloyed surface. This approach offers a materials pathway for engineering chemically robust Nb interfaces, including sidewalls, toward higher-coherence superconducting qubit architectures."
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以计算模拟）。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“demonstrated”、“fabricated”、“Spectroscopic and microscopic analyses confirm”等实验操作与表征手段，同时提及“Ab initio simulations elucidate”作为理论支撑。；研究对象：超导铌（Nb）薄膜表面的氧化物界面，以及通过铂（Pt）合金化对其进行钝化处理的方法。具体体系为Nb薄膜表面的Nb-Pt合金层。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在已形成天然氧化物的Nb薄膜表面沉积一层薄Pt并进行热退火，可以形成化学稳定的Nb-Pt合金层，该合金层能有效抑制Nb表面进一步氧化，从而降低因界面二能级系统（TLS）引起的介电损耗。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在已形成天然氧化物的Nb薄膜表面沉积一层薄Pt并进行热退火，可以形成化学稳定的Nb-Pt合金层，该合金层能有效抑制Nb表面进一步氧化，从而降低因界面二能级系统（TLS）引起的介电损耗。；创新点：提出了一种**可扩展且稳健的制造策略**，通过表面合金化（而非简单的覆盖层）来化学稳定Nb表面（包括侧壁），从而抑制其进一步氧化。该方法为构建更高相干性的超导量子比特架构提供了材料工程路径。
papers.method_zh: 1.  **实验方法**：制备高纯度Nb薄膜（超导转变温度Tc=9.30±0.10 K）；在天然氧化物形成后沉积薄Pt封装层；通过热退火将Pt层转化为Nb-Pt合金。

papers.title: Modulation of the Nernst Thermoelectrics by Regulating the Anomalous Hall and Nernst Angles
papers.abstract: The large anomalous Nernst effect in magnetic Weyl semimetals is one of the most intriguing transport phenomena, which draws significant attention for its potential applications in topological thermoelectrics. Despite frequent reports of substantial anomalous Nernst conductivity (ANC), methods to optimize Nernst thermoelectrics remain limited. Our research reveals that the magnitude of the ANC is directly related to the sum of the anomalous Nernst and Hall angles. While the sign of the anomalous Hall angle is relatively stable in a certain material, the sign of the anomalous Nernst angle can be intrinsically tuned. Therefore, the ANC can be effectively optimized by regulating these angles to work in concert. This finding is verified by experimental modulation from iron-doped magnetic topological material Co3Sn2S2. Additionally, we observed a robust TlnT scaling law of the ANC over the temperature range of 40 to 140 K in all studied samples, suggesting an intrinsic origin of the ANC. Considering the common opposite sign of the anomalous Nernst and Hall angles in many magnetic topological materials, our research offers an applicable scheme for optimizing the Nernst thermoelectrics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：experimental modulation、observed、studied samples）；研究对象：磁性Weyl半金属Co₃Sn₂S₂中的反常能斯特效应（Anomalous Nernst Effect）及其热电性能优化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 反常能斯特电导率（ANC）的大小直接与反常能斯特角和反常霍尔角之和相关；通过调控这两个角度使其同向协同，可有效优化能斯特热电性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：反常能斯特电导率（ANC）的大小直接与反常能斯特角和反常霍尔角之和相关；通过调控这两个角度使其同向协同，可有效优化能斯特热电性能。；创新点：提出通过调控反常能斯特角与反常霍尔角的符号协同性来优化反常能斯特热电性能的新方案，并在磁性拓扑材料中通过铁掺杂实验验证。
papers.method_zh: 实验调制（铁掺杂Co₃Sn₂S₂）、输运测量（反常能斯特电导率、反常霍尔角与反常能斯特角的调控）、温度依赖关系分析（TlnT标度律）。

papers.title: Holographic Quantum Transformer: A Generalist Neuro-Symbolic Architecture for Solving Frustrated Systems via Generative Attention
