papers.abstract: Simulating two-dimensional frustrated quantum matter is a grand challenge due to the sign problem and exponential Hilbert space complexity. In this work, we introduce the Holographic Quantum Transformer (HQT), a physics-inspired generative architecture that leverages global self-attention to resolve non-local entanglement patterns. We validate HQT on the square lattice $J_1-J_2$ Heisenberg model. On the heavily frustrated $8 \times 8$ lattice at the quantum critical point ($J_2=0.5$), HQT reaches a ground-state energy per site ($E/N$) of $\mathbf{-0.5001(1)}$, consistent with the expected finite-size scaling trend. Beyond numerical accuracy, HQT exhibits intrinsic physical awareness, autonomously recovering the underlying $J_2$ interaction geometry through interpretable attention maps. Our central contribution is ``Holographic Transfer", a zero-shot size-extrapolation protocol with rapid alignment: a model trained on $8 \times 8$ systems is directly projected onto larger $10 \times 10$ lattices via continuous positional-embedding interpolation and head re-initialization, achieving high-fidelity initialization and rapid convergence. This zero-shot protocol yields an energy of $E/N = \mathbf{-0.49782(3)}$, statistically consistent with the variational state of the art while requiring no from-scratch training on the target lattice. Our results establish generative attention as a scalable paradigm for transferable quantum simulation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：generative architecture、self-attention、zero-shot size-extrapolation protocol。；研究对象：二维阻挫量子自旋系统，具体为正方晶格 \( J_1-J_2 \) 海森堡模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 全息量子变换器（HQT）在阻挫严重的 \( 8 \times 8 \) 晶格量子临界点（\( J_2=0.5 \)）达到基态能量每格点 \(-0.5001(1)\)，符合有限尺寸标度趋势；通过“全息转移”零样本外推协议，将 \( 8 \times 8 \) 训练模型直接投影到 \( 10 \times 10 \) 晶格，获得能量 \(-0.49782(3)\)，与变分法最优结果统计一致且无需重新训练。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：全息量子变换器（HQT）在阻挫严重的 \( 8 \times 8 \) 晶格量子临界点（\( J_2=0.5 \)）达到基态能量每格点 \(-0.5001(1)\)，符合有限尺寸标度趋势；通过“全息转移”零样本外推协议，将 \( 8 \times 8 \) 训练模型直接投影到 \( 10 \times 10 \) 晶格，获得能量 \(-0.49782(3)\)，与变分法最优结果统计一致且无需重新训练。；创新点：提出“全息转移”零样本尺寸外推协议，实现模型在目标晶格上的高保真初始化与快速收敛，无需从头训练；通过可解释注意力图自主恢复 \( J_2 \) 相互作用几何，展现内在物理感知能力。
papers.method_zh: 基于物理启发的生成式架构——全息量子变换器（HQT），利用全局自注意力机制解析非局域纠缠模式；采用连续位置嵌入插值和头部重初始化实现零样本尺寸外推。

papers.title: Modulation of anomalous Hall angle in a magnetic topological semimetal
papers.abstract: The anomalous Hall angle (θA) is a measure of the efficiency of converting a longitudinal driving current to a transverse spin-polarized Hall current. For anomalous Hall sensing, a large anomalous Hall angle can improve the sensitivity of magnetic field detection. However, modulation of this angle is challenging and magnetic materials typically have low angles of 0.1 to 3°. Here, we report modulation of the anomalous Hall angle in the magnetic Weyl semimetal Co3Sn2S2. We propose that the angle parameter tanθA can be formulated as a function of the product of electrical resistivity and anomalous Hall conductivity. Our scheme was utilized to demonstrate the modulation of tanθA up to a magnitude of 0.46, corresponding to an angle of around 25°. Microfabricated anomalous Hall devices using Fe-doped Co3Sn2S2 single-crystalline nanoflakes exhibit a high Hall sensitivity of 7028 μΩucm/T and a magnetic field detectability of 23.5 nT/Hz0.5 at 1 Hz.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了实验调制反常霍尔角、制备器件并测量灵敏度与探测能力，关键词包括“report modulation”、“Microfabricated devices”、“exhibit high Hall sensitivity”。；研究对象：磁性外尔半金属Co₃Sn₂S₂及其Fe掺杂单晶纳米片中的反常霍尔角调制现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在磁性外尔半金属Co₃Sn₂S₂中实现了反常霍尔角的大幅调制，tanθA最高可达0.46（对应约25°），远高于传统磁性材料（0.1–3°）；基于Fe掺杂Co₃Sn₂S₂的微纳器件展现出高霍尔灵敏度（7028 μΩ·cm/T）和低磁场探测极限（23.5 nT/Hz⁰·⁵ @1 Hz）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在磁性外尔半金属Co₃Sn₂S₂中实现了反常霍尔角的大幅调制，tanθA最高可达0.46（对应约25°），远高于传统磁性材料（0.1–3°）；基于Fe掺杂Co₃Sn₂S₂的微纳器件展现出高霍尔灵敏度（7028 μΩ·cm/T）和低磁场探测极限（23.5 nT/Hz⁰·⁵ @1 Hz）。；创新点：提出了将反常霍尔角参数tanθA表示为电阻率与反常霍尔电导率乘积的函数，并利用该方案在磁性外尔半金属中实现了反常霍尔角的大幅调制，显著提升了霍尔传感性能。
papers.method_zh: 实验上制备了Fe掺杂Co₃Sn₂S₂单晶纳米片，并微加工成反常霍尔器件；通过测量电阻率和反常霍尔电导率，利用tanθA = ρ·σA（电阻率与反常霍尔电导率乘积）的关系来调制反常霍尔角。

papers.title: Universal Scaling of the Spin Hall Effect
papers.abstract: We study the spin Hall (SH) effect for the Dirac electrons in terms of the spin and magnetic-moment accumulation coefficients $-Γ^{00} g_{s(m)z}^{\phantom{s(m)z} xy}$. We take short-range nonmagnetic impurities into account within the self-consistent $T$-matrix approximation. Similarly to the universal scaling for the anomalous Hall (AH) effect, we find three disctinct regimes by changing the electric conductivity $σ^{yy}$; the superclean regime with $-Γ^{00} g_{s(m)z}^{\phantom{s(m)z} xy} \propto σ^{yy}$ owing to the skew scattering, moderately dirty regime with almost constant $-Γ^{00} g_{s(m)z}^{\phantom{s(m)z} xy}$, and dirty regime with a new scaling relation $-Γ^{00} g_{s(m)z}^{\phantom{s(m)z} xy} \propto (σ^{yy})^{0.6}$ whose exponent differs from that of the AH conductivity. Our results construct a unified theory of the SH effect without any ambiguity of spin current.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We study”“We find”“Our results construct”等理论推导和模型分析表述，未提及实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：狄拉克电子的自旋霍尔效应（spin Hall effect），具体研究自旋积累系数和磁矩积累系数 $-Γ^{00} g_{s(m)z}^{\phantom{s(m)z} xy}$ 随电导率 $\sigma^{yy}$ 的标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自旋霍尔效应存在三种不同的标度区域：超清洁区（$-Γ^{00} g_{s(m)z}^{\phantom{s(m)z} xy} \propto \sigma^{yy}$，源于斜散射）、中等脏区（近似常数）、脏区（新标度关系 $-Γ^{00} g_{s(m)z}^{\phantom{s(m)z} xy} \propto (\sigma^{yy})^{0.6}$，其指数与反常霍尔电导率不同）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自旋霍尔效应存在三种不同的标度区域：超清洁区（$-Γ^{00} g_{s(m)z}^{\phantom{s(m)z} xy} \propto \sigma^{yy}$，源于斜散射）、中等脏区（近似常数）、脏区（新标度关系 $-Γ^{00} g_{s(m)z}^{\phantom{s(m)z} xy} \propto (\sigma^{yy})^{0.6}$，其指数与反常霍尔电导率不同）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用自洽 $T$-矩阵近似（self-consistent $T$-matrix approximation）处理短程非磁性杂质，基于狄拉克电子模型分析自旋霍尔效应。

papers.title: Valley-dependent electron optics using quantum dots in bilayer graphene
papers.abstract: Electrostatically defined quantum dots (QDs) with layer-antisymmetric gating in Bernal-stacked bilayer graphene (BLG) open a local gap and generate a mass-like term with opposite sign in the two valleys, producing strongly valley-dependent scattering without magnetic fields, strain, or spin-orbit coupling. Building on this mechanism, we propose a tunable platform based on such QDs for valley-dependent electron optics in BLG. Using a four-band continuum model and a generalized multiple-scattering formalism, we analyze scattering of Gaussian electron beams from single- and multi-dot architectures and compute valley-resolved currents and angular profiles. A single dot produces distinct valley-dependent deflection, while multi-dot configurations enable enhanced control: identical-dot arrays act as valley splitters, whereas oppositely gated pairs function as valley filters. Combining these elements yields tunable generation, steering, and filtering of highly valley-polarized currents with strong suppression of forward transmission. The required energy scales, gate asymmetries, and device dimensions are within experimentally accessible regimes for dual-gated BLG, establishing quantum-dot arrays as a realistic platform for controllable valley-resolved electron optics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：使用四带连续模型和广义多重散射形式进行理论分析，未提及实验数据。；研究对象：基于伯纳尔堆叠双层石墨烯中静电定义量子点的谷电子光学体系，具体研究谷依赖的电子束散射、偏转、分束与滤波现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过层反对称门控在双层石墨烯中构建量子点，可在无磁场、无应变、无自旋轨道耦合条件下实现强谷依赖散射；单量子点产生谷依赖偏转，多量子点阵列可作为谷分束器或谷滤波器，实现高度谷极化电流的可调生成与操控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过层反对称门控在双层石墨烯中构建量子点，可在无磁场、无应变、无自旋轨道耦合条件下实现强谷依赖散射；单量子点产生谷依赖偏转，多量子点阵列可作为谷分束器或谷滤波器，实现高度谷极化电流的可调生成与操控。；创新点：提出利用静电量子点阵列作为可控谷电子光学平台，无需外加磁场或自旋轨道耦合即可实现谷分束与滤波，且所需能量尺度、门控不对称性和器件尺寸均在实验可及范围内。
papers.method_zh: 四带连续模型（four-band continuum model）描述双层石墨烯电子结构；广义多重散射形式（generalized multiple-scattering formalism）分析高斯电子束从单量子点及多量子点构型的散射；计算谷分辨电流和角分布。

papers.title: Anomalous bulk dealloying below the parting limit
papers.abstract: Dealloying has been extensively studied both as a corrosion degradation mechanism in structural materials, including those used in nuclear, aerospace, or marine environments, and as a versatile method to fabricate porous materials for catalysts and other functional applications. Classical dealloying theory in aqueous environments predicts a critical reactive-element concentration (parting limit) for continuous selective dissolution at temperatures where bulk diffusion does not dominate; this threshold is commonly reported around 50~60 at.%. Yet recent studies show that molten salt environments can generate extensive bulk dealloying below this threshold. Despite the importance of this anomalous dealloying behavior in many energy systems and electrochemical applications, its fundamental origin remains elusive. Here, we address this critical gap, revealing a grain boundary (GB)-assisted bulk dealloying mechanism. Using three-dimensional (3D) reconstruction of the dealloyed regions correlated with crystallographic and elemental analyses, we directly map the 3D GB-void architecture and reveal that diffusion-induced recrystallization (DIR) generates a high-density GB network, which then promotes molten-salt infiltration and can drive bulk dealloying far-below the conventionally reported parting limit, producing a distinctive morphology reminiscent of discontinuous precipitation (DP). Understanding this dynamic GB-void interplay is crucial for the prediction and control of dealloying in complex electrochemical environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：3D reconstruction、crystallographic and elemental analyses、directly map。；研究对象：熔盐环境中合金的异常体脱合金化现象，具体涉及低于传统“分界浓度”（parting limit）的连续选择性溶解行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了一种晶界辅助的体脱合金化机制：扩散诱导再结晶生成高密度晶界网络，促进熔盐渗透，从而在远低于传统分界浓度的条件下驱动体脱合金化，产生类似不连续沉淀的独特形貌。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了一种晶界辅助的体脱合金化机制：扩散诱导再结晶生成高密度晶界网络，促进熔盐渗透，从而在远低于传统分界浓度的条件下驱动体脱合金化，产生类似不连续沉淀的独特形貌。；创新点：首次阐明了熔盐环境中低于分界浓度发生异常体脱合金化的微观机制，即晶界辅助的扩散诱导再结晶过程，并建立了动态晶界-孔洞相互作用与脱合金化行为之间的直接关联。
papers.method_zh: 三维重构技术（3D reconstruction）结合晶体学分析（crystallographic analysis）和元素分析（elemental analysis），直接映射脱合金区域的三维晶界-孔洞结构。

papers.title: Dominant-pair free energies predict phase selection in high-entropy alloys
papers.abstract: Phase selection in multicomponent alloys is governed by the competition between entropic stabilization of disordered solutions and enthalpic driving forces for chemical ordering. However, widely used parametric criteria reduce it to a single scalar, carrying no explicit free energy for any competing ordered phase. Herein, we develop a thermodynamic framework based on the semi-empirical macroscopic atom model and the Dinsdale lattice stability database to fill this gap. We show that a dominant-pair mechanism, in which the Al-transition-metal interaction family dominates the ordering enthalpy, enables the complex multicomponent B2-ordering problem to be reduced to an effective pseudo-binary system with an analytically evaluated Bragg-Williams free energy. Combined with a minimum-free-energy classifier, the framework predicts the lowest-energy phase as a function of composition and temperature. This provides continuous phase stability maps rather than the single-value predictions of conventional descriptors. Demonstrated on high-entropy alloys using a dataset of 269 experimentally characterized samples, the model outperforms widely used phase-selection criteria in the class-balanced macro-F1 metric and achieves 77.9% on the well-posed three-class task, outperforming the valence electron concentration criterion. The model is general by construction and computationally efficient for predicting phase stability in multicomponent alloys over a broad range of compositions and temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：关键词“thermodynamic framework”、“semi-empirical macroscopic atom model”、“analytically evaluated Bragg-Williams free energy”、“minimum-free-energy classifier”。；研究对象：高熵合金中的相选择问题，具体涉及无序固溶体与有序B2相之间的竞争。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出“主导对机制”（dominant-pair mechanism），即Al-过渡金属相互作用族主导有序化焓，可将复杂多组元B2有序化问题简化为有效伪二元系统，并通过解析的Bragg-Williams自由能预测最低能相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出“主导对机制”（dominant-pair mechanism），即Al-过渡金属相互作用族主导有序化焓，可将复杂多组元B2有序化问题简化为有效伪二元系统，并通过解析的Bragg-Williams自由能预测最低能相。；创新点：将传统单一标量判据（如VEC）扩展为连续相稳定性图，首次实现了对多组元合金中B2有序相自由能的解析计算，并在三类相选择任务中达到77.9%的宏F1分数，优于传统判据。
papers.method_zh: 基于半经验宏观原子模型（semi-empirical macroscopic atom model）和Dinsdale晶格稳定性数据库，构建热力学框架；结合最小自由能分类器，生成连续相稳定性图；使用269个实验表征的高熵合金数据集进行验证，并与价电子浓度（VEC）准则等传统判据对比。

papers.title: Structure-Dependent Chemical Order Modification in Strained Alloy Nanoparticles
papers.abstract: Alloy nanoparticles (nanoalloys) exhibit tuneable physicochemical properties that depend sensitively on their atomic arrangement, making control over chemical ordering a central challenge in nanomaterials design. While most theoretical studies consider nanoalloys in vacuum, practical systems are typically supported, where strong cluster-substrate interactions can introduce significant lattice strain. Here, we investigate strain as a control parameter for chemical ordering in bimetallic nanoalloys using atomistic molecular dynamics and Monte Carlo simulations. By imposing controlled tensile and compressive strain through an implicit anchored interface, we systematically probe the response of NiPt nanoparticles with distinct structural motifs. For truncated octahedral particles, we find that chemical ordering and segregation behaviour remain remarkably robust even under large strains, indicating that intrinsic thermodynamic preferences dominate. In contrast, icosahedral nanoparticles exhibit pronounced strain-induced chemical redistribution, with a significant increase in surface Ni concentration under tensile strain. This behaviour is attributed to the combined effects of intrinsic geometric frustration and a high fraction of undercoordinated sites in icosahedral structures. Our results demonstrate that strain can selectively modulate chemical ordering in nanoalloys in a structure-dependent manner, establishing a general framework for understanding strain-induced chemical ordering in nanoalloys.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“atomistic molecular dynamics and Monte Carlo simulations”（原子分子动力学和蒙特卡洛模拟）。；研究对象：双金属合金纳米颗粒（NiPt纳米颗粒）在应变作用下的化学有序性调控。具体研究了截角八面体和二十面体两种结构基序的纳米颗粒。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 应变对合金纳米颗粒化学有序性的影响具有结构依赖性：截角八面体颗粒的化学有序性对应变不敏感，而二十面体颗粒在拉伸应变下表面Ni浓度显著增加。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：应变对合金纳米颗粒化学有序性的影响具有结构依赖性：截角八面体颗粒的化学有序性对应变不敏感，而二十面体颗粒在拉伸应变下表面Ni浓度显著增加。；创新点：揭示了应变可以作为一种选择性调控参数，以结构依赖的方式改变纳米合金的化学有序性，为理解应变诱导的化学有序化建立了一个通用框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用原子分子动力学（MD）和蒙特卡洛（MC）模拟。通过一个隐式的锚定界面施加可控的拉伸和压缩应变，系统探测不同结构NiPt纳米颗粒的响应。

papers.title: Topological Hall plateau in quasi-2D kagome magnet YMn$_6$Sn$_6$
papers.abstract: We examine the impact of the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (DMI) in kagome magnets and show that a predominantly planar DMI together with ferromagnetic exchange stabilizes a disordered skyrmion phase in quasi-two-dimensional (2D) YMn$_6$Sn$_6$. Within an ab initio framework combining density functional theory and spin-dynamics simulations, we generate realistic spin textures of disordered skyrmion and find that this phase persists for $B_{ext} < 0.5$ T, with a decreasing skyrmion size as magnetic field increases. We demonstrate the emergence of topological Hall plateau in the range $-0.5 \leq B_{ext} < 0.5$ T, driven by nearly uniform scalar spin chirality and the resulting constant real-space Berry curvature. This response is anti-symmetric with magnetic field while magnitude and sign of these plateau are determined by a complex interplay between Hund's coupling strength and chemical potential signifying the role of Dirac points and van Hove singularities. In addition, we reveal topological magnon excitations in the disordered skyrmion phase of quasi-2D YMn$_6$Sn$_6$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“within an ab initio framework combining density functional theory and spin-dynamics simulations”（结合密度泛函理论和自旋动力学模拟的第一性原理框架）。；研究对象：准二维笼目磁体YMn₆Sn₆中的无序斯格明子相及其拓扑霍尔效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在准二维YMn₆Sn₆中，主要由面内Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用（DMI）和铁磁交换作用共同稳定了一个无序斯格明子相，该相在0.5 T以下的外磁场中持续存在，并产生一个拓扑霍尔平台。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在准二维YMn₆Sn₆中，主要由面内Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用（DMI）和铁磁交换作用共同稳定了一个无序斯格明子相，该相在0.5 T以下的外磁场中持续存在，并产生一个拓扑霍尔平台。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用结合密度泛函理论（DFT）和自旋动力学模拟的第一性原理计算框架，生成了无序斯格明子的真实自旋纹理，并计算了其拓扑霍尔响应。

papers.title: Phase distinction of Gibbs states without symmetry breaking: topological invariants of the 3D toric code
papers.abstract: We study the finite-temperature topological order of the three-dimensional $\mathbb{Z}_2$ toric code in a generic magnetic field, where every higher-form symmetry is explicitly broken and can at most be emergent. We show perturbatively, and confirm by large-scale quantum Monte Carlo, that the topological entanglement entropy stays quantized at $γ= \ln 2$ throughout the topological phase -- at finite temperature and under the symmetry-breaking field alike -- and collapses to $0$ across the thermal transition, a quantization protected geometrically by the Bianchi identity rather than by any exact symmetry of the system. The plateau $γ= \ln 2$ is, however, not invariant under quasi-local channels: a constant-depth channel can generate this identical quantized value from a trivial product state. We therefore introduce the decoded Wilson-loop correlation $f_W$, which quantizes to $1$ in the topological phase and $0$ in the trivial phase as $L\to\infty$ and, unlike $γ$, is a quasi-local-channel invariant -- a robust topological invariant of the mixed state.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值计算）。判断依据：关键词包括“perturbatively”（微扰理论）、“quantum Monte Carlo”（量子蒙特卡洛数值计算）、“topological invariant”（拓扑不变量）、“mixed state”（混合态理论）。；研究对象：三维 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 环面码（3D toric code）在有限温度及一般磁场下的拓扑序，特别是其拓扑纠缠熵与解码Wilson环关联函数的量子化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在拓扑相中，拓扑纠缠熵 $\gamma = \ln 2$ 在有限温度和对称性破缺场下仍保持量子化，但该值并非准局域信道不变量；而解码Wilson环关联函数 $f_W$ 在热相变两侧分别量子化为 $1$ 和 $0$，且是准局域信道不变量，可作为混合态拓扑序的鲁棒拓扑不变量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在拓扑相中，拓扑纠缠熵 $\gamma = \ln 2$ 在有限温度和对称性破缺场下仍保持量子化，但该值并非准局域信道不变量；而解码Wilson环关联函数 $f_W$ 在热相变两侧分别量子化为 $1$ 和 $0$，且是准局域信道不变量，可作为混合态拓扑序的鲁棒拓扑不变量。；创新点：首次指出在无任何精确高阶对称性保护的情况下，拓扑纠缠熵的量子化可由Bianchi恒等式几何保护，但该量并非混合态拓扑序的可靠不变量；提出解码Wilson环关联函数作为混合态拓扑不变量，其量子化值在准局域信道下保持稳定，从而区分拓扑相与平庸相。
papers.method_zh: 微扰理论分析（perturbative analysis）结合大规模量子蒙特卡洛模拟（large-scale quantum Monte Carlo），并引入准局域信道（constant-depth channel）下的不变量分析。

papers.title: An analog ac voltage amplifier based on a single straintronic magnetic tunnel junction
papers.abstract: Magnetic tunnel junctions (MTJs) are known for their digital applications (memory and logic). A special class of them called "straintronic" magnetic tunnel junctions (s-MTJ) has lately emerged as a potential platform for analog applications because their conductance can be varied continuously with mechanical strain generated with a gate voltage. The conductance versus gate voltage (transfer) characteristic always has a linear region and that can be leveraged for a variety of analog applications. Here, we discuss one such application, namely analog voltage amplification. If the s-MTJ's gate voltage is fixed around the midpoint of the linear region and a small ac voltage is superimposed on it, then the ac voltage can be amplified without distortion as long as its amplitude is small enough to avoid gate voltage excursion beyond the linear region. Unlike a transistor-based voltage amplifier whose amplification is determined solely by the transistor's internal parameters - namely the transconductance and Early resistance - here the amplification can be varied by an external power supply voltage. We examine the maximum allowed amplitude and frequency of input signal for distortion-free amplification by modeling the magnetization dynamics and derive an expression for the amplification.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：modeling（建模）、derive an expression（推导表达式）、magnetization dynamics（磁化动力学）。；研究对象：基于单个应变磁隧道结（straintronic magnetic tunnel junction, s-MTJ）的模拟交流电压放大器。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将s-MTJ的栅极电压固定在线性传输特性曲线的中点，并叠加小幅度交流电压，可实现无失真的交流电压放大；且该放大倍数可通过外部电源电压调节，不同于晶体管放大器仅由内部参数决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将s-MTJ的栅极电压固定在线性传输特性曲线的中点，并叠加小幅度交流电压，可实现无失真的交流电压放大；且该放大倍数可通过外部电源电压调节，不同于晶体管放大器仅由内部参数决定。；创新点：提出利用s-MTJ的连续可调电导特性实现模拟电压放大，并发现放大倍数可由外部电源电压调控，突破了传统晶体管放大器放大倍数仅由内部参数（跨导和厄利电阻）决定的限制。
papers.method_zh: 通过磁化动力学建模（magnetization dynamics modeling）分析输入信号的最大允许幅度和频率，并推导出放大倍数的解析表达式。

papers.title: Dissipation splits the Mott transition in one dimension
papers.abstract: Understanding how dissipation modifies quantum phase transitions is a central challenge in many-body physics. A paradigmatic example is the one-dimensional Mott transition, which in isolated systems separates a conducting Luttinger liquid (LL) from a Mott insulator (MI). Here, we study the fate of this transition in the presence of dissipative baths locally coupled to the density. Using bosonisation and an exact integration of the bath degrees of freedom, we show that dissipation fundamentally reshapes the phase diagram for bath exponents $s<3/2$, where $s$ characterises the low-energy bath spectrum. Rather than undergoing a direct LL-MI transition, the system develops an intermediate dissipative phase (DP) that is compressible and gapless, yet has zero superfluid stiffness. As a result, the conventional Mott transition splits into two distinct critical phenomena: a Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless transition from the LL to the DP, followed by a new commensurate-incommensurate transition from the DP to the MI. We derive an effective field theory for the latter transition and characterize its universality. For $1<s<3/2$, the critical exponents vary continuously with the bath exponent as $β=ν=1/z=s-1$, while for $s<1$ the transition is governed by $β=ν=1/z=0$ and the doping vanishes sharper than any power law. State-of-the-art Monte Carlo simulations quantitatively support our predictions. These results demonstrate that dissipation can qualitatively alter the nature of the Mott transition and generate novel critical behaviour in strongly correlated one-dimensional systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值模拟）。判断依据：bosonisation（玻色化）、exact integration（精确积分）、effective field theory（有效场论）、Monte Carlo simulations（蒙特卡洛模拟）。；研究对象：一维Mott相变在耗散（dissipation）影响下的行为，具体为局域耦合到密度的耗散浴（dissipative baths locally coupled to the density）对Luttinger液体（LL）到Mott绝缘体（MI）相变的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 耗散将一维Mott相变从直接的LL-MI转变分裂为两个不同的临界现象：首先是一个Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless（BKT）转变从LL进入一个中间耗散相（DP），该相可压缩、无能隙但超流刚度为零；随后是一个新的公度-非公度（commensurate-incommensurate）转变从DP进入MI。临界指数随浴指数s连续变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：耗散将一维Mott相变从直接的LL-MI转变分裂为两个不同的临界现象：首先是一个Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless（BKT）转变从LL进入一个中间耗散相（DP），该相可压缩、无能隙但超流刚度为零；随后是一个新的公度-非公度（commensurate-incommensurate）转变从DP进入MI。临界指数随浴指数s连续变化。；创新点：首次揭示耗散可以根本性地改变一维Mott相变的性质，将单一的直接相变分裂为两个不同普适类的临界现象，并发现临界指数随耗散浴谱指数s连续可调的新奇临界行为。
papers.method_zh: 采用玻色化（bosonisation）方法对一维相互作用电子系统进行低能描述，并通过精确积分（exact integration）消去浴自由度，推导出有效场论。同时使用最先进的蒙特卡洛模拟（state-of-the-art Monte Carlo simulations）对理论预测进行定量验证。

papers.title: Designing topological edge currents in chiral active matter
papers.abstract: Achieving robust functionality in active matter driven away from thermal equilibrium is a current theoretical and experimental challenge. Several recent studies have reported edge currents--persistent transport along walls and density inhomogeneities--in chiral active matter. Yet, the microscopic rules that render these edge currents robust with respect to the confinement geometry and defects remain elusive. Here, we introduce a simple particle model of two-dimensional chiral active swimmers that undergo chirality switching and demonstrate that the model exhibits robust edge currents, i.e., when a single particle is confined, edge currents arise regardless of the confinement geometry or the presence of defects. We also investigate the collective behavior of interacting particles in bulk and find that chirality switching induces phase separation accompanied by edge currents along interfaces. This phase separation is distinct from motility-induced phase separation and is qualitatively explained by an effective hydrodynamic theory derived via bottom-up coarse-graining. Furthermore, by analyzing the topological properties of the linearized hydrodynamic equations, we show that the edge currents in our system are genuine topological edge modes. Notably, phase separation induced by chirality switching can be regarded as the coexistence of two topologically distinct domains. Our results provide guidelines for designing robust edge currents in active matter systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。判断依据：introduce a simple particle model、investigate the collective behavior、derived via bottom-up coarse-graining、analyzing the topological properties of the linearized hydrodynamic equations。；研究对象：手性活性物质中的边缘流（edge currents），具体为二维手性活性游泳体（chiral active swimmers）在受限几何和缺陷下的边缘输运行为，以及相互作用粒子体相中的相分离现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入手性切换（chirality switching）机制，活性粒子在任意受限几何或存在缺陷时均能产生鲁棒的边缘流；该边缘流是线性化流体动力学方程的本征拓扑边缘模，且手性切换诱导的相分离可视为两个拓扑不同畴的共存。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入手性切换（chirality switching）机制，活性粒子在任意受限几何或存在缺陷时均能产生鲁棒的边缘流；该边缘流是线性化流体动力学方程的本征拓扑边缘模，且手性切换诱导的相分离可视为两个拓扑不同畴的共存。；创新点：首次提出通过手性切换机制实现与受限几何和缺陷无关的鲁棒边缘流，并揭示该边缘流的拓扑起源；发现手性切换诱导的相分离不同于传统的运动性诱导相分离（MIPS），且可被解释为拓扑不同畴的共存。
papers.method_zh: 构建二维手性活性游泳体的简单粒子模型（含手性切换规则）；通过数值模拟观察单粒子和多粒子集体行为；采用自底向上粗粒化方法推导有效流体动力学理论；利用线性化流体动力学方程的拓扑性质分析（如拓扑边缘模分析）。

papers.title: Polynomial equivalence of the global transverse-field Ising model and the gate model of quantum computation
papers.abstract: The transverse-field Ising model has attracted a lot of attention in recent years, especially in the quantum simulation and quantum computation literature. This interest is driven by many platforms for analog quantum computation, which implement the transverse-field Ising model for solving optimization problems, such as quantum annealing. However, it has remained an open question whether the Ising model with a global transverse field is equivalent to the gate model of quantum computation. Here we answer this question affirmatively for the case of a non-monotonic time-dependent transverse field. Building on a recent result by Cesa and Pichler on global control of Rydberg atoms, we provide a construction that allows simulating arbitrary quantum circuits using the Ising model with global transverse field with polynomial overhead in time, qubit number, and energy scale. Although the polynomial overheads we establish here are large relative to what is feasible on real-world quantum hardware, our result motivates the development of more sophisticated methods for simulating quantum circuits using the Ising model with a global transverse field. Additionally, under the assumption that quantum computing is strictly more powerful than classical computing, our result serves as a no-go theorem for efficient classical simulation of the transverse-field Ising model with a time-dependent global transverse field. Therefore, our finding is relevant for multiple communities, from analog quantum simulation and quantum optimization on various platforms to complexity and control theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：equivalence（等价性）、construction（构造）、simulating（模拟）、no-go theorem（不可能定理）。；研究对象：全局横向场伊辛模型（global transverse-field Ising model）与量子计算的门模型（gate model）之间的计算等价性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了在非单调时变全局横向场条件下，全局横向场伊辛模型在多项式时间、量子比特数和能量尺度开销下，可以模拟任意量子电路，从而与门模型量子计算等价。这一结果也意味着，在量子计算严格强于经典计算的假设下，经典计算机无法高效模拟该模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了在非单调时变全局横向场条件下，全局横向场伊辛模型在多项式时间、量子比特数和能量尺度开销下，可以模拟任意量子电路，从而与门模型量子计算等价。这一结果也意味着，在量子计算严格强于经典计算的假设下，经典计算机无法高效模拟该模型。；创新点：首次肯定地回答了全局横向场伊辛模型是否与门模型量子计算等价这一长期悬而未决的问题。
papers.method_zh: 基于Cesa和Pichler关于里德伯原子全局控制的最新结果，构造了一种显式的模拟方案，将任意量子电路映射到全局横向场伊辛模型的动力学演化中，并分析了时间、量子比特数和能量尺度的多项式开销。

papers.title: Optimal Resource Utilization for Autonomous Laboratory Orchestrators
papers.abstract: In autonomous laboratories, AI agents suggest the next batch of experiments to do. However, planning and executing those tasks taking full advantage of the available resources is a completely different question. This can be challenging when dealing with real-world hardware constraints, especially so when there are multiple instruments with different capacities and throughputs. Here we demonstrate a 2-step method to address resource utilization for our autonomous platform for metal-organic framework synthesis. First, we use constraint programming to find optimal schedules. This finds schedules that minimizes the total time while still satisfying the limitations and capacities of the hardware. Secondly, we use a system of status dependencies for each task, which allows for the robust execution of the optimal schedules.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（涉及算法设计与实验平台应用）。关键词：constraint programming（约束编程）、autonomous platform（自主平台）、synthesis（合成）。；研究对象：自主实验室中金属有机框架（metal-organic framework）合成实验的资源调度与执行优化问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种两步法：先利用约束编程找到最小化总时间且满足硬件限制的最优调度方案，再通过任务状态依赖系统实现该调度方案的稳健执行。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种两步法：先利用约束编程找到最小化总时间且满足硬件限制的最优调度方案，再通过任务状态依赖系统实现该调度方案的稳健执行。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 约束编程（constraint programming）用于调度优化；任务状态依赖系统（system of status dependencies）用于调度执行。

papers.title: Scattering, Trapping and Cloaking-Type Effects of Plane Waves by Point Scatterers in Strain Gradient Elasticity
papers.abstract: Wave scattering by localized constraints in microstructured solids is strongly influenced by the interplay of material length scales, dispersion and geometry. This work investigates plane-strain scattering of time-harmonic P and SV waves by clusters of rigid point constraints embedded in an infinite strain gradient elastic medium. A closed-form dynamic Green's tensor is derived for the plane-strain problem. Unlike the classical elastodynamic Green's tensor, the strain gradient Green's tensor remains bounded at the source, enabling point constraints to be introduced directly through superposition of fundamental solutions. The multiple-scattering problem is reduced to a finite-dimensional algebraic system for the pin reaction amplitudes. A frequency-domain procedure is developed to identify resonance-like amplification and trapping. Candidate resonant frequencies are associated with local minima of the Green matrix determinant, while higher-order curvature criteria distinguish trapping-dominated resonances from non-localized scattering responses. The results show that the response is governed primarily by the ratio of the microinertial and energetic strain gradient lengths. In the anomalous dispersion regime, sharp resonances produce strong displacement localization, including perimeter-localized trapping modes in dense circular arrays. In the normal dispersion regime, these resonances are strongly attenuated and the pins behave as weak scatterers, producing a cloaking-type response in which the incident field is only weakly perturbed. The influence of Poisson's ratio, incidence angle and compound pin configurations is also examined, demonstrating how intrinsic material lengths and geometric arrangement can be used to tune scattering, trapping and wave-screening mechanisms in microstructured elastic media.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：推导、封闭形式解、代数系统、频域分析。；研究对象：微结构固体中，由刚性点约束（点散射体）簇对时间谐和P波和SV波的平面应变散射现象。具体体系为嵌入无限大应变梯度弹性介质中的点散射体阵列。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 散射响应主要由微观惯性应变梯度长度与能量应变梯度长度的比值决定。在反常色散区，尖锐共振导致强位移局域化（如密集圆环阵列中的周界局域化俘获模式）；在正常色散区，共振被强烈抑制，点散射体表现为弱散射体，产生类似隐形衣的响应，即入射场仅受到微弱扰动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：散射响应主要由微观惯性应变梯度长度与能量应变梯度长度的比值决定。在反常色散区，尖锐共振导致强位移局域化（如密集圆环阵列中的周界局域化俘获模式）；在正常色散区，共振被强烈抑制，点散射体表现为弱散射体，产生类似隐形衣的响应，即入射场仅受到微弱扰动。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 推导了平面应变问题的封闭形式动态格林张量（该张量在源点有界），通过基本解叠加引入点约束，将多重散射问题简化为关于销钉反作用力振幅的有限维代数系统。开发了一种频域方法，通过格林矩阵行列式的局部最小值识别候选共振频率，并利用高阶曲率判据区分俘获主导的共振与非局域散射响应。

papers.title: Quantum-Informed Portfolio Selection: An End-to-End Pipeline Validated on Trapped-Ion Hardware with Real Market Data
papers.abstract: Portfolio diversification - a cornerstone of modern investment management - can be formulated as a Maximum Independent Set (MIS) problem on asset correlation graphs. Solving this problem at scale is computationally challenging, motivating the exploration of quantum algorithms for practical financial optimization. We propose an end-to-end pipeline leveraging qReduMIS, a recursive hybrid quantum-classical algorithm. Rather than using quantum optimization to directly produce a final solution, qReduMIS leverages independent set measurements from the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) to identify frozen nodes - vertices likely to belong to optimal solutions - thereby guiding and unblocking subsequent (provably optimal) classical reductions on the remaining graph. We benchmark qReduMIS on real financial data from four major market indices with up to 225 assets, executing experiments on Quantinuum's 98-qubit trapped-ion Helios system, with QAOA circuits acting on kernels of up to 78 qubits and 1016 two-qubit gates. While standalone QAOA fails to find the optimal solution for two of the largest indices (S&P 100 and Nikkei 225), qReduMIS achieves success probabilities of $0.40$ and $0.95$, respectively, with average approximation ratios $\geq 0.96$ across all four indices. We perform a systematic benchmark on the Quantinuum H2-1 noisy emulator over 73 asset correlation graphs of varying size showing that, for $p=2$ QAOA layers, the optimal time-to-solution scaling exponent of qReduMIS is $3.2$ times smaller than that of standalone QAOA.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算+实验）。关键词：hybrid quantum-classical algorithm、benchmark on trapped-ion hardware、noisy emulator。；研究对象：金融资产组合选择问题，具体为将投资组合多样化形式化为资产相关性图上的最大独立集（MIS）问题，并基于真实市场指数数据（S&P 100、Nikkei 225等）进行验证。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出的混合量子-经典算法qReduMIS在真实量子硬件（Quantinuum Helios系统）上，对包含225只资产的大规模指数（S&P 100和Nikkei 225）成功概率分别达到0.40和0.95，平均近似比≥0.96，而单独使用QAOA无法找到最优解；在噪声模拟器上，qReduMIS的最优时间-解缩放指数比单独QAOA小3.2倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出的混合量子-经典算法qReduMIS在真实量子硬件（Quantinuum Helios系统）上，对包含225只资产的大规模指数（S&P 100和Nikkei 225）成功概率分别达到0.40和0.95，平均近似比≥0.96，而单独使用QAOA无法找到最优解；在噪声模拟器上，qReduMIS的最优时间-解缩放指数比单独QAOA小3.2倍。；创新点：提出了一种端到端流水线，将量子优化（QAOA）用于辅助经典约化（而非直接求解），通过识别冻结节点来提升大规模MIS问题的求解效率，并在真实市场数据和当前最先进的离子阱量子硬件上进行了验证。摘要未突出说明与纯经典算法或其它量子算法的具体性能对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用递归混合量子-经典算法qReduMIS，核心是利用量子近似优化算法（QAOA）的独立集测量结果识别“冻结节点”（大概率属于最优解的顶点），从而引导并解锁后续可证明最优的经典约化步骤。实验在Quantinuum的98量子比特离子阱Helios系统上执行，QAOA电路作用于最多78量子比特和1016个双量子比特门的核上，并在H2-1噪声模拟器上对73个不同规模的资产相关性图进行系统基准测试。

papers.title: Susceptibility-kinetic uncertainty relations for quantum systems
papers.abstract: Kinetic uncertainty relations bound current precision of stochastic processes by dynamical activity. The extension of these bounds to quantum systems has been impeded by coherence, strong system-reservoir coupling, and the subtlety of defining dynamical activity in the quantum regime. Here, we introduce a partial dynamical activity through the quantum Fisher information associated with the rescaling of the system-reservoir coupling and show that it bounds current precision via a universal susceptibility-kinetic uncertainty relation. The general validity of this relation for any open quantum system is guaranteed by the natural contribution of a susceptibility term, which is experimentally accessible by tuning the system-reservoir coupling strength. We show how the partial dynamical activity encompasses previous definitions of activity in the weak-coupling Markovian limit and that it provides an information-geometric interpretation of correlator-based activities. We illustrate the tight constraint on precision that our bound provides with the example of steady-state transport through a double quantum dot, where quantum effects invalidate previously developed kinetic uncertainty relations. We expect our bound to provide a powerful tool for optimizing precision in arbitrary quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：kinetic uncertainty relations、quantum Fisher information、information-geometric interpretation。；研究对象：开放量子系统中的电流精度与动力学活性之间的普适约束关系，具体以双量子点稳态输运为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入与系统-环境耦合重标度相关的量子Fisher信息定义的“部分动力学活性”，建立了普适的“ susceptibility-kinetic uncertainty relation”，该关系对任意开放量子系统均成立，且能严格约束量子效应使已有动力学不确定性关系失效时的电流精度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入与系统-环境耦合重标度相关的量子Fisher信息定义的“部分动力学活性”，建立了普适的“ susceptibility-kinetic uncertainty relation”，该关系对任意开放量子系统均成立，且能严格约束量子效应使已有动力学不确定性关系失效时的电流精度。；创新点：首次将动力学不确定性关系从经典随机过程推广到任意开放量子系统，克服了相干性、强耦合及量子动力学活性定义模糊的障碍；通过引入实验可调的耦合强度响应项，使该关系具有实验可测性。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：基于量子Fisher信息定义部分动力学活性，结合响应函数（susceptibility）项构建不确定性关系；数值示例：以双量子点稳态输运为例验证该约束的紧致性。

papers.title: Graph-Native Reinforcement Learning Enables Traceable Scientific Hypothesis Generation through Conceptual Recombination
papers.abstract: Accelerating materials discovery requires AI systems that can generate scientifically valid hypotheses through multi-step, domain-grounded reasoning. Standard large language models often produce fluent but weakly traceable responses to open-ended materials design problems, making it difficult to determine whether final answers are supported by coherent intermediate reasoning. We develop Graph-PRefLexOR, a family of graph-native reasoning models fine-tuned with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to organize reasoning into explicit phases for mechanism exploration, graph construction, pattern extraction, and hypothesis synthesis. This design links neural language generation with symbolic relational structure, enabling causal connections to be constructed, inspected, and reused. On 100 open-ended questions from materials science and mechanics literature, Graph-PRefLexOR achieves 40-65% improvements over corresponding base models, with the largest gains in reasoning traceability. Embedding analyses show broader semantic exploration and approximately 2-3 times greater semantic diversity than baselines. Semantic backtracking and layer-wise hidden-state analyses further show stronger alignment between structured reasoning and final answers. Finally, test-time graph expansion reveals that additional compute primarily increases long-range conceptual recombination within a bounded semantic space, rather than simply expanding semantic coverage. These results establish graph-native reinforcement learning as a pathway toward interpretable AI systems for scientific hypothesis generation in materials design and other scientific applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“fine-tuned with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)”、“graph-native reasoning models”、“embedding analyses”、“layer-wise hidden-state analyses”。；研究对象：论文研究的是AI系统在材料科学和力学文献中，针对开放式问题生成科学假设的过程。具体研究对象是“Graph-PRefLexOR”这一图原生推理模型家族，以及其生成的推理路径和假设。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过图原生强化学习（Graph-Native Reinforcement Learning）训练的模型Graph-PRefLexOR，在材料科学开放式问题的推理可追溯性上相比基础模型提升了40-65%，其生成的推理过程具有更高的语义多样性和更强的结构化推理与最终答案之间的对齐。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过图原生强化学习（Graph-Native Reinforcement Learning）训练的模型Graph-PRefLexOR，在材料科学开放式问题的推理可追溯性上相比基础模型提升了40-65%，其生成的推理过程具有更高的语义多样性和更强的结构化推理与最终答案之间的对齐。；创新点：该工作的主要新意在于将神经语言生成与符号化关系结构（图结构）直接结合，使得因果连接可以被构建、检查和重用，从而解决了标准大语言模型在开放式科学问题中推理过程不透明、难以追溯的问题。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用了一种结合图原生推理模型与强化学习的方法。具体框架为：使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）对模型进行微调，将推理过程显式组织为机制探索、图构建、模式提取和假设合成等阶段。分析方法包括嵌入分析、语义回溯和逐层隐藏状态分析。

papers.title: Near-Field Characterisation of Guided Modes in WS2 Nanobeams and Quasi-Bulk Crystals
papers.abstract: The exceptionally high in-plane refractive index, low sub-bandgap absorption, and strong optical anisotropy of WS2 make it a promising material platform for next-generation integrated circuits for nanophotonics. Its layered van der Waals structure further enables heterogeneous integration with silicon photonics and emerging two-dimensional optoelectronic materials. However, despite increasing interest in the waveguiding properties of WS2, experimental studies of wavelength-dependent modal confinement and attenuation remain limited. Additionally, though the extinction coefficient of WS2 is expected to be near-negligible beneath the bandgap, reported values span orders of magnitude, leading to large uncertainty in predicted modal decay lengths and wafer-scale integration feasibility. To resolve these ambiguities we perform hyperspectral cavity-enhanced imaging, determining high-resolution upper and lower bounds on the extinction coefficient of WS2 within the visible-NIR edge. We further employ scattering-type scanning near-field optical microscopy (s-SNOM) to probe TE0, TM0, and higher-order modes in both quasi-bulk and nanobeam WS2 waveguides across the 800-1400 nm spectral range, enabling identification of mode-specific trends in wavevector dispersion and loss. This work simultaneously assesses s-SNOM as a probe of waveguide performance, and we find that while absolute loss values depend on measurement geometry, s-SNOM reliably captures relative modal trends and provides upper bounds on propagation loss, supporting its use as a diagnostic tool for anisotropic waveguides. We further identify significant artefacts in nanobeam measurements arising from transverse interference and spatial sampling effects when the structure size approaches the excitation wavelength, which can shift extracted effective indices by up to 0.25.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：hyperspectral cavity-enhanced imaging、scattering-type scanning near-field optical microscopy (s-SNOM)。；研究对象：WS₂（二硫化钨）纳米梁和准块体晶体中的导模（guided modes），具体包括TE0、TM0及高阶模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过s-SNOM在800-1400 nm光谱范围内探测了WS₂波导中不同模式的波矢色散和损耗趋势，发现s-SNOM能可靠捕获相对模态趋势并提供传播损耗的上限，但绝对损耗值依赖于测量几何结构；同时发现当纳米梁结构尺寸接近激发波长时，横向干涉和空间采样效应会引入显著伪影，使提取的有效折射率偏移高达0.25。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过s-SNOM在800-1400 nm光谱范围内探测了WS₂波导中不同模式的波矢色散和损耗趋势，发现s-SNOM能可靠捕获相对模态趋势并提供传播损耗的上限，但绝对损耗值依赖于测量几何结构；同时发现当纳米梁结构尺寸接近激发波长时，横向干涉和空间采样效应会引入显著伪影，使提取的有效折射率偏移高达0.25。；创新点：首次同时利用s-SNOM作为各向异性波导的诊断工具，系统评估了其测量波导性能的可靠性，并揭示了纳米梁测量中因结构尺寸与激发波长可比拟而产生的显著伪影。
papers.method_zh: 采用高光谱腔增强成像（hyperspectral cavity-enhanced imaging）确定WS₂在可见-近红外边缘消光系数的高分辨率上下限；使用散射型扫描近场光学显微镜（s-SNOM）探测准块体和纳米梁WS₂波导中的导模。

papers.title: In-Situ Polarimetry in Collimated Magneto-Infrared Spectroscopy System
papers.abstract: Magneto-infrared spectroscopy under strong magnetic fields provides a powerful probe of Landau quantization and field-induced collective excitations, yet its full potential has long been constrained by the lack of in-situ polarization control, because the highly divergent infrared beam propagating through narrow light tubes undergoes multiple wall reflections, leading to severe polarization degradation. Here we report a collimated magneto-infrared spectroscopy system that integrates continuous in-situ polarimetry. The system employs incident and exit collimation chambers forming a Kepler type optical architecture, which converts the large-aperture FTIR output into a low-divergence beam and strongly suppresses multi-reflection trajectories inside long gold-plated light tubes, thereby enhancing both optical throughput and polarization fidelity. A remotely controlled polarization module, consisting of an automated linear polarizer and a switchable Fresnel rhomb positioned entirely outside the high-field region, enables continuous in-situ tuning between linear, circular, and arbitrary elliptical polarization states without thermal cycling, manual realignment, or breaking vacuum. Interchangeable compact focusing modules further support Faraday and Voigt geometries in both transmission and reflection experiments within a 50 mm magnet bore, providing efficient beam focusing and signal collection while maintaining polarization fidelity. The setup achieves a minimum root-mean-square noise of 0.0033%, an average noise of 0.0082%, and a linear polarization extinction ratio up to 40:1. We demonstrate the capability through continuous in-situ linear polarimetry and broadband circular polarimetry in the magneto-infrared spectroscopy of various single crystals. This platform establishes a robust experimental framework for in-situ polarization-resolved magneto-infrared spectroscopy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：collimated magneto-infrared spectroscopy system、in-situ polarimetry、optical architecture、polarization module。；研究对象：磁光红外光谱测量系统本身，以及用于演示其性能的各种单晶样品（摘要未明确具体材料名称）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过设计开普勒型准直光学架构和远程控制偏振模块，实现了在强磁场下对红外光束的连续原位偏振控制，显著提升了偏振保真度和光学通量，并获得了低噪声（均方根噪声0.0033%）和高消光比（40:1）的性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过设计开普勒型准直光学架构和远程控制偏振模块，实现了在强磁场下对红外光束的连续原位偏振控制，显著提升了偏振保真度和光学通量，并获得了低噪声（均方根噪声0.0033%）和高消光比（40:1）的性能。；创新点：首次在强磁场红外光谱系统中实现了无需热循环、手动重对准或破坏真空的连续原位偏振态调控（线性、圆偏振及任意椭圆偏振），解决了因窄光管多次反射导致的偏振退化问题。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：准直磁光红外光谱系统，集成原位偏振测量。具体包括：开普勒型入射与出射准直腔、长镀金光管、远程控制偏振模块（自动线性偏振器+可切换菲涅耳菱形棱镜）、可互换紧凑聚焦模块（支持法拉第和Voigt几何构型下的透射与反射实验）。

papers.title: Self-selected phase-matched second harmonic generation in nonlinear optical materials: from phenomenon to applications
papers.abstract: Self-selected phase-matched second harmonic generation is introduced as an all-optical probe of refractive-index dispersion in birefringent nonlinear optical materials. Rather than requiring wavelength or angular tuning, the exposure with a spectrally broad, intense ultrashort pulse allows the material to self-select the fundamental spectral component that satisfies the type-I noncritical phase-matching condition. This produces a narrow peak in the second harmonic spectrum whose position is governed by the refractive indices and is therefore highly sensitive to material parameters that affect the optical dispersion. We demonstrate the application of this phenomenon for the optical inspection of stoichiometry and temperature gradients in technologically relevant lithium niobate, as well as composition inhomogeneities in newly grown lithium niobate-tantalate solid solutions. These results establish self-selected phase-matched second harmonic generation as a rapid, non-contact method for inspecting nonlinear optical materials, with potential relevance for bulk crystals, wafers, and thin-film platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“demonstrate the application”、“optical inspection”、“experimentally observed”等关键词，描述了具体实验现象和应用演示。；研究对象：双折射非线性光学材料中的自选相位匹配二次谐波产生现象，具体应用于铌酸锂（lithium niobate）及铌酸锂-钽酸锂固溶体（lithium niobate-tantalate solid solutions）的成分与温度梯度检测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用宽谱超短脉冲照射，材料可自动选择满足I型非临界相位匹配条件的基频光谱成分，从而在二次谐波光谱中产生一个窄峰，该峰位对折射率色散高度敏感，可用于快速、非接触地检测材料的化学计量比、温度梯度和成分不均匀性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用宽谱超短脉冲照射，材料可自动选择满足I型非临界相位匹配条件的基频光谱成分，从而在二次谐波光谱中产生一个窄峰，该峰位对折射率色散高度敏感，可用于快速、非接触地检测材料的化学计量比、温度梯度和成分不均匀性。；创新点：提出并演示了“自选相位匹配二次谐波产生”作为一种全光学探针，无需传统波长或角度扫描即可实现折射率色散的高灵敏度检测，并将其应用于实际材料质量评估（如化学计量比、温度梯度、成分均匀性），为块体晶体、晶圆及薄膜平台提供了一种快速、非接触的检测方法。
papers.method_zh: 采用宽谱、强超短脉冲激发，无需波长或角度调谐，通过测量自选相位匹配产生的二次谐波光谱峰位，实现对材料光学色散特性的探测。具体应用于铌酸锂晶体的化学计量比和温度梯度检测，以及新生长铌酸锂-钽酸锂固溶体的成分不均匀性检测。

papers.title: Evanescent absorption spectroscopy of transition metal dichalcogenide materials using guided photoluminescence in Si$_3$N$_4$ photonic waveguides
papers.abstract: On-chip integration of two-dimensional transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) with photonic waveguides underpins a growing class of compact optoelectronic and sensing devices, whose performance depends on the optical absorption of the 2D material in this integrated environment. We demonstrate source-free, on-chip evanescent absorption spectroscopy of MoS$_2$ and WS$_2$ flakes integrated on Si$_3$N$_4$ waveguides, in which the broadband defect-related photoluminescence of the Si$_3$N$_4$ core itself acts as the internal probe. Light generated inside the core propagates under the TMD flake and is spectrally attenuated by evanescent interaction with the 2D material, and normalizing the transmitted spectrum to a reference waveguide without TMD yields the energy-dependent absorption response without any external illumination. The extracted guided absorption agrees with Raman and local micro-photoluminescence characterization and resolves differences between spatially uniform and non-uniform flakes. A complementary top-pumping scheme recovers guided WS$_2$ photoluminescence, whose spectral reshaping during propagation is quantitatively reproduced by the measured absorption. This source-free platform qualifies 2D materials in their integrated photonic environment and provides a direct route toward waveguide-integrated TMD photodetectors and sensors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验演示（demonstrate）、测量（extracted guided absorption）、表征（Raman and local micro-photoluminescence characterization）等关键词。；研究对象：过渡金属二硫族化物（TMDs）材料（具体为MoS₂和WS₂薄片）与Si₃N₄光子波导的片上集成体系，以及该体系中TMD材料的光学吸收特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用Si₃N₄波导芯层自身的宽带缺陷相关光致发光作为内部探针，无需外部光源即可实现片上倏逝波吸收光谱测量，成功提取了MoS₂和WS₂的能量依赖吸收响应，并能区分空间均匀与非均匀薄片。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用Si₃N₄波导芯层自身的宽带缺陷相关光致发光作为内部探针，无需外部光源即可实现片上倏逝波吸收光谱测量，成功提取了MoS₂和WS₂的能量依赖吸收响应，并能区分空间均匀与非均匀薄片。；创新点：提出了一种无外部光源（source-free）的片上倏逝波吸收光谱技术，利用波导材料自身的发光作为内禀探针，直接对集成环境中的二维材料进行吸收表征，无需额外照明，为波导集成型TMD光电探测器和传感器提供了直接评估平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：将MoS₂和WS₂薄片集成在Si₃N₄波导上，利用波导芯层内部产生的光致发光作为内禀探针，光在波导中传播时与TMD薄片发生倏逝波相互作用，通过将透射光谱与无TMD的参考波导归一化，提取吸收光谱。同时采用互补的顶部泵浦方案恢复波导中WS₂的光致发光，并通过测量吸收定量再现其传播过程中的光谱重塑。辅助表征手段包括拉曼光谱和局域微区光致发光。

papers.title: A bilayer cellular Potts model of epithelial docking
papers.abstract: Fusion of two epithelial cell sheets brought together in a bilayer configuration is a common step in animal morphogenesis, yet, in contrast to other epithelial fusion processes such as wound healing in a monolayer of cells, it has not been a strong focus of modeling efforts. Here we consider a preliminary stage of bilayer fusion, recently termed "docking." In multiple instances of docking that span apical and basal varieties, cells appear to have a tendency to remodel so as to co-localize their bilateral junctions (match their edges) across the bilayer. Motivated by this observation, we introduce a bilayer cellular Potts model that couples two standard 2D area- and perimeter-elasticity models via short-range, out-of-plane interactions between cell edges. The new coupling involves a single adjustable parameter that minimally models the combined effect of dynamic cytoskeletal protrusions, cadherins, and other potential edge-associated adhesion molecules. Our model predicts that bilayer edge matching is maximized when the two monolayers are in their fluid-like regimes (average cell shape index greater than 4.6 in our implementation), and when the bilayer coupling strength strikes a balance between in-plane and out-of-plane energy scales. At higher coupling strengths, the system tends to get stuck in metastable states with sub-optimal edge matching. Exploration of the mechanisms of edge matching reveals that pairs and quadruplets of coordinated T1 transitions play a particularly important role. We also find numerous examples of emergent features we term "domain walls" - branching or unbranching curves that cross no matched edges, but that separate regions of nearly complete matching. These domain walls can be both system spanning and long lived. Finally, we extend our model to crudely account for bending of the two sheets, and study the distributions of docking front speeds that result.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：cellular Potts model、model predicts、simulation）；研究对象：上皮细胞双层融合过程中的“对接”（docking）阶段，特别是细胞边缘在双层间的共定位（edge matching）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 模型预测，当两个单层处于类流体状态（平均细胞形状指数大于4.6）且双层耦合强度在面内与面外能量尺度间达到平衡时，边缘匹配最大化；过高的耦合强度会导致系统陷入亚稳态，匹配效果不佳。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：模型预测，当两个单层处于类流体状态（平均细胞形状指数大于4.6）且双层耦合强度在面内与面外能量尺度间达到平衡时，边缘匹配最大化；过高的耦合强度会导致系统陷入亚稳态，匹配效果不佳。；创新点：首次针对上皮双层融合的“对接”阶段建立计算模型，揭示了边缘匹配的机制（特别是协调的T1转变对和四重态的作用），并发现了“畴壁”（domain walls）这一涌现特征。
papers.method_zh: 采用双层细胞Potts模型（bilayer cellular Potts model），将两个标准二维面积-周长弹性模型通过细胞边缘间的短程面外相互作用耦合起来，并引入一个可调参数来模拟细胞骨架突起、钙黏蛋白等边缘相关黏附分子的综合效应。模型还扩展考虑了双层弯曲，并研究了对接前沿速度的分布。

papers.title: Subsystem Thermalization and Work Statistical Characterizations of Floquet Dynamics
papers.abstract: We study Floquet thermalization in a periodically driven quantum non-integrable Ising chain by combining two operational diagnostics: subsystem thermalization and work statistics. For generic interacting Floquet systems, stroboscopic dynamics lead to heating toward an infinite-temperature state at low driving frequencies, to a prethermal state during the crossover regime, and then to a finite-temperature state at high driving frequencies. We show that reduced density matrices of small subsystems provide a precise measure of local equilibration and clearly resolve prethermal plateaus. In parallel, we analyze the statistics of work performed over a Floquet cycle using both the characteristic function of work with and without the two-point measurements, and the related fluctuation theorem, which captures coherent contributions and deviations from thermal equilibrium. By comparing these two diagnostics within the same Floquet setting, we demonstrate that work statistics encode the same dynamical crossover that governs subsystem thermalization. Our results establish a unified and experimentally accessible framework for characterizing Floquet thermalization, prethermal regimes, and coherent energy absorption in interacting quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“We study”“We show”“We demonstrate”等理论分析表述，未涉及实验或计算模拟的具体方法。；研究对象：周期性驱动的量子非可积伊辛链（Floquet系统）中的热化现象，具体关注子系统热化与功统计特征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在周期性驱动的非可积量子系统中，子系统热化与功统计两种诊断手段能够共同刻画从低驱动频率下的无限温加热态、交叉区间的预热态到高驱动频率下的有限温态的动态交叉行为，且功统计编码了与子系统热化相同的动力学交叉信息。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在周期性驱动的非可积量子系统中，子系统热化与功统计两种诊断手段能够共同刻画从低驱动频率下的无限温加热态、交叉区间的预热态到高驱动频率下的有限温态的动态交叉行为，且功统计编码了与子系统热化相同的动力学交叉信息。；创新点：首次将子系统热化与功统计两种诊断手段在同一Floquet框架下进行统一比较，证明功统计能够编码与子系统热化相同的动力学交叉信息，从而建立了一个可实验实现的统一框架来表征Floquet热化、预热态及相干能量吸收。
papers.method_zh: 结合两种操作诊断方法：1）子系统热化分析：通过小子系统约化密度矩阵精确测量局域平衡并分辨预热平台；2）功统计：利用含/不含两点测量的功特征函数以及相关涨落定理，分析Floquet周期内做功的统计性质，捕捉相干贡献与热平衡偏离。

papers.title: Coupling effect of nearest-neighbor interacting qubit chains to a single qubit system
papers.abstract: This study establishes a theorem that provides sufficient criteria for identifying terms in any time-independent Hamiltonian that have no influence on local dynamics, local observables, or any local phenomena, without any approximation. The usefulness of this theorem is demonstrated by predicting the behavior of three systems. The first system consists of multiple qubit chains with Ising interactions. The second system is formed by a single qubit chain, differentiated by the substitution of Dzyalonshinskii-Moriya (DM) interaction for the last Ising interaction. The predictions were verified by analytically deriving the reduced dynamics of both systems. A third system was also considered, namely, a short qubit chain with a transverse magnetic field on the intermediary environment qubit. This transverse magnetic field signals that the commutation relation required by our theorem no longer holds. The third system's local dynamics were also derived analytically, demonstrating that all Hamiltonian constituents contributed to the reduced dynamics. The physical consequences of our theorem's inapplicability were also explored using this third system by analyzing the entanglement dynamics between the qubits that do not directly interact. The results showed that the entanglement is caused by an \textit{emergent coupling} between the two non-directly interacting subsystems. This \textit{emergent coupling} arises from the non-commutativity of the intermediate interactions connecting the two subsystems. When searching for these \textit{emergent couplings}, our theorem can eliminate intermediate interactions that will not produce them.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“建立了一个定理”、“推导了约化动力学”、“解析推导”等理论分析关键词，未涉及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：由多个具有Ising相互作用的量子比特链构成的系统，以及包含Dzyalonshinskii-Moriya（DM）相互作用的单量子比特链系统。核心物理现象是量子比特链之间的耦合效应及其对局部动力学和纠缠动力学的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作建立了一个定理，能够在不做任何近似的情况下，识别出对局部动力学、局域可观测量或任何局域现象无影响的哈密顿量项。通过分析三个系统，发现当定理适用时，部分哈密顿量项可被忽略；当定理不适用时（如存在横向磁场），所有哈密顿量成分都会贡献到约化动力学中，并导致非直接相互作用子系统之间产生“涌现耦合”，从而引发纠缠。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作建立了一个定理，能够在不做任何近似的情况下，识别出对局部动力学、局域可观测量或任何局域现象无影响的哈密顿量项。通过分析三个系统，发现当定理适用时，部分哈密顿量项可被忽略；当定理不适用时（如存在横向磁场），所有哈密顿量成分都会贡献到约化动力学中，并导致非直接相互作用子系统之间产生“涌现耦合”，从而引发纠缠。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异，但核心创新在于提出了一个无需近似即可判断哈密顿量项是否影响局部动力学的通用定理，并利用该定理揭示了“涌现耦合”的产生机制——即中间相互作用的非对易性。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导。具体包括：建立识别无关哈密顿量项的充分判据定理；对具有Ising相互作用的量子比特链系统进行解析约化动力学推导；对替换为DM相互作用的单量子比特链系统进行解析约化动力学推导；对存在横向磁场的短量子比特链系统进行解析约化动力学推导，并分析其纠缠动力学。

papers.title: Demographic senescence as multi-level selection in miniature
papers.abstract: Multi-level selection and senescence do not at first sight have much in common. Here, we demonstrate that the emergent mortality patterns generated by demographic senescence can be understood as the product of multi-level selection. We formulate a two-level Moran type process and use its scaling limits to illustrate that a simple mathematical framework that models multi-level selection in group-structured populations also models damage accumulation patterns and resultant mortality curves in ageing organisms. To verbally make the connection, observe that defectors spread within a group consisting of cooperators and defectors; when groups compete against each other, defector-rich groups suffer, and between-group selection causes such groups to be systematically under-represented. Exactly analogously, senescing individuals accumulate damage to physiological sub-systems, and `damage begets damage'; individuals who are more damaged are more likely to die, hence damage-rich individuals are systematically under-represented in later age classes. Thus, emergent senescence patterns in complex, integrated organisms are formally equivalent to the patterns generated by a within-generation multi-level selection process in which intra-organismal sub-systems play the role of particles, organisms play the role of collectives, and selective disappearance plays the role of group selection.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：formulate a two-level Moran type process、scaling limits、mathematical framework。；研究对象：生物衰老（demographic senescence）中的死亡模式与多层级选择（multi-level selection）之间的形式等价性，具体涉及群体结构中的合作者/背叛者动态与生物体内损伤累积过程的类比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 生物衰老所呈现的涌现性死亡模式，可以理解为多层级选择过程的产物：个体内部子系统间的损伤累积与选择性消失，等价于群体内合作者与背叛者竞争、群体间选择淘汰的动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：生物衰老所呈现的涌现性死亡模式，可以理解为多层级选择过程的产物：个体内部子系统间的损伤累积与选择性消失，等价于群体内合作者与背叛者竞争、群体间选择淘汰的动力学。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 构建了两层Moran过程模型，并利用其标度极限（scaling limits）进行分析，将多层级选择的数学框架映射到损伤累积与死亡率曲线的生成过程。

papers.title: A universal time-of-arrival signature of Bose--Einstein condensation
papers.abstract: We show that Bose--Einstein condensation produces a cusp in the time-of-arrival (TOA) statistics of a harmonically trapped gas released into free fall. In the semiclassical long time-of-flight regime, with $ε=σ_V/\sqrt{2gH}\ll1$, both the mean and standard deviation of the arrival time distribution, which are governed by the longitudinal velocity variance, remain continuous, but acquire a cusp whose one-sided slope ratio is universal within the ideal-gas far-field limit, $\mathcal{R}_\infty=2.5556\ldots$, and equals the trapped-gas specific-heat ratio $C(Tc^-)/C(Tc^+)$. Finite atom number rounds the cusp and weak interactions perturb it only weakly, leaving a measurable time-domain signature of condensation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We show that...”、“semiclassical long time-of-flight regime”、“ideal-gas far-field limit”等理论推导和解析分析术语，未提及实验或数值计算细节。；研究对象：玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（Bose-Einstein condensation）在自由落体释放过程中产生的到达时间（time-of-arrival, TOA）统计特征。具体体系为简谐势阱中的气体释放后自由下落。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚会在自由落体释放气体的到达时间统计中产生一个尖点（cusp）。在理想气体远场极限下，该尖点的单侧斜率比是普适的，等于凝聚温度以下与以上热容之比 \( C(T_c^-)/C(T_c^+) \)，数值为 \( \mathcal{R}_\infty = 2.5556\ldots \)。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚会在自由落体释放气体的到达时间统计中产生一个尖点（cusp）。在理想气体远场极限下，该尖点的单侧斜率比是普适的，等于凝聚温度以下与以上热容之比 \( C(T_c^-)/C(T_c^+) \)，数值为 \( \mathcal{R}_\infty = 2.5556\ldots \)。；创新点：首次提出到达时间统计中的尖点可作为玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚的普适时间域特征，并建立了该尖点斜率比与热容比之间的精确解析联系。摘要未突出说明与已有实验或理论工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用半经典长飞行时间（long time-of-flight）近似，在条件 \( \varepsilon = \sigma_V / \sqrt{2gH} \ll 1 \) 下，解析推导到达时间分布的均值和标准差，分析其由纵向速度方差主导的行为，并讨论有限原子数和弱相互作用对尖点圆滑化的影响。

papers.title: Synchronization and Swarming of Two-Mode Stochastic Oscillators
papers.abstract: Synchronization and swarming are canonical manifestations of self-organization, observable across scales from cellular processes to animal flocks. This study investigates the collective dynamics of a novel agent-based model where individuals exhibit both spatial mobility and internal, two-mode stochastic oscillatory states. By introducing a local, distance-dependent coupling between the agents' spatial configuration and their internal state transitions, we establish a mutual feedback loop that drives complex pattern formation. Through large-scale numerical simulations, we identify seven distinct morphological configurations, ranging from stationary \textit{Filled-disk} states to highly disordered \textit{Intense-motion} regimes. By performing a rigorous quantitative analysis of the rotational energy and radial dispersion, we transcend simple morphological classification and demonstrate that the system organizes into discrete, quantized topological attractors. We derive a macroscopic scaling law, $Ω\propto r^{-1/2}$, which proves that the emerging rotating states are not rigid-body rotations, but rather composite differential vortex structures characterized by spontaneous chiral symmetry breaking. Our results suggest that these stable, quantized dynamical states are fundamental features of systems governed by bidirectional spatial-phase feedback, offering a robust framework for designing autonomous, decentralized robotic swarms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：agent-based model、numerical simulations、scaling law。；研究对象：一种新型个体基模型（agent-based model）中，具有空间移动能力和双模随机振荡状态的个体所构成的集体动力学系统，具体研究同步与集群行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 系统通过空间构型与内部状态之间的双向反馈，自组织形成七种不同的形态，并展现出离散的、量子化的拓扑吸引子；旋转态并非刚体转动，而是由自发手性对称破缺产生的复合微分涡旋结构，满足标度律 Ω∝r^{-1/2}。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：系统通过空间构型与内部状态之间的双向反馈，自组织形成七种不同的形态，并展现出离散的、量子化的拓扑吸引子；旋转态并非刚体转动，而是由自发手性对称破缺产生的复合微分涡旋结构，满足标度律 Ω∝r^{-1/2}。；创新点：揭示了双向空间-相位反馈系统中稳定、量子化的动力学态是基本特征，并建立了从形态分类到拓扑吸引子定量分析的跨越，为自主分散式机器人集群设计提供了理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 建立个体基模型，引入依赖于距离的局部耦合实现空间构型与内部状态转变之间的双向反馈；通过大规模数值模拟识别形态，并对旋转能量和径向色散进行定量分析，推导宏观标度律。

papers.title: Superconducting Spiral Inductors for RF Reflectometry: Operation at Elevated Temperatures and Magnetic Fields
papers.abstract: Superconducting spiral inductors are emerging as key components for radio-frequency (RF) reflectometry, a widely used readout technique for semiconductor spin qubits. Future scalable quantum-computing architectures are expected to operate at elevated temperatures and magnetic fields, placing new demands on the performance and stability of superconducting circuit elements. Here, we present a systematic study of NbTiN spiral inductors under temperatures of several kelvin and magnetic fields approaching 1 T. By combining weakly coupled resonator measurements with independent two-port inductance extraction, we separate inductive and capacitive contributions to device behaviour and directly identify the origin of resonance shifts and quality factor degradation. Furthermore, we establish practical design metrics linking geometry, temperature sensitivity, and magnetic-field robustness. These results provide a general framework for benchmarking superconducting inductors and guiding the design of future RF-reflectometry circuits for practical quantum technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“systematic study”、“measurements”、“extraction”。；研究对象：NbTiN超导螺旋电感器，用于射频反射测量技术，应用于半导体自旋量子比特读出。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在数开尔文温度和接近1特斯拉的磁场下，通过分离电感和电容贡献，明确了NbTiN螺旋电感器共振频率偏移和品质因数退化的物理起源，并建立了连接几何结构、温度敏感性和磁场鲁棒性的设计指标。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在数开尔文温度和接近1特斯拉的磁场下，通过分离电感和电容贡献，明确了NbTiN螺旋电感器共振频率偏移和品质因数退化的物理起源，并建立了连接几何结构、温度敏感性和磁场鲁棒性的设计指标。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 弱耦合谐振器测量与独立双端口电感提取相结合，分离器件行为中的电感和电容贡献。

papers.title: Scaling Up Thermodynamic AI Models
papers.abstract: Thermodynamic computing devices based on the Ising model show great promise for low-power AI inference and edge computing, but scalable methods for training large models for such hardware remain limited. Prior theory shows that the time-averaged behavior of high-temperature Gibbs-sampled Ising systems can implement feed-forward neural inference. We turn this theoretical correspondence into a scalable and purely backpropagation-based algorithm for training deep convolutional networks for thermodynamic inference on Ising machine hardware. Our image classification models achieve accuracies of 94.9% on CIFAR-10 and 76.0% on CIFAR-100 under binary Gibbs sampling. We then develop and experimentally validate a mathematical theory relating inference cost to accuracy and controlling autocorrelation times. Subsequently, we calculate asymptotic results showing that inference cost is bounded by a well-controlled tradeoff with performance and exhibit algorithms for computing optimal inference schedules. Finally, we discuss implications for hardware development and the future of high-temperature thermodynamic AI models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论+计算）。判断依据：摘要提及“prior theory shows”“develop and experimentally validate a mathematical theory”“calculate asymptotic results”以及“image classification models achieve accuracies”，表明包含理论推导与数值计算验证。；研究对象：基于伊辛模型的热力学计算设备（thermodynamic computing devices），具体研究高温吉布斯采样伊辛系统的时间平均行为如何实现前馈神经推理，并用于图像分类任务（CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种可扩展的纯反向传播算法，用于训练深度卷积网络在伊辛机硬件上进行热力学推理，在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上分别达到94.9%和76.0%的准确率；同时建立了推理成本与精度之间的理论关系，并证明推理成本受控于与性能的良好权衡。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种可扩展的纯反向传播算法，用于训练深度卷积网络在伊辛机硬件上进行热力学推理，在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上分别达到94.9%和76.0%的准确率；同时建立了推理成本与精度之间的理论关系，并证明推理成本受控于与性能的良好权衡。；创新点：将已有的理论对应关系转化为可扩展的、纯反向传播的训练算法，并首次实验验证了推理成本与精度之间的数学理论，给出了最优推理调度算法。摘要未突出说明与已有训练方法的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论方面：建立高温吉布斯采样伊辛系统时间平均行为与前馈神经推理之间的数学对应，推导推理成本与精度及自相关时间的关系，并计算渐近结果。计算方面：使用纯反向传播算法训练深度卷积网络，在二进制吉布斯采样条件下进行图像分类模拟。

papers.title: Work Statistics Under Quantum-Jump and Quench Dynamics in Monitored Ising Chains
papers.abstract: We investigate work statistics in monitored transverse-field Ising chains subject to both a quantum quench of the transverse field and either stochastic quantum jumps or controlled measurement sequences. For generalized measurements, we derive a trajectory-resolved generating function for work statistics in the two-point energy measurement scheme. Evaluating it using a fermionic Gaussian-state formalism, we show that, under stochastic jump dynamics, the work distribution crosses over from a comb-like structure to an essentially Gaussian form with shrinking sub-Gaussian tails, as the number of detection events grows. For controlled jump protocols, the energy added by each jump is constant when successive jumps are causally disconnected but decreases and then saturates when they lie within each other's light cone, yielding linear and sublinear growth of the average work, respectively. For monitored quenches, continuous observation washes out the fine structure of the isolated-quench distribution and again drives the statistics toward Gaussian behavior.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“derive a generating function”“evaluating it using a fermionic Gaussian-state formalism”等理论推导和计算方法，未提及实验数据或实验装置。；研究对象：受监测的横场伊辛链（monitored transverse-field Ising chains），具体研究该系统中量子淬火（quantum quench）与随机量子跳变（stochastic quantum jumps）或受控测量序列（controlled measurement sequences）下的功统计（work statistics）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在随机跳变动力学下，功分布随探测事件增多从梳状结构（comb-like structure）演变为近似高斯分布，且次高斯尾部收缩；在受控跳变协议中，因果连接性决定平均功的线性或亚线性增长；连续监测会抹去孤立淬火分布的精细结构，并驱动统计行为趋向高斯分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在随机跳变动力学下，功分布随探测事件增多从梳状结构（comb-like structure）演变为近似高斯分布，且次高斯尾部收缩；在受控跳变协议中，因果连接性决定平均功的线性或亚线性增长；连续监测会抹去孤立淬火分布的精细结构，并驱动统计行为趋向高斯分布。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用两点能量测量方案（two-point energy measurement scheme）推导轨迹分辨的功统计生成泛函（trajectory-resolved generating function），并利用费米子高斯态形式（fermionic Gaussian-state formalism）进行解析计算。

papers.title: Monte Carlo reconstruction of symmetry-twisted partition function ratios: the critical 3D Ising
papers.abstract: We introduce a Monte Carlo strategy for directly estimating partition function ratios between distinct global sectors of a lattice theory. It enlarges the configuration space to sample an interpolating family whose endpoints are the desired sectors, and uses flat histogram methods to reconstruct the corresponding free energy difference. Although the construction is more general, we focus here on the three-dimensional Ising model on the slab $\mathbb{R}^{2}\times S^{1}_{L_{z}}$ at the bulk critical point, comparing the untwisted periodic sector with the $\mathbb{Z}_{2}$-twisted antiperiodic sector. A large-volume and aspect ratio extrapolation gives the symmetry-twisted thermodynamic Casimir difference $Δ_{\mathbb{Z}_{2}}=0.327(2)$ directly, without lattice derivatives or bulk subtractions. This provides an independent twisted sector probe of tensions observed in periodic sector thermodynamic Casimir observables. More generally, the method gives direct but selective numerical access to CFT compactification data, including estimates of the effective thermal screening scale and the $\mathbb{Z}_{2}$-odd sector energy gap on $T^{2}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Monte Carlo strategy、flat histogram methods、numerical access。；研究对象：三维Ising模型在平板几何（ℝ² × S¹_{L_z}）上的临界行为，具体比较无扭曲周期边界条件与Z₂扭曲反周期边界条件之间的配分函数比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 直接通过蒙特卡洛方法重建对称性扭曲配分函数比，得到临界三维Ising模型在平板上的Z₂扭曲热力学Casimir差值为Δ_{Z₂}=0.327(2)，无需晶格导数或体相扣除。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：直接通过蒙特卡洛方法重建对称性扭曲配分函数比，得到临界三维Ising模型在平板上的Z₂扭曲热力学Casimir差值为Δ_{Z₂}=0.327(2)，无需晶格导数或体相扣除。；创新点：直接估计不同全局扇区之间的配分函数比，从而直接获得对称性扭曲的热力学Casimir差值，避免了传统方法中所需的晶格导数或体相扣除步骤。该方法为CFT紧致化数据提供了直接但选择性的数值访问途径。
papers.method_zh: 采用蒙特卡洛策略，通过扩展构型空间以采样连接两个目标扇区的插值族，并利用平直直方图方法（flat histogram methods）重建相应的自由能差。

papers.title: Toward Hamiltonian simulations of Maxwell-Chern-Simons theory: constant modes and gauge field truncation
papers.abstract: Maxwell-Chern-Simons (MCS) theory in $2+1$ dimensions provides a paradigmatic example of a topological gauge theory with both dynamical and topological degrees of freedom. Its Euclidean formulation suffers from a sign problem, making Hamiltonian numerical approaches particularly attractive. As a first step toward the non-perturbative Hamiltonian study of MCS theory, we investigate the constant mode sector on a spatial torus. Being analytically solvable in the continuum, it provides an ideal benchmark for understanding how the topological properties of the theory are encoded in a finite-dimensional lattice Hilbert space. We construct a finite-dimensional discretization of the torus of flat connections and show that the resulting lattice problem maps onto a generalized Harper-Hofstadter model with twisted boundary conditions. We identify the commensurability conditions under which the finite lattice exactly reproduces the magnetic translation algebra and the topological degeneracy of the continuum theory. A systematic analysis of gauge field truncation and its convergence toward the continuum limit is then presented.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Hamiltonian simulations、non-perturbative Hamiltonian study、continuum theory、lattice Hilbert space。；研究对象：2+1维Maxwell-Chern-Simons（MCS）理论，特别是其空间环面上的常数模（constant mode）扇区。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将平坦联络的环面离散化，MCS理论的常数模扇区可映射为具有扭曲边界条件的广义Harper-Hofstadter模型；在特定可公度条件下，有限格点能精确再现连续理论的磁平移代数和拓扑简并度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将平坦联络的环面离散化，MCS理论的常数模扇区可映射为具有扭曲边界条件的广义Harper-Hofstadter模型；在特定可公度条件下，有限格点能精确再现连续理论的磁平移代数和拓扑简并度。；创新点：首次在非微扰哈密顿量框架下，通过有限维格点离散化系统研究了MCS理论常数模扇区的拓扑性质，并建立了与Harper-Hofstadter模型的精确映射关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值建模相结合。具体包括：构造有限维格点希尔伯特空间离散化平坦联络环面；将格点问题映射为广义Harper-Hofstadter模型；系统分析规范场截断及其向连续极限的收敛性。

papers.title: Exactly solvable non-unitary conformal interfaces in unitary CFTs
papers.abstract: We construct directly on the lattice a class of non-unitary interfaces that are both exactly conformal and exactly solvable, and establish their corresponding boundary and interface conformal field theory (CFT) descriptions. The construction is obtained by analytically continuing the scattering data of known exact unitary conformal interfaces on the lattice, yielding an $SL(2,\mathbb C)$-parametrized family, which is non-compact and breaks probability-current conservation. Exploiting the exact lattice-continuum correspondence, we derive the conformal boundary states in the folded picture. We show that a proper definition of the Hilbert space in the closed-string channel requires the incoming and outgoing boundary states to be specified independently by boundary data associated with a pair of dual biorthogonal bases, in close analogy with the right and left eigenvectors of a non-Hermitian Hamiltonian. This requirement determines a consistent CFT construction of non-unitary boundaries and interfaces, and leads to a non-unitary generalization of the conventional Cardy's condition for unitary boundary CFT. Beyond their formal construction, these non-unitary interfaces are shown to exhibit logarithmic entanglement scaling governed by an effective central charge that is generally complex. For the $SU(1,1)$ subclass, the effective central charge remains real but grows without bound as the transmission coefficient increases. This result is demonstrated through analytical and numerical lattice calculations, as well as an interface CFT analysis in the unfolded picture. Finally, we present a general CFT analysis of a class of global quantum quenches whose initial states are prepared with non-unitary boundaries. We relate their effective temperature to the conformal dimension of the boundary-condition-changing operators associated with non-unitary boundary conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exactly solvable、CFT descriptions、lattice-continuum correspondence、analytical and numerical lattice calculations。；研究对象：非幺正共形界面（non-unitary conformal interfaces）在幺正共形场论（unitary CFTs）中的构造与性质，以及相关的边界共形场论描述。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过解析延拓已知的幺正共形界面的散射数据，构造了一类在格点上精确可解且共形的非幺正界面，并建立了其边界/界面CFT描述。这些界面表现出由复有效中心荷（effective central charge）控制的纠缠熵对数标度，且在SU(1,1)子类中有效中心荷为实数但随透射系数增大而无界增长。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过解析延拓已知的幺正共形界面的散射数据，构造了一类在格点上精确可解且共形的非幺正界面，并建立了其边界/界面CFT描述。这些界面表现出由复有效中心荷（effective central charge）控制的纠缠熵对数标度，且在SU(1,1)子类中有效中心荷为实数但随透射系数增大而无界增长。；创新点：首次在格点上直接构造了同时满足精确可解和共形对称性的非幺正界面，并揭示了其希尔伯特空间需由双正交基（biorthogonal bases）独立指定，从而给出了非幺正边界/界面的自洽CFT构造，并推广了传统的Cardy条件。
papers.method_zh: 采用格点上的解析延拓方法构造非幺正界面，利用精确的格点-连续对应推导折叠图像中的共形边界态，结合解析与数值格点计算以及展开图像中的界面CFT分析，并推广了非幺正边界CFT中的Cardy条件。

papers.title: Multifractal Scaling in Hi-C Maps
papers.abstract: The three-dimensional organization of the genome exhibits rich, scale-dependent structure, as revealed by both chromosome contact maps (e.g., Hi-C maps) and chromatin density measured by microscopy. Recent studies have reported multifractal scaling in these data. Yet, the origin of this scaling behavior remains unclear: existing efforts describe it through postulated models. Here, we show that the multifractal structure of Hi-C maps is a direct consequence of the power-law contact probability $P(s)$, which is itself an empirical observable measured from Hi-C maps. Starting from $P(s)$ with a single exponent $γ$, we analytically derive the mass exponent $τ(q)$, which characterizes how the $q$-th moment of contact density scales with box size $l$ used to coarse-grain the genomic coordinate. This multifractal behavior reflects the geometric competition between intra- and inter-segment contacts. We find that the slope of $τ(q)$ at large $q$ is given by $2 -γ$ when $γ<1$, and by $1$ when $γ\geq 1$. We further show that this behavior is robust to noise and consistent across diverse organisms, indicating that it is a universal feature of chromatin organization. We extend our analysis into double-exponent $P(s)$, and show the $l$ dependence in multifractal behavior. Taken together, these results provide a physical explanation for multifractal scaling and establish a direct link between the multifractality in Hi-C maps and polymer contact statistics, with the large-$q$ slope of $τ(q)$ mapping onto a known polymer contact exponent.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“analytically derive”（解析推导）、“we show”（理论论证）、“extend our analysis”（理论分析扩展），未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：基因组三维组织中的多分形标度行为，具体研究对象为Hi-C图谱（染色体接触图谱）中的多分形结构及其与接触概率幂律标度的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Hi-C图谱中的多分形结构直接源于接触概率P(s)的幂律标度行为，且该多分形行为在不同生物体中具有普适性，其大q阶质量指数τ(q)的斜率由接触指数γ唯一确定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Hi-C图谱中的多分形结构直接源于接触概率P(s)的幂律标度行为，且该多分形行为在不同生物体中具有普适性，其大q阶质量指数τ(q)的斜率由接触指数γ唯一确定。；创新点：首次从理论上证明Hi-C图谱的多分形标度是接触概率幂律标度的直接数学推论，而非需要额外假设的模型现象，并建立了多分形性与聚合物接触统计之间的直接解析联系。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导：从单指数幂律接触概率P(s)出发，解析推导出质量指数τ(q)的表达式；进一步推广到双指数P(s)情形，分析多分形行为对粗粒化尺度l的依赖关系。

papers.title: Exploring the entropic asymmetry on logical stochastic resonance with energetically equivalent intrinsic outputs
papers.abstract: Small-scale systems are inherently subject to environmental noise that can be harnessed constructively to realize reliable logic operations -- a phenomenon known as logical stochastic resonance (LSR), where a bistable system produces correct logical outputs within an optimal window of noise intensity. The Brownian dynamics governed by appropriate inputs inside a double-well potential, modeling the bistable system, mimic the logic operations. The two wells of this potential represent two distinct logical output states 0 and 1. Asymmetry in this potential is known to be essential for improving logical reliability. However, prior studies have focused on energetic asymmetry, characterized by unequal depths of the two wells of the potential. This left the role of the width asymmetry in the potential, unexplored. This latter class of asymmetry emerges due to the dissimilar widths of the two wells of the potential. It can be classified as the entropic asymmetry between the two logical output states. Here, we systematically investigate the effect of width or the entropic asymmetry in the system on the logical response for OR and AND gate operations. Unlike energetic asymmetry, width asymmetry preserves the energetic equivalence of the two intrinsic logical output states, making it a geometric effect. We find that increasing width asymmetry consistently improves the optimal P(logic), the quantifier measuring the successful logical outcome. Moreover, when it is combined with an energetic bias, it produces reliable logic gate operation at a significantly reduced energetic cost compared to the symmetric case. The requirement of this energy bias also diminishes gradually with the increasing degree of width asymmetry in the potential.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Brownian dynamics、modeling、theoretical investigation。；研究对象：双稳势阱中受噪声驱动的布朗粒子系统，用于模拟逻辑随机共振（LSR）现象中的OR与AND逻辑门操作。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 势阱宽度不对称（熵不对称）能够持续提高逻辑输出成功率P(logic)的最优值；当与能量偏置结合时，可在显著降低能量代价的条件下实现可靠逻辑门操作，且所需能量偏置随宽度不对称程度增加而逐渐减小。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：势阱宽度不对称（熵不对称）能够持续提高逻辑输出成功率P(logic)的最优值；当与能量偏置结合时，可在显著降低能量代价的条件下实现可靠逻辑门操作，且所需能量偏置随宽度不对称程度增加而逐渐减小。；创新点：首次系统研究了势阱宽度不对称（而非传统研究中关注的深度不对称）对逻辑随机共振的影响，揭示了这种保持两个逻辑输出态能量等价性的几何效应（熵不对称）在提升逻辑可靠性及降低能量成本方面的独特作用。
papers.method_zh: 基于双稳势阱中布朗动力学的理论建模与数值模拟，系统比较了势阱宽度不对称（熵不对称）与深度不对称（能量不对称）对逻辑随机共振响应的影响。

papers.title: Non-Maxwellian Velocity Statistics in Supercooled Liquids and Their Possible Relation to Super-Arrhenius Viscosity
papers.abstract: For particles of fixed mass, classical equilibrium statistical mechanics dictates a Maxwellian velocity distribution determined solely by the temperature, regardless of the interactions, density, or structure. Supercooled glass forming liquids realize long lived metastable states that evade equilibrium crystallization and may thus violate assumptions underlying Maxwellian statistics.
