To address this bottleneck, we propose an industrialization-oriented Materials Bank, a dedicated valuefiltering and assetization layer that operates beyond traditional databases. It does not merely curate high-quality data but systematically elevates qualified candidates into standardized, upgradable materials assets via a multi-dimensional BankCard framework covering scientific validity, synthesis feasibility, application readiness, and industrial value. By unifying databases, AI models, automated experimentation, and multi-criteria assessment into a cohesive closed-loop ecosystem, the Materials Bank establishes a clear trajectory from data to knowledge, candidate, asset, and product. It serves not as an enhanced database or screening tool, but as a decision infrastructure bridging academic discovery and industrial demand, offering a scalable paradigm to accelerate AI-driven materials innovation and deliver tangible real-world impact.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（概念/框架性理论文章）。判断依据：摘要未提及具体实验或计算模拟，而是提出了一种新的数据管理范式（Materials Bank）和评估框架（BankCard），属于方法论和基础设施层面的理论构建。；研究对象：材料数据的管理与价值化体系。具体而言，研究对象并非某种特定材料或物理现象，而是如何将海量、异构的材料数据（包括成功与失败数据）转化为可驱动AI创新和工业应用的标准化“资产”。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理发现。核心论点是：传统材料数据库作为被动存储库，缺乏价值筛选和资产管理，阻碍了从数据到创新的转化。为此，作者提出“材料银行”（Materials Bank）概念，通过一个多维度的“BankCard”评估框架（涵盖科学有效性、合成可行性、应用就绪度和工业价值），将合格的数据候选者系统性地提升为标准化、可升级的材料资产，从而弥合学术发现与工业需求之间的鸿沟。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理发现。核心论点是：传统材料数据库作为被动存储库，缺乏价值筛选和资产管理，阻碍了从数据到创新的转化。为此，作者提出“材料银行”（Materials Bank）概念，通过一个多维度的“BankCard”评估框架（涵盖科学有效性、合成可行性、应用就绪度和工业价值），将合格的数据候选者系统性地提升为标准化、可升级的材料资产，从而弥合学术发现与工业需求之间的鸿沟。；创新点：提出“材料银行”（Materials Bank）这一工业化导向的概念，将其定位为超越传统数据库的“决策基础设施”。其核心创新在于：1）从被动存储转向主动的“资产化”（Assetizing）；2）引入系统性的、多维度的价值评估与筛选机制（BankCard）；3）构建从数据到知识、候选、资产再到产品的清晰转化路径，旨在直接加速AI驱动的材料创新并产生实际工业影响。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的实验或计算方法。提出的框架是概念性的，包括：一个“价值过滤与资产化层”（Materials Bank），一个多维度的“BankCard”评估框架，以及一个整合了数据库、AI模型、自动化实验和多标准评估的闭环生态系统。

papers.title: Ultrafast Fluence-Reversal Fingerprint of Fragile Kondo Hybridization in CePt$_2$In$_7$
papers.abstract: The emergence of heavy quasiparticles in a Kondo lattice is usually viewed as the formation of a low-energy hybridization gap. Whether this gap represents a rigid electronic structure or a fragile many-body state that can be dynamically reconfigured remains a central question for heavy-fermion systems near magnetic order, quantum criticality, and unconventional superconductivity. Here we use femtosecond pump-probe reflectivity to interrogate this problem in the weakly hybridized Kondo-lattice compound CePt$_2$In$_7$. At low fluence, a slow quasiparticle relaxation channel emerges below $T^* \sim$ 40 K and follows a Rothwarf-Taylor bottleneck response with a low-energy recombination scale 2$Δ\approx$ 7.4 meV. Coherent optical phonons, independently identified by Raman spectroscopy, act as an internal lattice thermometer and rule out large quasi-equilibrium lattice heating as the origin of the nonlinear electronic response. The phonon-free electronic amplitude $A_{\rm elec}$ reveals a fluence-reversal fingerprint: with cooling from the hybridization-crossover regime, the response evolves from weak-linear behavior to Rothwarf-Taylor-like bottleneck suppression and finally to anomalous high-fluence enhancement at the lowest temperatures. This reversal cannot be accounted for by a rigid fixed-gap bottleneck alone and instead identifies an ultrafast optical signature of photoinduced redistribution of a fragile Kondo-hybridized electronic response.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用飞秒泵浦-探测反射率（femtosecond pump-probe reflectivity）和拉曼光谱（Raman spectroscopy）等实验手段。；研究对象：弱杂化近藤晶格化合物 CePt₂In₇，具体研究其近藤杂化能隙的刚性或脆弱性，以及相关的重费米子准粒子动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在CePt₂In₇中，电子响应随激发光通量变化呈现反转特征：从弱线性行为演变为Rothwarf-Taylor瓶颈抑制，最终在最低温下出现反常的高通量增强。这一现象无法用刚性固定能隙的瓶颈模型解释，而是揭示了光致重分布下脆弱近藤杂化电子态的超快光学特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在CePt₂In₇中，电子响应随激发光通量变化呈现反转特征：从弱线性行为演变为Rothwarf-Taylor瓶颈抑制，最终在最低温下出现反常的高通量增强。这一现象无法用刚性固定能隙的瓶颈模型解释，而是揭示了光致重分布下脆弱近藤杂化电子态的超快光学特征。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 飞秒泵浦-探测反射率（测量准粒子弛豫动力学）、拉曼光谱（独立识别相干光学声子并用作内部晶格温度计）。

papers.title: Photon Statistics from Yb3+-Doped CsPbCl3 are Inconsistent with Quantum Cutting
papers.abstract: CsPb(Cl1-xBrx)3:Yb3+ has been widely reported as a broadband quantum-cutting material with a photoluminescence quantum yield exceeding 100%, making it a promising candidate for enhancing the blue-green spectral response of silicon photovoltaics. Many groups have reproduced absolute photoluminescence quantum yields over 100%, but others have struggled to obtain such high values. Here, we test the quantum-cutting capabilities of CsPbCl3:Yb3+ nanocrystals and bulk material using photon-correlation analysis. A quantum-cutting material is expected to exhibit photon bunching, but our experiments on CsPbCl3:Yb3+ show no such behavior. In fact, we observe the opposite -- anti-bunching -- under focused-excitation conditions. This observation can be explained with the previously established Auger-quenching pathway in CsPbCl3:Yb3+. Our results thus confirm high-power Auger quenching but question earlier descriptions of quantum cutting in CsPb(Cl1-xBrx)3:Yb3+.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：photon-correlation analysis、experiments、observation。；研究对象：Yb³⁺掺杂的CsPbCl₃纳米晶和块体材料，以及其量子切割（quantum cutting）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CsPbCl₃:Yb³⁺在光子关联实验中未表现出量子切割材料应有的光子聚束（photon bunching）行为，反而在聚焦激发条件下观察到反聚束（anti-bunching），表明该材料并非量子切割材料，其高量子产率可能源于此前已建立的俄歇淬灭路径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CsPbCl₃:Yb³⁺在光子关联实验中未表现出量子切割材料应有的光子聚束（photon bunching）行为，反而在聚焦激发条件下观察到反聚束（anti-bunching），表明该材料并非量子切割材料，其高量子产率可能源于此前已建立的俄歇淬灭路径。；创新点：首次利用光子统计方法直接检验CsPbCl₃:Yb³⁺的量子切割特性，发现其行为与量子切割预期相反，从而质疑了此前广泛报道的量子切割描述。
papers.method_zh: 光子关联分析（photon-correlation analysis），通过测量光子统计行为（聚束/反聚束）来检验量子切割能力。

papers.title: Ultrafast magnetization induced by linearly polarized pulses is widespread in nonmagnetic semiconductors
papers.abstract: Ultrafast optical on-off switching of magnetic order promises near-petahertz information processing. Recently, it has been proposed that non-magnetic semiconductors with narrow band edges or strong exchange interactions could display ultrafast magnetization when photoexcited with linearly polarized femtoseconds pulses, but the experimental detection of this effect remains a challenge, mostly for the lack of suitable candidate compounds. Here, we present a high-throughput first-principles screening of the MC3D database of experimentally known inorganic crystals, identifying nearly 440 non-magnetic semiconductors that develop spin polarization under photoexcitation with linearly polarized pulses via a light-induced exchange-driven instability. We determine how the crystal field environment and band-edge orbital character govern the magnitude and the type of magnetic order of the photoinduced state and we unveil systematic chemical and periodic trends that provide intuitive guidance for materials selection. Our results argue that on-off switching of magnetization with linearly polarized femtosecond pulses is a widespread occurrence in non-magnetic semiconductors, opening novel avenues for experimental verification and application.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：high-throughput first-principles screening、DFT、MC3D数据库）；研究对象：非磁性半导体在飞秒线性偏振光激发下产生超快磁化的现象，具体筛选了MC3D数据库中约440种已知无机晶体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 线性偏振飞秒脉冲诱导的非磁性半导体超快磁化是一种普遍现象，光激发可通过交换驱动的失稳使大量非磁性半导体产生自旋极化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：线性偏振飞秒脉冲诱导的非磁性半导体超快磁化是一种普遍现象，光激发可通过交换驱动的失稳使大量非磁性半导体产生自旋极化。；创新点：首次通过高通量计算证明线性偏振光诱导非磁性半导体产生超快磁化具有广泛性，并提供了材料选择的直观化学与周期性指导原则。
papers.method_zh: 高通量第一性原理筛选（基于MC3D实验已知无机晶体数据库），分析晶体场环境、能带边缘轨道特征对光致磁化强度和磁有序类型的影响，并揭示系统性的化学与周期趋势。

papers.title: Three-phonon mixing as a source of light-induced chirality
papers.abstract: Mid- and far-infrared optical pulses have found wide applicability in experiments in which collective modes of solids are driven nonlinearly, as a means to manipulate functional properties of materials on ultrafast time scales. In the illustrative case of boron phosphate (BPO$_4$), mid-infrared excitation has been used to induce chirality in an otherwise achiral crystal. The pump frequency dependence of photo-induced chirality reveals that, while on-resonance excitation is understood in terms of the well-documented phonon rectification from two-phonon mixing, additional pathways become relevant when the pump pulse is detuned from resonance. We find that a three-mode mixing mechanism becomes important in this case, whereas the contributions from other impulsive Raman terms are negligible. The results reported here provide a quantitative foundation for nonlinear phononic lineshapes in transparent materials, and open up new opportunities for lattice control.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章（关键词：three-mode mixing mechanism、nonlinear phononic lineshapes、quantitative foundation）；研究对象：硼磷酸盐（BPO₄）中光致手性的产生机制，具体为红外光脉冲驱动下非手性晶体中手性的诱导现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当泵浦脉冲偏离共振时，三声子混合机制成为光致手性的主要来源，而其他脉冲拉曼项贡献可忽略；该机制为透明材料中非线性声子线形提供了定量基础。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当泵浦脉冲偏离共振时，三声子混合机制成为光致手性的主要来源，而其他脉冲拉曼项贡献可忽略；该机制为透明材料中非线性声子线形提供了定量基础。；创新点：揭示了在非共振激发条件下，三声子混合（而非传统双声子整流）是光致手性的主导机制，拓展了对非线性声子驱动过程的理解。
papers.method_zh: 基于非线性声子耦合的理论分析，结合泵浦频率依赖的光致手性实验数据（摘要提及实验观测，但未明确具体实验手段，如泵浦-探测光谱等），通过对比双声子整流与三声子混合的贡献进行机制识别。

papers.title: Phonon-induced pseudogap phase in TiSe$_2$
papers.abstract: To comprehend quantum ordered states, such as charge density waves (CDW), in layered transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs), it is essential to uncover their underlying normal states. Here, we use time- and angle-resolved extreme ultraviolet photoemission spectroscopy and ab initio electron-phonon calculations to perform excited state band mapping of three prototypical 1T TMDCs, i.e., TiSe$_2$, HfTe$_2$, and ZrTe$_2$, at room temperature. The results reveal the profound impact of strong electron-phonon-induced thermal fluctuations on the normal-phase electronic structure. Specifically, in the moderate electron-phonon coupling regime, as in HfTe$_2$ and ZrTe$_2$, thermal fluctuations only lead to small spectral broadening and band renormalization. In the strongly coupled case, exemplified by TiSe$_2$, we observe soft-phonon-induced, momentum-dependent suppression of spectral weight, i.e., pseudogaps - extending up to 1 eV above the Fermi level. Our work establishes the normal phase of TiSe$_2$ as a phonon-induced pseudogap phase governed by strong CDW fluctuations, thereby uncovering previously missing aspects of the TiSe$_2$ phase diagram, with broader implications for other TMDCs in the strong electron-phonon coupling regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：使用了时间分辨极紫外光电子能谱（tr-XUV ARPES）实验手段，并结合了第一性原理电子-声子计算（ab initio electron-phonon calculations）。；研究对象：层状过渡金属二硫族化物（TMDCs）中的三种原型材料：TiSe₂、HfTe₂ 和 ZrTe₂，重点研究其室温下的正常相电子结构，特别是电荷密度波（CDW）序前的正常态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强电子-声子耦合的 TiSe₂ 中，观察到由软声子诱导的、动量依赖的谱权重抑制（即赝能隙），其能量范围可延伸至费米能级以上 1 eV，表明 TiSe₂ 的正常相是一个由强 CDW 涨落主导的声子诱导赝能隙相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强电子-声子耦合的 TiSe₂ 中，观察到由软声子诱导的、动量依赖的谱权重抑制（即赝能隙），其能量范围可延伸至费米能级以上 1 eV，表明 TiSe₂ 的正常相是一个由强 CDW 涨落主导的声子诱导赝能隙相。；创新点：首次通过实验揭示 TiSe₂ 正常相中由强电子-声子耦合导致的赝能隙特征，并指出该赝能隙源于软声子驱动的 CDW 涨落，填补了 TiSe₂ 相图中此前缺失的正常态物理图像，并对其他强电子-声子耦合 TMDCs 具有普适意义。
papers.method_zh: 时间分辨极紫外角分辨光电子能谱（tr-XUV ARPES）进行激发态能带映射，结合第一性原理电子-声子耦合计算（ab initio electron-phonon calculations）。

papers.title: Orientation-tunable correlated Chern insulating states in chiral twisted double bilayer graphene proximitized by WSe2
papers.abstract: Moire flat bands in graphene systems proximitized by transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) provide a setting where spin-orbit coupling (SOC) can reshape band topology. The crystallographic alignment angle twist angle between TMDC and graphene layers is predicted to tune the balance of Ising and Rashba SOC, but a combined theoretical and experimental understanding of how twist angle governs the topological character of correlated states has not been systematically established. Here we show that in chiral-stacked twisted double bilayer graphene in proximity to WSe2, twist angle between graphene and WSe2 determines the topological character of correlated Chern insulators. Continuum model calculations reveal that Ising spin-orbit coupling dominates at zero twist angle, giving rise to flat bands with finite valley Chern numbers, whereas Rashba coupling dominates at larger twist angle, resulting in topologically trivial bands. Transport measurements at quarter filling confirm this picture: twist angle = 0 deg devices exhibit C = +1 Chern insulators, consistent with spontaneous isospin polarization, whereas twist angle = 15 degree devices show C = 0 despite exhibiting similar correlated insulating behavior. The sharp contrast establishes crystallographic alignment as a new tuning knob, complementary to twist angle, displacement field, and carrier density, for engineering correlated topological states in van der Waals heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Continuum model calculations reveal...”（连续模型计算）和“Transport measurements confirm...”（输运测量）。；研究对象：手性堆叠的扭转双层石墨烯（twisted double bilayer graphene）与过渡金属硫族化合物WSe₂邻近耦合形成的范德华异质结，具体研究其中自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）调控的关联拓扑态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 石墨烯与WSe₂之间的晶格对准角度（twist angle）决定了关联陈绝缘体的拓扑性质：零度对准时Ising SOC主导，产生具有有限谷陈数的平带，实验观察到C=+1的陈绝缘体；15度对准时Rashba SOC主导，平带拓扑平庸，实验观察到C=0的关联绝缘体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：石墨烯与WSe₂之间的晶格对准角度（twist angle）决定了关联陈绝缘体的拓扑性质：零度对准时Ising SOC主导，产生具有有限谷陈数的平带，实验观察到C=+1的陈绝缘体；15度对准时Rashba SOC主导，平带拓扑平庸，实验观察到C=0的关联绝缘体。；创新点：首次系统建立并实验验证了石墨烯与TMDC之间的晶格对准角度（而非仅层间扭转角）作为调控关联拓扑态的新自由度，与扭转角、位移场和载流子密度互补。
papers.method_zh: 连续模型计算（continuum model calculations）分析不同对准角度下Ising和Rashba SOC的平衡；低温输运测量（transport measurements）在四分之一填充下表征陈绝缘体的陈数（C）。

papers.title: Thermal rectification due to phonon confinement in nanoparticles
papers.abstract: We demonstrate that thermal rectification can arise at the contact between two spherical nanoparticles of identical material but different size due to the geometric confinement of phonons. This confinement suppresses long-wavelength phonons differently in differently sized particles and creates a size-dependent gap in the phonon density of states. This gives rise to direction-dependent heat transport even in perfectly homogeneous materials. We develop an analytical model based on phonon confinement and phonon ray-tracing in the Casimir regime and derive expressions for heat fluxes and rectification efficiency as functions of particle sizes and temperatures. The model predicts measurable rectification efficiencies for nanoparticles with radii of a few tens of nanometers, reaching fraction of percent at room temperature and much larger values at low temperatures. The proposed mechanism provides a straightforward and scalable route to thermal rectification in granular nanomaterials without requiring material heterogeneity or strong nonlinearities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop an analytical model”“derive expressions”，属于理论建模与分析。；研究对象：两个不同尺寸的球形纳米颗粒之间的热整流现象，具体研究声子在纳米颗粒中的几何限制效应导致的定向热输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使材料完全均匀，仅因纳米颗粒尺寸不同导致的声子几何限制，也能产生热整流效应。该效应源于尺寸依赖的声子态密度带隙，使得长波长声子在大小不同的颗粒中被抑制程度不同，从而产生方向依赖的热流。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使材料完全均匀，仅因纳米颗粒尺寸不同导致的声子几何限制，也能产生热整流效应。该效应源于尺寸依赖的声子态密度带隙，使得长波长声子在大小不同的颗粒中被抑制程度不同，从而产生方向依赖的热流。；创新点：提出了一种无需材料异质性或强非线性的热整流机制，仅通过纳米颗粒的几何尺寸差异即可实现，为颗粒状纳米材料中的热整流提供了一条简单且可扩展的路径。
papers.method_zh: 基于声子限制（phonon confinement）和卡西米尔（Casimir） regime下的声子射线追踪（phonon ray-tracing）建立解析模型，推导出热流和整流效率作为颗粒尺寸和温度的函数表达式。

papers.title: Kinetic Monte Carlo-Ising Machine Optimization for Atomistic Inverse Design of Solid Electrolytes
papers.abstract: Maximizing ionic conductivity remains a fundamental challenge in the atomistic design of solid electrolytes. To this end, we present a framework that combines kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC) and factorization machine with quadratic-optimization annealing (FMQA), an Ising-machine-based black-box optimization algorithm for large-scale combinatorial optimization. KMC evaluates the ionic conductivity for a given dopant configuration, whereas FMQA iteratively learns a surrogate model from a small configuration-conductivity dataset and proposes configurations expected to maximize conductivity. To address the severe combinatorial explosion in large KMC simulation cells, we partition the configuration space for parallel optimization. As a proof of concept, we apply this KMC-FMQA framework to bulk 8 mol % yttria-stabilized zirconia, identifying a dopant configuration with an order-of-magnitude higher conductivity than that of random configurations and the experimentally reported conductivity. Combined with experiments, this framework will enable the determination of microscopic structures from measured conductivity, providing insight into the underlying transport mechanisms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC)、factorization machine with quadratic-optimization annealing (FMQA)、Ising-machine-based black-box optimization algorithm。；研究对象：固体电解质中的离子电导率最大化问题，具体材料为8 mol%氧化钇稳定氧化锆（yttria-stabilized zirconia）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该框架能够识别出比随机掺杂构型和实验报道电导率高出一个数量级的掺杂构型，从而显著提升离子电导率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该框架能够识别出比随机掺杂构型和实验报道电导率高出一个数量级的掺杂构型，从而显著提升离子电导率。；创新点：将伊辛机优化算法（FMQA）与KMC结合，用于固体电解质的原子级逆向设计，并通过对构型空间进行分区并行优化来解决大规模组合优化难题。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 结合动力学蒙特卡洛（KMC）和基于伊辛机的黑箱优化算法（FMQA，即因子分解机与二次优化退火）。KMC用于评估给定掺杂构型的离子电导率，FMQA通过小规模构型-电导率数据集迭代学习代理模型并提出预期最大化电导率的构型。为应对大KMC模拟单元中的组合爆炸问题，采用分区并行优化策略。

papers.title: Symmetry-Enforced Ferroelectric Switching of Two-Dimensional Altermagnetism
papers.abstract: Altermagnetism features strong momentum-dependent spin splitting despite zero net magnetization, offering a transformative platform for next-generation spintronics. However, the nonvolatile and deterministic switching between its two equivalent spin-splitting states remains a fundamental bottleneck. Here, we propose a universal layer-engineering paradigm to achieve symmetry-enforced ferroelectric switching of two-dimensional altermagnetism. By sandwiching a conventional antiferromagnetic monolayer between two identical ferroelectric layers, the out-of-plane polarization cleanly breaks the spatial symmetry to induce robust altermagnetic splitting. Crucially, the global combined parity-time symmetry dictates that reversing the ferroelectric polarization exactly inverts the altermagnetic spin-splitting pattern. We rigorously validate this mechanism in the In2Se3/MnPTe3/In2Se3 trilayer using first-principles calculations. As a direct consequence, the ferroelectrically driven spin-splitting reversal deterministically flips the anomalous Hall effect signal, providing an unambiguous transport fingerprint to electrically distinguish the two altermagnetic states. Unconstrained by the stringent symmetry requirements of intrinsic single-phase materials, our findings establish a versatile physical framework for electrically addressable altermagnetic spintronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含第一性原理计算验证）。判断依据：propose（提出）、first-principles calculations（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：二维交变磁体（altermagnet）的对称性增强铁电开关机制，具体材料体系为In₂Se₃/MnPTe₃/In₂Se₃三明治异质结。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将常规反铁磁单层夹在两个相同铁电层之间，铁电极化反转可精确反转交变磁自旋劈裂图案，从而实现对两种等价自旋劈裂态的非易失性、确定性切换，并可通过反常霍尔效应信号进行电学区分。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将常规反铁磁单层夹在两个相同铁电层之间，铁电极化反转可精确反转交变磁自旋劈裂图案，从而实现对两种等价自旋劈裂态的非易失性、确定性切换，并可通过反常霍尔效应信号进行电学区分。；创新点：提出了一种普适的层工程范式，通过铁电层引入对称性破缺实现交变磁自旋劈裂，并利用铁电反转实现自旋劈裂图案的确定性翻转，突破了传统单相材料对对称性的严苛要求，为电学可寻址的交变磁自旋电子学建立了通用物理框架。
papers.method_zh: 对称性分析（全局联合宇称-时间对称性约束）与第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）相结合。

papers.title: Quantitative description of cognitive fatigue in repetitive monotonous tasks
papers.abstract: There is strong qualitative empirical evidence in the scientific literature that, due to cognitive fatigue, workers performing repetitive and monotonous tasks are characterized by a gradual deterioration in their performance abilities as the time-on-task increases, a phenomenon known as the vigilance decrement. Using a time-dependent Sisyphus random climb model, we provide a quantitative description of this intriguing phenomenon. In particular, we use analytical techniques in order to determine the success probability function $S(t;{\cal N})$ of Sisyphus workers, the time-dependent fraction of workers who succeed, after making $t$ repetitive operations or less, to complete their task by making ${\cal N}$ successful operations in a row without a single fault in between. It is explicitly shown that the functional behavior of the increasing-in-time one-operation tumble probability $1-s(t)$ of exhausted Sisyphus workers may have a dramatic effect on the probability of the workers to achieve their ultimate goal in repetitive monotonous processes. In particular, we prove that the Sisyphus random climb model with the inverse power law functional behavior $s(t)\sim t^{-1/{\cal N}}$ of the one-operation success probability marks the boundary between Sisyphus workers whose success functions $S[t;s(t),{\cal N}]$ approach $1$ asymptotically in time (implying that all the workers eventually complete their task) and Sisyphus workers whose success functions approach an asymptotic value which is less than $1$, in which case some of the exhausted Sisyphus workers never complete their task successfully.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：time-dependent Sisyphus random climb model、analytical techniques、probability function。；研究对象：认知疲劳（cognitive fatigue）现象，具体表现为重复单调任务中工人表现随任务时间逐渐下降的“警戒衰减”（vigilance decrement）效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过Sisyphus随机爬升模型，证明了单次操作成功概率$s(t)$的时变行为（特别是逆幂律行为$s(t)\sim t^{-1/{\cal N}}$）决定了工人最终能否全部成功完成任务：当$s(t)$衰减慢于该边界时，所有工人最终都能成功；反之，部分工人将永远无法完成任务。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过Sisyphus随机爬升模型，证明了单次操作成功概率$s(t)$的时变行为（特别是逆幂律行为$s(t)\sim t^{-1/{\cal N}}$）决定了工人最终能否全部成功完成任务：当$s(t)$衰减慢于该边界时，所有工人最终都能成功；反之，部分工人将永远无法完成任务。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用时间依赖的Sisyphus随机爬升模型（time-dependent Sisyphus random climb model），通过解析技术（analytical techniques）推导出成功概率函数$S(t;{\cal N})$的表达式，并分析单次操作失败概率$1-s(t)$的时变效应。

papers.title: Observation of Intrinsic Anderson Localization in Few-Layer ReS$_2$
papers.abstract: Electron localization phenomena are expected to play an important role in the transport properties of two-dimensional materials. Rhenium disulfide (ReS$_2$), with its narrow conduction bandwidth, is uniquely susceptible to this effect. However, extrinsic disorder caused by fabrication methods obscures inherent localization behavior arising from reduced dimensionality and degrades transport properties. We report intrinsic Anderson localization in few-layer ReS$_2$ by eliminating extrinsic fabrication-induced disorder through all-dry van der Waals assembly and suppressing interface charge trapping through a hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) gate dielectric. Temperature-dependent transport reveals a crossover from nearest-neighbor hopping to two-dimensional (2D) Mott variable-range hopping (VRH). The non-monotonic gate-voltage dependence of activation energy provides direct access to the energy-resolved band-tail density of states of the ReS$_2$ conduction band. 2D Mott VRH yields a localization length of (3.5 $\pm$ 0.1) nm, an order of magnitude larger than disorder-dominated devices, providing a quantitative characterization of intrinsic Anderson localization in ReS$_2$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了具体的实验制备（全干法范德华组装）、测量（变温输运）和数据分析（提取局域化长度等）。；研究对象：少层二硫化铼（ReS₂）中的本征安德森局域化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过消除制备工艺引入的外在无序，在少层ReS₂中观测到了本征安德森局域化，并定量表征出其局域化长度为（3.5 ± 0.1）nm，比受无序主导的器件大一个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过消除制备工艺引入的外在无序，在少层ReS₂中观测到了本征安德森局域化，并定量表征出其局域化长度为（3.5 ± 0.1）nm，比受无序主导的器件大一个数量级。；创新点：首次在ReS₂中通过消除外在制备无序，实现了对本征安德森局域化的定量观测，并获得了比以往无序主导器件大一个数量级的局域化长度。
papers.method_zh: 全干法范德华组装制备器件，使用六方氮化硼（hBN）作为栅介质以抑制界面电荷陷阱；通过变温输运测量，分析电阻随温度的变化，识别出从最近邻跳跃到二维Mott变程跳跃（VRH）的转变；通过激活能对栅电压的非单调依赖关系，直接获取ReS₂导带尾态的能量分辨态密度。

papers.title: High-Mobility and High-Reliability Top-Gate Oxide Semiconductor Transistors by Oxygen Engineering
papers.abstract: In this work, we investigate the role of oxygen (O) on the performance of top-gate (TG) atomic-layer-deposited (ALD) oxide semiconductor transistors. The results reveal distinct defect characteristics and positive bias temperature instability (PBTI) degradation mechanisms between oxygen-rich (O-rich) and oxygen-deficient (O-poor) devices. It is found that an O-rich device fabrication process followed by O-free annealing can effectively achieve TG indium-rich (In-rich) oxide semiconductor transistors with high mobility, high reliability and high stability in hydrogen environment because O-rich process can suppress oxygen vacancies and their interaction with hydrogen, while O-free annealing plays a critical role in minimizing the formation of O-rich defects such as oxygen dimers (O-O bonds). Consequently, TG In-rich transistors with high mobility, steep subthreshold slope, and high PBTI reliability at high temperature are demonstrated. The understanding of O-rich defects provides a new insight to overcome the mobility-stability trade-off.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“investigate the role of oxygen on the performance of top-gate oxide semiconductor transistors”，并描述了器件制备工艺（如O-rich process、O-free annealing）和性能测试（PBTI、迁移率、亚阈值摆幅等）。；研究对象：顶栅原子层沉积氧化物半导体晶体管，具体为富铟氧化物半导体薄膜晶体管，并研究氧含量对其性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过富氧工艺结合无氧退火，可同时实现高迁移率、高可靠性和高氢环境稳定性，克服了氧化物半导体中迁移率与稳定性之间的权衡。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过富氧工艺结合无氧退火，可同时实现高迁移率、高可靠性和高氢环境稳定性，克服了氧化物半导体中迁移率与稳定性之间的权衡。；创新点：揭示了富氧缺陷（如氧二聚体O-O键）对器件可靠性的影响，并提出通过富氧工艺抑制氧空位及其与氢的相互作用，同时利用无氧退火减少富氧缺陷，从而突破迁移率-稳定性权衡的新思路。
papers.method_zh: 采用原子层沉积（ALD）制备顶栅氧化物半导体晶体管，通过调控氧含量（富氧与缺氧条件）及退火气氛（无氧退火），结合正偏压温度不稳定性（PBTI）测试和缺陷特性分析。

papers.title: Andreev reflection mediated by topological corner states in a two-dimensional honeycomb lattice
papers.abstract: Topological corner states in two-dimensional second-order topological insulators (SOTIs) are localized in real space. We numerically demonstrate that such localized topological corner states can mediate Andreev reflection when coupled to a superconducting lead. We consider a transport setup based on a two-dimensional honeycomb lattice, consisting of a normal lead, a central SOTI region, and a superconducting lead. The central SOTI region is described by the modified Kane--Mele model with an in-plane Zeeman field and hosts topological corner states in a diamond-shaped flake. Although the central region is insulating, the local density of states shows that incident electrons can turn the localized corner state into an extended scattering state, which forms a resonant tunneling channel to the superconducting lead. This process leads to a perfect Andreev reflection peak near zero energy. Away from this resonance, antiresonance dips appear in the Andreev reflection spectrum, and their positions can be tuned by the Zeeman field strength. We show that the suppression of Andreev reflection is caused by quantum interference and the imbalance between electron and hole dwell times in the central region. These results demonstrate that topological corner states can provide a resonant tunneling path to the superconducting interface and mediate Andreev reflection in second-order topological systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：numerically demonstrate、transport setup、modified Kane--Mele model。；研究对象：基于二维蜂窝晶格的二阶拓扑绝缘体（SOTI）中的拓扑角态，以及其与超导引线耦合时诱导的Andreev反射现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 局域的拓扑角态在与超导引线耦合时，可被入射电子转化为扩展散射态，形成共振隧穿通道，从而在零能附近产生完美的Andreev反射峰；远离共振时，Andreev反射谱中出现反共振谷，其位置可由塞曼场强度调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：局域的拓扑角态在与超导引线耦合时，可被入射电子转化为扩展散射态，形成共振隧穿通道，从而在零能附近产生完美的Andreev反射峰；远离共振时，Andreev反射谱中出现反共振谷，其位置可由塞曼场强度调控。；创新点：首次在二阶拓扑绝缘体中证明拓扑角态可以介导Andreev反射，揭示了局域角态通过共振隧穿机制与超导界面耦合的物理图像，并指出反共振源于量子干涉及电子与空穴在中心区域驻留时间的不平衡。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟。具体采用修正的Kane-Mele模型（含面内塞曼场）描述菱形flake状的中心SOTI区域，构建正常引线-中心SOTI-超导引线的输运结构，通过计算局域态密度和Andreev反射谱进行分析。

papers.title: Nonlinear topological laser based on multipole insulators
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional higher-order topological insulators (HOTIs), characterized by distinctive one-dimensional edge states and zero-dimensional corner states, provide an ideal platform for developing higher-order topological lasers. In this work, we systematically investigate the two-dimensional Benalcazar-Bernevig-Hughes (BBH) model, which hosts quantized quadrupole moments and topologically protected corner and edge states. By confining the lasing mode to selected topological corner or edge states under controlled gain, we demonstrate that the stable light excitation achieved after long-time evolution is predominantly determined by the topological properties of the model Hamiltonian. To characterize the system's topological features, we introduce several diagnostic ratios: the corner decay ratio $τ_{1}$ and edge-to-corner ratio $τ_{2}$ quantify the localization degree and spatial extent of corner states, respectively, while the inter-corner transfer ratio $χ$ measures the intensity transfer efficiency mediated by coherent edge-state dynamics. The abrupt changes in $τ_{1}$ and $τ_{2}$ as functions of the hopping parameter $γ/λ$ directly reveal topological phase transitions, providing a comprehensive toolkit for extracting topological signatures from the system's dynamical evolution. Additionally, modulating the lattice site parity enables flexible tuning of corner state localization positions, offering insights for device engineering. Our calculations reveal that achieving bistability between corner states and edge states is relatively challenging.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：systematically investigate、introduce diagnostic ratios、calculations reveal。；研究对象：基于多极绝缘体的二维高阶拓扑激光器，具体为Benalcazar-Bernevig-Hughes (BBH)模型中的量子化四极矩及拓扑保护的角态和边态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将激光模式限制在受控增益下的拓扑角态或边态，长时间演化后的稳定光激发主要由模型哈密顿量的拓扑性质决定；通过引入诊断比率（角衰减比τ₁、边角比τ₂、角间转移比χ）可揭示拓扑相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将激光模式限制在受控增益下的拓扑角态或边态，长时间演化后的稳定光激发主要由模型哈密顿量的拓扑性质决定；通过引入诊断比率（角衰减比τ₁、边角比τ₂、角间转移比χ）可揭示拓扑相变。；创新点：提出了利用角衰减比τ₁、边角比τ₂和角间转移比χ等诊断比率从系统动力学演化中提取拓扑特征的新方法，并揭示了这些比率随跳变参数γ/λ的突变可直接反映拓扑相变。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值计算。基于BBH模型，通过调控增益实现激光模式在拓扑角态或边态的选择性激发，并引入τ₁、τ₂、χ等诊断比率表征拓扑特征，同时通过调节晶格格点宇称调控角态局域位置。

papers.title: Beyond binary scission: a generalized three-species cascade breakage model for wormlike micellar solutions
papers.abstract: Wormlike micellar fluids exhibit complex rheological behavior driven by the continuous breakage and recombination of self-assembled micellar networks. Existing two-species models provide a coarse binary representation of the micellar population, limiting their ability to resolve intermediate structural states and broad relaxation spectra. To address this limitation, we develop a three-species cascade breakage model consisting of gel-network, long chains, and short chains. By introducing an intermediate micellar state, the model links the rapid relaxation of short fragments to the slow recovery of the gel-network within a unified kinetic framework. This additional structural pathway gives rise to a three-mode viscoelastic response, improves the high-frequency description of the dynamic moduli, and produces a non-monotone constitutive curve that evolves into a stress plateau with coexisting shear bands in Couette flow. This cascade mechanism also governs the transient response, including stress overshoot, hysteresis, and multistep relaxation after shear cessation. Overall, the proposed three-species model provides a physically interpretable framework for worm-like micellar shear banding, capturing the connection between cascade microstructural evolution, broad relaxation dynamics, and macroscopic flow localization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：模型构建、动力学框架、理论分析。；研究对象：蠕虫状胶束溶液中的剪切带现象，具体为胶束网络在流动中的断裂与重组动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一个包含凝胶网络、长链和短链的三物种级联断裂模型，能够解释蠕虫状胶束溶液中的多模式粘弹性响应、非单调本构曲线以及剪切带共存现象，并捕捉应力过冲、滞后和剪切停止后的多步松弛等瞬态行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一个包含凝胶网络、长链和短链的三物种级联断裂模型，能够解释蠕虫状胶束溶液中的多模式粘弹性响应、非单调本构曲线以及剪切带共存现象，并捕捉应力过冲、滞后和剪切停止后的多步松弛等瞬态行为。；创新点：将传统二元断裂模型扩展为三物种级联模型，引入中间结构态，从而更精细地解析胶束群体的中间结构状态和宽弛豫谱，并建立了微观结构演化与宏观流动局域化之间的物理联系。
papers.method_zh: 构建三物种级联断裂动力学模型，引入中间胶束态，在统一动力学框架内连接短链快速松弛与凝胶网络慢速恢复，并通过理论分析研究其流变响应和流动局域化行为。

papers.title: Hidden ordered compound-layer and its tailoring of the electronic/optical property in Ge2Sb2SexTe5-x alloys
papers.abstract: Ge2Sb2SexTe5-x (GSST) alloys represent an emerging class of phase-change materials for integrated photonics. However, the microscopic origins underlying their superior performance compared to the parent compound Ge2Sb2Te5 remain elusive. By using atomic simulations, this work elucidates that the thermal stability and low optical loss of GSST are fundamentally governed by the formation of an in-layer compound-like structure with SeTe2 or Se2Te stoichiometry depending on the Se content, contrasting to the previously believed pure-element-layered model where Se and Te atoms occupy separate layers inside GSST. The newly identified compound-layered structures maintaining stability at temperature above 370 K, yield an enlarged bandgap, weakened antibonding character, and more importantly, a moderate refractive index as well as decreased extinction coefficient which align better with the experiment compared to the previously believed model. The present findings not only help bridge the long-standing theory-experiment gap regarding the optical properties of GSST by redefining its atomic structure, but also establish local chemical ordering as a critical materials design principle for high-performance photonics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“atomic simulations”（原子模拟）。；研究对象：Ge₂Sb₂SeₓTe₅₋ₓ (GSST) 合金，一种用于集成光子学的相变材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: GSST合金的热稳定性和低光学损耗并非源于之前认为的纯元素分层结构，而是由一种隐藏的层内化合物结构（SeTe₂或Se₂Te，取决于Se含量）所决定。该结构导致带隙增大、反键特性减弱，并产生更符合实验的折射率和消光系数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：GSST合金的热稳定性和低光学损耗并非源于之前认为的纯元素分层结构，而是由一种隐藏的层内化合物结构（SeTe₂或Se₂Te，取决于Se含量）所决定。该结构导致带隙增大、反键特性减弱，并产生更符合实验的折射率和消光系数。；创新点：推翻了GSST中Se和Te原子占据独立层的“纯元素分层模型”，首次识别出层内化合物结构，并以此解释了长期存在的理论与实验在光学性质上的差异，将局域化学有序性确立为高性能光子学的材料设计原则。
papers.method_zh: 原子模拟（atomic simulations），具体方法摘要未明确说明（如是否使用DFT、分子动力学等）。

papers.title: Tunable Extended Magnetic Non-Fermi Liquid in Graphene Moiré Heterostructures
papers.abstract: Exploring exotic quantum metallic states beyond Landau's Fermi liquid theory remains a central focus in condensed matter physics. Such non-Fermi liquid behavior is mostly observed near quantum criticality, yet growing attention is directed toward extended NFL phases with intrinsic quantum fluctuations rooted in the extended ground state. While these extended NFL states have been previously reported only in a limited set of d- and f-electron systems, realizing a single, highly tunable platform capable of exhibiting multiple resistance exponent values is essential for uncovering the connection between the resistance exponent and the dominant quantum fluctuations coupled to quasiparticles. However, corresponding experimental progress remains elusive. Here, we report the observation of tunable extended non-Fermi liquid behavior in twisted double bilayer graphene encapsulated by aligned hBN layers. This NFL phase spans a broad range of carrier densities and exhibiting a carrier density dependent resistance exponent. Combined with temperature dependent resistance, magnetotransport and differential resistance measurements, these findings support a scenario where strong quantum fluctuations emerge from the interplay between localized and itinerant carriers. Our work establishes a highly tunable platform beyond conventional frameworks to investigate the organizing principles of non-Fermi liquid physics manifested in diverse behaviors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“we report the observation of...”、“temperature dependent resistance, magnetotransport and differential resistance measurements”等实验手段。；研究对象：扭曲双层石墨烯与对齐六方氮化硼（hBN）层构成的莫尔异质结中的非费米液体行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在该异质结中观测到可调谐的扩展非费米液体相，其电阻指数随载流子密度变化，且该相覆盖了较宽的载流子密度范围。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在该异质结中观测到可调谐的扩展非费米液体相，其电阻指数随载流子密度变化，且该相覆盖了较宽的载流子密度范围。；创新点：在单一、高度可调的石墨烯莫尔异质结平台上实现了多种电阻指数值的非费米液体行为，为研究电阻指数与主导量子涨落之间的联系提供了新平台。此前扩展非费米液相仅在有限的d电子和f电子体系中报道过。
papers.method_zh: 通过温度依赖的电阻测量、磁输运测量以及微分电阻测量等实验手段，研究该体系的输运性质。

papers.title: Investigation of the $J_1$-$J_2$ Heisenberg model on the triangular lattice: A study with projected entangled-pair states
papers.abstract: The nature of the quantum spin liquid (QSL) phase in the frustrated $J_1$-$J_2$ Heisenberg model on the triangular lattice remains an open and actively debated problem. In this work, we employ the infinite projected entangled-pair state (PEPS) to systematically investigate the model under different symmetry constraints. Our simulations reveal a direct transition from the $120^\circ$ Néel state to a putative QSL at $J_2/J_1\approx 0.08$, signaled by the collapse of magnetic order. We further show that, through either an appropriate unitary rotation or spontaneous spin long-range order, the stripe antiferromagnetic phase can also be accurately captured within the infinite PEPS framework. A central focus of our study is the role played by the PEPS symmetry in approximating the QSL ground-state sandwiched between the two magnetic phases. We first found that a fully-symmetric topological $\mathbb{Z}_2$ Resonating Valence Bond state, which can be written as a simple PEPS with bond dimension $D=3$, exhibits a reasonably good variational energy. Motivated by this finding, we have further constructed generic $\mathbb{Z}_2$-symmetric PEPS of larger bond dimension (up to $D=7$). We found that, under wavefunction optimization, spinons condense and, simultaneously, topological vison excitations get confined, hence precluding $\mathbb{Z}_2$ topological order. This strongly indicates the gapless (or critical) nature of the QSL phase, which is most naturally consistent with a U(1) Dirac spin liquid scenario.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：projected entangled-pair state (PEPS)、波函数优化、变分能量。；研究对象：三角晶格上 \( J_1 \)-\( J_2 \) 海森堡模型中的量子自旋液体（QSL）相，特别是其基态性质与拓扑序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 \( J_2/J_1 \approx 0.08 \) 处，系统从 \( 120^\circ \) 奈尔态直接进入一个无带隙（或临界）的量子自旋液相，该相最自然地符合 U(1) 狄拉克自旋液体的图像，而非 \( \mathbb{Z}_2 \) 拓扑有序态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 \( J_2/J_1 \approx 0.08 \) 处，系统从 \( 120^\circ \) 奈尔态直接进入一个无带隙（或临界）的量子自旋液相，该相最自然地符合 U(1) 狄拉克自旋液体的图像，而非 \( \mathbb{Z}_2 \) 拓扑有序态。；创新点：通过 PEPS 波函数优化发现，在尝试构造 \( \mathbb{Z}_2 \) 对称的拓扑有序态时，自旋子发生凝聚且拓扑涡旋激发被禁闭，从而排除了 \( \mathbb{Z}_2 \) 拓扑序，有力地支持了该量子自旋液相为无带隙的 U(1) 狄拉克自旋液体。摘要未突出说明与以往 DMRG 或张量网络研究的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用无限投影纠缠对态（infinite PEPS）方法，在对称性约束下进行系统模拟，并构建了具有不同对称性（包括完全对称的 \( \mathbb{Z}_2 \) 共振价键态）和不同键维数（最高至 \( D=7 \)）的 PEPS 波函数，通过波函数优化进行变分计算。

papers.title: Self-consistent field theory of semiflexible nematics: Density-nematic coupling, anisotropic elasticity, and defect core sizes
papers.abstract: The linear response of wormlike chains in the nematic phase is studied by self-consistent field theory. The model Hamiltonian incorporates Maier--Saupe orientational interactions together with an isotropic excluded volume interaction. The latter models implicitly solvent mediated chain interactions, as appropriate for a lyotropic nematic. An effective free energy description for uniform nematic states is constructed in terms of the chain segment density and uniaxial nematic order parameter, providing a unified framework for density--degree of order coupling, isotropic-nematic coexistence, and the limit of stability of the nematic phase. Our results show that strong density--nematic degree of order coupling can destabilize the nematic state. The location of the instability depends on the ratio of excluded volume and nematic interaction, $u_0/u_2$. In contrast, director distortions couple to density and nematic order variations only at higher order, remaining effectively decoupled in the linear response regime. The Frank elastic constants and the correlation lengths are obtained from a linear response analysis based on the self-consistent field theory free energy. Increasing flexibility strongly suppresses twist and bend elasticity while affecting splay elasticity comparatively weakly, leading to a crossover from bend-dominated to splay-dominated elasticity. The correlation lengths and Frank elastic anisotropy obtained from the linear response analysis explain well director profiles around a +1/2 disclination core, including the core size. The latter is proportional to the equilibrium correlation length, in agreement with Landau--de Gennes scaling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：self-consistent field theory（自洽场理论）、linear response analysis（线性响应分析）、effective free energy（有效自由能）。；研究对象：半柔性高分子链在向列相中的线性响应行为，具体涉及密度-向列序耦合、各向异性弹性以及缺陷核心尺寸。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 密度-向列序的强耦合会破坏向列相的稳定性，其失稳位置取决于排除体积与向列相互作用的比值 \(u_0/u_2\)；增加链柔性会显著抑制扭曲和弯曲弹性，而对展曲弹性影响较弱，导致弹性从弯曲主导转变为展曲主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：密度-向列序的强耦合会破坏向列相的稳定性，其失稳位置取决于排除体积与向列相互作用的比值 \(u_0/u_2\)；增加链柔性会显著抑制扭曲和弯曲弹性，而对展曲弹性影响较弱，导致弹性从弯曲主导转变为展曲主导。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用自洽场理论（SCFT），模型哈密顿量包含Maier-Saupe取向相互作用和各向同性排除体积相互作用（模拟溶剂介导的链间相互作用）。通过构建均匀向列态的有效自由能描述，并进行线性响应分析，得到Frank弹性常数和关联长度。

papers.title: The competition between low-temperature kinks and magnons at the vicinity of the deconfinement transition point in 1D easy-axis XXZ ferromagnet
papers.abstract: Studying the ordered phases and quantum supercritical low-temperature regime at the vicinity of the deconfinement transition point in 1D easy-axis XXZ ferromagnet, we suggest their interpretations according to the corresponding dominant lowest-energy excitations. We show, that the two ordered phases are governed by magnons, while the quantum supercritical regime is governed by kinks. Within this framework the Ising model is treated in detail.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“suggest their interpretations”“treated in detail”等理论分析表述，未提及实验或计算模拟方法。；研究对象：一维易轴XXZ铁磁体在退禁闭相变点附近的低温有序相与量子超临界区，具体包括磁振子（magnons）与扭结（kinks）的竞争行为，并以伊辛模型为例进行详细处理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在退禁闭相变点附近，两个有序相由磁振子主导，而量子超临界区则由扭结主导。这一框架揭示了不同低温激发类型对相图结构的决定性作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在退禁闭相变点附近，两个有序相由磁振子主导，而量子超临界区则由扭结主导。这一框架揭示了不同低温激发类型对相图结构的决定性作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于对最低能量激发（磁振子与扭结）的识别与主导性判断，并对伊辛模型进行详细解析处理。

papers.title: Deep Indentation of Hyperelastic Materials Reveals Tip Independent Parabolic Force Depth Response via Strain Energy Delocalization
papers.abstract: Indentation is a practical route for probing soft materials when standard tests are difficult, destructive, or cannot be performed in situ. Conventional indentation is usually interpreted in the shallow-depth regime, where the indentation depth D is small compared with the indenter radius R. In this limit, the response is controlled by local contact geometry and primarily identifies the small-strain Young's modulus E. Here, we show that at deep indentation, D >> R, flat and spherical indenters converge to the same parabolic force-depth law, F = beta E D^2. The coefficient beta is independent of indenter radius and tip shape, only mildly affected by interfacial friction, and controlled by the hyperelastic strain-stiffening response. Finite-element simulations show that this scaling arises from strain-energy delocalization: the region where SED/mu > 0.01 expands into a spheroidal domain whose size scales with D. The activated volume therefore scales as D^3, giving stored elastic energy U ~ E D^3 and force F = dU/dD ~ E D^2. Far from contact, the strain-energy-density fields collapse toward the Boussinesq far-field solution when distances are normalized by a = sqrt(F/E), which scales as D in the deep-indentation regime. These results provide a mechanistic basis for tip-shape independence and link beta to the Ogden strain-stiffening parameter alpha, enabling hyperelastic parameter extraction from deep-indentation data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Finite-element simulations”（有限元模拟）以及理论推导（如力-深度关系、能量标度分析）。；研究对象：超弹性材料（hyperelastic materials）在深度压痕（deep indentation）下的力学响应，具体关注压痕深度远大于压头半径（D >> R）时的力-深度关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在深度压痕条件下，平头和球形压头均遵循相同的抛物线力-深度定律 F = β E D²，其中系数β与压头半径和尖端形状无关，仅受界面摩擦轻微影响，并由超弹性材料的应变硬化响应控制。该标度律源于应变能离域（strain-energy delocalization）：激活体积随D³标度，导致存储弹性能U ~ E D³，从而力F ~ E D²。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在深度压痕条件下，平头和球形压头均遵循相同的抛物线力-深度定律 F = β E D²，其中系数β与压头半径和尖端形状无关，仅受界面摩擦轻微影响，并由超弹性材料的应变硬化响应控制。该标度律源于应变能离域（strain-energy delocalization）：激活体积随D³标度，导致存储弹性能U ~ E D³，从而力F ~ E D²。；创新点：揭示了深度压痕下力-深度响应的尖端形状无关性（tip-shape independence），并建立了系数β与Ogden应变硬化参数α之间的定量联系，从而为从深度压痕数据中提取超弹性参数提供了机制基础。摘要未突出说明与浅压痕传统理论的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 有限元模拟（Finite-element simulations），结合理论标度分析（scaling analysis）和Boussinesq远场解的比较。具体涉及Ogden超弹性本构模型（Ogden strain-stiffening parameter α）的参数提取。

papers.title: Computed materials proposals depart from the structural memory of experimental discovery
papers.abstract: Generative AI and high-throughput DFT pipelines propose millions of inorganic crystal structures, but lack a calibrated reference frame against experimentally realized chemistry. Here we embed 167,500 Inorganic Crystal Structure Database entries in a continuous structural-similarity space, partition it into graph communities, and replay them in time. Experimental discovery shows strong structural memory: 82.9% of new formulas enter pre-existing communities; new-community formation falls from 40.2% (1930s) to 2.6% (2010s). The communities are chemically meaningful, positively identifying nine textbook field-defining renaissances, including cuprates, colossal-magnetoresistance manganites, MAX phases, and Li-ion battery cathodes. Projecting GNoME, MatterGen-public, Materials Project, JARVIS-DFT, and Alexandria-PBE into frozen historical maps yields a cutoff-robust ordering: held-out ICSD > MatterGen > {GNoME ~ MP-theoretical} > JARVIS > Alexandria. Structural departure from experimental basins is not specific to generative AI but general across the tested computed sets. Combining structural proximity with reduced-formula precedent defines a historical synthesizability prior for triaging computed materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：Generative AI, high-throughput DFT pipelines, structural-similarity space, graph communities, projection）；研究对象：无机晶体结构数据库（ICSD）中167,500个实验已知的晶体结构，以及多个计算材料数据库（GNoME, MatterGen-public, Materials Project, JARVIS-DFT, Alexandria-PBE）提出的理论结构。核心物理现象是材料发现的历史模式与计算材料提案之间的结构性偏差。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验材料发现具有强烈的“结构记忆”效应，即绝大多数新发现的化学式都落入已有的结构相似性社区中，且新社区的形成率随时间急剧下降。相比之下，所有被测试的计算材料数据库（包括生成式AI和DFT高通量筛选）都系统性地偏离了实验发现的结构空间，这种偏离并非生成式AI所独有。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验材料发现具有强烈的“结构记忆”效应，即绝大多数新发现的化学式都落入已有的结构相似性社区中，且新社区的形成率随时间急剧下降。相比之下，所有被测试的计算材料数据库（包括生成式AI和DFT高通量筛选）都系统性地偏离了实验发现的结构空间，这种偏离并非生成式AI所独有。；创新点：提出了一个基于历史实验发现的结构记忆和化学先例的“历史可合成性先验”（historical synthesizability prior），用于对计算材料进行筛选和排序。该工作首次系统性地量化了多种计算材料提案（包括生成式AI和传统DFT）与实验发现的结构空间之间的系统性偏离。
papers.method_zh: 1. 将ICSD中的167,500个晶体结构嵌入到一个连续的“结构相似性空间”中。2. 利用图论方法（graph communities）对该空间进行分区，识别出结构社区。3. 按时间顺序回放（replay）这些社区，分析实验发现的历史模式。4. 将GNoME、MatterGen-public、Materials Project、JARVIS-DFT和Alexandria-PBE等计算材料数据库投影到基于ICSD构建的“冻结历史地图”上，定量比较它们与实验结构空间的偏离程度。

papers.title: Prebiotic Chemistry Assemblies of L-Cysteine on Defect-Free Pyrite Terraces
papers.abstract: Wächtershäuser's theory proposes iron-sulfur minerals as key platforms for molecular synthesis and supramolecular organization in prebiotic environments. However, defects have been traditionally considered at the center of such assemblies, thereby underestimating the contributions of regular and pristine interfaces. Here, we combine scanning tunneling microscopy and spectroscopy (STM/STS) with density functional theory (DFT) to investigate the fundamental prebiotic chemistry system of L-Cysteine (L-Cys) on defectless FeS$_2$(100) terraces. To do so, we first achieved atomically ordered, defect-free terraces that act as support of two distinct supramolecular phases of L-Cys: one compact, highly ordered supramolecular network and another less packed, labile supramolecular network. We unveil trimer-based intermolecular interactions to be at the origin of these pattern formations. These results demonstrate that L-Cys self-assemblies can be hosted on flawless FeS$_2$ terraces due to the cooperative interplay between substrate electronic structure and intermolecular interactions, without the participation of dominant defects. Therefore, the autocatalytic activity of pyrite could have triggered the on-surface polymerization process of these non-static self-assembled structures under primordial conditions, thereby endorsing Wächtershäuser's postulates on the origin of life.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。关键词：scanning tunneling microscopy and spectroscopy (STM/STS)、density functional theory (DFT)。；研究对象：L-半胱氨酸（L-Cysteine）在无缺陷黄铁矿（FeS₂(100)）平台上的自组装体系，属于前生命化学中的有机-无机界面组装现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无缺陷的FeS₂(100)平台上，L-半胱氨酸可形成两种不同的超分子相（致密有序网络和松散不稳定网络），其形成源于三聚体分子间相互作用，而非传统认为的缺陷位点主导。这表明黄铁矿的催化活性足以在无缺陷表面上驱动前生命化学聚合过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无缺陷的FeS₂(100)平台上，L-半胱氨酸可形成两种不同的超分子相（致密有序网络和松散不稳定网络），其形成源于三聚体分子间相互作用，而非传统认为的缺陷位点主导。这表明黄铁矿的催化活性足以在无缺陷表面上驱动前生命化学聚合过程。；创新点：传统观点认为缺陷是前生命化学组装的核心，本文首次证明在原子级平整、无缺陷的黄铁矿平台上也能实现L-半胱氨酸的自组装，强调了规则界面的贡献，从而支持并扩展了Wächtershäuser关于铁硫矿物在生命起源中作用的假说。
papers.method_zh: 扫描隧道显微镜/扫描隧道谱（STM/STS）结合密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。

papers.title: Role of polarity in the growth of cubic GaN within silicon inverted pyramids
papers.abstract: A lack of spontaneous internal polarization makes cubic GaN (c-GaN) a well-suited material for emerging micro-LED-based short-range communication, where c-GaN promises increased speed over conventional hexagonal GaN (h-GaN). Although c-GaN is metastable, there are well-established methods for growing it in Si V- or U-grooves; the logical step is to truncate these grooves to wedges or inverted pyramids for small devices. There are limited reports of GaN grown in inverted pyramid templates, and the results are contradictory. To study this process, we perform selective area growth of GaN using organometallic vapor phase epitaxy (OMVPE) on Si inverted pyramidal templates and analyze our samples by cross-sectional TEM. We find that polarity is critical to understanding the growth of c-GaN in this four-fold geometry, in contrast to the growth in long grooves. This effect fits within the broader set of challenges of polar-on-nonpolar heteroepitaxy; the c-GaN inside the four-fold symmetric template has its symmetry reduced by polarity to be two-fold. In typical growth conditions -- where the underlying h-GaN polarity is uniform -- we find this implies that two h-GaN to c-GaN grain boundaries will have a polarity inversion. We observe two different structures at these inverting boundaries, including a previously unreported inversion domain boundary along the basal plane of the undoped h-GaN. These findings show that for small devices -- such as micro-LEDs -- the polarity-inverting interfaces must be prevented, for example by suppressing the growth of h-GaN on two facets of the template or by locally controlling the h-GaN polarity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“perform selective area growth of GaN using organometallic vapor phase epitaxy (OMVPE)”和“analyze our samples by cross-sectional TEM”，属于实验手段。；研究对象：立方相氮化镓（c-GaN）在硅倒金字塔模板中的选择性区域生长，以及极性（polarity）在该生长过程中的作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在四重对称的倒金字塔模板中，极性会降低c-GaN的对称性至二重，导致两个h-GaN到c-GaN的晶界处出现极性反转，并观察到一种此前未报道的沿未掺杂h-GaN基面的反转畴界。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在四重对称的倒金字塔模板中，极性会降低c-GaN的对称性至二重，导致两个h-GaN到c-GaN的晶界处出现极性反转，并观察到一种此前未报道的沿未掺杂h-GaN基面的反转畴界。；创新点：揭示了在四重对称的倒金字塔几何结构中，极性对c-GaN生长的关键作用，这与在长沟槽中的生长行为不同；并首次报道了一种沿未掺杂h-GaN基面的反转畴界结构。
papers.method_zh: 采用有机金属气相外延（OMVPE）在硅倒金字塔模板上进行选择性区域生长，并通过横截面透射电子显微镜（cross-sectional TEM）对样品进行分析。

papers.title: An Interaction Language Model: Mechanism Discovery from Statistical Patterns of Physical Interactions
papers.abstract: Interactions among building blocks in physical, chemical, and biological systems follow structured patterns interpretable as a learnable language: just as language models learn which words tend to follow others, one can learn which physical phenomena follow others and under what conditions. We introduce an Interaction Language Model (ILM): a framework that treats interaction as a statistically structured, learnable language for design-to-function reasoning across fields. By learning statistical dependencies and ordering among components, ILMs infer interaction pathways, identify missing steps, and predict the next likely interaction. We demonstrate it through two complementary components, PhenoLink and PhenoSeq, applied to molecular diffusion, a ubiquitous mechanism for energy and particle transport. PhenoLink is a directed graph of interactions among diffusion-based events extracted from publications, where each edge aggregates paragraph-level evidence and carries a transition probability interpreted as an information cost. PhenoSeq complements this with a sequence model that proposes missing mechanistic steps under endpoint constraints. Together they form a generate-then-verify pipeline returning every explanation with a reproducible, per-step, corpus-grounded audit trail. Across four held-out suites of 172 queries, the pipeline matches a zero-shot Claude Opus 4.7 baseline on in-distribution accuracy, yet unlike the baseline, which fabricates a chain for every impossible query, it refuses up to 93.5% of transitions in corpus evidence by construction. ILM thus delivers what zero-shot generation structurally cannot: deterministic refusal of evidence-absent queries and auditable, per-step support. The framework extends to natural and engineered systems where function emerges from sequential and conditional interactions among molecules, cells, devices, or other components.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论框架+计算模型+文献数据挖掘）。判断依据：提出了一个名为ILM的统计学习框架，包含PhenoLink（文献数据构建的有向图）和PhenoSeq（序列模型），并应用于分子扩散现象的分析，属于理论建模与数据驱动计算的结合。；研究对象：分子扩散现象（一种能量和粒子输运的普遍机制），以及更广泛的由分子、细胞、器件等组分之间顺序和条件相互作用产生功能的自然与工程系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种“交互语言模型”（ILM），能够从物理交互的统计模式中学习并推断交互路径、识别缺失步骤、预测下一步交互，并实现了对无证据查询的确定性拒绝（最高达93.5%的转换被拒绝），而零样本生成模型无法做到这一点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种“交互语言模型”（ILM），能够从物理交互的统计模式中学习并推断交互路径、识别缺失步骤、预测下一步交互，并实现了对无证据查询的确定性拒绝（最高达93.5%的转换被拒绝），而零样本生成模型无法做到这一点。；创新点：将物理交互视为一种可学习的统计语言，并构建了能够进行确定性拒绝（而非编造）和可审计逐步支持的框架，克服了零样本生成模型在缺乏证据时编造链条的根本缺陷。摘要未突出说明与已有具体语言模型或图模型在技术细节上的对比。
papers.method_zh: 1. PhenoLink：从已发表文献中提取基于扩散的事件交互，构建有向图，每条边聚合段落级证据并带有转移概率（解释为信息成本）。2. PhenoSeq：一种序列模型，在端点约束下提出缺失的机制步骤。两者结合形成“生成-验证”流水线，每一步提供可复现的、基于语料库的审计轨迹。

papers.title: Topological random alloy
papers.abstract: Topological phases of matter are often realized in crystalline materials. To extend their understanding beyond perfect stoichiometry, we introduce a minimal model of a topological random binary alloy and show that the system realizes an exotic form of impurity-band engineering. We reveal that, in contrast to Wannier charge centers pinned by impurities in conventional semiconductors, doping a proximate quantum anomalous Hall insulator results in dopant-centric chiral current loops. The nature of such current loops is intrinsically tied to the properties of both the host and the dopant. We demonstrate that, even at dilute dopant density, these current loops can form topological domains in an otherwise trivial host and trigger a topological phase transition. On the other hand, doping a topological host having chirality opposite to that of the dopants can unexpectedly stabilize a metallic phase in which bulk transport is mediated by inter-domain edge modes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：introduce a minimal model、show、reveal、demonstrate（理论建模与数值分析）。；研究对象：拓扑随机二元合金（topological random binary alloy），具体为掺杂近邻量子反常霍尔绝缘体（proximate quantum anomalous Hall insulator）或拓扑宿主材料形成的无序体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在拓扑随机合金中，掺杂剂会形成手性电流环（chiral current loops），这些电流环可在原本平庸的宿主中形成拓扑畴并触发拓扑相变；若宿主与掺杂剂手性相反，则可能稳定一种由畴间边缘模式介导体态输运的金属相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在拓扑随机合金中，掺杂剂会形成手性电流环（chiral current loops），这些电流环可在原本平庸的宿主中形成拓扑畴并触发拓扑相变；若宿主与掺杂剂手性相反，则可能稳定一种由畴间边缘模式介导体态输运的金属相。；创新点：首次提出拓扑随机合金的概念，并揭示掺杂剂在拓扑绝缘体宿主中形成手性电流环而非传统杂质束缚态，实现了杂质带工程与拓扑相变的耦合。
papers.method_zh: 构建最小模型（minimal model）描述拓扑随机二元合金，通过分析杂质带工程（impurity-band engineering）和Wannier电荷中心行为，对比传统半导体中杂质钉扎效应，揭示电流环的拓扑性质。

papers.title: Rheological and Photoelastic Response of Hydrated Soft Granular Particles
papers.abstract: Photoelasticity is a qualitative and quantitative optical technique to image internal stress distributions in transparent materials. In the past few decades, discrete photoelastic particles have been used as a proxy for dry granular materials in both static, quasistatic, and dynamic analogue experiments. The technique allows the visualization of force chains, determination of the location and magnitude of contact forces, and outputs a stress tensor for each particle with shear and normal stress components. To date, little to no work has investigated photoelastic suspensions, where photoelastic granular particles are immersed in a fluid medium, despite its relevance in industrial and natural applications. The introduction of a fluid phase yields additional considerations in the rheological and photoelastic behavior of our proxy particles. In this manuscript, we summarize the state-of-the-art in resolving forces in immersed photoelastic granular materials. We introduce characterization techniques to probe changes in rheological and optical properties of hydrated photoelastic particles, and we report considerations for use of photoelastic particles in immersion-based experiments. We intend for this work to provide the leading framework to study the hydrodynamic interactions in 2D systems of photoelastic particles immersed in a fluid medium.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与综述结合）。关键词：summarize the state-of-the-art、introduce characterization techniques、report considerations。；研究对象：水合软颗粒（hydrated soft granular particles）在流体介质中的流变学与光弹性响应，具体为浸没在流体中的光弹性颗粒体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，主要旨在总结当前浸没式光弹性颗粒体系中力分辨的技术现状，并提出表征水合光弹性颗粒流变与光学性质变化的方法及使用注意事项。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，主要旨在总结当前浸没式光弹性颗粒体系中力分辨的技术现状，并提出表征水合光弹性颗粒流变与光学性质变化的方法及使用注意事项。；创新点：首次系统研究浸没在流体中的光弹性颗粒悬浮液（photoelastic suspensions）的流变与光弹性行为，填补了此前仅针对干颗粒（dry granular materials）研究而缺乏对流体介质中光弹性颗粒体系研究的空白。
papers.method_zh: 光弹性成像技术（photoelasticity），用于可视化力链、确定接触力位置与大小、输出每个颗粒的应力张量（含剪切与正应力分量）；同时引入表征水合光弹性颗粒流变与光学性质变化的表征技术。

papers.title: Family of (NxH)-polytypes with La2WO6-related stoichiometry
papers.abstract: Structure and chemical composition of non-stoichiometric $\mathrm{(N \times H)}$-polytypes, $\mathrm{N} \in \{3,\,4,\,5,\,6,\,7\}$, belonging to the family of La2WO6-related tungstates, are presented and the basic rules behind their construction are formulated. The polytypes are validated from the point of view of the internal energy per atom against all the competing La-O-W compounds by means of the ternary convex hull computed by DFT. According to DFT, the ground state of the La2WO6 family surprisingly turned out to be the as-yet hypothetical tungstate La2WO6.oP36, isostructural with the known compound Gd2WO6, closely related to the basic building H-block of the polytypes. One more candidate for an experimentally accessible low-energy structure, La2WO6.mC72, derived from the already observed Sm2MoO6, has been identified to lie only $ΔE \approx 5\:\mathrm{meV/at.} \cong 60\:\mathrm{K}$ above the convex envelope.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（依据：DFT计算、三元凸包分析、内能比较）；研究对象：La₂WO₆相关非化学计量比(N×H)-多型体家族（N∈{3,4,5,6,7}）的结构与化学组成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: DFT计算表明，La₂WO₆家族的基态是迄今假设的La₂WO₆.oP36结构（与已知Gd₂WO₆同构），而非实验已观测到的多型体；另一个低能候选结构La₂WO₆.mC72（源自Sm₂MoO₆）仅高出凸包约5 meV/atom（≈60 K）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：DFT计算表明，La₂WO₆家族的基态是迄今假设的La₂WO₆.oP36结构（与已知Gd₂WO₆同构），而非实验已观测到的多型体；另一个低能候选结构La₂WO₆.mC72（源自Sm₂MoO₆）仅高出凸包约5 meV/atom（≈60 K）。；创新点：首次系统提出并验证了La₂WO₆相关(N×H)-多型体的构建规则，并发现其基态为尚未实验合成的假想结构。
papers.method_zh: 基于密度泛函理论（DFT）计算三元凸包（ternary convex hull），通过每原子内能评估多型体与所有竞争La-O-W化合物的相对稳定性。

papers.title: Quantum sensing of nanoscale electronic phase segregation
papers.abstract: Doping of transition metal oxides such as CaFe$_3$O$_5$ offers a controlled way to tune the interplay of charge, spin, and lattice degrees of freedom, yet local-probe studies remain difficult because strong correlations and dynamic charge-spin fluctuations obscure fine spectroscopic features in powder samples. Here, we employ quantum magnetometry based on nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in nanodiamonds impressed into an Mn-doped CaFe$_3$O$_5$ powder pellet to probe static and dynamic magnetic fields at the nanoscale across the weak ferromagnetic transition. The splitting and broadening of the optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR) spectra exhibit an order-parameter-like increase by ~ 15 MHz upon cooling below the critical temperature, T$_{\rm c}$. Concomitantly, the spin-lattice relaxation rate, 1/T$_1$, exhibits a pronounced, divergence-like enhancement at T$_{\rm c}$, increasing by about one order of magnitude from its high-temperature value. Moreover, detailed lineshape fits of ODMR spectra together with the stretched-exponential NV magnetization recovery curves corroborate the proposed electronic phase segregation in charge-ordered and charge-averaged phases at the nanometric scales. The presented study demonstrates the viability of using nanodiamonds as a platform for nanoscale magnetic probing of strongly correlated matter, including phenomena such as electronic phase separation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：quantum magnetometry、NV centers、ODMR、spin-lattice relaxation。；研究对象：Mn掺杂的CaFe₃O₅粉末样品中的纳米尺度电子相分离现象，以及弱铁磁相变附近的静态与动态磁场。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在弱铁磁转变温度以下，ODMR谱线分裂与展宽呈现类序参量行为（约15 MHz），同时自旋-晶格弛豫率1/T₁在T_c处出现发散式增强（约一个数量级），证实了纳米尺度上电荷有序相与电荷平均相的电子相分离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在弱铁磁转变温度以下，ODMR谱线分裂与展宽呈现类序参量行为（约15 MHz），同时自旋-晶格弛豫率1/T₁在T_c处出现发散式增强（约一个数量级），证实了纳米尺度上电荷有序相与电荷平均相的电子相分离。；创新点：首次利用嵌入粉末样品的纳米金刚石作为平台，实现对强关联材料中纳米尺度电子相分离的静态与动态磁学探测，展示了NV量子磁力测量在粉末样品中研究电子相分离等复杂现象的可行性。
papers.method_zh: 基于纳米金刚石中氮-空位（NV）中心的量子磁力测量技术，将纳米金刚石压入Mn掺杂CaFe₃O₅粉末压片中，通过光探测磁共振（ODMR）谱和自旋-晶格弛豫率（1/T₁）测量，结合ODMR线形拟合与拉伸指数NV磁化恢复曲线分析。

papers.title: Bridging electrode preparation and electrocatalyst performance with physics-based causal AI
papers.abstract: State-of-the-art artificial intelligence (AI) and Machine-Learning (ML) tools have not yet enabled rapid design of next-generation materials. Detailed physical understanding of how material properties affect device performance is required to advance materials development. For example, optimization of ink parameters for electrocatalysts has no known physical mathematical model and thus insights are difficult to translate from material studies to device studies. Herein, we demonstrate how to use the emerging AI tool, physics-based structural causal models (SCMs), to extract quantitative causative insights from complex heterogeneous electrochemical systems with small (n < 10), but multi-modal datasets (modes > 10). Our SCM quantitatively separates the role that varying the support-to-catalyst ratios and total material loadings plays on catalytic performance. The proof of concept model developed in this work enables root-cause-analysis on the cyclic voltammograms of manganese-antimony oxide oxygen reduction electrocatalysts on Vulcan carbon supports tested in alkaline media using a rotating disc electrode device configuration. Our preliminary causal analyses quantitatively disentangle how the catalyst performance is affected by the number of active sites versus the thickness of the electrode. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of physics-based SCMs applied to electrochemical materials and their performance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与AI建模结合）。判断依据：摘要提及“heterogeneous electrochemical systems”“cyclic voltammograms”“rotating disc electrode device configuration”等实验表征，同时使用“physics-based structural causal models (SCMs)”进行因果分析。；研究对象：锰锑氧化物（manganese-antimony oxide）氧还原电催化剂，负载于Vulcan碳载体上，在碱性介质中采用旋转圆盘电极装置测试。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过物理因果模型（SCM）定量分离了载体与催化剂比例以及总材料负载量对催化性能的影响，并初步厘清了活性位点数量与电极厚度对性能的不同作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过物理因果模型（SCM）定量分离了载体与催化剂比例以及总材料负载量对催化性能的影响，并初步厘清了活性位点数量与电极厚度对性能的不同作用。；创新点：首次将基于物理的结构因果模型（SCMs）应用于电化学材料体系及其性能分析，实现了从复杂异质电化学系统中提取定量因果洞察。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于物理的结构因果模型（physics-based structural causal models, SCMs），结合小样本（n < 10）但多模态（模态数 > 10）的实验数据集，对循环伏安曲线进行根因分析。

papers.title: Thermal transport and low-temperature specific heat in 4Hb-TaS$_2$
papers.abstract: We investigate the low-energy excitation spectrum of the van der Waals heterostructure superconductor 4Hb-TaS$_2$ using ultra-low-temperature specific-heat and thermal-conductivity measurements with magnetic fields applied parallel and perpendicular to the crystallographic $c$ axis. The specific heat is broadly consistent with a nodeless superconducting gap, but retains a finite residual linear contribution, indicating a small residual low-energy density of states in the superconducting state. In addition, a pronounced upturn appears below approximately 0.3K. Its weak magnetic-field dependence, together with the absence of a corresponding feature in thermal transport, supports an interpretation in terms of localized degrees of freedom, most likely a nuclear Schottky contribution. In contrast to the finite residual thermodynamic density of states, the thermal conductivity extrapolates to a vanishing zero-field electronic linear term within experimental uncertainty for both field orientations. Thus, the residual low-energy states do not form a detectable itinerant heat-conduction channel. In finite magnetic field, the electronic heat transport grows rapidly. For out-of-plane fields, this response is broadly consistent with previous thermal-conductivity measurements and with the behavior commonly associated with multigap nodeless superconductivity. The even steeper increase observed for in-plane fields suggests that the field-induced quasiparticle response of 4Hb-TaS$_2$ is more complicated than the standard multigap picture alone.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：ultra-low-temperature specific-heat and thermal-conductivity measurements（超低温比热和热导率测量）。；研究对象：范德瓦尔斯异质结超导体4Hb-TaS₂，具体研究其低能激发谱及超导态下的热输运和热力学性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 4Hb-TaS₂的超导能隙基本无节点，但存在少量残余低能态密度；这些残余态不形成可探测的传导热通道，而热导率在零场下趋于零，表明其局域化特征。面内磁场下热导率增长比标准多能隙无节点超导图像更陡，暗示更复杂的场致准粒子响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：4Hb-TaS₂的超导能隙基本无节点，但存在少量残余低能态密度；这些残余态不形成可探测的传导热通道，而热导率在零场下趋于零，表明其局域化特征。面内磁场下热导率增长比标准多能隙无节点超导图像更陡，暗示更复杂的场致准粒子响应。；创新点：通过同时测量比热和热导率，区分了残余低能态的热力学信号与热输运信号，揭示了残余态局域化而非巡游的特征，并发现面内磁场下热导率异常增长超出标准多能隙超导模型预期。
papers.method_zh: 超低温比热测量和热导率测量，磁场分别平行和垂直于晶格c轴方向施加。

papers.title: Adaptive fine-tuning of foundation models for crystal structure prediction: Discovery of high-pressure phases in the CaFeNi system
papers.abstract: The prediction of crystal structures is a key challenge in chemistry and materials science, but evolutionary crystal structure prediction (CSP) remains computationally expensive because it relies on repeated \textit{ab initio} relaxations and energy ranking. Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) can accelerate CSP, yet their use is limited by the need for large training sets and by the difficulty of choosing which candidate structures should be labeled by density functional theory (DFT). Here we introduce a self-consistent, foundation-model-assisted CSP workflow that combines evolutionary search with adaptive data selection and fine-tuning. Starting from a pretrained MLIP, the algorithm rapidly explores configuration space while iteratively selecting compact, representative, and physically relevant subsets of structures for DFT labeling, thereby reducing redundant calculations and improving a system-specific potential. We apply the method to the chemically complex Ca--Fe--Ni ternary system. The workflow reproduces the known low-pressure convex hull and enables efficient high-pressure exploration. It predicts a previously unreported compound, Ca$_6$FeNi, which becomes thermodynamically stable above 100~GPa. These results show that foundation-model-based, data-efficient CSP can greatly reduce computational cost while preserving accuracy and enabling the discovery of new materials in complex multicomponent systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs)、density functional theory (DFT)、evolutionary crystal structure prediction (CSP)。；研究对象：Ca-Fe-Ni三元体系在高压下的晶体结构，特别是预测新化合物Ca₆FeNi在100 GPa以上的热力学稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于预训练基础模型的自适应微调工作流，成功预测了Ca-Fe-Ni体系中一个此前未被报道的化合物Ca₆FeNi，该化合物在100 GPa以上变得热力学稳定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于预训练基础模型的自适应微调工作流，成功预测了Ca-Fe-Ni体系中一个此前未被报道的化合物Ca₆FeNi，该化合物在100 GPa以上变得热力学稳定。；创新点：引入了一种自洽的、基于基础模型辅助的CSP工作流，通过自适应数据选择和微调大幅减少冗余计算，在保持精度的同时显著降低计算成本，并成功应用于复杂多组分体系（Ca-Fe-Ni）的高压新相发现。
papers.method_zh: 结合进化晶体结构预测（CSP）与自适应数据选择及微调策略。从预训练的机器学习原子间势（MLIP）出发，通过迭代选择紧凑、具代表性且物理相关的结构子集进行DFT标记，从而优化系统特定的势函数，实现高效的高压相探索。

papers.title: Atomic-Scale Characterization of Oxide Interfaces and Superlattices Using Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy
papers.abstract: Scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) is a cornerstone of our understanding of oxide interfaces and superlattices. No other technique provides the same level of insight into structure, chemistry, composition, and dynamics across as wide a variety of material systems. STEM imaging and diffraction, coupled with electron energy loss (EELS) and energy-dispersive X-ray (EDS) spectroscopies, offer unparalleled, high-resolution analysis of structure--property relationships. In this chapter we highlight investigations into key phenomena, including interfacial conductivity in oxide superlattices, charge screening effects in magnetoelectric heterostructures, interface engineering in iron oxides, and the complex physics governing atomic-scale chemical mapping. We also discuss emerging plasma preparation techniques and artificial intelligence-guided approaches to both ex situ and in situ microscopy. These studies illustrate how unique insights from STEM characterization can be integrated with other techniques and theory calculations to develop more predictive models for the behavior of functional oxides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM)、imaging and diffraction、EELS、EDS、plasma preparation techniques、in situ microscopy）；研究对象：氧化物界面与超晶格（oxide interfaces and superlattices），具体包括界面导电性、磁电异质结中的电荷屏蔽效应、氧化铁中的界面工程，以及原子尺度化学成像。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: STEM结合EELS和EDS能够对氧化物界面和超晶格的结构、化学、组分及动力学提供其他技术无法比拟的高分辨率分析，从而揭示结构-性能关系，并有助于发展功能氧化物的预测模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：STEM结合EELS和EDS能够对氧化物界面和超晶格的结构、化学、组分及动力学提供其他技术无法比拟的高分辨率分析，从而揭示结构-性能关系，并有助于发展功能氧化物的预测模型。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）成像与衍射，电子能量损失谱（EELS），能量色散X射线谱（EDS），以及新兴的等离子体样品制备技术和人工智能辅助的原位/非原位显微方法。

papers.title: Carbon encapsulation of levitated Au nanoparticles
papers.abstract: We investigate the formation of a barrier to evaporation that develops when levitated nanoscale Au nanoparticles are exposed to pulses of 532 nm laser radiation in a high vacuum (pressure $p=10^{-8}-10^{-7}$ Torr) environment. Our data are derived from precision measurements of the charge to mass ratio ($Q/M$) of $\sim$200 nm diameter Au particles confined in a quadrupole ion trap. We characterize the development of the barrier over time as the particle is repeatedly heated with laser pulses and determine the impact of variations of the interval between pulses and of exposure to several gases added to the vacuum chamber. We observe a slow increase in the mass of particles upon prolonged exposure to the vacuum, which we attribute to the growth of a barrier layer. For particles that have acquired a barrier during exposure to CO, we observe a rapid decrease in their mass upon subsequent exposure to O$_2$. These findings are consistent with the growth and subsequent oxidation of a graphene layer on the Au that forms the barrier to evaporation. However, we have not found that the rate of formation of the barrier depends on the pressure of carbon-containing gases (CO, C$_2$H$_4$, CO$_2$) we have added to the chamber. We hypothesize that a rare surface state on the solid Au particle catalyzes the reaction that introduces C to the particle. Repeated laser pulse heating is necessary--either to enable diffusion away from this state or to create fresh states that allow continued C uptake--to facilitate the growth of the surface graphene layer.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：measurements、charge to mass ratio、quadrupole ion trap、laser pulses。；研究对象：悬浮在真空中的纳米金颗粒（~200 nm直径）在激光脉冲照射下形成的蒸发屏障，以及该屏障与碳包覆层（石墨烯层）生长和氧化的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在反复激光脉冲加热下，悬浮金纳米颗粒表面会缓慢生长一层碳基屏障（推测为石墨烯层），该屏障可抑制蒸发；暴露于CO后形成的屏障在后续暴露于O₂时会迅速消失（氧化），但屏障形成速率与碳源气体（CO、C₂H₄、CO₂）的分压无关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在反复激光脉冲加热下，悬浮金纳米颗粒表面会缓慢生长一层碳基屏障（推测为石墨烯层），该屏障可抑制蒸发；暴露于CO后形成的屏障在后续暴露于O₂时会迅速消失（氧化），但屏障形成速率与碳源气体（CO、C₂H₄、CO₂）的分压无关。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用四极离子阱捕获~200 nm直径的金纳米颗粒，在高真空（10⁻⁸–10⁻⁷ Torr）环境中施加532 nm激光脉冲加热，通过精确测量颗粒的荷质比（Q/M）随时间的变化来表征屏障的形成与演化；通过改变脉冲间隔和引入不同气体（CO、C₂H₄、CO₂、O₂）研究其影响。

papers.title: Experimental Realization of Synthetic Magnonic Lattice via Floquet Engineering
papers.abstract: Magnonic systems, which exploit spin-wave excitations in magnetic materials, offer a promising platform for coherent information processing due to their low dissipation, strong nonlinearities, and intrinsic nonreciprocity. However, scaling magnonic circuits remains challenging, particularly with low-loss insulators such as yttrium iron garnet (YIG), which are difficult to pattern. Here, we experimentally realize a synthetic dimension in a magnonic system by coupling multimode magnon resonances in the frequency domain using time-periodic Floquet modulation. This approach enables electronically tunable interactions between discrete modes within a single YIG device, forming a reconfigurable mode-space lattice that supports functionalities such as Bloch oscillation. Our results demonstrate that high-dimensional magnonic dynamics can be achieved without increasing device footprint, establishing synthetic dimensions as a scalable and programmable route for integrated magnonic technologies. This advancement positions magnonic systems as promising platforms for engineering emergent phenomena that are inaccessible at equilibrium.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：标题中的“Experimental Realization”（实验实现）及摘要中的“we experimentally realize”。；研究对象：人工合成磁子晶格（synthetic magnonic lattice），具体基于钇铁石榴石（YIG）中的多模磁子共振，通过频域Floquet工程实现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过时间周期性的Floquet调制，在单个YIG器件中实现了频域上的可重构模式空间晶格，并演示了布洛赫振荡等动力学行为，证明无需增加器件尺寸即可实现高维磁子动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过时间周期性的Floquet调制，在单个YIG器件中实现了频域上的可重构模式空间晶格，并演示了布洛赫振荡等动力学行为，证明无需增加器件尺寸即可实现高维磁子动力学。；创新点：首次在磁子系统中实验实现了基于Floquet工程的合成维度，克服了低损耗绝缘体（如YIG）难以图形化的挑战，为可扩展、可编程的集成磁子技术提供了新路径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用时间周期性Floquet调制，耦合YIG器件中多模磁子共振的频域模式，形成可电子调控的合成维度晶格。

papers.title: Magnetic Dipole in a Cuboidal Superconducting Trap
papers.abstract: We derive the exact image-dipole potential of a point dipole inside a closed cuboidal superconducting trap. The construction generalises the parallel-plate result to a geometry that confines every translational degree of freedom, and we prove that the image lattice satisfies the Meissner boundary condition on all six walls. For a centred dipole the orientational energy reduces to a diagonal quadratic form whose three coefficients are Epstein-zeta-type lattice sums. We show that in both the infinite and finite rectangular traps the dipole orientation aligns with the \emph{short} cross-sectional axis over a finite range of aspect ratios. The equilibrium orientation in both cases is described by a phase diagram whose degeneracies we classify. Every prediction is verified against finite-element solutions of the same boundary-value problem, with agreement better than $0.16\%$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：derive（推导）、prove（证明）、image-dipole potential（镜像偶极势）、boundary-value problem（边值问题）。；研究对象：封闭长方体超导陷阱中的磁偶极子，具体研究点偶极子在超导边界条件下的镜像势与取向行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导了封闭长方体超导陷阱中点偶极子的精确镜像偶极势，证明该势在所有六个壁面上满足迈斯纳边界条件；发现偶极子在有限长宽比范围内倾向于沿短截面轴取向，并给出了描述平衡取向的相图。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导了封闭长方体超导陷阱中点偶极子的精确镜像偶极势，证明该势在所有六个壁面上满足迈斯纳边界条件；发现偶极子在有限长宽比范围内倾向于沿短截面轴取向，并给出了描述平衡取向的相图。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：将平行板结果推广至封闭长方体几何，构造镜像晶格；数值验证：使用有限元方法求解同一边值问题，验证理论预测，误差小于0.16%。

papers.title: Critically Enhanced Magnon Transport in Low-dimensional Magnets
papers.abstract: Transport properties of (quasi)particles in condensed matter depend profoundly on the spatial dimension. Motivated by recent advances in growing ultrathin magnetic films and monolayer van der Waals magnets, we present a theory of magnon transport in magnetic films spanning the crossover from bulk to the two-dimensional (2D) limit. We find a magnon conductivity that diverges~\emph{logarithmically} in magnetically soft but stable (quasi)2D magnets with long-range dipolar interactions. This critical enhancement is absent in bulk systems and may explain the unusually large magnon conductivities recently observed in ultrathin yttrium iron garnet films. Our results reveal an intrinsic mechanism for enhanced magnon transport in low dimensions and highlight the potential for engineering high-efficiency magnon conductors in atomically thin magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“present a theory of magnon transport”、“we find”、“our results reveal”。；研究对象：低维磁性薄膜（特别是从三维体材料到二维极限的过渡区域）中的磁振子（magnon）输运现象，具体涉及具有长程偶极相互作用的准二维磁性体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在磁学上软但稳定的准二维磁性材料中，磁振子电导率会随系统尺寸呈对数发散，这种临界增强效应在体材料中不存在，可解释超薄钇铁石榴石薄膜中观测到的异常大磁振子电导率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在磁学上软但稳定的准二维磁性材料中，磁振子电导率会随系统尺寸呈对数发散，这种临界增强效应在体材料中不存在，可解释超薄钇铁石榴石薄膜中观测到的异常大磁振子电导率。；创新点：揭示了低维磁性体系中磁振子输运增强的内在机制（偶极相互作用导致的对数发散），为原子级薄磁性材料中设计高效磁振子导体提供了理论依据。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与分析，基于磁振子输运理论，考虑空间维度从体材料到二维极限的交叉行为，并纳入长程偶极相互作用的影响。

papers.title: Density Wave Ordering with Disordered Ultracold Fermions in Optical Cavities
papers.abstract: We investigate the interplay between cavity-induced density-wave ordering and controllable disorder in a trapped two-dimensional gas of ultracold fermions. The atoms are dispersively coupled to an optical cavity and transversely driven by a pump beam, while an additional speckle beam spatially modulates the atom-light coupling through an AC-Stark shift of the atomic transition. In momentum space, this disorder converts the usual coupling between the cavity mode and a discrete set of density-wave Fourier components into a coupling to a continuum of fermionic density modes, weighted by the spectrum of the speckle pattern. Using linear response theory, we derive the superradiant threshold and show that the disordered interaction renormalizes the effective light-matter coupling, lowering the critical pump strength on average, with the threshold becoming self-averaging for short speckle correlation lengths. We complement this analysis with a numerical mean-field treatment that gives access to the intracavity photon number and to the real-space fermion density across the transition. These results confirm that the disorder shifts the photonic phase boundary and, above threshold, distorts the density-wave crystal by populating Fourier components beyond those selected by the clean cavity geometry. Our findings identify both the emitted cavity light and in situ density images as probes of engineered disorder in fermionic matter coupled to optical cavities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：investigate、linear response theory、numerical mean-field treatment）；研究对象：光学腔中受控无序超冷费米子的密度波有序化现象，具体为二维超冷费米子气体与光学腔及散斑光束耦合的系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 无序通过AC-斯塔克效应将腔模与离散密度波傅里叶分量的耦合转变为与连续费米子密度模的耦合，从而重整化有效光-物质耦合强度，平均上降低超辐射阈值，并使阈值在短散斑关联长度下自平均化；在阈值以上，无序会扭曲密度波晶体，填充除干净腔几何所选择之外的傅里叶分量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：无序通过AC-斯塔克效应将腔模与离散密度波傅里叶分量的耦合转变为与连续费米子密度模的耦合，从而重整化有效光-物质耦合强度，平均上降低超辐射阈值，并使阈值在短散斑关联长度下自平均化；在阈值以上，无序会扭曲密度波晶体，填充除干净腔几何所选择之外的傅里叶分量。；创新点：揭示了可控无序如何通过改变光-物质耦合的动量空间结构来影响腔诱导的密度波有序化，并指出发射腔光与原位密度图像可作为探测工程化无序的探针。
papers.method_zh: 线性响应理论（推导超辐射阈值）、数值平均场方法（计算腔内光子数及实空间费米子密度）。
